# KAS-SANTRI v4.2 — SELURUH STRUKTUR & KODE SUMBER APLIKASI

> Dokumen referensi pengembangan tunggal (*Single-File Full Source Bundle*) yang memuat struktur direktori lengkap beserta **100% kode sumber utuh (tanpa dipotong)** dari aplikasi **Kas-Santri v4.2.0+42**. File ini dibuat ulang otomatis dari working tree Git; aset biner hanya dicantumkan di struktur direktori.

## 1. Ringkasan Spesifikasi Proyek
- **Nama Aplikasi:** Kas-Santri (Sistem Uang Saku, Sambangan, Buku Infak & Brankas Pesantren Offline-First)
- **Versi Aplikasi:** v4.2.0+42 (Rekonsiliasi Akuntansi 100%, Eliminasi N+1 Query, Isolasi Undo Notifier, Modular Repository Architecture, Reconnect SantriDetailScreen, Kepatuhan Play Store & CI/CD 2-Job)
- **Package ID Android (applicationId):** com.pondok.kassantri
- **Konfigurasi Build CI/CD (Bagian 8 PRD):** AGP 9.3.1, Gradle 9.5.0, Kotlin 2.4.20, Compile/Target SDK 36, Min SDK 24, Java 17 (CI Runner JDK 21 Temurin)
- **Total File Proyek:** 132 file (123 file kode sumber & konfigurasi teks + 9 aset biner)

## 4. Seluruh Kode Sumber Aplikasi (Lengkap 100%)

### [1/123] `.flutter-version`

```text
3.50.1
```

### [2/123] `.githooks/pre-commit`

```text
#!/bin/sh
set -e

echo "[Pre-Commit] Menjalankan validasi kualitas kode lokal..."

# 1. Cek format kode Dart
if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "-> Memeriksa format kode (dart format)..."
    dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .
else
    echo "-> Peringatan: Dart SDK belum terdeteksi di lingkungan lokal."
fi

# 2. Cek linter static analysis
if command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "-> Memeriksa static analysis (flutter analyze)..."
    flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos
else
    echo "-> Peringatan: Flutter SDK belum terdeteksi di lingkungan lokal."
fi

echo "[Pre-Commit] Seluruh validasi pre-commit lolos!"
exit 0
```

### [3/123] `.githooks/pre-push`

```text
#!/bin/sh
set -e

echo "[Pre-Push] Menjalankan pengujian regresi lokal sebelum push..."

if command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "-> Menjalankan unit & widget test suite..."
    flutter test
    echo "[Pre-Push] 100% tes lokal lulus! Melanjutkan proses git push..."
else
    echo "-> Peringatan: Flutter SDK tidak ditemukan, push diteruskan ke CI runner."
fi

exit 0
```

### [4/123] `.github/workflows/flutter-apk.yml`

```yaml
name: Kas Santri CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - '**'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - '**'
  workflow_dispatch:

# ==============================================================================
# Pilar 5: Penanganan Secrets & Lingkungan Aman
# Menggunakan mock, stub, dan variabel dummy aman tanpa ketergantungan API nyata
# ==============================================================================
env:
  CI: 'true'
  APP_ENV: 'ci-testing'
  FLUTTER_SUPPRESS_ANALYTICS: 'true'
  OFFLINE_MODE: 'true'
  DUMMY_DATABASE_KEY: 'ci-safe-offline-stub'

jobs:
  # ============================================================================
  # Pilar 4 - Job 1: Quality Gate (Formatting, Static Analysis & Unit Tests)
  # Menggabungkan 3 job serial menjadi 1 job terpadu untuk menghemat ~4-6 menit CI
  # ============================================================================
  quality-gate:
    name: 1. Quality Gate (Format, Analyze & Unit Tests)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # Pilar 1: Patok versi action (@v4)
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Pilar 3: Environment Parity dengan .flutter-version
      - name: Set up Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # Pilar 6: Caching Terukur terikat hashFiles
      - name: Cache Flutter Pub dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.pub-cache
            .dart_tool
          key: pub-cache-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pub-cache-${{ runner.os }}-

      # Pilar 1: Instalasi bersih / strict
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Verify Code Formatting
        run: dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test || echo "::warning::Perbedaan minor dart format terdeteksi"

      - name: Validate Type Safety & Analyzer Rules
        run: flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --fatal-warnings

      - name: Run Test Suite with Coverage
        run: flutter test --coverage

  # ============================================================================
  # Pilar 4 - Job 2: Build Signed Release APK & Play Store App Bundle (.AAB)
  # ============================================================================
  build-release-apk:
    name: 2. Build Signed Release APK & AAB
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [quality-gate]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Pilar 3: Java 21 Temurin (dibutuhkan oleh AGP 9.3.1 / Gradle 9.5)
      - name: Set up Java 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '21'

      # Pilar 3: Flutter Stable
      - name: Set up Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Verify Environment Parity
        run: |
          java -version
          flutter --version

      # Pilar 6: Caching Terukur untuk Pub & Gradle
      - name: Cache Flutter Pub dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.pub-cache
            .dart_tool
          key: pub-cache-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pub-cache-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Cache Gradle wrapper & build caches
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.gradle/caches
            ~/.gradle/wrapper
          key: gradle-cache-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties', 'android/**/*.gradle*') }}
          restore-keys: |
            gradle-cache-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Configure Android Gradle wrapper
        run: |
          if [ ! -f "android/gradlew" ]; then
            echo "Generating Android Gradle wrapper via Flutter..."
            flutter create --platforms=android .
            rm -f android/*.gradle.kts android/app/*.gradle.kts
            rm -rf android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/pondok/kas_santri
          fi
          chmod +x android/gradlew

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Configure Release Keystore (Safe Fallback)
        env:
          KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.KEY_ALIAS }}
          KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEY_PASSWORD }}
          STORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.STORE_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" ] && [ -n "$KEY_ALIAS" ] && [ -n "$KEY_PASSWORD" ] && [ -n "$STORE_PASSWORD" ]; then
            echo "Configuring release signing keystore for AAB & APK..."
            echo "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 --decode > android/app/upload-keystore.jks
            printf "storePassword=%s\nkeyPassword=%s\nkeyAlias=%s\nstoreFile=upload-keystore.jks\n" \
              "$STORE_PASSWORD" "$KEY_PASSWORD" "$KEY_ALIAS" > android/key.properties
          else
            echo "::warning::Keystore secrets (KEYSTORE_BASE64, KEY_ALIAS, KEY_PASSWORD, STORE_PASSWORD) belum dikonfigurasi. Artifact .aab ditandatangani dengan Debug Keystore dan TIDAK dapat diunggah ke Google Play Console sampai Release Keystore dipasang."
            if [ -n "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY:-}" ]; then
              {
                echo "### ⚠️ Peringatan Penandatanganan Release (.AAB)"
                echo "Secrets \`KEYSTORE_BASE64\`, \`KEY_ALIAS\`, \`KEY_PASSWORD\`, atau \`STORE_PASSWORD\` belum disetel di GitHub Repository Secrets."
                echo "- **APK Direct** tetap dapat diinstal untuk pengujian perangkat."
                echo "- **App Bundle (.AAB)** saat ini menggunakan fallback *debug signing* dan **wajib** menggunakan Release Upload Keystore sebelum diunggah ke Google Play Console."
              } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            fi
          fi

      - name: Build Release APK
        env:
          REVENUECAT_ANDROID_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.REVENUECAT_ANDROID_API_KEY }}
          SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_URL }}
          SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}
          KAS_SANTRI_ED25519_PUBKEY: ${{ secrets.KAS_SANTRI_ED25519_PUBKEY }}
        run: |
          EXTRA_DEFINES=()
          if [ -n "$REVENUECAT_ANDROID_API_KEY" ]; then
            EXTRA_DEFINES+=(--dart-define=REVENUECAT_ANDROID_API_KEY="$REVENUECAT_ANDROID_API_KEY")
          fi
          if [ -n "$SUPABASE_URL" ] && [ -n "$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" ]; then
            EXTRA_DEFINES+=(--dart-define=SUPABASE_URL="$SUPABASE_URL" --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")
          fi
          if [ -n "$KAS_SANTRI_ED25519_PUBKEY" ]; then
            EXTRA_DEFINES+=(--dart-define=KAS_SANTRI_ED25519_PUBKEY="$KAS_SANTRI_ED25519_PUBKEY")
          fi
          flutter build apk --release --obfuscate --split-debug-info=build/app/outputs/symbols --android-skip-build-dependency-validation --dart-define=PLAY_STORE_BUILD=false "${EXTRA_DEFINES[@]}"

      - name: Build Signed Release App Bundle (AAB)
        env:
          REVENUECAT_ANDROID_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.REVENUECAT_ANDROID_API_KEY }}
          SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_URL }}
          SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}
          KAS_SANTRI_ED25519_PUBKEY: ${{ secrets.KAS_SANTRI_ED25519_PUBKEY }}
        run: |
          EXTRA_DEFINES=()
          if [ -n "$REVENUECAT_ANDROID_API_KEY" ]; then
            EXTRA_DEFINES+=(--dart-define=REVENUECAT_ANDROID_API_KEY="$REVENUECAT_ANDROID_API_KEY")
          fi
          if [ -n "$SUPABASE_URL" ] && [ -n "$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" ]; then
            EXTRA_DEFINES+=(--dart-define=SUPABASE_URL="$SUPABASE_URL" --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")
          fi
          if [ -n "$KAS_SANTRI_ED25519_PUBKEY" ]; then
            EXTRA_DEFINES+=(--dart-define=KAS_SANTRI_ED25519_PUBKEY="$KAS_SANTRI_ED25519_PUBKEY")
          fi
          flutter build appbundle --release --obfuscate --split-debug-info=build/app/outputs/symbols --android-skip-build-dependency-validation --dart-define=PLAY_STORE_BUILD=true "${EXTRA_DEFINES[@]}"

      - name: Clean Signing Secrets
        if: always()
        run: rm -f android/app/upload-keystore.jks android/key.properties

      - name: Upload Release APK to Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: kas-santri-release-apk
          path: build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*.apk
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Upload Release AAB (Google Play) to Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: kas-santri-release-aab
          path: build/app/outputs/bundle/release/*.aab
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
```

### [7/123] `admin_dashboard/app.js`

```javascript
/**
 * Kas-Santri Admin Command Center — UI Controller
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const state = {
    customers: [],
    transactions: [],
    remoteConfig: null,
    searchQuery: '',
    statusFilter: 'ALL',
    revenueChart: null,
    growthChart: null,
    lastGeneratedCode: '',
    lastGeneratedWaMessage: '',
  };

  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  function showToast(msg, isError = false) {
    const el = $('toast');
    if (!el) return;
    el.textContent = msg;
    el.className = isError ? 'toast error' : 'toast';
    setTimeout(() => {
      el.classList.add('hidden');
    }, 3400);
  }

  function formatIdr(val) {
    const num = Number(val || 0);
    return 'Rp ' + num.toLocaleString('id-ID');
  }

  function formatDateShort(iso) {
    if (!iso) return '-';
    const d = new Date(iso);
    if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '-';
    return d.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
  }

  function daysUntil(iso) {
    if (!iso) return null;
    const d = new Date(iso);
    if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
    return Math.ceil((d.getTime() - Date.now()) / 86400000);
  }

  function daysSince(iso) {
    if (!iso) return null;
    const d = new Date(iso);
    if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
    return Math.floor((Date.now() - d.getTime()) / 86400000);
  }

  function normalizeWaPhone(raw) {
    let digits = String(raw || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (!digits) return '';
    if (digits.startsWith('0')) digits = '62' + digits.slice(1);
    if (!digits.startsWith('62') && digits.startsWith('8')) digits = '62' + digits;
    return digits;
  }

  function deriveEffectiveStatus(c) {
    if (c.is_revoked || c.status === 'DIBLOKIR') return 'DIBLOKIR';
    const rem = daysUntil(c.expiry_date);
    if (c.tier === 'TRIAL_14D') {
      if (rem !== null && rem < 0) return 'EXPIRED';
      return 'TRIAL';
    }
    if (['MONTHLY', 'YEARLY', 'LIFETIME'].includes(c.tier)) {
      if (c.tier !== 'LIFETIME' && rem !== null && rem < 0) return 'EXPIRED';
      return 'AKTIF';
    }
    return 'GRATIS';
  }

  function isExpiringSoonOrHotTrial(c) {
    const eff = deriveEffectiveStatus(c);
    if (eff === 'DIBLOKIR' || eff === 'EXPIRED') return false;
    const rem = daysUntil(c.expiry_date);
    if (eff === 'AKTIF' && c.tier !== 'LIFETIME' && rem !== null && rem <= 7 && rem >= 0) {
      return true;
    }
    if (eff === 'TRIAL') {
      const elapsed = daysSince(c.trial_started_at);
      if ((elapsed !== null && elapsed >= 10) || (rem !== null && rem <= 4 && rem >= 0)) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  function escapeHtml(str) {
    return String(str || '')
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
      .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
      .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  }

  // --- LOGIN GATE ---
  function initLoginGate() {
    const sbCfg = AdminStore.getSupabaseConfig();
    if (sbCfg.url) $('loginSbUrl').value = sbCfg.url;
    if (sbCfg.anonKey) $('loginSbAnonKey').value = sbCfg.anonKey;

    if (!AdminStore.hasOfflinePasswordConfigured()) {
      $('offlinePasswordLabel').textContent = 'Buat Password Admin Lokal Pertama Kali';
      $('offlineFirstTimeHint').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    $('tabLoginOffline').addEventListener('click', () => {
      $('tabLoginOffline').classList.add('active');
      $('tabLoginCloud').classList.remove('active');
      $('formOfflineLogin').classList.remove('hidden');
      $('formCloudLogin').classList.add('hidden');
    });

    $('tabLoginCloud').addEventListener('click', () => {
      $('tabLoginCloud').classList.add('active');
      $('tabLoginOffline').classList.remove('active');
      $('formCloudLogin').classList.remove('hidden');
      $('formOfflineLogin').classList.add('hidden');
    });

    $('formOfflineLogin').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      try {
        const pwd = $('offlinePasswordInput').value;
        const ok = await AdminStore.verifyOfflineLogin(pwd);
        if (!ok) {
          showToast('Password Admin lokal tidak cocok.', true);
          return;
        }
        await enterDashboard();
      } catch (err) {
        showToast(err.message || 'Gagal membuka Mode Offline.', true);
      }
    });

    $('formCloudLogin').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      try {
        AdminStore.saveSupabaseConfig($('loginSbUrl').value, $('loginSbAnonKey').value);
        await AdminStore.loginSupabase($('loginSbEmail').value, $('loginSbPassword').value);
        await enterDashboard();
        showToast('Berhasil login ke Supabase Cloud!');
      } catch (err) {
        showToast(err.message || 'Gagal login Supabase Cloud.', true);
      }
    });

    if (AdminStore.isSessionAuthenticated()) {
      enterDashboard();
    }
  }

  async function enterDashboard() {
    $('loginOverlay').classList.add('hidden');
    $('appShell').classList.remove('hidden');
    updateModeBadge();
    loadEd25519KeyIntoUi();
    await refreshDashboardData();
  }

  function updateModeBadge() {
    const mode = AdminStore.getActiveMode();
    const badge = $('modeBadge');
    const sess = AdminStore.getSupabaseSession();
    if (mode === 'CLOUD') {
      badge.textContent = `☁️ Supabase Cloud (${sess?.email || 'Admin'})`;
      badge.className = 'badge badge-aktif';
      $('btnSeedDemo').classList.add('hidden');
    } else {
      badge.textContent = '💾 Mode Offline (LocalStorage)';
      badge.className = 'badge badge-trial';
      $('btnSeedDemo').classList.remove('hidden');
    }
  }

  async function refreshDashboardData() {
    try {
      const data = await AdminStore.fetchAllData();
      state.customers = data.customers || [];
      state.transactions = data.transactions || [];
      state.remoteConfig = data.remoteConfig || {};
      renderAll();
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('Gagal memuat data: ' + err.message, true);
    }
  }

  // --- RENDERING ---
  function renderAll() {
    renderKpis();
    renderCharts();
    renderCrmTable();
    renderTransactionsTable();
    renderRemoteConfigForm();
  }

  function renderKpis() {
    const now = new Date();
    const curYm = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;

    let totalOmset = 0;
    let monthOmset = 0;
    for (const tx of state.transactions) {
      const nom = Number(tx.nominal_idr || 0);
      totalOmset += nom;
      if (String(tx.created_at || '').startsWith(curYm)) {
        monthOmset += nom;
      }
    }

    let proCount = 0;
    let monthlyCount = 0;
    let yearlyCount = 0;
    let lifetimeCount = 0;
    let trialCount = 0;
    let hotTrialCount = 0;
    let freeOrExpired = 0;
    let expiringSoon = 0;
    let revokedCount = 0;

    for (const c of state.customers) {
      const st = deriveEffectiveStatus(c);
      if (st === 'DIBLOKIR') {
        revokedCount++;
        continue;
      }
      if (st === 'AKTIF') {
        proCount++;
        if (c.tier === 'MONTHLY') monthlyCount++;
        if (c.tier === 'YEARLY') yearlyCount++;
        if (c.tier === 'LIFETIME') lifetimeCount++;
        const rem = daysUntil(c.expiry_date);
        if (c.tier !== 'LIFETIME' && rem !== null && rem <= 7 && rem >= 0) {
          expiringSoon++;
        }
      } else if (st === 'TRIAL') {
        trialCount++;
        if (isExpiringSoonOrHotTrial(c)) hotTrialCount++;
      } else {
        freeOrExpired++;
      }
    }

    $('kpiTotalOmset').textContent = formatIdr(totalOmset);
    $('kpiTxCount').textContent = `${state.transactions.length} transaksi lisensi tercatat`;
    $('kpiMonthOmset').textContent = formatIdr(monthOmset);
    $('kpiMonthLabel').textContent = `Bulan ${now.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })}`;
    $('kpiActivePro').textContent = String(proCount);
    $('kpiActiveBreakdown').textContent = `${monthlyCount} Bulanan • ${yearlyCount} Tahunan • ${lifetimeCount} Lifetime`;
    $('kpiTrialCount').textContent = String(trialCount);
    $('kpiTrialHot').textContent = `${hotTrialCount} siap follow-up (hari ke-10+)`;
    $('kpiFreeCount').textContent = String(freeOrExpired);
    $('kpiExpiringSoon').textContent = String(expiringSoon);
    $('kpiRevokedCount').textContent = `${revokedCount} lisensi dicabut admin`;
  }

  function renderCharts() {
    const revMap = new Map();
    const now = new Date();
    for (let i = 5; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - i, 1);
      const ym = `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
      revMap.set(ym, 0);
    }
    for (const tx of state.transactions) {
      const ym = String(tx.created_at || '').slice(0, 7);
      if (revMap.has(ym)) {
        revMap.set(ym, revMap.get(ym) + Number(tx.nominal_idr || 0));
      }
    }
    const labels = Array.from(revMap.keys());
    const revValues = Array.from(revMap.values());

    const counts = { AKTIF: 0, TRIAL: 0, GRATIS: 0, EXPIRED: 0, DIBLOKIR: 0 };
    for (const c of state.customers) {
      counts[deriveEffectiveStatus(c)] = (counts[deriveEffectiveStatus(c)] || 0) + 1;
    }

    if (typeof Chart === 'undefined') {
      $('revenueChart').classList.add('hidden');
      $('growthChart').classList.add('hidden');
      $('chartOfflineFallback1').classList.remove('hidden');
      $('chartOfflineFallback2').classList.remove('hidden');
      $('chartOfflineFallback1').textContent =
        'Mode Offline tanpa internet: grafik Chart.js tidak dimuat. Omset 6 bulan: ' +
        labels.map((l, i) => `${l}: ${formatIdr(revValues[i])}`).join(' | ');
      $('chartOfflineFallback2').textContent =
        `Komposisi Pondok: Aktif PRO ${counts.AKTIF}, Trial ${counts.TRIAL}, Gratis ${counts.GRATIS}, Expired ${counts.EXPIRED}, Diblokir ${counts.DIBLOKIR}.`;
      return;
    }

    $('revenueChart').classList.remove('hidden');
    $('growthChart').classList.remove('hidden');
    $('chartOfflineFallback1').classList.add('hidden');
    $('chartOfflineFallback2').classList.add('hidden');

    if (state.revenueChart) state.revenueChart.destroy();
    state.revenueChart = new Chart($('revenueChart'), {
      type: 'bar',
      data: {
        labels,
        datasets: [
          {
            label: 'Omset (Rp)',
            data: revValues,
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.55)',
            borderColor: '#34d399',
            borderWidth: 1.5,
            borderRadius: 8,
          },
        ],
      },
      options: {
        responsive: true,
        maintainAspectRatio: false,
        plugins: { legend: { labels: { color: '#cbd5e1' } } },
        scales: {
          x: { ticks: { color: '#94a3b8' }, grid: { color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' } },
          y: { ticks: { color: '#94a3b8' }, grid: { color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' } },
        },
      },
    });

    if (state.growthChart) state.growthChart.destroy();
    state.growthChart = new Chart($('growthChart'), {
      type: 'doughnut',
      data: {
        labels: ['Aktif PRO', 'Trial 14 Hari', 'Gratis', 'Expired', 'Diblokir'],
        datasets: [
          {
            data: [counts.AKTIF, counts.TRIAL, counts.GRATIS, counts.EXPIRED, counts.DIBLOKIR],
            backgroundColor: ['#34d399', '#38bdf8', '#64748b', '#fbbf24', '#fb7185'],
            borderColor: '#040812',
            borderWidth: 2,
          },
        ],
      },
      options: {
        responsive: true,
        maintainAspectRatio: false,
        plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { color: '#cbd5e1', font: { size: 11 } } } },
      },
    });
  }

  function renderCrmTable() {
    const q = state.searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    const filter = state.statusFilter;

    const filtered = state.customers.filter((c) => {
      const eff = deriveEffectiveStatus(c);
      if (filter === 'EXPIRING') {
        if (!isExpiringSoonOrHotTrial(c)) return false;
      } else if (filter !== 'ALL' && eff !== filter) {
        return false;
      }
      if (!q) return true;
      return (
        String(c.nama_pondok || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(c.nama_bendahara || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(c.no_wa || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(c.device_id || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    });

    const tbody = $('crmTableBody');
    if (filtered.length === 0) {
      tbody.innerHTML =
        '<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center; color:var(--text-muted); padding:26px;">Belum ada data pelanggan yang cocok dengan filter ini.</td></tr>';
      return;
    }

    tbody.innerHTML = filtered
      .map((c) => {
        const eff = deriveEffectiveStatus(c);
        const badgeCls =
          eff === 'AKTIF'
            ? 'badge-aktif'
            : eff === 'TRIAL'
            ? 'badge-trial'
            : eff === 'DIBLOKIR'
            ? 'badge-blocked'
            : eff === 'EXPIRED'
            ? 'badge-warn'
            : 'badge-gratis';
        const rem = daysUntil(c.expiry_date);
        const remText =
          c.tier === 'LIFETIME'
            ? 'Selamanya'
            : rem === null
            ? '-'
            : rem >= 0
            ? `${rem} hari lagi`
            : `Lewat ${Math.abs(rem)} hari`;
        const showFollowUp = isExpiringSoonOrHotTrial(c) || eff === 'EXPIRED';
        const revLabel = c.is_revoked ? 'Aktifkan' : 'Blokir';

        return `
          <tr>
            <td>
              <div style="font-weight:800; color:#fff;">${escapeHtml(c.nama_pondok || 'Pondok Belum Diisi')}</div>
              <div style="font-size:11px; color:var(--text-muted);">${escapeHtml(c.nama_bendahara || '-')}</div>
            </td>
            <td class="mono">${escapeHtml(c.no_wa || '-')}</td>
            <td class="mono" style="color:var(--gold-soft); font-weight:700;">${escapeHtml(c.device_id)}</td>
            <td>
              <div style="font-weight:700;">${escapeHtml(c.tier)}</div>
              <div style="font-size:10.5px; color:var(--text-muted);">${escapeHtml(c.payment_channel || 'FREE')}</div>
            </td>
            <td style="font-weight:800; color:var(--emerald);">${formatIdr(c.total_paid_idr)}</td>
            <td>
              <div>${c.tier === 'LIFETIME' ? 'Lifetime' : formatDateShort(c.expiry_date)}</div>
              <div style="font-size:10.5px; color:var(--text-muted);">${remText}</div>
            </td>
            <td class="mono">v${escapeHtml(c.app_version || '4.2.0')}</td>
            <td><span class="badge ${badgeCls}">${eff}</span></td>
            <td>
              <div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:5px;">
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" data-action="edit" data-id="${escapeHtml(c.device_id)}">Edit</button>
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-gold btn-sm" data-action="extend" data-id="${escapeHtml(c.device_id)}">Perpanjang</button>
                ${
                  showFollowUp
                    ? `<button type="button" class="btn btn-wa btn-sm" data-action="followup" data-id="${escapeHtml(c.device_id)}">WA Follow-Up</button>`
                    : ''
                }
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" data-action="revoke" data-id="${escapeHtml(c.device_id)}">${revLabel}</button>
              </div>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `;
      })
      .join('');
  }

  function renderTransactionsTable() {
    const tbody = $('txTableBody');
    if (state.transactions.length === 0) {
      tbody.innerHTML =
        '<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center; color:var(--text-muted); padding:20px;">Belum ada transaksi lisensi tercatat.</td></tr>';
      return;
    }
    tbody.innerHTML = state.transactions
      .map(
        (t) => `
        <tr>
          <td>${formatDateShort(t.created_at)}</td>
          <td class="mono">${escapeHtml(t.device_id)}</td>
          <td>${escapeHtml(t.paket)}</td>
          <td>${escapeHtml(t.metode_bayar)}</td>
          <td style="font-weight:800; color:var(--emerald);">${formatIdr(t.nominal_idr)}</td>
        </tr>
      `
      )
      .join('');
  }

  function renderRemoteConfigForm() {
    const cfg = state.remoteConfig || {};
    $('rcLatestVersion').value = cfg.latest_version || '4.2.0';
    $('rcMinVersion').value = cfg.min_version || '3.0.0';
    $('rcTitle').value = cfg.announcement_title || '';
    $('rcBody').value = cfg.announcement_body || '';
    $('rcUrl').value = cfg.update_url || '';
    $('rcPromoActive').checked = Boolean(cfg.promo_banner_active);
  }

  // --- ED25519 GENERATOR ---
  function loadEd25519KeyIntoUi() {
    const seed = AdminStore.getEd25519Seed();
    if (!seed) {
      $('edKeyBadge').textContent = 'Belum Dimuat';
      $('edKeyBadge').className = 'badge badge-warn';
      $('edPubKeyOutput').value = '';
      return;
    }
    try {
      const pub = KasSantriEd25519.publicKeyFromSeedBase64(seed);
      $('edSeedInput').value = seed;
      $('edPubKeyOutput').value = pub;
      $('edKeyBadge').textContent = '✓ Kunci Siap (Ed25519)';
      $('edKeyBadge').className = 'badge badge-aktif';
    } catch (_) {
      $('edKeyBadge').textContent = 'Seed Tidak Valid';
      $('edKeyBadge').className = 'badge badge-blocked';
    }
  }

  function initGeneratorSection() {
    $('btnApplySeed').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const seed = $('edSeedInput').value.trim();
      try {
        const pub = KasSantriEd25519.publicKeyFromSeedBase64(seed);
        AdminStore.setEd25519Seed(seed);
        $('edPubKeyOutput').value = pub;
        $('edKeyBadge').textContent = '✓ Kunci Siap (Ed25519)';
        $('edKeyBadge').className = 'badge badge-aktif';
        showToast('Private Seed Ed25519 disimpan ke sesi Admin.');
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Seed Ed25519 tidak valid: ' + err.message, true);
      }
    });

    $('btnToggleSeedVis').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const inp = $('edSeedInput');
      inp.type = inp.type === 'password' ? 'text' : 'password';
    });

    $('btnNewEdKeypair').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const kp = KasSantriEd25519.generateKeyPair();
      $('edSeedInput').value = kp.seedBase64;
      $('edPubKeyOutput').value = kp.publicKeyBase64;
      AdminStore.setEd25519Seed(kp.seedBase64);
      $('edKeyBadge').textContent = '✓ Keypair Baru Aktif';
      $('edKeyBadge').className = 'badge badge-aktif';
      showToast('Keypair Ed25519 baru dibuat! Salin Public Key ke LicenseService.dart jika memakai keypair ini.');
    });

    $('btnCopyPubKey').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const val = $('edPubKeyOutput').value;
      if (!val) return;
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(val);
      showToast('Public Key Ed25519 disalin!');
    });

    $('genTier').addEventListener('change', () => {
      const tier = $('genTier').value;
      if (tier === 'MONTHLY') {
        $('genNominal').value = 25000;
        $('genDays').value = 31;
      } else if (tier === 'YEARLY') {
        $('genNominal').value = 179000;
        $('genDays').value = 366;
      } else {
        $('genNominal').value = 399000;
        $('genDays').value = 36500;
      }
    });

    $('formGenerateLicense').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const seed = AdminStore.getEd25519Seed() || $('edSeedInput').value.trim();
      if (!seed) {
        showToast('Masukkan Private Seed Ed25519 terlebih dahulu di panel sebelah kiri.', true);
        return;
      }

      const deviceId = $('genDeviceId').value.trim().toUpperCase();
      const noWa = $('genNoWa').value.trim();
      const pondok = $('genNamaPondok').value.trim();
      const bendahara = $('genNamaBendahara').value.trim();
      const tier = $('genTier').value;
      const channel = $('genChannel').value;
      const nominal = Number($('genNominal').value || 0);
      const days = Math.max(1, Number($('genDays').value || 366));

      try {
        const expiryDate =
          tier === 'LIFETIME' ? null : new Date(Date.now() + days * 86400000);
        const expiryEpochSec =
          expiryDate === null ? 0 : Math.floor(expiryDate.getTime() / 1000);

        const signed = KasSantriEd25519.generateLicenseCode({
          seedBase64: seed,
          deviceId,
          tier,
          expiryEpochSec,
        });

        const existing = state.customers.find((c) => c.device_id === deviceId);
        const prevPaid = existing ? Number(existing.total_paid_idr || 0) : 0;

        await AdminStore.upsertCustomer({
          ...(existing || {}),
          device_id: deviceId,
          nama_pondok: pondok,
          nama_bendahara: bendahara || existing?.nama_bendahara || '',
          no_wa: noWa,
          tier,
          status: 'AKTIF',
          expiry_date: expiryDate ? expiryDate.toISOString() : null,
          payment_channel: channel,
          total_paid_idr: prevPaid + nominal,
          is_revoked: false,
          notes: `Lisensi ${tier} diterbitkan Admin (${formatDateShort(new Date().toISOString())})`,
        });

        await AdminStore.recordTransaction({
          device_id: deviceId,
          paket: tier,
          nominal_idr: nominal,
          metode_bayar: channel,
          kode_lisensi: signed.code,
        });

        const paketLabel =
          tier === 'LIFETIME' ? 'PRO Lifetime (Selamanya)' : tier === 'MONTHLY' ? 'PRO Bulanan' : 'PRO Tahunan';
        const waMsg =
          `Assalamu'alaikum Wr. Wb.\n` +
          `Terima kasih ${bendahara || 'Pengurus'} (${pondok}). Pembayaran Kas-Santri *${paketLabel}* telah kami verifikasi.\n\n` +
          `Device ID: ${deviceId}\n` +
          `Kode Aktivasi PRO:\n*${signed.code}*\n\n` +
          `Cara aktifkan: Buka aplikasi Kas-Santri -> menu Upgrade PRO -> pilih "Sudah Bayar? Masukkan Kode Aktivasi" -> tempel kode di atas.\n\n` +
          `Hormat kami,\nMoch Khoirul Azman (Admin Kas-Santri)`;

        state.lastGeneratedCode = signed.code;
        state.lastGeneratedWaMessage = waMsg;
        $('generatedCodeText').textContent = signed.code;
        $('generatedResultBox').classList.remove('hidden');

        const waNum = normalizeWaPhone(noWa);
        $('btnSendWaDirect').href = waNum
          ? `https://wa.me/${waNum}?text=${encodeURIComponent(waMsg)}`
          : `https://wa.me/?text=${encodeURIComponent(waMsg)}`;

        await refreshDashboardData();
        showToast('Kode Ed25519 dibuat & omset berhasil dicatat ke CRM!');
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Gagal generate lisensi: ' + err.message, true);
      }
    });

    $('btnCopyGeneratedCode').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (!state.lastGeneratedCode) return;
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(state.lastGeneratedCode);
      showToast('Kode aktivasi PRO disalin!');
    });

    $('btnCopyWaMessage').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (!state.lastGeneratedWaMessage) return;
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(state.lastGeneratedWaMessage);
      showToast('Template balasan WA disalin!');
    });
  }

  // --- CRM ACTIONS ---
  function openCustomerModal(customer = null) {
    $('custIsEdit').value = customer ? '1' : '0';
    $('modalCustomerTitle').textContent = customer ? 'Edit Pelanggan APK' : 'Tambah Pelanggan Manual';
    $('custDeviceId').value = customer?.device_id || '';
    $('custDeviceId').readOnly = Boolean(customer);
    $('custPondok').value = customer?.nama_pondok || '';
    $('custBendahara').value = customer?.nama_bendahara || '';
    $('custWa').value = customer?.no_wa || '';
    $('custTier').value = customer?.tier || 'FREE';
    $('custStatus').value = customer?.status || 'GRATIS';
    $('custChannel').value = customer?.payment_channel || 'FREE';
    $('custTotalPaid').value = Number(customer?.total_paid_idr || 0);
    $('custExpiry').value = customer?.expiry_date ? String(customer.expiry_date).slice(0, 10) : '';
    $('custVersion').value = customer?.app_version || '4.2.0';
    $('custNotes').value = customer?.notes || '';
    $('customerModal').classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  function initCrmSection() {
    $('crmSearchInput').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
      state.searchQuery = e.target.value;
      renderCrmTable();
    });

    $('crmFilterChips').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const btn = e.target.closest('.chip');
      if (!btn) return;
      document.querySelectorAll('#crmFilterChips .chip').forEach((c) => c.classList.remove('active'));
      btn.classList.add('active');
      state.statusFilter = btn.dataset.filter || 'ALL';
      renderCrmTable();
    });

    $('btnAddCustomer').addEventListener('click', () => openCustomerModal(null));
    $('btnCloseCustomerModal').addEventListener('click', () => $('customerModal').classList.add('hidden'));
    $('btnCancelCustomerModal').addEventListener('click', () => $('customerModal').classList.add('hidden'));

    $('formCustomerModal').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      try {
        const expVal = $('custExpiry').value;
        await AdminStore.upsertCustomer({
          device_id: $('custDeviceId').value,
          nama_pondok: $('custPondok').value,
          nama_bendahara: $('custBendahara').value,
          no_wa: $('custWa').value,
          tier: $('custTier').value,
          status: $('custStatus').value,
          payment_channel: $('custChannel').value,
          total_paid_idr: Number($('custTotalPaid').value || 0),
          expiry_date: expVal ? new Date(expVal + 'T23:59:59Z').toISOString() : null,
          app_version: $('custVersion').value,
          is_revoked: $('custStatus').value === 'DIBLOKIR',
          notes: $('custNotes').value,
        });
        $('customerModal').classList.add('hidden');
        await refreshDashboardData();
        showToast('Data pelanggan tersimpan.');
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Gagal menyimpan pelanggan: ' + err.message, true);
      }
    });

    $('crmTableBody').addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
      const btn = e.target.closest('button[data-action]');
      if (!btn) return;
      const action = btn.dataset.action;
      const id = btn.dataset.id;
      const customer = state.customers.find((c) => c.device_id === id);
      if (!customer) return;

      if (action === 'edit') {
        openCustomerModal(customer);
        return;
      }

      if (action === 'extend') {
        $('genDeviceId').value = customer.device_id;
        $('genNamaPondok').value = customer.nama_pondok || '';
        $('genNamaBendahara').value = customer.nama_bendahara || '';
        $('genNoWa').value = customer.no_wa || '';
        switchSection('sec-generator');
        showToast('Data pelanggan diisikan ke Generator Ed25519 untuk perpanjangan cepat.');
        return;
      }

      if (action === 'followup') {
        const waNum = normalizeWaPhone(customer.no_wa);
        const eff = deriveEffectiveStatus(customer);
        const rem = daysUntil(customer.expiry_date);
        const contextText =
          eff === 'TRIAL'
            ? `masa Uji Coba Gratis 14 Hari Kas-Santri PRO untuk *${customer.nama_pondok}* tinggal ${Math.max(0, rem ?? 0)} hari lagi`
            : `langganan Kas-Santri PRO *${customer.nama_pondok}* akan segera berakhir (${rem !== null && rem >= 0 ? `sisa ${rem} hari` : 'sudah berakhir'})`;

        const msg =
          `Assalamu'alaikum Wr. Wb.\n` +
          `Yth. ${customer.nama_bendahara || 'Bendahara'} (${customer.nama_pondok}),\n` +
          `Kami informasikan bahwa ${contextText}.\n\n` +
          `Agar fitur PRO (Ekspor PDF/Excel Berkop, QR Scanner, Auto-Backup Google Drive, & Manajemen Infak) tetap berjalan lancar, silakan lakukan perpanjangan:\n` +
          `• DANA Resmi: *082130678956* (a.n. Moch Khoirul Azman) — Bulanan Rp25rb / Tahunan Rp179rb / Lifetime Rp399rb\n` +
          `• Atau langsung lewat Google Play Store di dalam aplikasi.\n\n` +
          `Sertakan Device ID *${customer.device_id}* setelah transfer agar kode aktivasi segera kami kirimkan. Terima kasih.`;

        const url = waNum
          ? `https://wa.me/${waNum}?text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`
          : `https://wa.me/?text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`;
        window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
        return;
      }

      if (action === 'revoke') {
        const nextRevoke = !customer.is_revoked;
        const ok = window.confirm(
          nextRevoke
            ? `Cabut/Blokir lisensi PRO perangkat ${customer.device_id} (${customer.nama_pondok})? Saat APK online, status akan otomatis diturunkan ke Gratis.`
            : `Aktifkan kembali akses perangkat ${customer.device_id}?`
        );
        if (!ok) return;
        try {
          await AdminStore.toggleRevoke(customer.device_id, nextRevoke);
          await refreshDashboardData();
          showToast(nextRevoke ? 'Lisensi perangkat berhasil diblokir (Revoke).' : 'Blokir perangkat dibuka.');
        } catch (err) {
          showToast('Gagal mengubah status revoke: ' + err.message, true);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  // --- REMOTE CONFIG & EXPORTS ---
  function downloadTextFile(filename, content, mime = 'text/plain;charset=utf-8') {
    const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mime });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = filename;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  function toCsvCell(val) {
    const s = String(val ?? '').replace(/"/g, '""');
    return `"${s}"`;
  }

  function initRemoteAndExportSection() {
    $('formRemoteConfig').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      try {
        await AdminStore.saveRemoteConfig({
          latest_version: $('rcLatestVersion').value,
          min_version: $('rcMinVersion').value,
          announcement_title: $('rcTitle').value,
          announcement_body: $('rcBody').value,
          update_url: $('rcUrl').value,
          promo_banner_active: $('rcPromoActive').checked,
        });
        await refreshDashboardData();
        showToast('Pengumuman & versi terbaru APK tersimpan!');
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Gagal menyimpan remote config: ' + err.message, true);
      }
    });

    $('btnExportCustomersCsv').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const headers = ['device_id', 'nama_pondok', 'nama_bendahara', 'no_wa', 'tier', 'status', 'payment_channel', 'total_paid_idr', 'expiry_date', 'app_version', 'is_revoked'];
      const rows = [headers.join(',')].concat(
        state.customers.map((c) => headers.map((h) => toCsvCell(c[h])).join(','))
      );
      downloadTextFile(`kas_santri_pelanggan_${Date.now()}.csv`, rows.join('\n'), 'text/csv;charset=utf-8');
      showToast('CSV Pelanggan diunduh.');
    });

    $('btnExportTxCsv').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const headers = ['created_at', 'device_id', 'paket', 'metode_bayar', 'nominal_idr', 'kode_lisensi'];
      const rows = [headers.join(',')].concat(
        state.transactions.map((t) => headers.map((h) => toCsvCell(t[h])).join(','))
      );
      downloadTextFile(`kas_santri_omset_${Date.now()}.csv`, rows.join('\n'), 'text/csv;charset=utf-8');
      showToast('CSV Pembukuan Omset diunduh.');
    });

    $('btnExportAdminJson').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const dump = {
        exported_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        customers: state.customers,
        transactions: state.transactions,
        remoteConfig: state.remoteConfig,
      };
      downloadTextFile(
        `kas_santri_admin_backup_${Date.now()}.json`,
        JSON.stringify(dump, null, 2),
        'application/json'
      );
      showToast('Backup JSON Admin diunduh.');
    });

    $('inputImportAdminJson').addEventListener('change', async (e) => {
      const file = e.target.files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;
      try {
        const raw = JSON.parse(await file.text());
        await AdminStore.importJson(raw);
        await refreshDashboardData();
        showToast('Backup JSON Admin berhasil dipulihkan.');
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Gagal impor JSON Admin: ' + err.message, true);
      } finally {
        e.target.value = '';
      }
    });
  }

  // --- NAVIGATION & SETTINGS MODAL ---
  function switchSection(targetId) {
    document.querySelectorAll('nav.nav-tabs .nav-tab').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.section === targetId);
    });
    ['sec-overview', 'sec-generator', 'sec-crm', 'sec-remote'].forEach((id) => {
      $(id).classList.toggle('hidden', id !== targetId);
    });
  }

  function initShellControls() {
    document.querySelectorAll('nav.nav-tabs .nav-tab').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => switchSection(btn.dataset.section));
    });

    $('btnRefreshData').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      await refreshDashboardData();
      showToast('Data diperbarui.');
    });

    $('btnSeedDemo').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      await AdminStore.seedSampleDataIfOffline();
      await refreshDashboardData();
      showToast('4 contoh pondok & omset simulasi dimuat (Mode Offline).');
    });

    $('btnOpenSettings').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const cfg = AdminStore.getSupabaseConfig();
      $('setSbUrl').value = cfg.url || '';
      $('setSbAnon').value = cfg.anonKey || '';
      $('setNewOfflinePwd').value = '';
      $('settingsModal').classList.remove('hidden');
    });

    $('btnCloseSettingsModal').addEventListener('click', () => $('settingsModal').classList.add('hidden'));
    $('btnCancelSettingsModal').addEventListener('click', () => $('settingsModal').classList.add('hidden'));

    $('formSettingsModal').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      try {
        AdminStore.saveSupabaseConfig($('setSbUrl').value, $('setSbAnon').value);
        const newPwd = $('setNewOfflinePwd').value;
        if (newPwd.trim()) {
          await AdminStore.setupOrUpdateOfflinePassword(newPwd);
        }
        $('settingsModal').classList.add('hidden');
        updateModeBadge();
        showToast('Pengaturan kredensial disimpan.');
      } catch (err) {
        showToast(err.message, true);
      }
    });

    $('btnLogout').addEventListener('click', () => {
      AdminStore.logout();
      $('appShell').classList.add('hidden');
      $('loginOverlay').classList.remove('hidden');
      $('offlinePasswordInput').value = '';
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    initLoginGate();
    initShellControls();
    initGeneratorSection();
    initCrmSection();
    initRemoteAndExportSection();
  });
})();
```

### [8/123] `admin_dashboard/CARA_PAKAI_ADMIN.md`

````markdown
# Panduan Singkat Admin Command Center Kas-Santri (v3.4)

> **Catatan Keamanan Mutlak:** Folder `admin_dashboard/` hanya untuk **Admin (Anda)** dan tidak pernah didaftarkan di `pubspec.yaml`, sehingga **tidak ikut masuk ke file APK/AAB publik**.

---

## 1. Cara Membuka Dashboard Admin (Mode Offline — Langsung Jalan)
1. Buka file `admin_dashboard/index.html` langsung di browser Chrome/Edge/Safari (baik di Laptop maupun HP).
2. Pilih tab **💾 Mode Offline** dan buat Password Admin Lokal pertama kali (minimal 4 karakter).
3. Anda dapat langsung:
   - Memasukkan **Private Seed Base64** Ed25519 (hasil `dart run tool/generate_keypair.dart --generate-keys`) atau membuat keypair baru.
   - Menghasilkan kode lisensi `KSPRO-...` di tab **🔐 Generator Ed25519**.
   - Mencatat pelanggan pondok, omset DANA/Play Store, follow-up WhatsApp 1-klik, dan ekspor CSV/JSON pembukuan pribadi.

---

## 2. Menghubungkan ke Cloud Supabase (Gratis 5 Menit)
Agar data pelanggan dari seluruh HP bendahara tersinkron otomatis ke Dashboard Admin dan Anda bisa melakukan **Remote Revoke** atau mengirim **Pengumuman Update APK**:

1. **Buat Proyek Gratis di Supabase**:
   - Daftar/masuk ke [supabase.com](https://supabase.com) -> **New Project** -> pilih region terdekat (`Singapore`).
2. **Jalankan Skema SQL**:
   - Buka **SQL Editor** -> **New Query** -> tempel seluruh isi file [`admin_dashboard/supabase_schema.sql`](supabase_schema.sql) -> klik **Run**.
3. **Daftarkan Akun Admin Anda**:
   - Buka **Authentication -> Users -> Add User**, buat akun email & password khusus Admin.
   - Jalankan query di SQL Editor (ganti email sesuai akun yang baru dibuat):
     ```sql
     insert into public.admin_users (user_id, email)
     select id, email from auth.users where email = 'email_admin_anda@gmail.com'
     on conflict (user_id) do nothing;
     ```
4. **Salin URL & Anon Key**:
   - Buka **Project Settings -> API**, salin **Project URL** dan **anon public key**.
   - Buka `admin_dashboard/index.html`, pilih tab **☁️ Supabase Cloud**, tempel URL, Anon Key, Email & Password Admin -> **Login**.

---

## 3. Menghubungkan APK Flutter ke Supabase (Opsional, Aman via GitHub Secrets)
Tambahkan 2 Secrets di repositori GitHub Anda (**Settings -> Secrets and variables -> Actions**):
- `SUPABASE_URL`: `https://xxxxxxxxxxxx.supabase.co`
- `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`: `eyJhbGci...` (`anon public` key — **JANGAN** pernah memakai `service_role` key).

Workflow `.github/workflows/flutter-apk.yml` otomatis menyuntikkan keduanya lewat `--dart-define` saat build APK/AAB. Jika Secrets tidak diisi, aplikasi tetap berjalan 100% offline-first tanpa error.

---

## 4. Sinkronisasi Kunci Ed25519
1. Jalankan sekali di PC/CI yang terpasang Dart:
   ```bash
   dart run tool/generate_keypair.dart --generate-keys
   ```
   *(Atau klik **✨ Buat Keypair Baru** di tab Generator Ed25519 pada Dashboard Admin).*
2. Tempel **Public Key Base64** ke `LicenseService.defaultPublicKeyBase64` di `lib/services/license_service.dart` sebelum merilis APK.
3. Simpan **Private Seed Base64** hanya di brankas pribadi Anda, dan tempel ke kolom Private Seed setiap kali membuka Dashboard Admin.
````

### [9/123] `admin_dashboard/ed25519.js`

```javascript
/**
 * Kas-Santri Ed25519 + RFC 4648 Base32 Pure-JS Engine (RFC 8032 Compliant)
 * Kompatibel 100% byte-for-byte dengan:
 * - lib/services/license_service.dart (cryptography ^2.7.0 Ed25519)
 * - tool/generate_keypair.dart
 *
 * Bekerja offline penuh (termasuk file://) menggunakan native JS BigInt tanpa CDN luar.
 */
(function (root) {
  'use strict';

  const MASK64 = 0xffffffffffffffffn;
  const K512 = [
    0x428a2f98d728ae22n, 0x7137449123ef65cdn, 0xb5c0fbcfec4d3b2fn, 0xe9b5dba58189dbbcn,
    0x3956c25bf348b538n, 0x59f111f1b605d019n, 0x923f82a4af194f9bn, 0xab1c5ed5da6d8118n,
    0xd807aa98a3030242n, 0x12835b0145706fben, 0x243185be4ee4b28cn, 0x550c7dc3d5ffb4e2n,
    0x72be5d74f27b896fn, 0x80deb1fe3b1696b1n, 0x9bdc06a725c71235n, 0xc19bf174cf692694n,

    0x391c0cb3c5c95a63n, 0x4ed8aa4ae3418acbn, 0x5b9cca4f7763e373n, 0x682e6ff3d6b2b8a3n,

    0x4cc5d4becb3e42b6n, 0x597f299cfc657e2an, 0x5fcb6fab3ad6faecn, 0x6c44198c4a475817n,

  const H0_512 = [
    0x6a09e667f3bcc908n, 0xbb67ae8584caa73bn, 0x3c6ef372fe94f82bn, 0xa54ff53a5f1d36f1n,
    0x510e527fade682d1n, 0x9b05688c2b3e6c1fn, 0x1f83d9abfb41bd6bn, 0x5be0cd19137e2179n,
  ];

  function rotr64(x, n) {
    return ((x >> BigInt(n)) | (x << BigInt(64 - n))) & MASK64;
  }

  function sha512(bytes) {
    const msg = bytes instanceof Uint8Array ? bytes : new Uint8Array(bytes);
    const bitLen = BigInt(msg.length) * 8n;
    const rem = (msg.length + 17) % 128;
    const padZero = rem === 0 ? 0 : 128 - rem;
    const padded = new Uint8Array(msg.length + 1 + padZero + 16);
    padded.set(msg, 0);
    padded[msg.length] = 0x80;
    const dv = new DataView(padded.buffer);
    dv.setBigUint64(padded.length - 8, bitLen & MASK64, false);
    dv.setBigUint64(padded.length - 16, bitLen >> 64n, false);

    const H = H0_512.slice();
    const W = new Array(80);

    for (let off = 0; off < padded.length; off += 128) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        W[i] = dv.getBigUint64(off + i * 8, false);
      }
      for (let i = 16; i < 80; i++) {
        const s0 = rotr64(W[i - 15], 1) ^ rotr64(W[i - 15], 8) ^ (W[i - 15] >> 7n);
        const s1 = rotr64(W[i - 2], 19) ^ rotr64(W[i - 2], 61) ^ (W[i - 2] >> 6n);
        W[i] = (W[i - 16] + s0 + W[i - 7] + s1) & MASK64;
      }

      let [a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h] = H;
      for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
        const S1 = rotr64(e, 14) ^ rotr64(e, 18) ^ rotr64(e, 41);
        const ch = (e & f) ^ ((~e & MASK64) & g);
        const temp1 = (h + S1 + ch + K512[i] + W[i]) & MASK64;
        const S0 = rotr64(a, 28) ^ rotr64(a, 34) ^ rotr64(a, 39);
        const maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
        const temp2 = (S0 + maj) & MASK64;
        h = g;
        g = f;
        f = e;
        e = (d + temp1) & MASK64;
        d = c;
        c = b;
        b = a;
        a = (temp1 + temp2) & MASK64;
      }

      H[0] = (H[0] + a) & MASK64;
      H[1] = (H[1] + b) & MASK64;
      H[2] = (H[2] + c) & MASK64;
      H[3] = (H[3] + d) & MASK64;
      H[4] = (H[4] + e) & MASK64;
      H[5] = (H[5] + f) & MASK64;
      H[6] = (H[6] + g) & MASK64;
      H[7] = (H[7] + h) & MASK64;
    }

    const out = new Uint8Array(64);
    const outDv = new DataView(out.buffer);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      outDv.setBigUint64(i * 8, H[i], false);
    }
    return out;
  }

  // Curve Ed25519 constants
  const P = (1n << 255n) - 19n;
  const L = (1n << 252n) + 27742317777372353535851937790883648493n;

  function mod(a, m) {
    const r = a % m;
    return r >= 0n ? r : r + m;
  }

  function powMod(base, exp, m) {
    let result = 1n;
    let b = mod(base, m);
    let e = exp;
    while (e > 0n) {
      if (e & 1n) result = (result * b) % m;
      e >>= 1n;
      b = (b * b) % m;
    }
    return result;
  }

  function modInv(a, m) {
    return powMod(a, m - 2n, m);
  }

  const D = mod(-121665n * modInv(121666n, P), P);
  const D2 = mod(2n * D, P);
  const SQRT_M1 = powMod(2n, (P - 1n) / 4n, P);
  const BY = mod(4n * modInv(5n, P), P);
  const BX = 15112221349535400772501151409588531511454012693041857206046113283949847762202n;
  const BASE = [BX, BY, 1n, mod(BX * BY, P)];
  const NEUTRAL = [0n, 1n, 1n, 0n];

  function pointAdd(p1, p2) {
    const [X1, Y1, Z1, T1] = p1;
    const [X2, Y2, Z2, T2] = p2;
    const A = mod((Y1 - X1) * (Y2 - X2), P);
    const B = mod((Y1 + X1) * (Y2 + X2), P);
    const C = mod(T1 * D2 * T2, P);
    const D4 = mod(2n * Z1 * Z2, P);
    const E = mod(B - A, P);
    const F = mod(D4 - C, P);
    const G = mod(D4 + C, P);
    const H = mod(B + A, P);
    return [
      mod(E * F, P),
      mod(G * H, P),
      mod(F * G, P),
      mod(E * H, P),
    ];
  }

  function pointMul(pt, scalar) {
    let Q = NEUTRAL;
    let N = pt;
    let k = scalar;
    while (k > 0n) {
      if (k & 1n) Q = pointAdd(Q, N);
      N = pointAdd(N, N);
      k >>= 1n;
    }
    return Q;
  }

  function bytesToLeBigInt(bytes) {
    let res = 0n;
    for (let i = bytes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      res = (res << 8n) | BigInt(bytes[i]);
    }
    return res;
  }

  function bigIntToLe32(num) {
    const out = new Uint8Array(32);
    let n = num;
    for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
      out[i] = Number(n & 0xffn);
      n >>= 8n;
    }
    return out;
  }

  function encodePoint(pt) {
    const zInv = modInv(pt[2], P);
    const x = mod(pt[0] * zInv, P);
    const y = mod(pt[1] * zInv, P);
    const out = bigIntToLe32(y);
    if (x & 1n) out[31] |= 0x80;
    return out;
  }

  function decodePoint(bytes) {
    if (!bytes || bytes.length !== 32) return null;
    const copy = new Uint8Array(bytes);
    const signX = (copy[31] >> 7) & 1;
    copy[31] &= 0x7f;
    const y = bytesToLeBigInt(copy);
    if (y >= P) return null;

    const y2 = mod(y * y, P);
    const u = mod(y2 - 1n, P);
    const v = mod(D * y2 + 1n, P);
    const v3 = mod(v * v * v, P);
    const v7 = mod(v3 * v3 * v, P);
    let x = mod(u * v3 * powMod(mod(u * v7, P), (P - 5n) / 8n, P), P);

    const check = mod(v * x * x, P);
    if (check !== u) {
      if (check === mod(-u, P)) {
        x = mod(x * SQRT_M1, P);
      } else {
        return null;
      }
    }
    if (x === 0n && signX === 1) return null;
    if ((x & 1n) !== BigInt(signX)) {
      x = mod(P - x, P);
    }
    return [x, y, 1n, mod(x * y, P)];
  }

  function pointsEqual(p1, p2) {
    const lhsX = mod(p1[0] * p2[2], P);
    const rhsX = mod(p2[0] * p1[2], P);
    const lhsY = mod(p1[1] * p2[2], P);
    const rhsY = mod(p2[1] * p1[2], P);
    return lhsX === rhsX && lhsY === rhsY;
  }

  function concatBytes(...arrays) {
    const total = arrays.reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.length, 0);
    const out = new Uint8Array(total);
    let offset = 0;
    for (const a of arrays) {
      out.set(a, offset);
      offset += a.length;
    }
    return out;
  }

  function clampScalar(seed32) {
    const h = sha512(seed32);
    const a = h.slice(0, 32);
    a[0] &= 248;
    a[31] &= 127;
    a[31] |= 64;
    return {
      scalar: bytesToLeBigInt(a),
      prefix: h.slice(32, 64),
    };
  }

  function publicKeyFromSeed(seedBytes) {
    if (!seedBytes || seedBytes.length !== 32) {
      throw new Error('Ed25519 private seed harus tepat 32 byte.');
    }
    const { scalar } = clampScalar(seedBytes);
    return encodePoint(pointMul(BASE, scalar));
  }

  function signMessage(messageBytes, seedBytes) {
    if (!seedBytes || seedBytes.length !== 32) {
      throw new Error('Ed25519 private seed harus tepat 32 byte.');
    }
    const msg = messageBytes instanceof Uint8Array ? messageBytes : new Uint8Array(messageBytes);
    const { scalar, prefix } = clampScalar(seedBytes);
    const pubKeyBytes = encodePoint(pointMul(BASE, scalar));
    const r = bytesToLeBigInt(sha512(concatBytes(prefix, msg))) % L;
    const RBytes = encodePoint(pointMul(BASE, r));
    const k = bytesToLeBigInt(sha512(concatBytes(RBytes, pubKeyBytes, msg))) % L;
    const S = (r + k * scalar) % L;
    return concatBytes(RBytes, bigIntToLe32(S));
  }

  function verifySignature(messageBytes, sigBytes, pubKeyBytes) {
    if (!sigBytes || sigBytes.length !== 64) return false;
    if (!pubKeyBytes || pubKeyBytes.length !== 32) return false;
    const msg = messageBytes instanceof Uint8Array ? messageBytes : new Uint8Array(messageBytes);
    const RBytes = sigBytes.slice(0, 32);
    const S = bytesToLeBigInt(sigBytes.slice(32, 64));
    if (S >= L) return false;

    const A = decodePoint(pubKeyBytes);
    const R = decodePoint(RBytes);
    if (!A || !R) return false;

    const k = bytesToLeBigInt(sha512(concatBytes(RBytes, pubKeyBytes, msg))) % L;
    const lhs = pointMul(BASE, (8n * S) % L);
    const rhs = pointAdd(pointMul(R, 8n), pointMul(A, (8n * k) % L));
    return pointsEqual(lhs, rhs);
  }

  // Base64 helpers (Node + Browser safe)
  function bytesToBase64(bytes) {
    if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && typeof btoa === 'undefined') {
      return Buffer.from(bytes).toString('base64');
    }
    let bin = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
      bin += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
    }
    return btoa(bin);
  }

  function base64ToBytes(b64) {
    const clean = String(b64 || '').trim();
    if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && typeof atob === 'undefined') {
      return new Uint8Array(Buffer.from(clean, 'base64'));
    }
    const bin = atob(clean);
    const out = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) {
      out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
    }
    return out;
  }

  // RFC 4648 Base32 (tanpa padding, identik dengan LicenseService & tool/generate_keypair.dart)
  const B32_ALPHABET = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567';

  function encodeBase32(bytes) {
    if (!bytes || bytes.length === 0) return '';
    let out = '';
    let buffer = 0;
    let bitsLeft = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
      buffer = (buffer << 8) | (bytes[i] & 0xff);
      bitsLeft += 8;
      while (bitsLeft >= 5) {
        const index = (buffer >> (bitsLeft - 5)) & 0x1f;
        bitsLeft -= 5;
        out += B32_ALPHABET[index];
      }
    }
    if (bitsLeft > 0) {
      const index = (buffer << (5 - bitsLeft)) & 0x1f;
      out += B32_ALPHABET[index];
    }
    return out;
  }

  function decodeBase32(str) {
    const clean = String(str || '').trim().toUpperCase().replace(/=+$/, '');
    const bytes = [];
    let buffer = 0;
    let bitsLeft = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < clean.length; i++) {
      const idx = B32_ALPHABET.indexOf(clean[i]);
      if (idx < 0) {
        throw new Error('Karakter Base32 tidak valid: ' + clean[i]);
      }
      buffer = (buffer << 5) | idx;
      bitsLeft += 5;
      if (bitsLeft >= 8) {
        bytes.push((buffer >> (bitsLeft - 8)) & 0xff);
        bitsLeft -= 8;
      }
    }
    return new Uint8Array(bytes);
  }

  function randomSeed32() {
    const seed = new Uint8Array(32);
    if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.getRandomValues === 'function') {
      crypto.getRandomValues(seed);
      return seed;
    }
    if (typeof require === 'function') {
      const nodeCrypto = require('crypto');
      return new Uint8Array(nodeCrypto.randomBytes(32));
    }
    throw new Error('CSPRNG tidak tersedia.');
  }

  function generateKeyPair() {
    const seed = randomSeed32();
    const pub = publicKeyFromSeed(seed);
    return {
      seedBase64: bytesToBase64(seed),
      publicKeyBase64: bytesToBase64(pub),
    };
  }

  function publicKeyFromSeedBase64(seedBase64) {
    const seed = base64ToBytes(seedBase64);
    const pub = publicKeyFromSeed(seed);
    return bytesToBase64(pub);
  }

  function utf8Encode(str) {
    if (typeof TextEncoder !== 'undefined') {
      return new TextEncoder().encode(str);
    }
    return new Uint8Array(Buffer.from(str, 'utf8'));
  }

  function generateLicenseCode({ seedBase64, deviceId, tier, expiryEpochSec }) {
    const cleanDevice = String(deviceId || '').trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\|/g, '');
    const cleanTier = String(tier || 'YEARLY').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!cleanDevice || cleanDevice.length < 4) {
      throw new Error('Device ID tidak valid.');
    }
    if (!['MONTHLY', 'YEARLY', 'LIFETIME'].includes(cleanTier)) {
      throw new Error('Tier lisensi harus MONTHLY, YEARLY, atau LIFETIME.');
    }
    const epoch = cleanTier === 'LIFETIME' ? 0 : Number(expiryEpochSec || 0);
    if (cleanTier !== 'LIFETIME' && (!Number.isFinite(epoch) || epoch <= 0)) {
      throw new Error('ExpiryEpochSec harus bernilai timestamp detik valid.');
    }

    const seedBytes = base64ToBytes(seedBase64);
    const pubBytes = publicKeyFromSeed(seedBytes);
    const payloadString = `${cleanDevice}|${cleanTier}|${Math.floor(epoch)}`;
    const payloadBytes = utf8Encode(payloadString);
    const sigBytes = signMessage(payloadBytes, seedBytes);
    const verified = verifySignature(payloadBytes, sigBytes, pubBytes);
    if (!verified) {
      throw new Error('Verifikasi internal tanda tangan Ed25519 gagal.');
    }

    const code = `KSPRO-${encodeBase32(payloadBytes)}-${encodeBase32(sigBytes)}`;
    return {
      code,
      payloadString,
      publicKeyBase64: bytesToBase64(pubBytes),
      verified,
    };
  }

  function verifyLicenseCode({ code, publicKeyBase64 }) {
    const clean = String(code || '').trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
    const parts = clean.split('-');
    if (parts.length !== 3 || parts[0] !== 'KSPRO') {
      return { valid: false, error: 'Format kode bukan KSPRO-<PAYLOAD>-<SIG>' };
    }
    const payloadBytes = decodeBase32(parts[1]);
    const sigBytes = decodeBase32(parts[2]);
    const pubBytes = base64ToBytes(publicKeyBase64);
    const valid = verifySignature(payloadBytes, sigBytes, pubBytes);
    const payloadString = typeof TextDecoder !== 'undefined'
      ? new TextDecoder().decode(payloadBytes)
      : Buffer.from(payloadBytes).toString('utf8');
    return { valid, payloadString };
  }

  function hexToBytes(hex) {
    const out = new Uint8Array(hex.length / 2);
    for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {
      out[i] = parseInt(hex.substr(i * 2, 2), 16);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * RFC 8032 Section 7.1 TEST 1 verification:
   * Private Seed: 9d61b19deffd5a60ba844af492ec2cc44449c5697b326919703bac031cae7f60
   * Expected Public Key: d75a980182b10ab7d54bfed3c964073a0ee172f3daa62325af021a68f707511a
   * Base64: 11qYAYKxCrfVS/7TyWQHOg7hcvPapiMlrwIaaPcHURo=
   */
  function runSelfTest() {
    const rfcSeedHex = '9d61b19deffd5a60ba844af492ec2cc44449c5697b326919703bac031cae7f60';
    const expectedPubB64 = '11qYAYKxCrfVS/7TyWQHOg7hcvPapiMlrwIaaPcHURo=';
    const seed = hexToBytes(rfcSeedHex);
    const pubB64 = bytesToBase64(publicKeyFromSeed(seed));
    const gen = generateLicenseCode({
      seedBase64: bytesToBase64(seed),
      deviceId: 'KS-TEST1234',
      tier: 'YEARLY',
      expiryEpochSec: 1893456000,
    });
    const checked = verifyLicenseCode({
      code: gen.code,
      publicKeyBase64: pubB64,
    });
    const ok = pubB64 === expectedPubB64 && gen.verified && checked.valid;
    return {
      ok,
      pubB64,
      expectedPubB64,
      sampleCode: gen.code,
      payloadString: checked.payloadString,
    };
  }

  const api = {
    generateKeyPair,
    publicKeyFromSeedBase64,
    signMessage,
    verifySignature,
    encodeBase32,
    decodeBase32,
    generateLicenseCode,
    verifyLicenseCode,
    runSelfTest,
    sha512,
  };

  if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
    module.exports = api;
  }
  root.KasSantriEd25519 = api;
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
```
