```dart
      where: periodeBulan != null && periodeBulan.isNotEmpty
          ? 'periode_bulan = ?'
          : null,
      whereArgs: periodeBulan != null && periodeBulan.isNotEmpty
          ? [periodeBulan]
          : null,
      orderBy: 'tanggal_serah DESC, created_at DESC',
    );
    return rows.map((r) => SerahTerimaInfakModel.fromMap(r)).toList();
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getSaldoKantongInfak() async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    final infakAgg = await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
          WHEN UPPER(TRIM(sumber_dompet)) NOT IN ('REKENING', 'BANK', 'TRANSFER') THEN
            (CASE WHEN is_masak_bebas = 1 THEN 0 ELSE nominal_masak END) +
            (CASE WHEN is_listrik_bebas = 1 THEN 0 ELSE nominal_listrik END) +
            (CASE WHEN jenis_beras = '${InfakSantriModel.berasUangVal}' THEN beras_uang ELSE 0 END)
          ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS masuk_tunai,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
          WHEN UPPER(TRIM(sumber_dompet)) IN ('REKENING', 'BANK', 'TRANSFER') THEN
            (CASE WHEN is_masak_bebas = 1 THEN 0 ELSE nominal_masak END) +
            (CASE WHEN is_listrik_bebas = 1 THEN 0 ELSE nominal_listrik END) +
            (CASE WHEN jenis_beras = '${InfakSantriModel.berasUangVal}' THEN beras_uang ELSE 0 END)
          ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS masuk_rekening,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
          WHEN jenis_beras = '${InfakSantriModel.berasFisik}' THEN beras_liter
          ELSE 0.0
        END), 0.0) AS beras_masuk
      FROM infak_santri
    ''');

    final serahAgg = await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
          WHEN UPPER(TRIM(sumber_dompet)) = 'TUNAI' THEN nominal_uang
          ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS serah_tunai,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
          WHEN UPPER(TRIM(sumber_dompet)) = 'REKENING' THEN nominal_uang
          ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS serah_rekening,
        COALESCE(SUM(jumlah_beras_liter), 0.0) AS beras_serah
      FROM serah_terima_infak
    ''');

    final infRow =
        infakAgg.isNotEmpty ? infakAgg.first : const <String, Object?>{};
    final serRow =
        serahAgg.isNotEmpty ? serahAgg.first : const <String, Object?>{};

    final int masukTunai = (infRow['masuk_tunai'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
    final int masukRekening = (infRow['masuk_rekening'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
    final double berasMasuk =
        (infRow['beras_masuk'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;

    final int serahTunai = (serRow['serah_tunai'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
    final int serahRekening = (serRow['serah_rekening'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
    final double berasSerah =
        (serRow['beras_serah'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;

    final sisaTunai = masukTunai - serahTunai;
    final sisaRekening = masukRekening - serahRekening;
    final sisaBeras = berasMasuk - berasSerah;

    return {
      'tunai': sisaTunai,
      'rekening': sisaRekening,
      'total_uang': sisaTunai + sisaRekening,
      'beras_masuk': berasMasuk,
      'beras_serah': berasSerah,
      'beras_stok': sisaBeras < 0 ? 0.0 : sisaBeras,
    };
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:sqflite/sqflite.dart';

class LedgerRepository {

  const LedgerRepository(this._getDb);

  Future<void> kelolaTunggakan({
    required String santriId,
    required int nominal,
    required String catatan,
    required bool isBayar,
    String sumberDompet = 'TUNAI',
  }) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    final dompet = SantriRepository.normalizeDompet(sumberDompet);
    await db.transaction((txn) async {
      final santriMaps = await txn.query(
        'santri',
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [santriId],
      );
      if (santriMaps.isEmpty) return;

      final santri = Santri.fromMap(santriMaps.first);
      int newTunggakan = santri.tunggakan;
      String newCatatan = santri.catatanTunggakan;

      if (isBayar) {
        newTunggakan = (santri.tunggakan - nominal);
        if (newTunggakan < 0) newTunggakan = 0;
        if (newTunggakan == 0) {
          newCatatan = '';
        } else if (catatan.trim().isNotEmpty) {
          newCatatan = catatan.trim();
        }
      } else {
        newTunggakan = santri.tunggakan + nominal;
        if (catatan.trim().isNotEmpty) {
          newCatatan = catatan.trim();
        } else if (newCatatan.isEmpty) {
          newCatatan = 'Tunggakan Kasbon / Pondok';
        }
      }

      await txn.update(
        'santri',
        {
          'tunggakan': newTunggakan,
          'catatan_tunggakan': newCatatan,
        },
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [santriId],
      );

      final now = DateTime.now();
      await txn.insert('tunggakan_log', {
        'id': const Uuid().v4(),
        'santri_id': santriId,
        'tipe': isBayar ? 'BAYAR' : 'TAMBAH',
        'nominal': nominal,
        'saldo_tunggakan_setelah': newTunggakan,
        'catatan': catatan.trim().isNotEmpty ? catatan.trim() : newCatatan,
        'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
      });

      if (isBayar && nominal > 0) {
        await txn.insert('mutasi_dompet', {
          'id': const Uuid().v4(),
          'jenis_dompet': dompet,
          'tipe': 'MASUK',
          'nominal': nominal,
          'referensi_id': santriId,
          'catatan': 'Pelunasan Tunggakan ${santri.namaLengkap}',
          'tanggal_lokal': DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(now),
          'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
        });
      }
    });
  }

  Future<SetoranBulanan> catatSetoranBaru({
    required String santriId,
    required int nominalSetoran,
    required int durasiHari,
    required int jatahHarianHitung,
    required TipeSetoran tipeSetoran,
    required DateTime tanggalSetor,
    String? catatan,
    PerlakuanSisaSaldoLalu perlakuanSisa =
        PerlakuanSisaSaldoLalu.gabungBulanBaru,
    OpsiSetoranSusulan? opsiSusulan,
    bool potongTunggakan = true,
    String metodeBayar = 'TUNAI',
  }) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    final setoranId = const Uuid().v4();
    final transaksiId = const Uuid().v4();

    final setoran = SetoranBulanan(
      id: setoranId,
      santriId: santriId,
      nominalSetoran: nominalSetoran,
      durasiHari: durasiHari,
      jatahHarianHitung: jatahHarianHitung,
      tipeSetoran: tipeSetoran,
      tanggalSetor: tanggalSetor,
      catatan: catatan,
      perlakuanSisa: perlakuanSisa,
    );

    await db.transaction((txn) async {
      final pengaturanMaps = await txn.query(
        'pengaturan_aplikasi',
        where: 'id = 1',
      );
      final kelipatanPembulatan = pengaturanMaps.isNotEmpty
          ? ((pengaturanMaps.first['pembulatan_jatah'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 500)
          : 500;

      final santriMaps = await txn.query(
        'santri',
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [santriId],
      );
      if (santriMaps.isEmpty) throw Exception('Santri tidak ditemukan');
      final currentSantri = Santri.fromMap(santriMaps.first);

      int sisaSetoranMasukSaldo = nominalSetoran;
      int tunggakanBaru = currentSantri.tunggakan;
      String catatanTunggakanBaru = currentSantri.catatanTunggakan;
      int saldoBaru = currentSantri.saldoTotal;
      int jatahBaru = currentSantri.jatahHarian;
      int nominalPotongTunggakan = 0;
      String logPotongTunggakan = '';

      if (potongTunggakan && tunggakanBaru > 0) {
        if (sisaSetoranMasukSaldo >= tunggakanBaru) {
          nominalPotongTunggakan = tunggakanBaru;
          sisaSetoranMasukSaldo -= tunggakanBaru;
          tunggakanBaru = 0;
          catatanTunggakanBaru = '';
          logPotongTunggakan =
              ' (Potong Lunas Tunggakan ${CurrencyFormatter.format(nominalPotongTunggakan)})';
        } else {
          nominalPotongTunggakan = sisaSetoranMasukSaldo;
          tunggakanBaru -= sisaSetoranMasukSaldo;
          logPotongTunggakan =
              ' (Potong Cicil Tunggakan ${CurrencyFormatter.format(nominalPotongTunggakan)})';
          sisaSetoranMasukSaldo = 0;
        }

        await txn.insert('tunggakan_log', {
          'id': const Uuid().v4(),
          'santri_id': santriId,
          'tipe': 'POTONG_SETORAN',
          'nominal': nominalPotongTunggakan,
          'saldo_tunggakan_setelah': tunggakanBaru,
          'catatan': catatan ?? 'Potong otomatis dari setoran',
          'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
        });
      }

      if (tipeSetoran == TipeSetoran.awalBulan) {
        if (perlakuanSisa == PerlakuanSisaSaldoLalu.simpanTabungan) {
          saldoBaru = sisaSetoranMasukSaldo;
        } else {
          saldoBaru += sisaSetoranMasukSaldo;
        }
        if (durasiHari > 0 && sisaSetoranMasukSaldo > 0) {
          jatahBaru = CurrencyFormatter.hitungJatahHarianBulat(
            sisaSetoranMasukSaldo,
            durasiHari,
            kelipatan: kelipatanPembulatan,
          );
        } else if (sisaSetoranMasukSaldo == 0) {
          jatahBaru = currentSantri.jatahHarian;
        } else {
          jatahBaru = jatahHarianHitung;
        }
      } else {
        saldoBaru += sisaSetoranMasukSaldo;
        if (opsiSusulan == OpsiSetoranSusulan.tambahJatahHarian) {
          final tambahanJatah = durasiHari > 0
              ? CurrencyFormatter.hitungJatahHarianBulat(
                  sisaSetoranMasukSaldo,
                  durasiHari,
                  kelipatan: kelipatanPembulatan,
                )
              : 0;
          jatahBaru += tambahanJatah;
        } else if (opsiSusulan == null &&
            durasiHari > 0 &&
            sisaSetoranMasukSaldo > 0) {
          jatahBaru = CurrencyFormatter.hitungJatahHarianBulat(
            sisaSetoranMasukSaldo,
            durasiHari,
            kelipatan: kelipatanPembulatan,
          );
        }
      }

      final dompet = SantriRepository.normalizeDompet(metodeBayar);
      final setoranMap = setoran.toMap();
      setoranMap['jatah_harian_hitung'] = jatahBaru;
      setoranMap['metode_bayar'] = dompet;
      setoranMap['potong_tunggakan'] =
          (potongTunggakan && nominalPotongTunggakan > 0) ? 1 : 0;
      setoranMap['nominal_potong_tunggakan'] = nominalPotongTunggakan;
      await txn.insert('setoran_bulanan', setoranMap);

      await txn.update(
        'santri',
        {
          'saldo_total': saldoBaru,
          'jatah_harian': jatahBaru,
          'tunggakan': tunggakanBaru,
          'catatan_tunggakan': catatanTunggakanBaru,
        },
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [santriId],
      );

      final now = DateTime.now();
      final tglStr = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(tanggalSetor);
      final transaksiMutasi = TransaksiHarian(
        id: transaksiId,
        santriId: santriId,
        nominal: nominalSetoran,
        waktuAmbil: now,
        tanggalLokal: tglStr,
        kategoriWaktu: TimeCategory.setoran,
        catatan: (catatan != null && catatan.isNotEmpty)
            ? '$catatan$logPotongTunggakan'
            : (tipeSetoran == TipeSetoran.awalBulan
                ? 'Setoran Awal Bulan$logPotongTunggakan'
                : 'Top-Up Susulan$logPotongTunggakan'),
        saldoSetelahTransaksi: saldoBaru,
        tipe: TipeTransaksi.setoran,
        sumberDompet: dompet,
      );
      await txn.insert('transaksi_harian', transaksiMutasi.toMap());

      await txn.insert('mutasi_dompet', {
        'id': const Uuid().v4(),
        'jenis_dompet': dompet,
        'tipe': 'MASUK',
        'nominal': nominalSetoran,
        'referensi_id': transaksiId,
        'catatan': 'Setoran ${currentSantri.namaLengkap}',
        'tanggal_lokal': tglStr,
        'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),

  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getAllSetoranByDateRange({
    String? tanggalMulai,
    String? tanggalSelesai,
  }) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    final conditions = <String>[];
    final args = <dynamic>[];
    if (tanggalMulai != null && tanggalMulai.isNotEmpty) {
      conditions.add('tanggal_setor >= ?');
      args.add(tanggalMulai);
    }
    if (tanggalSelesai != null && tanggalSelesai.isNotEmpty) {
      conditions.add('tanggal_setor <= ?');
      args.add(tanggalSelesai);
    }
    final whereClause = conditions.isEmpty ? null : conditions.join(' AND ');
    return db.query(
      'setoran_bulanan',
      where: whereClause,
      whereArgs: args.isEmpty ? null : args,
      orderBy: 'tanggal_setor DESC',
    );
  }

            'setoran_bulanan',
            columns: ['tanggal_setor', 'durasi_hari'],
            where: 'santri_id = ?',
            whereArgs: [santriId],
            orderBy: 'tanggal_setor DESC, rowid DESC',
            limit: 1,
          );
          if (latestSetoranRows.isNotEmpty) {
            final tglSetorStr =
                latestSetoranRows.first['tanggal_setor']?.toString() ?? '';
            final durasi =
                (latestSetoranRows.first['durasi_hari'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 30;
            final tglSetor = DateTime.tryParse(tglSetorStr);
            if (tglSetor != null && durasi > 0) {
              final tglAmbil = DateTime(waktu.year, waktu.month, waktu.day);
              final startDay = DateTime(
                tglSetor.year,
                tglSetor.month,
                tglSetor.day,
              );
              final elapsedDays = tglAmbil.difference(startDay).inDays + 1;
              sisaHariPeriode = (durasi - elapsedDays).clamp(1, durasi);
            }
          }
          if (sisaHariPeriode <= 0) {
            sisaHariPeriode = santri.jatahHarian > 0
                ? (saldoBaru / santri.jatahHarian).ceil().clamp(1, 30)
                : 20;
          }

          final pengaturanMaps = await txn.query(
            'pengaturan_aplikasi',
            where: 'id = 1',
          );
          final kelipatan = pengaturanMaps.isNotEmpty
              ? ((pengaturanMaps.first['pembulatan_jatah'] as num?)?.toInt() ??
                  500)
              : 500;
          final jatahBaru = CurrencyFormatter.hitungJatahHarianBulat(
            saldoBaru,
            sisaHariPeriode,
            kelipatan: kelipatan,
          );
          updateData['jatah_harian'] = jatahBaru;
        }
      }

      await txn.update(
        'santri',
        updateData,
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [santriId],
      );
    });

    return transaksi;
  }

  Future<void> voidTransaksi(String transaksiId) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    await db.transaction((txn) async {
      final txMaps = await txn.query(
        'transaksi_harian',
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [transaksiId],
      );
      if (txMaps.isEmpty) return;
      final tx = TransaksiHarian.fromMap(txMaps.first);
      if (tx.isVoided) return;

      await txn.update(
        'transaksi_harian',
        {'is_void': 1},
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [transaksiId],
      );

      final santriMaps = await txn.query(
        'santri',
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [tx.santriId],
      );
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final dompetAsal = SantriRepository.normalizeDompet(tx.sumberDompet);
      if (santriMaps.isNotEmpty) {
        final currentSantri = Santri.fromMap(santriMaps.first);
        if (tx.tipe == TipeTransaksi.pengambilan) {
          int sisaRefund = tx.nominal;
          int tunggakanBaru = currentSantri.tunggakan;
          String catatanTunggakanBaru = currentSantri.catatanTunggakan;
          int saldoBaru = currentSantri.saldoTotal;
          int nominalRollbackTunggakan = 0;

          if (tunggakanBaru > 0) {
            if (sisaRefund >= tunggakanBaru) {
              nominalRollbackTunggakan = tunggakanBaru;
              sisaRefund -= tunggakanBaru;
              tunggakanBaru = 0;
              catatanTunggakanBaru = '';
            } else {
              nominalRollbackTunggakan = sisaRefund;
              tunggakanBaru -= sisaRefund;
              sisaRefund = 0;
            }
          }
          saldoBaru += sisaRefund;

          await txn.update(
            'santri',
            {
              'saldo_total': saldoBaru,
              'tunggakan': tunggakanBaru,
              'catatan_tunggakan': catatanTunggakanBaru,
            },
            where: 'id = ?',
            whereArgs: [tx.santriId],
          );

          await txn.insert('mutasi_dompet', {
            'id': const Uuid().v4(),
            'jenis_dompet': dompetAsal,
            'tipe': 'MASUK',
            'nominal': tx.nominal,
            'referensi_id': tx.id,
            'catatan': 'Void Pengambilan ${currentSantri.namaLengkap}',
            'tanggal_lokal': DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(now),
            'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
          });

          if (nominalRollbackTunggakan > 0) {
            await txn.insert('tunggakan_log', {
              'id': const Uuid().v4(),
              'santri_id': tx.santriId,
              'tipe': 'ROLLBACK_VOID',
              'nominal': nominalRollbackTunggakan,
              'saldo_tunggakan_setelah': tunggakanBaru,
              'catatan': 'Pembatalan transaksi ${tx.id}',
              'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
            });
          }
        } else {
          int nominalPotongTunggakan = 0;
          final matchingSetoran = await txn.query(
            'setoran_bulanan',
            where:
                'santri_id = ? AND tanggal_setor = ? AND nominal_setoran = ?',
            whereArgs: [tx.santriId, tx.tanggalLokal, tx.nominal],
            orderBy: 'rowid DESC',
            limit: 1,
          );
          if (matchingSetoran.isNotEmpty) {
            final setoranRow = matchingSetoran.first;
            nominalPotongTunggakan =
                (setoranRow['nominal_potong_tunggakan'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
            final setoranId = setoranRow['id']?.toString();
            if (setoranId != null && setoranId.isNotEmpty) {
              await txn.delete(
                'setoran_bulanan',
                where: 'id = ?',
                whereArgs: [setoranId],
              );
            }
          }

          final int porsiSaldoJajan =
              (tx.nominal - nominalPotongTunggakan).clamp(0, tx.nominal);
          int tunggakanBaru = currentSantri.tunggakan + nominalPotongTunggakan;
          String catatanTunggakanBaru = currentSantri.catatanTunggakan;
          if (nominalPotongTunggakan > 0 && catatanTunggakanBaru.isEmpty) {
            catatanTunggakanBaru = 'Pemulihan Tunggakan (Void Setoran)';
          }

          int saldoBaru = currentSantri.saldoTotal;
          int selisihTerpakai = 0;
          if (currentSantri.saldoTotal >= porsiSaldoJajan) {
            saldoBaru = currentSantri.saldoTotal - porsiSaldoJajan;
          } else {
            selisihTerpakai = porsiSaldoJajan - currentSantri.saldoTotal;
            saldoBaru = 0;
            tunggakanBaru += selisihTerpakai;
            catatanTunggakanBaru = catatanTunggakanBaru.isEmpty
                ? 'Talangan Kas Pondok (Void Setoran)'
                : '$catatanTunggakanBaru, Talangan Void Setoran';
          }

          await txn.update(
            'santri',
            {
              'saldo_total': saldoBaru,
              'tunggakan': tunggakanBaru,
              'catatan_tunggakan': catatanTunggakanBaru,
            },
            where: 'id = ?',
            whereArgs: [tx.santriId],
          );

          if (nominalPotongTunggakan > 0) {
            await txn.insert('tunggakan_log', {
              'id': const Uuid().v4(),
              'santri_id': tx.santriId,
              'tipe': 'ROLLBACK_POTONG_SETORAN',
              'nominal': nominalPotongTunggakan,
              'saldo_tunggakan_setelah':
                  currentSantri.tunggakan + nominalPotongTunggakan,
              'catatan':
                  'Pemulihan potongan tunggakan dari Void Setoran ${tx.id}',
              'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
            });
          }

          if (selisihTerpakai > 0) {
            await txn.insert('tunggakan_log', {
              'id': const Uuid().v4(),
              'santri_id': tx.santriId,
              'tipe': 'TALANGAN_SALDO',
              'nominal': selisihTerpakai,
              'saldo_tunggakan_setelah': tunggakanBaru,
              'catatan':
                  'Selisih saldo terpakai dari pembatalan setoran ${tx.id}',
              'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
            });
          }

          final tglNow = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(now);
          await txn.insert('mutasi_dompet', {
            'id': const Uuid().v4(),
            'jenis_dompet': dompetAsal,
            'tipe': 'KELUAR',
            'nominal': tx.nominal,
            'referensi_id': tx.id,
            'catatan': 'Void Setoran ${currentSantri.namaLengkap}',
            'tanggal_lokal': tglNow,
            'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
          });

          final int koreksiPiutangDompet =
              nominalPotongTunggakan + selisihTerpakai;
          if (koreksiPiutangDompet > 0) {
            await txn.insert('mutasi_dompet', {
              'id': const Uuid().v4(),
              'jenis_dompet': dompetAsal,
              'tipe': 'MASUK',
              'nominal': koreksiPiutangDompet,
              'referensi_id': tx.id,
              'catatan':
                  'Rekonsiliasi Piutang/Tunggakan atas Void Setoran ${currentSantri.namaLengkap}',
              'tanggal_lokal': tglNow,
              'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
            });
          }
        }
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> editTransaksi(String id, int newNominal, String? note) async {
    if (newNominal <= 0) {
      throw ArgumentError('Nominal transaksi harus lebih dari Rp 0.');
    }
    final db = await _getDb();
    await db.transaction((txn) async {
      final maps = await txn.query(
        'transaksi_harian',
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [id],
      );
      if (maps.isEmpty) return;

      final tx = TransaksiHarian.fromMap(maps.first);
      if (tx.isVoided) return;

      final int diff = newNominal - tx.nominal;
      final santriMaps = await txn.query(
        'santri',
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [tx.santriId],
      );
      if (santriMaps.isEmpty) return;

      final currentSantri = Santri.fromMap(santriMaps.first);
      final dompet = SantriRepository.normalizeDompet(tx.sumberDompet);
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final tglNow = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(now);

      int saldoBaru = currentSantri.saldoTotal;
      int tunggakanBaru = currentSantri.tunggakan;
      String catatanTunggakanBaru = currentSantri.catatanTunggakan;
      int deltaDompet = 0;

      if (tx.tipe == TipeTransaksi.pengambilan) {
        if (diff > 0) {
          if (currentSantri.saldoTotal >= diff) {
            saldoBaru = currentSantri.saldoTotal - diff;
            deltaDompet = -diff;
          } else {
            final int terpotongDariSaldo = currentSantri.saldoTotal;
            final int tambahanTunggakan = diff - terpotongDariSaldo;
            saldoBaru = 0;
            tunggakanBaru += tambahanTunggakan;
            catatanTunggakanBaru = catatanTunggakanBaru.isEmpty
                ? 'Talangan Kas Pondok'
                : catatanTunggakanBaru;
            deltaDompet = -terpotongDariSaldo;

            await txn.insert('tunggakan_log', {
              'id': const Uuid().v4(),
              'santri_id': tx.santriId,
              'tipe': 'TALANGAN_SALDO',
              'nominal': tambahanTunggakan,
              'saldo_tunggakan_setelah': tunggakanBaru,
              'catatan': note ?? 'Koreksi Edit Pengambilan ${tx.id}',
              'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
            });
          }
        } else if (diff < 0) {
          int sisaRefund = -diff;
          int nominalRollbackTunggakan = 0;
          if (tunggakanBaru > 0) {
            if (sisaRefund >= tunggakanBaru) {
              nominalRollbackTunggakan = tunggakanBaru;
              sisaRefund -= tunggakanBaru;
              tunggakanBaru = 0;
              catatanTunggakanBaru = '';
            } else {
              nominalRollbackTunggakan = sisaRefund;
              tunggakanBaru -= sisaRefund;
              sisaRefund = 0;
            }
          }
          saldoBaru += sisaRefund;
          deltaDompet = sisaRefund;

          if (nominalRollbackTunggakan > 0) {
            await txn.insert('tunggakan_log', {
              'id': const Uuid().v4(),
              'santri_id': tx.santriId,
              'tipe': 'KOREKSI_EDIT',
              'nominal': nominalRollbackTunggakan,
              'saldo_tunggakan_setelah': tunggakanBaru,
              'catatan': 'Pengurangan tunggakan dari edit transaksi ${tx.id}',
              'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
            });
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (diff > 0) {
          saldoBaru = currentSantri.saldoTotal + diff;
          deltaDompet = diff;
        } else if (diff < 0) {
          final int pengurangan = -diff;
          if (currentSantri.saldoTotal >= pengurangan) {
            saldoBaru = currentSantri.saldoTotal - pengurangan;
            deltaDompet = -pengurangan;
          } else {
            final int terpotongDariSaldo = currentSantri.saldoTotal;
            final int tambahanTunggakan = pengurangan - terpotongDariSaldo;
            saldoBaru = 0;
            tunggakanBaru += tambahanTunggakan;
            catatanTunggakanBaru = catatanTunggakanBaru.isEmpty
                ? 'Talangan Kas Pondok (Koreksi Setoran)'
                : catatanTunggakanBaru;
            deltaDompet = -terpotongDariSaldo;

            await txn.insert('tunggakan_log', {
              'id': const Uuid().v4(),
              'santri_id': tx.santriId,
              'tipe': 'TALANGAN_SALDO',
              'nominal': tambahanTunggakan,
              'saldo_tunggakan_setelah': tunggakanBaru,
              'catatan': note ?? 'Selisih koreksi edit setoran ${tx.id}',
              'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
            });
          }
        }
      }

      await txn.update(
        'transaksi_harian',
        {
          'nominal': newNominal,
          'catatan': note,
          'saldo_setelah_transaksi': saldoBaru,
          'is_overlimit':
              (tx.isOverlimit || tunggakanBaru > currentSantri.tunggakan)
                  ? 1
                  : 0,
        },
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [id],
      );

      await txn.update(
        'santri',
        {
          'saldo_total': saldoBaru,
          'tunggakan': tunggakanBaru,
          'catatan_tunggakan': catatanTunggakanBaru,
        },
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [tx.santriId],
      );

      if (deltaDompet != 0) {
        await txn.insert('mutasi_dompet', {
          'id': const Uuid().v4(),
          'jenis_dompet': dompet,
          'tipe': deltaDompet > 0 ? 'MASUK' : 'KELUAR',
          'nominal': deltaDompet.abs(),
          'referensi_id': tx.id,
          'catatan':
              'Koreksi Edit Transaksi ${currentSantri.namaLengkap}${note != null && note.isNotEmpty ? ' ($note)' : ''}',
          'tanggal_lokal': tglNow,
          'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
        });
      }
    });
  }

  Future<List<TransaksiHarian>> getBukuMutasiSantri(
    String santriId, {
    String? tanggalMulai,
    String? tanggalSelesai,
  }) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    String where = 'santri_id = ?';
    final List<dynamic> args = [santriId];

    if (tanggalMulai != null && tanggalSelesai != null) {
      where += ' AND tanggal_lokal BETWEEN ? AND ?';
      args.addAll([tanggalMulai, tanggalSelesai]);
    } else if (tanggalMulai != null) {
      where += ' AND tanggal_lokal >= ?';
      args.add(tanggalMulai);
    }

    final maps = await db.query(
      'transaksi_harian',
      where: where,
      whereArgs: args,
      orderBy: 'waktu_ambil DESC',
    );
    return maps.map((m) => TransaksiHarian.fromMap(m)).toList();
  }

  Future<int> getTotalPengambilanHariIni(
    String santriId,
    String tanggalLokal,
  ) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    final result = await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT SUM(nominal) as total 
      FROM transaksi_harian 
      WHERE santri_id = ? 
        AND tanggal_lokal = ? 
        AND is_void = 0 
        AND tipe = 'PENGAMBILAN'
    ''', [santriId, tanggalLokal]);

    final total = result.first['total'];
    return (total as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
  }

  Future<List<TransaksiHarian>> getTransaksiHariIni(
    String santriId,
    String tanggalLokal,
  ) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    final maps = await db.query(
      'transaksi_harian',
      where:
          'santri_id = ? AND tanggal_lokal = ? AND is_void = 0 AND tipe = "PENGAMBILAN"',

  Future<Map<String, List<TransaksiHarian>>>
      getAllTransaksiPengambilanHariIniMap(String tanggalLokal) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    final maps = await db.query(
      'transaksi_harian',
      where: "tanggal_lokal = ? AND is_void = 0 AND tipe = 'PENGAMBILAN'",
      whereArgs: [tanggalLokal],
      orderBy: 'waktu_ambil ASC',
    );
    final grouped = <String, List<TransaksiHarian>>{};
    for (final m in maps) {
      final tx = TransaksiHarian.fromMap(m);
      grouped.putIfAbsent(tx.santriId, () => <TransaksiHarian>[]).add(tx);
    }
    return grouped;
  }

  Future<Map<String, int>> computeEffectiveDailyQuotaMap({
    required String todayLokal,
    required List<Santri> activeSantri,
    required ModeSisaHarian modeSisaHarian,
  }) async {
    final result = <String, int>{
      for (final s in activeSantri) s.id: s.jatahHarian,
    };
    if (activeSantri.isEmpty) return result;

    final todayDate = DateFormatter.parseLocalDate(todayLokal);
    final yesterdayDate = todayDate.subtract(const Duration(days: 1));
    final yesterdayLokal = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(yesterdayDate);

    final db = await _getDb();

    if (modeSisaHarian == ModeSisaHarian.ketat) {
      final yesterdayRows = await db.rawQuery('''
        SELECT
          santri_id,
          COALESCE(SUM(nominal), 0) AS total_kemarin,
          MAX(CASE WHEN overlimit_handling = 'POTONG_BESOK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_potong_besok
        FROM transaksi_harian
        WHERE tanggal_lokal = ?
          AND is_void = 0
          AND tipe = 'PENGAMBILAN'
        GROUP BY santri_id
      ''', [yesterdayLokal]);

      final yesterdayBySantri = <String, ({int total, bool hasPotongBesok})>{};
      for (final r in yesterdayRows) {
        final sid = r['santri_id']?.toString() ?? '';
        if (sid.isEmpty) continue;
        yesterdayBySantri[sid] = (
          total: (r['total_kemarin'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
          hasPotongBesok: ((r['has_potong_besok'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0) == 1,
        );
      }

      for (final s in activeSantri) {
        final yInfo = yesterdayBySantri[s.id];
        if (yInfo != null &&
            yInfo.hasPotongBesok &&
            yInfo.total > s.jatahHarian) {
          final excess = yInfo.total - s.jatahHarian;
          result[s.id] = (s.jatahHarian - excess).clamp(0, s.jatahHarian);
        }
      }
      return result;
    }

    final setoranRows = await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT santri_id, MAX(tanggal_setor) AS last_setor
      FROM setoran_bulanan
      WHERE tanggal_setor < ?
      GROUP BY santri_id
    ''', [todayLokal]);

    final lastSetorBySantri = <String, String>{};
    for (final r in setoranRows) {
      final sid = r['santri_id']?.toString() ?? '';
      final tgl = r['last_setor']?.toString() ?? '';
      if (sid.isNotEmpty && tgl.isNotEmpty) {
        lastSetorBySantri[sid] = tgl;
      }
    }

    final priorTxRows = await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT
        santri_id,
        tanggal_lokal,
        COALESCE(SUM(nominal), 0) AS total_hari
      FROM transaksi_harian
      WHERE tanggal_lokal < ?
        AND is_void = 0
        AND tipe = 'PENGAMBILAN'
      GROUP BY santri_id, tanggal_lokal
    ''', [todayLokal]);

    final txBySantri = <String, List<({String tanggal, int total})>>{};
    for (final r in priorTxRows) {
      final sid = r['santri_id']?.toString() ?? '';
      final tgl = r['tanggal_lokal']?.toString() ?? '';
      final tot = (r['total_hari'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
      if (sid.isNotEmpty && tgl.isNotEmpty) {
        txBySantri
            .putIfAbsent(sid, () => <({String tanggal, int total})>[])
            .add((tanggal: tgl, total: tot));
      }
    }

    for (final s in activeSantri) {
      String? anchorStr = lastSetorBySantri[s.id];
      final txList =
          txBySantri[s.id] ?? const <({String tanggal, int total})>[];
      if (anchorStr == null && txList.isNotEmpty) {
        anchorStr = txList
            .map((e) => e.tanggal)
            .reduce((a, b) => a.compareTo(b) <= 0 ? a : b);
      }
      if (anchorStr == null) {
        result[s.id] = s.jatahHarian;
        continue;
      }

      final anchorDate = DateFormatter.parseLocalDate(anchorStr);
      final elapsedDays = todayDate.difference(anchorDate).inDays.clamp(0, 30);
      if (elapsedDays <= 0) {
        result[s.id] = s.jatahHarian;
        continue;
      }

      int totalAmbilSejakAnchor = 0;
      for (final item in txList) {
        if (item.tanggal.compareTo(anchorStr) >= 0) {
          totalAmbilSejakAnchor += item.total;
        }
      }

      final int totalKuotaLalu = elapsedDays * s.jatahHarian;
      final int sisaAkumulasiLalu = totalKuotaLalu - totalAmbilSejakAnchor;
      final int jatahEfektif = (s.jatahHarian + sisaAkumulasiLalu).clamp(
        0,
        s.saldoTotal > s.jatahHarian
            ? s.saldoTotal
            : s.jatahHarian * (elapsedDays + 1),
      );
      result[s.id] = jatahEfektif;
    }

    return result;
  }

  Future<List<TransaksiHarian>> getAllTransaksi({
    String? santriId,
    String? kategoriWaktu,
    String? tanggalMulai,
    String? tanggalSelesai,
    int? limit,
  }) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    String where = 'is_void = 0';
    final List<dynamic> args = [];

    if (santriId != null && santriId.isNotEmpty && santriId != 'ALL') {
      where += ' AND santri_id = ?';
      args.add(santriId);
    }

    if (kategoriWaktu != null &&
        kategoriWaktu.isNotEmpty &&
        kategoriWaktu != 'ALL') {
      where += ' AND kategori_waktu = ?';
      args.add(kategoriWaktu);
    }

    if (tanggalMulai != null && tanggalMulai.isNotEmpty) {
      where += ' AND tanggal_lokal >= ?';
      args.add(tanggalMulai);
    }

    if (tanggalSelesai != null && tanggalSelesai.isNotEmpty) {
      where += ' AND tanggal_lokal <= ?';

    final resPengeluaran = await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT SUM(nominal) as total
      FROM transaksi_harian
      WHERE tanggal_lokal LIKE ? AND is_void = 0 AND tipe = 'PENGAMBILAN'
    ''', [prefix]);

    final resPemasukan = await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT SUM(nominal_setoran) as total
      FROM setoran_bulanan
      WHERE tanggal_setor LIKE ?
    ''', [prefix]);

    final keluar = (resPengeluaran.first['total'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;

    return {

      'pengeluaran': keluar,
      'net': masuk - keluar,
    };
  }

  Future<Map<String, int>> getSaldoDompet() async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    final countRes = await db.rawQuery(
      'SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM mutasi_dompet',
    );
    final cnt = (countRes.first['cnt'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;

    if (cnt == 0) {
      final totalBrankas = await getTotalSaldoBrankasFisik();
      if (totalBrankas > 0) {
        final now = DateTime.now();
        await db.insert('mutasi_dompet', {
          'id': const Uuid().v4(),
          'jenis_dompet': 'TUNAI',
          'tipe': 'MASUK',
          'nominal': totalBrankas,
          'referensi_id': 'SALDO_AWAL',
          'catatan': 'Inisialisasi Kas Laci Tunai',
          'tanggal_lokal': DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(now),
          'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
        });
      }
    }

    final agg = await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
          WHEN UPPER(TRIM(tipe)) = 'TARIK_TUNAI' THEN nominal
          WHEN UPPER(TRIM(tipe)) = 'MASUK' AND UPPER(TRIM(jenis_dompet)) NOT IN ('REKENING', 'BANK', 'TRANSFER') THEN nominal
          WHEN UPPER(TRIM(tipe)) = 'KELUAR' AND UPPER(TRIM(jenis_dompet)) NOT IN ('REKENING', 'BANK', 'TRANSFER') THEN -nominal
          ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS tunai,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
          WHEN UPPER(TRIM(tipe)) = 'TARIK_TUNAI' THEN -nominal
          WHEN UPPER(TRIM(tipe)) = 'MASUK' AND UPPER(TRIM(jenis_dompet)) IN ('REKENING', 'BANK', 'TRANSFER') THEN nominal
          WHEN UPPER(TRIM(tipe)) = 'KELUAR' AND UPPER(TRIM(jenis_dompet)) IN ('REKENING', 'BANK', 'TRANSFER') THEN -nominal
          ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS rekening
      FROM mutasi_dompet
    ''');

    final row = agg.isNotEmpty ? agg.first : const <String, Object?>{};
    return {
      'tunai': (row['tunai'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      'rekening': (row['rekening'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
    };
  }

  Future<void> tarikTunaiKeLaci({required int nominal, String? catatan}) async {
    if (nominal <= 0) {
      throw Exception('Nominal tarik tunai harus lebih dari Rp 0');
    }
    final saldo = await getSaldoDompet();
    final saldoBank = saldo['rekening'] ?? 0;
    if (nominal > saldoBank) {
      throw Exception(
        'Saldo Rekening Bank tidak mencukupi (${CurrencyFormatter.format(saldoBank)})',
      );
    }

    final db = await _getDb();
    final now = DateTime.now();
    await db.insert('mutasi_dompet', {
      'id': const Uuid().v4(),
      'jenis_dompet': 'TUNAI',
      'tipe': 'TARIK_TUNAI',
      'nominal': nominal,
      'referensi_id': 'ATM_LACI',
      'catatan': (catatan != null && catatan.trim().isNotEmpty)
          ? catatan.trim()
          : 'Tarik Tunai Bank ke Kas Laci',
      'tanggal_lokal': DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(now),
      'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
    });
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getRecentTarikTunaiLogs({
    int limit = 5,
  }) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    return await db.query(
      'mutasi_dompet',
      where: "tipe = 'TARIK_TUNAI'",
      orderBy: 'created_at DESC',
      limit: limit,
    );
  }

  Future<void> insertCashOpnameLog(CashOpnameLog log) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    await db.insert('cash_opname_logs', log.toMap());
  }

  Future<List<CashOpnameLog>> getCashOpnameLogs({int limit = 15}) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    final maps = await db.query(
      'cash_opname_logs',
      orderBy: 'created_at DESC',
      limit: limit,
    );
    return maps.map((m) => CashOpnameLog.fromMap(m)).toList();
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getTransaksiByDateRange({
    String? tanggalMulai,
    String? tanggalSelesai,
  }) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    final conditions = <String>[];
    final args = <dynamic>[];
    if (tanggalMulai != null && tanggalMulai.isNotEmpty) {
      conditions.add('t.tanggal_lokal >= ?');
      args.add(tanggalMulai);
    }
    if (tanggalSelesai != null && tanggalSelesai.isNotEmpty) {
      conditions.add('t.tanggal_lokal <= ?');
      args.add(tanggalSelesai);
    }
    final whereClause =
        conditions.isEmpty ? '' : 'WHERE ${conditions.join(' AND ')}';
    return await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT t.*, s.nama_lengkap, s.kamar
      FROM transaksi_harian t
      LEFT JOIN santri s ON t.santri_id = s.id
      $whereClause
      ORDER BY t.waktu_ambil DESC
    ''', args);
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getAllMutasiDompet({
    String? tanggalMulai,
    String? tanggalSelesai,
  }) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    final conditions = <String>[];
    final args = <dynamic>[];
    if (tanggalMulai != null && tanggalMulai.isNotEmpty) {
      conditions.add('tanggal_lokal >= ?');
      args.add(tanggalMulai);
    }
    if (tanggalSelesai != null && tanggalSelesai.isNotEmpty) {
      conditions.add('tanggal_lokal <= ?');
      args.add(tanggalSelesai);
    }
    final whereClause = conditions.isEmpty ? null : conditions.join(' AND ');
    return await db.query(
      'mutasi_dompet',
      where: whereClause,
      whereArgs: args.isEmpty ? null : args,
      orderBy: 'created_at DESC',
    );
  }

  Future<int> getVoidCountSince(DateTime since) async {
    final db = await _getDb();

      'SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM transaksi_harian WHERE is_void = 1 AND waktu_ambil >= ?',
      [since.toIso8601String()],
    );
    return (rows.first['cnt'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
  }
```

```dart
import 'package:sqflite/sqflite.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';
import '../../models/pengaturan.dart';
import '../../models/santri.dart';
import '../../utils/date_formatter.dart';

class SantriRepository {
  final Future<Database> Function() _getDb;

  const SantriRepository(this._getDb);

  static String normalizeDompet(String raw) {
    final upper = raw.toUpperCase().trim();
    if (upper == 'REKENING' || upper == 'BANK' || upper == 'TRANSFER') {
      return 'REKENING';
    }
    return 'TUNAI';
  }

  Future<List<Santri>> getAllSantri({bool onlyActive = true}) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    final where = onlyActive ? 'status_aktif = 1' : null;
    final maps = await db.query(
      'santri',
      where: where,
      orderBy: 'kamar ASC, nama_lengkap ASC',
    );
    return maps.map((m) => Santri.fromMap(m)).toList();
  }

  Future<Santri?> getSantriById(String id) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    final maps = await db.query('santri', where: 'id = ?', whereArgs: [id]);
    if (maps.isNotEmpty) {
      return Santri.fromMap(maps.first);
    }
    return null;
  }

  Future<Santri?> getSantriByQrCode(String rawCode) async {
    final code = rawCode.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (code.isEmpty) return null;
    final db = await _getDb();
    final maps = await db.query(
      'santri',
      where: '(UPPER(qr_code) = ? OR UPPER(id) = ?) AND status_aktif = 1',
      whereArgs: [code, code],
      limit: 1,
    );
    if (maps.isEmpty) return null;
    return Santri.fromMap(maps.first);
  }

  Future<int> insertSantri(
    Santri santri, {
    String sumberDompet = 'TUNAI',
  }) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    final dompet = normalizeDompet(sumberDompet);
    await db.transaction((txn) async {
      await txn.insert('santri', santri.toMap());
      if (santri.saldoTotal > 0) {
        final now = DateTime.now();
        await txn.insert('mutasi_dompet', {
          'id': const Uuid().v4(),
          'jenis_dompet': dompet,
          'tipe': 'MASUK',
          'nominal': santri.saldoTotal,
          'referensi_id': santri.id,
          'catatan': 'Saldo Awal ${santri.namaLengkap}',
          'tanggal_lokal': DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(now),
          'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
        });
      }
    });
    return 1;
  }

  Future<int> updateSantri(Santri santri) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    return await db.update(
      'santri',
      santri.toMap(),
      where: 'id = ?',
      whereArgs: [santri.id],
    );
  }

      where: 'id = ?',
      whereArgs: [santriId],
    );
  }

    required String namaLengkap,
    required String namaPanggilan,
    required String kamar,
    String? noWaWali,
    required int jatahHarian,
  }) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    await db.update(
      'santri',
      {
        'nama_lengkap': namaLengkap,
        'nama_panggilan': namaPanggilan,
        'kamar': kamar,
        'no_wa_wali': noWaWali,
        'jatah_harian': jatahHarian,
      },
      where: 'id = ?',
      whereArgs: [santriId],
    );
  }

  Future<void> toggleSantriStatus(String id, bool active) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    await db.update(
      'santri',
      {'status_aktif': active ? 1 : 0},
      where: 'id = ?',
      whereArgs: [id],
    );
  }

  Future<int> deleteSantri(
    String santriId, {
    String sumberDompet = 'TUNAI',
  }) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    final dompet = normalizeDompet(sumberDompet);
    int refundedSaldo = 0;
    await db.transaction((txn) async {
      final santriMaps = await txn.query(
        'santri',
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [santriId],
      );
      if (santriMaps.isNotEmpty) {
        final santri = Santri.fromMap(santriMaps.first);
        if (santri.saldoTotal > 0) {
          refundedSaldo = santri.saldoTotal;
          final now = DateTime.now();
          await txn.insert('mutasi_dompet', {
            'id': const Uuid().v4(),
            'jenis_dompet': dompet,
            'tipe': 'KELUAR',
            'nominal': refundedSaldo,
            'referensi_id': santriId,
            'catatan':
                'Pengembalian/Penghapusan Saldo Santri ${santri.namaLengkap}',
            'tanggal_lokal': DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(now),
            'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
          });
        }
      }
      await txn.delete(
        'infak_santri',
        where: 'santri_id = ?',
        whereArgs: [santriId],
      );
      await txn.delete(
        'tunggakan_log',
        where: 'santri_id = ?',
        whereArgs: [santriId],
      );
      await txn.delete(
        'transaksi_harian',
        where: 'santri_id = ?',
        whereArgs: [santriId],
      );
      await txn.delete(
        'setoran_bulanan',
        where: 'santri_id = ?',
        whereArgs: [santriId],
      );
      await txn.delete('santri', where: 'id = ?', whereArgs: [santriId]);
    });
    return refundedSaldo;
  }

  Future<List<String>> getAllKamars() async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    final maps = await db.rawQuery(
      'SELECT DISTINCT kamar FROM santri ORDER BY kamar ASC',
    );
    return maps.map((m) => m['kamar'] as String).toList();
  }

  Future<int> bulkInsertSantri(
    List<Santri> santriList, {
    String sumberDompet = 'TUNAI',
  }) async {
    if (santriList.isEmpty) return 0;
    final db = await _getDb();
    final dompet = normalizeDompet(sumberDompet);
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final todayStr = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(now);

    await db.transaction((txn) async {
      for (final santri in santriList) {
        await txn.insert('santri', santri.toMap());
        if (santri.saldoTotal > 0) {
          await txn.insert('mutasi_dompet', {
            'id': const Uuid().v4(),
            'jenis_dompet': dompet,
            'tipe': 'MASUK',
            'nominal': santri.saldoTotal,
            'referensi_id': santri.id,
            'catatan': 'Import Excel Saldo Awal ${santri.namaLengkap}',
            'tanggal_lokal': todayStr,
            'created_at': now.toIso8601String(),
          });
        }
      }
    });
    return santriList.length;
  }

  Future<int> bulkMoveKamar(List<String> santriIds, String newKamar) async {
    final cleanKamar = newKamar.trim();
    if (santriIds.isEmpty || cleanKamar.isEmpty) return 0;
    final db = await _getDb();
    var updatedCount = 0;
    await db.transaction((txn) async {
      for (final id in santriIds) {
        final cnt = await txn.update(
          'santri',
          {'kamar': cleanKamar},
          where: 'id = ?',
          whereArgs: [id],
        );
        updatedCount += cnt;
      }
    });
    return updatedCount;
  }

  Future<int> bulkArchiveSantriStatus(
    List<String> santriIds, {
    required String newStatusSantri,
  }) async {
    if (santriIds.isEmpty) return 0;
    final normalizedStatus = Santri.normalizeStatusSantri(newStatusSantri);
    final db = await _getDb();
    var updatedCount = 0;
    await db.transaction((txn) async {
      for (final id in santriIds) {
        final cnt = await txn.update(
          'santri',
          {
            'status_santri': normalizedStatus,
            'status_aktif': 0,
          },
          where: 'id = ?',
          whereArgs: [id],
        );
        updatedCount += cnt;
      }
    });
    return updatedCount;
  }

  Future<PengaturanAplikasi> getPengaturan() async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    final maps = await db.query('pengaturan_aplikasi', where: 'id = 1');
    if (maps.isNotEmpty) {
      return PengaturanAplikasi.fromMap(maps.first);
    }
    return PengaturanAplikasi();
  }

  Future<void> updatePengaturan(PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan) async {
    final db = await _getDb();
    await db.update(
      'pengaturan_aplikasi',
      pengaturan.toMap(),
      where: 'id = 1',
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:sqflite/sqflite.dart';
import '../models/santri.dart';

class SchemaMigrator {
  const SchemaMigrator();

  Future<void> configureDatabase(Database db) async {
    await db.execute('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;');
  }

  Future<Set<String>> getExistingColumns(
    DatabaseExecutor db,
    String table,
  ) async {
    try {
      final info = await db.rawQuery('PRAGMA table_info($table)');
      return info.map((e) => e['name'].toString()).toSet();
    } catch (_) {
      return const <String>{};
    }
  }

  Future<void> addColumnIfNotExists(
    Database db,
    String table,
    String columnDef, {
    Set<String>? existingColumns,
  }) async {
    final colName = columnDef.trim().split(RegExp(r'\s+')).first;
    final cols = existingColumns ?? await getExistingColumns(db, table);
    if (cols.contains(colName)) return;
    try {
      await db.execute('ALTER TABLE $table ADD COLUMN $columnDef;');
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> ensureColumnsAndIndexes(Database db) async {
    final santriCols = await getExistingColumns(db, 'santri');
    await addColumnIfNotExists(
      db,
      'santri',
      'foto_path TEXT',
      existingColumns: santriCols,
    );
    await addColumnIfNotExists(
      db,
      'santri',
      'qr_code TEXT',
      existingColumns: santriCols,
    );
    await addColumnIfNotExists(
      db,
      'santri',
      "kategori_santri TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SANTRIYIN'",
      existingColumns: santriCols,
    );
    await addColumnIfNotExists(
      db,
      'santri',
      "status_santri TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AKTIF'",
      existingColumns: santriCols,
    );

    final setoranCols = await getExistingColumns(db, 'setoran_bulanan');
    await addColumnIfNotExists(
      db,
      'setoran_bulanan',
      "metode_bayar TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TUNAI'",
      existingColumns: setoranCols,
    );
    await addColumnIfNotExists(
      db,
      'setoran_bulanan',
      'potong_tunggakan INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0',
      existingColumns: setoranCols,
    );
    await addColumnIfNotExists(
      db,
      'setoran_bulanan',
      'nominal_potong_tunggakan INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0',
      existingColumns: setoranCols,
    );

    final txCols = await getExistingColumns(db, 'transaksi_harian');
    await addColumnIfNotExists(
      db,
      'transaksi_harian',
      'is_void INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0',
      existingColumns: txCols,
    );
    await addColumnIfNotExists(
      db,
      'transaksi_harian',
      "sumber_dompet TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TUNAI'",
      existingColumns: txCols,
    );

    final pengCols = await getExistingColumns(db, 'pengaturan_aplikasi');
    await addColumnIfNotExists(
      db,
      'pengaturan_aplikasi',
      'pembulatan_jatah INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 500',
      existingColumns: pengCols,
    );
    await addColumnIfNotExists(

  Future<void> backfillQrCodes(Database db) async {
    try {
      final rows = await db.query(
        'santri',
        columns: ['id', 'qr_code'],
        where: "qr_code IS NULL OR TRIM(qr_code) = ''",
      );
      for (final row in rows) {
        final id = row['id'] as String?;
        if (id != null && id.isNotEmpty) {
          await db.update(
            'santri',
            {'qr_code': Santri.generateQrCode(id)},
            where: 'id = ?',
            whereArgs: [id],
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

      )

    await createV3InfakTablesAndIndexes(db);
    await createV33AuditTableAndIndex(db);
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';

class AuditLogVerificationResult {
  final bool isValid;
  final int totalEntries;
  final int? brokenIndex;
  final String? brokenId;
  final String message;

  const AuditLogVerificationResult({
    required this.isValid,
    required this.totalEntries,
    this.brokenIndex,
    this.brokenId,
    required this.message,
  });
}

/// Entri Jejak Audit Keamanan (Immutable & Hash-Chained) Kas-Santri v3.3.
/// Setiap baris mengikat hash SHA-256 dari baris sebelumnya (`prevHash -> entryHash`).
class AuditLogEntry {
  static const String genesisHash = 'GENESIS';

  final String id;
  final String createdAt;
  final String actor;
  final String action;
  final String? targetId;
  final String summary;
  final String prevHash;
  final String entryHash;

  const AuditLogEntry({
    required this.id,
    required this.createdAt,
    required this.actor,
    required this.action,
    this.targetId,
    required this.summary,
    required this.prevHash,
    required this.entryHash,
  });

  static String computeChainHash({
    required String id,
    required String createdAt,
    required String actor,
    required String action,
    String? targetId,
    required String summary,
    required String prevHash,
  }) {
    final payload =
        '$id|$createdAt|${actor.trim()}|${action.trim()}|${(targetId ?? '').trim()}|${summary.trim()}|${prevHash.trim()}';
    return sha256.convert(utf8.encode(payload)).toString();
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() => {
        'id': id,
        'created_at': createdAt,
        'actor': actor,
        'action': action,
        'target_id': targetId,
        'summary': summary,
        'prev_hash': prevHash,
        'entry_hash': entryHash,
      };

  factory AuditLogEntry.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) => AuditLogEntry(
        id: map['id']?.toString() ?? '',
        createdAt: map['created_at']?.toString() ?? '',
        actor: map['actor']?.toString() ?? 'Bendahara',
        action: map['action']?.toString() ?? '',
        targetId: map['target_id']?.toString(),
        summary: map['summary']?.toString() ?? '',
        prevHash: map['prev_hash']?.toString() ?? genesisHash,
        entryHash: map['entry_hash']?.toString() ?? '',
      );

  /// Memverifikasi integritas rantai SHA-256 dari urutan tertua -> terbaru.
  static AuditLogVerificationResult verifyChain(
    List<AuditLogEntry> orderedOldestFirst,
  ) {
    if (orderedOldestFirst.isEmpty) {
      return const AuditLogVerificationResult(
        isValid: true,
        totalEntries: 0,
        message: 'Belum ada entri audit tercatat. Rantai bersih.',
      );
    }

    var expectedPrev = genesisHash;
    for (var i = 0; i < orderedOldestFirst.length; i++) {
      final entry = orderedOldestFirst[i];
      if (entry.prevHash != expectedPrev) {
        return AuditLogVerificationResult(
          isValid: false,
          totalEntries: orderedOldestFirst.length,
          brokenIndex: i,
          brokenId: entry.id,
          message:
              'Terdeteksi rantai audit terputus di entri #${i + 1} (${entry.action}).',
        );
      }

      final expectedHash = computeChainHash(
        id: entry.id,
        createdAt: entry.createdAt,
        actor: entry.actor,
        action: entry.action,
        targetId: entry.targetId,
        summary: entry.summary,
        prevHash: entry.prevHash,
      );
      if (entry.entryHash != expectedHash) {
        return AuditLogVerificationResult(
          isValid: false,
          totalEntries: orderedOldestFirst.length,
          brokenIndex: i,
          brokenId: entry.id,
          message:
              'Terdeteksi modifikasi tidak sah pada entri #${i + 1} (${entry.action}).',
        );
      }
      expectedPrev = entry.entryHash;
    }

    return AuditLogVerificationResult(
      isValid: true,
      totalEntries: orderedOldestFirst.length,
      message:
          'Integritas Terverifikasi: ${orderedOldestFirst.length} catatan audit utuh tanpa modifikasi.',
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
  final String? email;
  final String? passwordHash;
  final String? fotoPath;
  final String authMode;
  final DateTime createdAt;

  BendaharaAccount({
    required this.id,
    required this.namaLengkap,
    this.jabatan = 'Bendahara Pondok',
    this.username,
    this.email,
    this.passwordHash,
    this.fotoPath,
    this.authMode = modeLocal,
    DateTime? createdAt,
  }) : createdAt = createdAt ?? DateTime.now();

  String get authModeLabel {
    switch (authMode) {
      case modeGoogle:
        return 'Akun Google + Drive';
      case modeOfflineQuick:
        return 'Mode Offline Cepat';
      case modeLocal:
      default:
        return 'Akun Lokal Terdaftar';
    }
  }

  String get initials {
    final trimmed = namaLengkap.trim();
    if (trimmed.isEmpty) return 'BP';
    final parts = trimmed.split(RegExp(r'\s+'));
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
      return (parts[0][0] + parts[1][0]).toUpperCase();
    }
    return parts[0].substring(0, parts[0].length >= 2 ? 2 : 1).toUpperCase();
  }

  BendaharaAccount copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? namaLengkap,
    String? jabatan,
    String? username,
    String? email,
    String? passwordHash,
    String? fotoPath,
    bool clearFoto = false,
    String? authMode,
    DateTime? createdAt,
  }) {
    return BendaharaAccount(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      namaLengkap: namaLengkap ?? this.namaLengkap,
      jabatan: jabatan ?? this.jabatan,
      username: username ?? this.username,
      email: email ?? this.email,
      passwordHash: passwordHash ?? this.passwordHash,
      fotoPath: clearFoto ? null : (fotoPath ?? this.fotoPath),
      authMode: authMode ?? this.authMode,
      createdAt: createdAt ?? this.createdAt,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'nama_lengkap': namaLengkap,
      'jabatan': jabatan,
      'username': username,
      'email': email,
      'password_hash': passwordHash,
      'foto_path': fotoPath,
      'auth_mode': authMode,
      'created_at': createdAt.toIso8601String(),
    };
  }

  factory BendaharaAccount.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return BendaharaAccount(
      id: map['id'].toString(),
      namaLengkap: map['nama_lengkap']?.toString() ?? 'Bendahara Pondok',
      jabatan: map['jabatan']?.toString() ?? 'Bendahara Pondok',
      username: map['username'] as String?,
      email: map['email'] as String?,
      passwordHash: map['password_hash'] as String?,
      fotoPath: map['foto_path'] as String?,
      authMode: map['auth_mode']?.toString() ?? modeLocal,
      createdAt: map['created_at'] != null
          ? DateTime.tryParse(map['created_at'].toString()) ?? DateTime.now()
          : DateTime.now(),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert';

class CashOpnameLog {
  final String id;
  final String tanggalLokal;
  final int totalSistem;
  final int totalFisik;
  final int selisih;
  final Map<int, int> rincianPecahan;
  final String? catatan;
  final DateTime createdAt;

  CashOpnameLog({
    required this.id,
    required this.tanggalLokal,
    required this.totalSistem,
    required this.totalFisik,
    required this.selisih,
    required this.rincianPecahan,
    this.catatan,
    DateTime? createdAt,
  }) : createdAt = createdAt ?? DateTime.now();

  bool get isCocok => selisih == 0;

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    final jsonMap = <String, int>{};
    for (final entry in rincianPecahan.entries) {
      jsonMap[entry.key.toString()] = entry.value;
    }
    return {
      'id': id,
      'tanggal_lokal': tanggalLokal,
      'total_sistem': totalSistem,
      'total_fisik': totalFisik,
      'selisih': selisih,
      'rincian_pecahan_json': jsonEncode(jsonMap),
      'catatan': catatan,
      'created_at': createdAt.toIso8601String(),
    };
  }

  factory CashOpnameLog.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    final Map<int, int> parsedPecahan = {};
    final rawJson = map['rincian_pecahan_json'] as String?;
    if (rawJson != null && rawJson.isNotEmpty) {
      try {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(rawJson) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        for (final entry in decoded.entries) {
          final denom = int.tryParse(entry.key);
          final qty = (entry.value as num?)?.toInt();
          if (denom != null && qty != null) {
            parsedPecahan[denom] = qty;
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    return CashOpnameLog(
      id: map['id'] as String,
      tanggalLokal: map['tanggal_lokal'] as String? ?? '',
      totalSistem: (map['total_sistem'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      totalFisik: (map['total_fisik'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      selisih: (map['selisih'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      rincianPecahan: parsedPecahan,
      catatan: map['catatan'] as String?,
      createdAt: map['created_at'] != null
          ? DateTime.tryParse(map['created_at'].toString()) ?? DateTime.now()
          : DateTime.now(),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
typedef InfakSantri = InfakSantriModel;

class InfakSantriModel {
  static const String berasBelum = 'BELUM';
  static const String berasFisik = 'FISIK';
  static const String berasUangVal = 'UANG';
  static const String berasBebas = 'BEBAS';

  static const String statusLunasVal = 'LUNAS';
  static const String statusCicilVal = 'CICIL';
  static const String statusBelumVal = 'BELUM';

  final String id;
  final String santriId;
  final String periodeBulan; // YYYY-MM
  final String tahunAjaran;
  final int nominalMasak;
  final bool isMasakBebas;
  final int nominalListrik;
  final bool isListrikBebas;
  final String jenisBeras; // BELUM, FISIK, UANG, BEBAS
  final double berasLiter;
  final int berasUang;
  final String tglMasuk; // YYYY-MM-DD
  final String tglHabis; // YYYY-MM-DD (+1 bulan)
  final String statusLunas; // LUNAS, CICIL, BELUM
  final String sumberDompet; // TUNAI, REKENING
  final String? setoranId;
  final String? catatan;
  final DateTime createdAt;

  InfakSantriModel({
    required this.id,
    required this.santriId,
    required this.periodeBulan,
    this.tahunAjaran = '2026/2027 M / 1448 H',
    this.nominalMasak = 0,
    this.isMasakBebas = false,
    this.nominalListrik = 0,
    this.isListrikBebas = false,
    this.jenisBeras = berasBelum,
    this.berasLiter = 0.0,
    this.berasUang = 0,
    required this.tglMasuk,
    String? tglHabis,
    String? statusLunas,
    this.sumberDompet = 'TUNAI',
    this.setoranId,
    this.catatan,
    DateTime? createdAt,
  })  : tglHabis = (tglHabis != null && tglHabis.isNotEmpty)
            ? tglHabis
            : hitungTglHabis(tglMasuk),
        statusLunas = (statusLunas != null && statusLunas.isNotEmpty)
            ? statusLunas
            : hitungStatusLunas(
                nominalMasak: nominalMasak,
                isMasakBebas: isMasakBebas,
                nominalListrik: nominalListrik,
                isListrikBebas: isListrikBebas,
                jenisBeras: jenisBeras,
                berasLiter: berasLiter,
                berasUang: berasUang,
              ),
        createdAt = createdAt ?? DateTime.now();

  int get totalUangMasuk => nominalMasak + nominalListrik + berasUang;

  static String hitungTglHabis(String tglMasukYmd) {
    final parts = tglMasukYmd.split('-');
    if (parts.length != 3) return tglMasukYmd;
    final y = int.tryParse(parts[0]);
    final m = int.tryParse(parts[1]);
    final d = int.tryParse(parts[2]);
    if (y == null || m == null || d == null) return tglMasukYmd;

    final nextYear = m == 12 ? y + 1 : y;
    final nextMonth = m == 12 ? 1 : m + 1;
    final maxDay = DateTime(nextYear, nextMonth + 1, 0).day;
    final safeDay = d > maxDay ? maxDay : d;
    return '${nextYear.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-'
        '${nextMonth.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-'
        '${safeDay.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  static String hitungStatusLunas({
    required int nominalMasak,
    required bool isMasakBebas,
    required int nominalListrik,
    required bool isListrikBebas,
    required String jenisBeras,
    required double berasLiter,
    required int berasUang,
    int targetMasak = 130000,
    int targetListrik = 20000,
    double targetBerasLiter = 15.0,
    int targetBerasUang = 150000,
  }) {
    final masakOk = isMasakBebas || nominalMasak >= targetMasak;
    final listrikOk = isListrikBebas || nominalListrik >= targetListrik;
    final bool berasOk;
    if (jenisBeras == berasBebas) {
      berasOk = true;
    } else if (jenisBeras == berasFisik) {
      berasOk = berasLiter >= targetBerasLiter;
    } else if (jenisBeras == berasUangVal) {
      berasOk = berasUang >= targetBerasUang;
    } else {
      berasOk = false;
    }

    if (masakOk && listrikOk && berasOk) {
      return statusLunasVal;
    }

    final anyPaid = isMasakBebas ||
        nominalMasak > 0 ||
        isListrikBebas ||
        nominalListrik > 0 ||
        jenisBeras == berasBebas ||
        berasLiter > 0 ||
        berasUang > 0;
    return anyPaid ? statusCicilVal : statusBelumVal;
  }

  InfakSantriModel copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? santriId,
    String? periodeBulan,
    String? tahunAjaran,
    int? nominalMasak,
    bool? isMasakBebas,
    int? nominalListrik,
    bool? isListrikBebas,
    String? jenisBeras,
    double? berasLiter,
    int? berasUang,
    String? tglMasuk,
    String? tglHabis,
    String? statusLunas,
    String? sumberDompet,
    String? setoranId,
    String? catatan,
    DateTime? createdAt,
  }) {
    return InfakSantriModel(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      santriId: santriId ?? this.santriId,
      periodeBulan: periodeBulan ?? this.periodeBulan,
      tahunAjaran: tahunAjaran ?? this.tahunAjaran,
      nominalMasak: nominalMasak ?? this.nominalMasak,
      isMasakBebas: isMasakBebas ?? this.isMasakBebas,
      nominalListrik: nominalListrik ?? this.nominalListrik,
      isListrikBebas: isListrikBebas ?? this.isListrikBebas,
      jenisBeras: jenisBeras ?? this.jenisBeras,
      berasLiter: berasLiter ?? this.berasLiter,
      berasUang: berasUang ?? this.berasUang,
      tglMasuk: tglMasuk ?? this.tglMasuk,
      tglHabis: tglHabis ?? this.tglHabis,
      statusLunas: statusLunas ?? this.statusLunas,
      sumberDompet: sumberDompet ?? this.sumberDompet,
      setoranId: setoranId ?? this.setoranId,
      catatan: catatan ?? this.catatan,
      createdAt: createdAt ?? this.createdAt,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'santri_id': santriId,
      'periode_bulan': periodeBulan,
      'tahun_ajaran': tahunAjaran,
      'nominal_masak': nominalMasak,
      'is_masak_bebas': isMasakBebas ? 1 : 0,
      'nominal_listrik': nominalListrik,
      'is_listrik_bebas': isListrikBebas ? 1 : 0,
      'jenis_beras': jenisBeras,
      'beras_liter': berasLiter,

      'setoran_id': setoranId,

      'created_at': createdAt.toIso8601String(),
    };
  }

  factory InfakSantriModel.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {

      catatan: map['catatan'] as String?,
```

```dart
class Santri {

  static const String kategoriSantriyat = 'SANTRIYAT';
  static const String kategoriSantriBaru = 'SANTRI_BARU';

  static const String statusAktifVal = 'AKTIF';
  static const String statusPulangVal = 'PULANG';
  static const String statusPindahVal = 'PINDAH';
  static const String statusAlumniVal = 'ALUMNI';

  final String id;
  final String namaLengkap;
  final String namaPanggilan;
  final String kategoriSantri; // SANTRIYIN, SANTRIYAT, SANTRI_BARU
  final String statusSantri; // AKTIF, PULANG, PINDAH
  final String kamar;
  final String? noWaWali;
  final int saldoTotal;
  final int jatahHarian;
  final int setoranAwal;
  final int tunggakan;
  final String catatanTunggakan;
  final String? fotoPath;
  final String qrCode;
  final bool statusAktif;
  final DateTime createdAt;

  static String normalizeKategori(String? raw) {
    switch (raw?.toUpperCase().trim()) {
      case kategoriSantriyat:
        return kategoriSantriyat;
      case kategoriSantriBaru:
        return kategoriSantriBaru;
      case kategoriSantriyin:
      default:
        return kategoriSantriyin;
    }
  }

  static String normalizeStatusSantri(String? raw) {
    switch (raw?.toUpperCase().trim()) {
      case statusPulangVal:
        return statusPulangVal;
      case statusPindahVal:
        return statusPindahVal;
      case statusAlumniVal:
      case 'LULUS':
      case 'ALUMNI / LULUS':
        return statusAlumniVal;
      case statusAktifVal:
      default:
        return statusAktifVal;
    }
  }

  static String generateQrCode(String id) {
    final clean = id.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9]'), '').toUpperCase();
    if (clean.isEmpty) return 'KS-SANTRI';
    final suffix = clean.length > 12 ? clean.substring(0, 12) : clean;
    return 'KS-$suffix';
  }

  Santri({
    required this.id,
    required this.namaLengkap,
    required this.namaPanggilan,
    String kategoriSantri = kategoriSantriyin,
    String statusSantri = statusAktifVal,
    required this.kamar,
    this.noWaWali,
    this.saldoTotal = 0,
    this.jatahHarian = 10000,
    this.setoranAwal = 300000,
    this.tunggakan = 0,
    this.catatanTunggakan = '',
    this.fotoPath,
    String? qrCode,
    this.statusAktif = true,
    DateTime? createdAt,
  })  : kategoriSantri = normalizeKategori(kategoriSantri),
        statusSantri = normalizeStatusSantri(statusSantri),
        qrCode = (qrCode != null && qrCode.trim().isNotEmpty)
            ? qrCode.trim()
            : generateQrCode(id),
        createdAt = createdAt ?? DateTime.now();

  bool get isPulang => statusSantri == statusPulangVal;
  bool get isPindah => statusSantri == statusPindahVal;
  bool get isAlumni => statusSantri == statusAlumniVal;
  bool get isAktifDiPondok => statusAktif && statusSantri == statusAktifVal;

  String get kategoriLabel {
    switch (kategoriSantri) {
      case kategoriSantriyat:
        return 'Santriyat';
      case kategoriSantriBaru:
        return 'Santri Baru';
      case kategoriSantriyin:
      default:
        return 'Santriyin';
    }
  }

  String get statusSantriLabel {
    switch (statusSantri) {
      case statusPulangVal:
        return 'Pulang';
      case statusPindahVal:
        return 'Pindah';
      case statusAlumniVal:
        return 'Alumni / Lulus';
      case statusAktifVal:
      default:
        return 'Aktif';
    }
  }

  /// Estimasi berapa hari sisa saldo dapat mencukupi
  /// Estimasi Hari = floor(saldoTotal / jatahHarian)
  int get estimasiHari {
    if (jatahHarian <= 0) return 0;
    if (saldoTotal <= 0) return 0;
    return (saldoTotal / jatahHarian).floor();
  }

  Santri copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? namaLengkap,
    String? namaPanggilan,
    String? kategoriSantri,
    String? statusSantri,
    String? kamar,
    String? noWaWali,
    int? saldoTotal,
    int? jatahHarian,
    int? setoranAwal,
    int? tunggakan,
    String? catatanTunggakan,
    String? fotoPath,
    String? qrCode,
    bool? statusAktif,
    DateTime? createdAt,
  }) {
    return Santri(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      namaLengkap: namaLengkap ?? this.namaLengkap,
      namaPanggilan: namaPanggilan ?? this.namaPanggilan,
      kategoriSantri: kategoriSantri ?? this.kategoriSantri,
      statusSantri: statusSantri ?? this.statusSantri,
      kamar: kamar ?? this.kamar,
      noWaWali: noWaWali ?? this.noWaWali,
      saldoTotal: saldoTotal ?? this.saldoTotal,
      jatahHarian: jatahHarian ?? this.jatahHarian,
      setoranAwal: setoranAwal ?? this.setoranAwal,
      tunggakan: tunggakan ?? this.tunggakan,
      catatanTunggakan: catatanTunggakan ?? this.catatanTunggakan,
      fotoPath: fotoPath ?? this.fotoPath,
      qrCode: qrCode ?? this.qrCode,
      statusAktif: statusAktif ?? this.statusAktif,
      createdAt: createdAt ?? this.createdAt,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'nama_lengkap': namaLengkap,
      'nama_panggilan': namaPanggilan,
      'kategori_santri': kategoriSantri,
      'status_santri': statusSantri,
      'kamar': kamar,
      'no_wa_wali': noWaWali,
      'saldo_total': saldoTotal,
      'jatah_harian': jatahHarian,
      'setoran_awal': setoranAwal,
      'tunggakan': tunggakan,
      'catatan_tunggakan': catatanTunggakan,
      'foto_path': fotoPath,
      'qr_code': qrCode,
      'status_aktif': statusAktif ? 1 : 0,
      'created_at': createdAt.toIso8601String(),
    };
  }

  factory Santri.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    final id = map['id'] as String;
    return Santri(
      id: id,
      namaLengkap: map['nama_lengkap'] as String,
      namaPanggilan: map['nama_panggilan'] as String? ?? '',
      kategoriSantri: normalizeKategori(map['kategori_santri']?.toString()),
      statusSantri: normalizeStatusSantri(map['status_santri']?.toString()),
      kamar: map['kamar'] as String? ?? '',
      noWaWali: map['no_wa_wali'] as String?,
      saldoTotal: (map['saldo_total'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      jatahHarian: (map['jatah_harian'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 10000,
      setoranAwal: (map['setoran_awal'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 300000,
      tunggakan: (map['tunggakan'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      catatanTunggakan: map['catatan_tunggakan'] as String? ?? '',
      fotoPath: map['foto_path'] as String?,
      qrCode: map['qr_code'] as String?,
      statusAktif: (map['status_aktif'] as int?) == 1,
      createdAt: map['created_at'] != null
          ? DateTime.tryParse(map['created_at'].toString()) ?? DateTime.now()
          : DateTime.now(),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'santri.dart';
export 'santri.dart';
import 'transaksi.dart';
import '../utils/currency_formatter.dart';
import '../utils/time_category_helper.dart';

enum BadgeStatusHariIni {
  utuh, // 🟢 Belum ambil hari ini
  sebagian, // 🔵 Sudah ambil sebagian, masih ada sisa jatah
  limitHabis, // 🟡 Jatah hari ini sudah Rp 0
  overlimitKritis, // 🔴 Overlimit atau saldo hampir habis/habis
}

class SantriStatusHariIni {
  final Santri santri;
  final int totalAmbilHariIni;
  final int sisaJatahHariIni;
  final int jatahHariIni;
  final List<TransaksiHarian> transaksiHariIni;
  final bool hasOverlimitToday;

  SantriStatusHariIni({
    required this.santri,
    required this.totalAmbilHariIni,
    required this.sisaJatahHariIni,
    required this.jatahHariIni,
    required this.transaksiHariIni,
    this.hasOverlimitToday = false,
  });

  int get jumlahAmbilHariIni => transaksiHariIni.length;

  BadgeStatusHariIni get badgeStatus {
    if (hasOverlimitToday || santri.saldoTotal <= 0 || santri.saldoTotal < santri.jatahHarian) {
      return BadgeStatusHariIni.overlimitKritis;
    }
    if (totalAmbilHariIni == 0) {
      return BadgeStatusHariIni.utuh;
    }
    if (sisaJatahHariIni > 0) {
      return BadgeStatusHariIni.sebagian;
    }
    return BadgeStatusHariIni.limitHabis;
  }

  String get badgeLabel {
    switch (badgeStatus) {
      case BadgeStatusHariIni.utuh:
        return 'Utuh';
      case BadgeStatusHariIni.sebagian:
        return 'Sebagian';
      case BadgeStatusHariIni.limitHabis:
        return 'Limit Habis';
      case BadgeStatusHariIni.overlimitKritis:
        if (hasOverlimitToday) return 'Overlimit';
        return 'Saldo Kritis';
    }
  }

  /// Progress rasio jatah hari ini (0.0 sampai 1.0)
  double get progressRatio {
    if (jatahHariIni <= 0) return 1.0;
    final ratio = totalAmbilHariIni / jatahHariIni;
    if (ratio > 1.0) return 1.0;
    if (ratio < 0.0) return 0.0;
    return ratio;
  }

  /// Rasio sisa kuota hari ini: 1.0 (100% penuh saat utuh) lalu menyusut ke 0.0 saat terpakai
  double get remainingRatio {
    if (jatahHariIni <= 0) return 0.0;
    final ratio = sisaJatahHariIni / jatahHariIni;
    return ratio.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
  }

  /// Ringkasan teks pengambilan hari ini, contoh:
  /// "Hari ini sudah ambil 2x: Pagi 2rb, Siang 5rb"
  String get ringkasanAmbilHariIni {
    if (transaksiHariIni.isEmpty) {
      return 'Belum ambil hari ini';
    }
    final rincian = transaksiHariIni.map((t) {
      final kat = TimeCategoryHelper.getLabel(t.kategoriWaktu);
      final nom = CurrencyFormatter.formatCompact(t.nominal);
      return '$kat $nom';
    }).join(', ');

    return 'Sudah ambil ${transaksiHariIni.length}x: $rincian';
  }
}
```

```dart
enum TipeSetoran { awalBulan, susulanTopUp, sambanganSplit }

enum OpsiSetoranSusulan { tambahJatahHarian, perpanjangHari }

enum PerlakuanSisaSaldoLalu { gabungBulanBaru, simpanTabungan }

class SetoranBulanan {
  final String id;
  final String santriId;
  final int nominalSetoran;
  final int durasiHari;
  final int jatahHarianHitung;
  final TipeSetoran tipeSetoran;
  final DateTime tanggalSetor;
  final String? catatan;
  final PerlakuanSisaSaldoLalu perlakuanSisa;

  SetoranBulanan({
    required this.id,
    required this.santriId,
    required this.nominalSetoran,
    required this.durasiHari,
    required this.jatahHarianHitung,
    required this.tipeSetoran,
    required this.tanggalSetor,
    this.catatan,
    this.perlakuanSisa = PerlakuanSisaSaldoLalu.gabungBulanBaru,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    final String tipeStr;
    switch (tipeSetoran) {
      case TipeSetoran.awalBulan:
        tipeStr = 'AWAL_BULAN';
        break;
      case TipeSetoran.sambanganSplit:
        tipeStr = 'SAMBANGAN_SPLIT';
        break;
      case TipeSetoran.susulanTopUp:
        tipeStr = 'SUSULAN_TOPUP';
        break;
    }
    return {
      'id': id,
      'santri_id': santriId,
      'nominal_setoran': nominalSetoran,
      'durasi_hari': durasiHari,
      'jatah_harian_hitung': jatahHarianHitung,
      'tipe_setoran': tipeStr,
      'tanggal_setor': tanggalSetor.toIso8601String().substring(0, 10),
      'catatan': catatan,
      'perlakuan_sisa': perlakuanSisa == PerlakuanSisaSaldoLalu.gabungBulanBaru
          ? 'GABUNG_BULAN_BARU'
          : 'SIMPAN_TABUNGAN',
    };
  }

  factory SetoranBulanan.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    final tipeRaw = map['tipe_setoran']?.toString();
    final TipeSetoran tipe;
    if (tipeRaw == 'SUSULAN_TOPUP') {
      tipe = TipeSetoran.susulanTopUp;
    } else if (tipeRaw == 'SAMBANGAN_SPLIT') {
      tipe = TipeSetoran.sambanganSplit;
    } else {
      tipe = TipeSetoran.awalBulan;
    }
    return SetoranBulanan(
      id: map['id'] as String,
      santriId: map['santri_id'] as String,
      nominalSetoran: (map['nominal_setoran'] as num).toInt(),
      durasiHari: (map['durasi_hari'] as num).toInt(),
      jatahHarianHitung: (map['jatah_harian_hitung'] as num).toInt(),
      tipeSetoran: tipe,
      tanggalSetor: map['tanggal_setor'] != null
          ? DateTime.tryParse(map['tanggal_setor'].toString()) ?? DateTime.now()
          : DateTime.now(),
      catatan: map['catatan'] as String?,
      perlakuanSisa: map['perlakuan_sisa'] == 'SIMPAN_TABUNGAN'
          ? PerlakuanSisaSaldoLalu.simpanTabungan
          : PerlakuanSisaSaldoLalu.gabungBulanBaru,
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
class TransaksiHarian {

  final TimeCategory kategoriWaktu;
```
