  final String? catatan;
  final bool isVoided;
  final OverlimitHandling? overlimitHandling;
  final int saldoSetelahTransaksi;
  final TipeTransaksi tipe;
  final String sumberDompet; // 'TUNAI' atau 'REKENING'

  TransaksiHarian({
    required this.id,
    required this.santriId,
    required this.nominal,
    required this.waktuAmbil,
    required this.tanggalLokal,
    required this.kategoriWaktu,
    this.isOverlimit = false,
    this.catatan,
    this.isVoided = false,
    this.overlimitHandling,
    this.saldoSetelahTransaksi = 0,
    this.tipe = TipeTransaksi.pengambilan,
    this.sumberDompet = 'TUNAI',
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'santri_id': santriId,
      'nominal': nominal,
      'waktu_ambil': waktuAmbil.toIso8601String(),
      'tanggal_lokal': tanggalLokal,
      'kategori_waktu': TimeCategoryHelper.toDbString(kategoriWaktu),
      'is_overlimit': isOverlimit ? 1 : 0,
      'catatan': catatan,
      'is_void': isVoided ? 1 : 0,
      'overlimit_handling': overlimitHandling == OverlimitHandling.potongBesok
          ? 'POTONG_BESOK'
          : overlimitHandling == OverlimitHandling.hitungUlangRataRata
              ? 'HITUNG_ULANG'
              : null,
      'saldo_setelah_transaksi': saldoSetelahTransaksi,
      'tipe': tipe == TipeTransaksi.setoran ? 'SETORAN' : 'PENGAMBILAN',
      'sumber_dompet': sumberDompet,
    };
  }

  factory TransaksiHarian.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return TransaksiHarian(
      id: map['id'] as String,
      santriId: map['santri_id'] as String,
      nominal: (map['nominal'] as num).toInt(),
      waktuAmbil: map['waktu_ambil'] != null
          ? DateTime.tryParse(map['waktu_ambil'].toString()) ?? DateTime.now()
          : DateTime.now(),
      tanggalLokal: map['tanggal_lokal'] as String? ?? '',
      kategoriWaktu: TimeCategoryHelper.fromDbString(
        map['kategori_waktu'] as String? ?? 'PAGI',
      ),
      isOverlimit: (map['is_overlimit'] as int?) == 1,
      catatan: map['catatan'] as String?,
      isVoided: (map['is_void'] ?? map['is_voided']) == 1,
      overlimitHandling: map['overlimit_handling'] == 'POTONG_BESOK'
          ? OverlimitHandling.potongBesok
          : map['overlimit_handling'] == 'HITUNG_ULANG'
              ? OverlimitHandling.hitungUlangRataRata
              : null,
      saldoSetelahTransaksi: (map['saldo_setelah_transaksi'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      tipe: map['tipe'] == 'SETORAN'
          ? TipeTransaksi.setoran
          : TipeTransaksi.pengambilan,
      sumberDompet: (map['sumber_dompet'] as String?) == 'REKENING' ||
              (map['sumber_dompet'] as String?) == 'BANK'
          ? 'REKENING'
          : 'TUNAI',
    );
  }
}

    final lastBackupStr = _pengaturan.lastDriveBackupAt;
    if (lastBackupStr == null || lastBackupStr.isEmpty) return true;
    final lastBackup = DateTime.tryParse(lastBackupStr);
    if (lastBackup == null) return true;
    if (_lastLocalChangeAt == null) return false;
    return _lastLocalChangeAt!.isAfter(lastBackup);
  }

  Future<void> init() async {
    _isLoading = true;
    notifyListeners();

    _pengaturan = await _db.getPengaturan();
    if (!_pengaturan.onboardingDone) {
      final existingSantri = await _db.getAllSantri(onlyActive: false);
      if (existingSantri.isNotEmpty) {
        _pengaturan = _pengaturan.copyWith(onboardingDone: true);
        await _db.updatePengaturan(_pengaturan);
      }
    }
    _activeAccount = await AccountAuthService.instance.getActiveAccount();
    if (_activeAccount == null && _pengaturan.onboardingDone) {
      _activeAccount = await AccountAuthService.instance
          .ensureLegacySessionIfNeeded(_pengaturan.namaPengurus);
    }
    if (_activeAccount != null &&
        _activeAccount!.namaLengkap.trim().isNotEmpty &&
        _activeAccount!.namaLengkap != _pengaturan.namaPengurus) {
      _pengaturan = _pengaturan.copyWith(namaPengurus: _activeAccount!.namaLengkap);
      await _db.updatePengaturan(_pengaturan);
    }
    await loadAllData();
    _isScreenPrivacyEnabled =
        await SecurityGuardService.instance.getScreenPrivacyEnabled();
    await SecurityGuardService.instance.applySavedScreenPrivacy();
    _integrityReport = await SecurityGuardService.instance.checkAppIntegrity();
    _isLicenseRevoked = await CustomerSyncService.instance.getCachedRevokedStatus();
    _remoteConfig = await CustomerSyncService.instance.getCachedRemoteConfig();
    await syncSubscriptionEntitlement();

    // Sinkronisasi waktu pasif & telemetri lisensi non-sensitif di latar belakang saat online
    unawaited(_backgroundClockSync());
    unawaited(syncCustomerTelemetryInBackground());

    _isLoading = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<CustomerSyncResult> syncCustomerTelemetryInBackground() async {
    try {
      if (_deviceId.isEmpty) {
        _deviceId = await LicenseService.instance.getOrCreateDeviceId();
      }
      final String tier;
      final DateTime? expiry;
      final String channel;
      if (_activeLicense != null && _activeLicense!.isValid) {
        tier = _activeLicense!.planKey ?? 'YEARLY';
        expiry = _activeLicense!.expiryDate;
        channel = 'DANA';
      } else if (_pengaturan.isPro && _pengaturan.proPlan == 'TRIAL_14D') {
        tier = 'TRIAL_14D';
        expiry = _trialStatus.expiresAt;
        channel = 'TRIAL';
      } else if (_pengaturan.isPro && _pengaturan.proPlan != null) {
        tier = _pengaturan.proPlan!;
        expiry = null;
        channel = kIsPlayStoreBuild ? 'PLAY_STORE' : 'DANA';
      } else {
        tier = 'FREE';
        expiry = null;
        channel = 'FREE';
      }

      final res = await CustomerSyncService.instance.syncDeviceInBackground(
        deviceId: _deviceId,
        namaPondok: _pengaturan.namaPondok,
        namaBendahara: activeOperatorName,
        noWaPengurus: _pengaturan.kontakPengurus,
        tier: tier,
        expiryDate: expiry,
        appVersion: AppConfig.appVersion,
        paymentChannel: channel,
      );

      if (res.remoteConfig != null) {
        _remoteConfig = res.remoteConfig;
        notifyListeners();
      }

      if (res.synced && res.isRevoked) {
        await LicenseService.instance.clearLicense();
        _activeLicense = null;
        _isLicenseRevoked = true;
        if (_pengaturan.isPro) {
          await deactivatePro();
        } else {
          notifyListeners();
        }
        await _recordAudit(
          action: 'LISENSI_DICABUT_ADMIN',
          targetId: _deviceId,
          summary:
              'Akses lisensi PRO perangkat $_deviceId dinonaktifkan oleh Admin (Remote Revoke).',
        );
      } else if (res.synced && !res.isRevoked && _isLicenseRevoked) {
        _isLicenseRevoked = false;
        await syncSubscriptionEntitlement();
      }
      return res;
    } catch (_) {
      return const CustomerSyncResult(synced: false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _backgroundClockSync() async {
    try {
      final res = await SecurityGuardService.instance.checkAndAdvanceClock(
        allowNetworkSync: true,
      );
      if (res.isTampered != _isClockTampered) {
        _isClockTampered = res.isTampered;
        _clockTamperMessage = res.isTampered ? res.message : null;
        if (!res.isTampered) {
          await syncSubscriptionEntitlement();
        } else {
          notifyListeners();
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> syncSubscriptionEntitlement() async {
    try {
      final clockCheck = await SecurityGuardService.instance.checkAndAdvanceClock();
      _isClockTampered = clockCheck.isTampered;
      _clockTamperMessage = clockCheck.isTampered ? clockCheck.message : null;
      final trustedNow = clockCheck.effectiveNow;

      _deviceId = await LicenseService.instance.getOrCreateDeviceId();
      _trialStatus = await SubscriptionService.instance.getTrialStatus(
        fallbackHasUsed: _pengaturan.hasUsedTrial,
        fallbackStartedAt: _pengaturan.trialStartedAt,
        fallbackExpiresAt: _pengaturan.trialExpiresAt,
        now: trustedNow,
      );

      if (_trialStatus.hasUsedTrial &&
          (!_pengaturan.hasUsedTrial || _pengaturan.trialExpiresAt == null)) {
        _pengaturan = _pengaturan.copyWith(
          hasUsedTrial: true,
          trialStartedAt: _trialStatus.startedAt?.toIso8601String(),
          trialExpiresAt: _trialStatus.expiresAt?.toIso8601String(),
        );
        await _db.updatePengaturan(_pengaturan);
      }

      if (!kIsPlayStoreBuild) {
        _activeLicense = await LicenseService.instance.checkSavedLicense(
          now: trustedNow,
        );
        if (_activeLicense != null && _activeLicense!.isValid) {
          await activatePro(plan: _activeLicense!.planKey ?? 'YEARLY');
          return;
        }
      }

      await SubscriptionService.instance.init();
      final status = await SubscriptionService.instance.checkEntitlementStatus();
      if (status.isPro) {
        await activatePro(plan: status.planKey ?? 'YEARLY');
        return;
      }

      if (_trialStatus.isActive) {
        if (!_pengaturan.isPro || _pengaturan.proPlan == null) {
          await activatePro(plan: 'TRIAL_14D');
        } else {
          notifyListeners();
        }
        return;
      }

      if (_pengaturan.proPlan == 'TRIAL_14D' && !_trialStatus.isActive) {
        await deactivatePro();
        return;
      }

      if (!kIsPlayStoreBuild &&
          _activeLicense != null &&
          _activeLicense!.isExpired &&
          _pengaturan.isPro &&
          _pengaturan.proPlan != 'TRIAL_14D') {
        await deactivatePro();
        return;
      }

      // Pada release build (!kDebugMode), pastikan status PRO di DB tidak pernah aktif
      // tanpa lisensi Ed25519 valid, langganan Play Store aktif, atau Trial 14 Hari aktif.
      if (!kDebugMode &&
          _pengaturan.isPro &&
          !status.isPro &&
          !_trialStatus.isActive &&
          (_activeLicense == null || !_activeLicense!.isValid)) {
        await deactivatePro();
        return;
      }

      SubscriptionService.instance.updateAccessState(
        isProActive: isProActive,
        isTrialActive: isTrialActive,
      );
      notifyListeners();
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<({bool success, TrialStatus status, String message})> startFreeTrial14Days() async {
    final res = await SubscriptionService.instance.startFreeTrial14Days(
      fallbackHasUsed: _pengaturan.hasUsedTrial,
      fallbackStartedAt: _pengaturan.trialStartedAt,
      fallbackExpiresAt: _pengaturan.trialExpiresAt,
    );
    _trialStatus = res.status;

    if (res.success) {
      final updated = _pengaturan.copyWith(
        isPro: true,
        proPlan: 'TRIAL_14D',
        hasUsedTrial: true,
        trialStartedAt: res.status.startedAt?.toIso8601String(),
        trialExpiresAt: res.status.expiresAt?.toIso8601String(),
      );
      _pengaturan = updated;
      await _db.updatePengaturan(updated);
      unawaited(syncCustomerTelemetryInBackground());
      notifyListeners();
    } else if (res.status.hasUsedTrial && !_pengaturan.hasUsedTrial) {
      final updated = _pengaturan.copyWith(
        hasUsedTrial: true,
        trialStartedAt: res.status.startedAt?.toIso8601String(),
        trialExpiresAt: res.status.expiresAt?.toIso8601String(),
      );
      _pengaturan = updated;
      await _db.updatePengaturan(updated);
      notifyListeners();
    }
    return res;
  }

  Future<LicenseVerificationResult> activateOfflineLicense(String rawCode) async {
    final res = await LicenseService.instance.activateLicense(rawCode);
    _deviceId = await LicenseService.instance.getOrCreateDeviceId();
    if (res.isValid) {
      _activeLicense = res;
      await activatePro(plan: res.planKey ?? 'YEARLY');
      await _recordAudit(
        action: 'AKTIVASI_LISENSI',
        targetId: res.deviceId,
        summary: 'Aktivasi lisensi Ed25519 paket ${res.planKey ?? 'PRO'}.',
      );
      unawaited(syncCustomerTelemetryInBackground());
    }
    return res;
  }

  Future<void> completeOnboarding({
    required String namaPondok,
    required String namaPengurus,
    required int defaultJatahHarian,
    required int pembulatanJatah,
    required bool useSimulationData,
  }) async {
    final updated = _pengaturan.copyWith(
      namaPondok: namaPondok.trim().isNotEmpty ? namaPondok.trim() : 'Nama Pondok',
      namaPengurus: namaPengurus.trim().isNotEmpty ? namaPengurus.trim() : 'Pengurus Kas & Keuangan',
      defaultJatahHarian: defaultJatahHarian > 0 ? defaultJatahHarian : 10000,
      pembulatanJatah: pembulatanJatah,
      onboardingDone: true,
    );
    _pengaturan = updated;
    await _db.updatePengaturan(updated);

    if (useSimulationData) {
      await _db.seedDemoData(force: true);
    }
    await loadAllData();
    unawaited(syncCustomerTelemetryInBackground());
  }

  Future<void> activatePro({required String plan}) async {
    final updated = _pengaturan.copyWith(isPro: true, proPlan: plan);
    _pengaturan = updated;
    await _db.updatePengaturan(updated);
    SubscriptionService.instance.updateAccessState(
      isProActive: isProActive,
      isTrialActive: isTrialActive,
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> deactivatePro() async {
    final updated = _pengaturan.copyWith(isPro: false, clearProPlan: true);
    _pengaturan = updated;
    await _db.updatePengaturan(updated);
    SubscriptionService.instance.updateAccessState(
      isProActive: isProActive,
      isTrialActive: isTrialActive,
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Toggle uji coba sementara HANYA untuk debug build (dinonaktifkan mutlak pada release build).
  Future<void> toggleProPreview() async {
    if (!kDebugMode) return;
    if (_pengaturan.isPro) {
      await deactivatePro();
    } else {
      await activatePro(plan: 'YEARLY');
    }
  }

  Future<void> loadAllData() async {
    _pengaturan = await _db.getPengaturan();
    _kamars = await _db.getAllKamars();
    _allSantri = await _db.getAllSantri(onlyActive: false);

    final todayStr = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(DateTime.now());
    final activeSantri = _allSantri.where((s) => s.statusAktif).toList();

    // 1. Batch query transaksi hari ini & kuota efektif untuk seluruh santri aktif (Eliminasi N+1)
    final txHariIniBySantri =
        await _db.getAllTransaksiPengambilanHariIniMap(todayStr);
    final effectiveQuotaBySantri = await _db.computeEffectiveDailyQuotaMap(
      todayLokal: todayStr,
      activeSantri: activeSantri,
      modeSisaHarian: _pengaturan.modeSisaHarian,
    );

    List<SantriStatusHariIni> statuses = [];
    int totalKuota = 0;
    for (final santri in activeSantri) {
      final jatahHariIni =
          effectiveQuotaBySantri[santri.id] ?? santri.jatahHarian;
      totalKuota += jatahHariIni;
      final txHariIni =
          txHariIniBySantri[santri.id] ?? const <TransaksiHarian>[];
      final totalAmbil =
          txHariIni.fold<int>(0, (sum, t) => sum + t.nominal);

      final int sisaJatah = jatahHariIni - totalAmbil;
      final bool hasOverlimit = txHariIni.any((t) => t.isOverlimit);

      statuses.add(
        SantriStatusHariIni(
          santri: santri,
          totalAmbilHariIni: totalAmbil,
          sisaJatahHariIni: sisaJatah,
          jatahHariIni: jatahHariIni,
          transaksiHariIni: txHariIni,
          hasOverlimitToday: hasOverlimit,
        ),
      );
    }
    _santriStatusList = statuses;
    _totalKuotaHariIni = totalKuota;

    // 2. Metrics, Brankas, Multi-Dompet, Kantong Infak & Cash Opname
    _totalBrankasFisik = await _db.getTotalSaldoBrankasFisik();
    final saldoDompet = await _db.getSaldoDompet();
    _kasLaciTunai = saldoDompet['tunai'] ?? 0;
    _rekeningBank = saldoDompet['rekening'] ?? 0;

    final kantongInfak = await _db.getSaldoKantongInfak();
    _kasInfakTunai = (kantongInfak['tunai'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
    _kasInfakRekening = (kantongInfak['rekening'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
    _stokBerasFisikLiter = (kantongInfak['beras_stok'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
    _infakPeriodeList = await _db.getInfakByPeriode(_selectedInfakPeriode);
    _serahTerimaList = await _db.getSerahTerimaInfak();

    _opnameLogs = await _db.getCashOpnameLogs(limit: 15);
    _totalPengeluaranHariIni = await _db.getTotalPengeluaranHariIni(todayStr);
    _totalTunggakanPondok = await _db.getTotalTunggakanPondok();
    _rekapPagiSiang = await _db.getTotalPagiSiangHariIni(todayStr);
    _rekapSoreMalam = await _db.getTotalSoreMalamHariIni(todayStr);

    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final lastChangeStr = prefs.getString(_keyLastLocalChangeAt);
      if (lastChangeStr != null) {
        _lastLocalChangeAt = DateTime.tryParse(lastChangeStr);
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    notifyListeners();
  }

  List<SantriStatusHariIni> get saldoKritisList {
    final list = _santriStatusList
        .where((item) => item.santri.isAktifDiPondok && item.santri.estimasiHari < 3)
        .toList();
    list.sort((a, b) {
      final hariCmp = a.santri.estimasiHari.compareTo(b.santri.estimasiHari);
      if (hariCmp != 0) return hariCmp;
      return a.santri.saldoTotal.compareTo(b.santri.saldoTotal);
    });
    return list;
  }

  SantriStatusHariIni? findStatusByQrCode(String rawCode) {
    final code = rawCode.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (code.isEmpty) return null;
    for (final item in _santriStatusList) {
      if (item.santri.qrCode.toUpperCase() == code ||
          item.santri.id.toUpperCase() == code) {
        return item;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  List<SantriStatusHariIni> get filteredSantriStatusList {
    return _santriStatusList.where((item) {
      // Filter kamar
      final matchesKamar = _selectedKamar == null ||
          _selectedKamar!.isEmpty ||
          item.santri.kamar == _selectedKamar;
      if (!matchesKamar) return false;

      // Filter status / tunggakan
      if (_activeFilter == 'TUNGGAKAN') {
        if (!item.santri.isAktifDiPondok || item.santri.tunggakan <= 0) return false;
      } else if (_activeFilter == 'KRITIS') {
        if (!item.santri.isAktifDiPondok || item.santri.estimasiHari >= 3) return false;
      } else if (_activeFilter == 'UTUH') {
        if (item.badgeStatus != BadgeStatusHariIni.utuh) return false;
      } else if (_activeFilter == 'SEBAGIAN') {
        if (item.badgeStatus != BadgeStatusHariIni.sebagian) return false;
      } else if (_activeFilter == 'HABIS') {
        if (item.badgeStatus != BadgeStatusHariIni.limitHabis &&
            item.badgeStatus != BadgeStatusHariIni.overlimitKritis) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      // Search query
      if (_searchQuery.trim().isEmpty) return true;
      final query = _searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      final matchNama = item.santri.namaLengkap.toLowerCase().contains(query);
      final matchPanggilan = item.santri.namaPanggilan.toLowerCase().contains(query);
      final matchKamar = item.santri.kamar.toLowerCase().contains(query);

      return matchNama || matchPanggilan || matchKamar;
    }).toList();
  }

  // ==================== CATAT PENGAMBILAN (3-TAP UX) ====================

  Future<TransaksiHarian> catatPengambilan({
    required Santri santri,
    required int nominal,
    String? catatan,
    bool isOverlimit = false,
    OverlimitHandling? overlimitHandling,
    TimeCategory? waktuCategory,
  }) async {
    final tx = await _db.catatPengambilan(
      santriId: santri.id,
      nominal: nominal,
      catatan: catatan,
      isOverlimit: isOverlimit,
      overlimitHandling: overlimitHandling,
      waktuCategory: waktuCategory,
    );

    // Set 5-second undo (isolasi ke ValueNotifier tanpa notifyListeners global per detik)
    _lastTransaction = tx;
    _lastSantri = santri;
    _undoCountdown = 5;
    undoStateNotifier.value = UndoState(
      transaction: tx,
      santri: santri,
      countdown: _undoCountdown,
    );

    _undoTimer?.cancel();
    _undoTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (_undoCountdown > 1) {
        _undoCountdown--;
        final currentTx = _lastTransaction;
        final currentSantri = _lastSantri;
        if (currentTx != null && currentSantri != null) {
          undoStateNotifier.value = UndoState(
            transaction: currentTx,
            santri: currentSantri,
            countdown: _undoCountdown,
          );
        }
      } else {
        _undoCountdown = 0;
        _lastTransaction = null;
        _lastSantri = null;
        timer.cancel();
        undoStateNotifier.value = null;
      }
    });

    await markLocalDataChanged();
    await loadAllData();
    return tx;
  }

  Future<void> undoLastTransaction() async {
    if (_lastTransaction == null) return;
    _undoTimer?.cancel();

    final txId = _lastTransaction!.id;
    await _db.voidTransaksi(txId);

    _lastTransaction = null;
    _lastSantri = null;
    _undoCountdown = 0;
    undoStateNotifier.value = null;

    await markLocalDataChanged();
    await loadAllData();
  }

  void dismissUndo() {
    _undoTimer?.cancel();
    _lastTransaction = null;
    _lastSantri = null;
    _undoCountdown = 0;
    undoStateNotifier.value = null;
  }

  Future<void> shiftInfakPeriode(int deltaMonths) async {
    final parts = _selectedInfakPeriode.split('-');
    if (parts.length != 2) return;
    final y = int.tryParse(parts[0]) ?? DateTime.now().year;
    final m = int.tryParse(parts[1]) ?? DateTime.now().month;
    final shifted = DateTime(y, m + deltaMonths, 1);
    final nextYm =
        '${shifted.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-${shifted.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
    await setSelectedInfakPeriode(nextYm);
  }

  Future<String?> _persistSantriPhotoIfNeeded(
    String santriId,
    String? sourceFotoPath,
  ) async {
    if (sourceFotoPath == null || sourceFotoPath.trim().isEmpty) {
      return null;
    }
    final cleanPath = sourceFotoPath.trim();
    try {
      final src = File(cleanPath);
      if (!await src.exists()) {
        return cleanPath;
      }
      final appDir = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
      final profDir = Directory(p.join(appDir.path, 'profiles'));
      if (p.isWithin(profDir.path, cleanPath)) {
        return cleanPath;
      }
      if (!await profDir.exists()) {
        await profDir.create(recursive: true);
      }
      final ext = p.extension(cleanPath).isNotEmpty
          ? p.extension(cleanPath)
          : '.jpg';
      final safeId = santriId.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]'), '_');
      final dest = p.join(
        profDir.path,
        'santri_${safeId}_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}$ext',
      );
      await src.copy(dest);
      return dest;
    } catch (_) {
      return cleanPath;
    }
  }

    if (isEdit) {
      await _db.updateSantri(normalizedSantri);
      await _recordAudit(
        action: 'EDIT_SANTRI',
        targetId: normalizedSantri.id,
        summary: 'Mengubah data santri ${normalizedSantri.namaLengkap} (${normalizedSantri.kamar}).',
      );
    } else {
      await _db.insertSantri(normalizedSantri, sumberDompet: sumberDompet);
    }
    await markLocalDataChanged();
    await loadAllData();
  }

  Future<void> updateBendaharaProfile({
    String? namaLengkap,
    String? jabatan,
    String? sourceFotoPath,
    bool clearFoto = false,
  }) async {
    String? permanentFotoPath;
    if (sourceFotoPath != null && sourceFotoPath.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      final src = File(sourceFotoPath);
      if (await src.exists()) {
        final appDir = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
        final profDir = Directory(p.join(appDir.path, 'profiles'));
        if (!await profDir.exists()) {
          await profDir.create(recursive: true);
        }
        final ext = p.extension(sourceFotoPath).isNotEmpty
            ? p.extension(sourceFotoPath)
            : '.jpg';
        final dest = p.join(
          profDir.path,
          'bendahara_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}$ext',
        );
        await src.copy(dest);
        permanentFotoPath = dest;
      }
    }

    if (_activeAccount == null) {
      final created = await AccountAuthService.instance.enterOfflineQuickMode(
        namaLengkap: namaLengkap ?? _pengaturan.namaPengurus,
        jabatan: jabatan ?? 'Bendahara Pondok',
      );
      _activeAccount = created;
    }

    final updatedAcc = await AccountAuthService.instance.updateActiveProfile(
      namaLengkap: namaLengkap,
      jabatan: jabatan,
      fotoPath: permanentFotoPath,
      clearFoto: clearFoto,
    );
    await syncActiveAccountToPengaturan(updatedAcc);
  }

  Future<DateTime> backupToGoogleDriveNow() async {
    var email = _pengaturan.driveAccountEmail;
    if (email == null || email.isEmpty) {
      email = await connectGoogleDrive();
      if (email == null || email.isEmpty) {
        throw Exception('Akun Google belum ditautkan.');
      }
    }
    final payload = await _db.dumpBackupJson();
    final uploadedAt = await GoogleDriveBackupService.instance.uploadBackupJson(payload);
    final updated = _pengaturan.copyWith(
      lastDriveBackupAt: uploadedAt.toIso8601String(),
      driveAccountEmail: email,
    );
    _pengaturan = updated;
    _lastLocalChangeAt = uploadedAt;
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setString(_keyLastLocalChangeAt, uploadedAt.toIso8601String());
    } catch (_) {}
    await _db.updatePengaturan(updated);
    notifyListeners();
    return uploadedAt;
  }

  Future<void> toggleAutoDriveBackup(bool enabled) async {
    final updated = _pengaturan.copyWith(autoDriveBackup: enabled);
    _pengaturan = updated;
    await _db.updatePengaturan(updated);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<({BackupValidationResult validation, DateTime? modifiedTime})>
      fetchGoogleDriveBackupForRestore() async {
    return await GoogleDriveBackupService.instance.downloadAndValidateBackup();
  }

  Future<void> tryAutoBackupDriveInBackground() async {
    final uploadedAt = await GoogleDriveBackupService.instance.runDailyAutoBackupIfDue(
      settings: _pengaturan,
      dumpPayload: _db.dumpBackupJson,
    );
    if (uploadedAt != null) {
      final updated = _pengaturan.copyWith(
        lastDriveBackupAt: uploadedAt.toIso8601String(),
      );
      _pengaturan = updated;
      _lastLocalChangeAt = uploadedAt;
      try {
        final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
        await prefs.setString(_keyLastLocalChangeAt, uploadedAt.toIso8601String());
      } catch (_) {}
      await _db.updatePengaturan(updated);
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _undoTimer?.cancel();
    spotlightTourRequestNotifier.dispose();
    undoStateNotifier.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }
}

import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;
import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../utils/app_feedback.dart';

enum WallpaperPreset {
  sunriseBeach,
  obsidianAurora,
  emeraldMist,
  midnightGold,
  deepOceanGlass,
  matteCharcoal,
}

class WallpaperPresetSpec {
  final WallpaperPreset preset;
  final String name;
  final String subtitle;
  final List<Color> gradientColors;
  final Color glowPrimary;
  final Color glowSecondary;
  final Color accentColor;
  final String? bundledAssetPath;

  const WallpaperPresetSpec({
    required this.preset,
    required this.name,
    required this.subtitle,
    required this.gradientColors,
    required this.glowPrimary,
    required this.glowSecondary,
    required this.accentColor,
    this.bundledAssetPath,
  });
}

class ThemeWallpaperProvider extends ChangeNotifier {
  static const String defaultBundledWallpaperAsset =
      'assets/wallpapers/default_wallpaper.jpg';

  static const String _keyPreset = 'ks_v41_wallpaper_preset';
  static const String _keyCustomPath = 'ks_v32_custom_wallpaper_path';
  static const String _keyCardOpacity = 'ks_v32_card_opacity';
  static const String _keyWallpaperDim = 'ks_v32_wallpaper_dim';
  static const String _keyWallpaperBlur = 'ks_v32_wallpaper_blur';
  static const String _keyHapticEnabled = 'ks_v32_haptic_enabled';

  static const List<WallpaperPresetSpec> presets = [
    WallpaperPresetSpec(
      preset: WallpaperPreset.sunriseBeach,
      name: 'Sunrise Pantai Teduh',
      subtitle: 'Pantai matahari terbit bawaan (Default)',
      gradientColors: [Color(0xFF061523), Color(0xFF102A3B), Color(0xFF07131E)],
      glowPrimary: Color(0xFFF59E0B),
      glowSecondary: Color(0xFF10B981),
      accentColor: Color(0xFFFBBF24),
      bundledAssetPath: defaultBundledWallpaperAsset,
    ),
    WallpaperPresetSpec(
      preset: WallpaperPreset.obsidianAurora,
      name: 'Obsidian Aurora',
      subtitle: 'Klasik emerald & cyan malam tenang',
      gradientColors: [Color(0xFF040811), Color(0xFF0A1626), Color(0xFF06111A)],
      glowPrimary: Color(0xFF10B981),
      glowSecondary: Color(0xFF06B6D4),
      accentColor: Color(0xFF34D399),
    ),
    WallpaperPresetSpec(
      preset: WallpaperPreset.emeraldMist,
      name: 'Emerald Mist',
      subtitle: 'Hijau zamrud teduh pesantren',
      gradientColors: [Color(0xFF03100E), Color(0xFF082420), Color(0xFF051318)],
      glowPrimary: Color(0xFF059669),
      glowSecondary: Color(0xFF34D399),
      accentColor: Color(0xFF6EE7B7),
    ),
    WallpaperPresetSpec(
      preset: WallpaperPreset.midnightGold,
      name: 'Midnight Gold',
      subtitle: 'Biru malam elegan aksen emas',
      gradientColors: [Color(0xFF070812), Color(0xFF141129), Color(0xFF0B0E17)],
      glowPrimary: Color(0xFFF59E0B),
      glowSecondary: Color(0xFF8B5CF6),
      accentColor: Color(0xFFFBBF24),
    ),
    WallpaperPresetSpec(
      preset: WallpaperPreset.deepOceanGlass,
      name: 'Deep Ocean Glass',
      subtitle: 'Samudra biru kaca bening modern',
      gradientColors: [Color(0xFF030B16), Color(0xFF0A203A), Color(0xFF061529)],
      glowPrimary: Color(0xFF38BDF8),
      glowSecondary: Color(0xFF6366F1),
      accentColor: Color(0xFF7DD3FC),
    ),
    WallpaperPresetSpec(
      preset: WallpaperPreset.matteCharcoal,
      name: 'Matte Charcoal',
      subtitle: 'Gelap kontras tinggi super ringan',
      gradientColors: [Color(0xFF07090E), Color(0xFF121722), Color(0xFF090C12)],
      glowPrimary: Color(0xFF38BDF8),
      glowSecondary: Color(0xFF10B981),
      accentColor: Color(0xFF67E8F9),
    ),
  ];

  WallpaperPreset _preset = WallpaperPreset.sunriseBeach;
  WallpaperPreset get preset => _preset;

  String? _customWallpaperPath;
  String? get customWallpaperPath => _customWallpaperPath;

  double _cardOpacity = 0.68;
  double get cardOpacity => _cardOpacity;

  double _wallpaperDim = 0.46;
  double get wallpaperDim => _wallpaperDim;

  double _wallpaperBlur = 2.0;
  double get wallpaperBlur => _wallpaperBlur;

  bool _hapticEnabled = true;
  bool get hapticEnabled => _hapticEnabled;

  WallpaperPresetSpec get activeSpec {
    return presets.firstWhere(
      (s) => s.preset == _preset,
      orElse: () => presets.first,
    );
  }

  bool get hasValidCustomWallpaper {
    final path = _customWallpaperPath;
    return path != null && path.trim().isNotEmpty;
  }

  Future<void> init() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final presetName = prefs.getString(_keyPreset);
      if (presetName != null) {
        _preset = WallpaperPreset.values.firstWhere(
          (e) => e.name == presetName,
          orElse: () => WallpaperPreset.sunriseBeach,
        );
      } else {
        _preset = WallpaperPreset.sunriseBeach;
      }
      _customWallpaperPath = prefs.getString(_keyCustomPath);
      _cardOpacity = (prefs.getDouble(_keyCardOpacity) ?? 0.68).clamp(0.35, 0.95);
      _wallpaperDim = (prefs.getDouble(_keyWallpaperDim) ?? 0.46).clamp(0.15, 0.85);
      _wallpaperBlur = (prefs.getDouble(_keyWallpaperBlur) ?? 2.0).clamp(0.0, 20.0);
      _hapticEnabled = prefs.getBool(_keyHapticEnabled) ?? true;
      AppFeedback.hapticEnabled = _hapticEnabled;
    } catch (_) {}
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setPreset(WallpaperPreset newPreset) async {
    _preset = newPreset;
    _customWallpaperPath = null;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setString(_keyPreset, newPreset.name);
      await prefs.remove(_keyCustomPath);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<String> setCustomWallpaperFromFile(String sourcePath) async {
    final src = File(sourcePath);
    if (!await src.exists()) {
      throw Exception('File gambar tidak ditemukan.');
    }
    final appDir = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
    final wallpaperDir = Directory(p.join(appDir.path, 'wallpapers'));
    if (!await wallpaperDir.exists()) {
      await wallpaperDir.create(recursive: true);
    }
    final ext = p.extension(sourcePath).isNotEmpty ? p.extension(sourcePath) : '.jpg';
    final destPath = p.join(
      wallpaperDir.path,
      'bg_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}$ext',
    );
    await src.copy(destPath);

    final oldPath = _customWallpaperPath;
    _customWallpaperPath = destPath;
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setString(_keyCustomPath, destPath);
    } catch (_) {}

    if (oldPath != null && oldPath != destPath) {
      try {
        final oldFile = File(oldPath);
        if (await oldFile.exists()) {
          await oldFile.delete();
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    return destPath;
  }

  Future<void> clearCustomWallpaper() async {
    final oldPath = _customWallpaperPath;
    _customWallpaperPath = null;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.remove(_keyCustomPath);
    } catch (_) {}
    if (oldPath != null) {
      try {
        final oldFile = File(oldPath);
        if (await oldFile.exists()) {
          await oldFile.delete();
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  Future<void> setCardOpacity(double value) async {
    _cardOpacity = value.clamp(0.35, 0.95);
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setDouble(_keyCardOpacity, _cardOpacity);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> setWallpaperDim(double value) async {
    _wallpaperDim = value.clamp(0.15, 0.85);
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setDouble(_keyWallpaperDim, _wallpaperDim);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> setWallpaperBlur(double value) async {
    _wallpaperBlur = value.clamp(0.0, 20.0);
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setDouble(_keyWallpaperBlur, _wallpaperBlur);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> setHapticEnabled(bool enabled) async {
    _hapticEnabled = enabled;
    AppFeedback.hapticEnabled = enabled;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setBool(_keyHapticEnabled, enabled);
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../../models/bendahara_account.dart';
import '../../providers/kas_santri_provider.dart';
import '../../services/account_auth_service.dart';
import '../../services/auth_service.dart';
import '../../services/google_drive_backup_service.dart';
import '../../utils/app_feedback.dart';
import '../../widgets/app_background_wrapper.dart';
import '../main_navigation_screen.dart';
import '../pin_lock_screen.dart';

class LoginScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final bool isSwitchingAccount;

  const LoginScreen({
    Key? key,
    this.isSwitchingAccount = false,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<LoginScreen> createState() => _LoginScreenState();
}

class _LoginScreenState extends State<LoginScreen> {
  bool _isRegisterMode = false;
  bool _rememberSession = true;
  bool _obscurePass = true;
  bool _isBusy = false;
  String? _errorMsg;
  bool _isGoogleFriendlyNotice = false;
  List<BendaharaAccount> _savedLocalAccounts = [];

  final _namaController = TextEditingController();
  final _jabatanController = TextEditingController(text: 'Bendahara Putra');
  final _usernameController = TextEditingController();
  final _passwordController = TextEditingController();
  final _confirmPassController = TextEditingController();

  static const List<String> _jabatanPresets = [
    'Bendahara Putra',
    'Bendahara Putri',
    'Bendahara Umum',
    'Musyrif Kas',
  ];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadSavedAccounts();
  }

  Future<void> _loadSavedAccounts() async {
    final all = await AccountAuthService.instance.getAllAccounts();
    final local = all
        .where((a) => a.authMode == BendaharaAccount.modeLocal)
        .toList();
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() => _savedLocalAccounts = local);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _namaController.dispose();
    _jabatanController.dispose();
    _usernameController.dispose();
    _passwordController.dispose();
    _confirmPassController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _onAuthenticated(BendaharaAccount account) async {
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    await provider.syncActiveAccountToPengaturan(account);

    if (!mounted) return;
    AppFeedback.success();

    if (widget.isSwitchingAccount) {
      Navigator.pop(context, true);
      return;
    }

    final shouldLock = await AuthService.instance.shouldLockApp();
    if (!mounted) return;

    if (shouldLock) {
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (_) => const PinLockScreen(isUnlockingSession: true),
        ),
      );
    } else {
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const MainNavigationScreen()),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _submitLocalAuth() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    setState(() {
      _isBusy = true;
      _errorMsg = null;
      _isGoogleFriendlyNotice = false;
    });
    try {
      final BendaharaAccount account;
      if (_isRegisterMode) {
        if (_passwordController.text != _confirmPassController.text) {
          throw Exception('Konfirmasi password tidak cocok.');
        }
        account = await AccountAuthService.instance.registerLocalAccount(
          namaLengkap: _namaController.text,
          jabatan: _jabatanController.text,
          username: _usernameController.text,
          password: _passwordController.text,
          rememberSession: _rememberSession,
        );
      } else {
        account = await AccountAuthService.instance.loginLocal(
          username: _usernameController.text,
          password: _passwordController.text,
          rememberSession: _rememberSession,
        );
      }
      if (!mounted) return;
      await _onAuthenticated(account);
    } catch (e) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _errorMsg = e.toString().replaceFirst('Exception: ', '');
        });
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isBusy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _submitGoogleLogin() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    AppFeedback.tap();
    setState(() {
      _isBusy = true;
      _errorMsg = null;
      _isGoogleFriendlyNotice = false;
    });
    try {
      final account = await AccountAuthService.instance.loginWithGoogle(
        rememberSession: _rememberSession,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      await _onAuthenticated(account);
    } catch (e) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      final friendly = GoogleDriveBackupService.mapAuthError(e);
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isGoogleFriendlyNotice = true;
          _errorMsg = friendly.message;
        });
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isBusy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _submitOfflineQuickMode() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    final nameCtrl = TextEditingController(
      text: provider.pengaturan.namaPengurus.trim().isNotEmpty
          ? provider.pengaturan.namaPengurus
          : 'Pengurus Kas & Keuangan',
    );
    final jabCtrl = TextEditingController(text: 'Bendahara Pondok');

    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text(
          '⚡ Mode Offline Cepat',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
        ),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            const Text(
              'Masuk langsung tanpa sinyal internet atau password. Nama petugas akan tercatat pada struk & serah terima.',
              style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextField(
              controller: nameCtrl,
              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 13),
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                labelText: 'Nama Petugas / Bendahara',
                isDense: true,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            TextField(
              controller: jabCtrl,
              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 13),
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                labelText: 'Jabatan',
                isDense: true,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Batal', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white60)),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Masuk Sekarang'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    final namaVal = nameCtrl.text;
    final jabVal = jabCtrl.text;
    nameCtrl.dispose();
    jabCtrl.dispose();

    if (confirmed != true || !mounted) return;

    setState(() => _isBusy = true);
    try {
      final account = await AccountAuthService.instance.enterOfflineQuickMode(
        namaLengkap: namaVal,
        jabatan: jabVal,
        rememberSession: true,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      await _onAuthenticated(account);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isBusy = false);
    }
  }

  Widget _modePill(
    String label, {
    required bool selected,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: () {
        AppFeedback.tap();
        onTap();
      },
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11),
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 9),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          gradient: selected
              ? const LinearGradient(colors: [Color(0xFF10B981), Color(0xFF06B6D4)])
              : null,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11),
        ),
        alignment: Alignment.center,
        child: Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(
            color: selected ? const Color(0xFF040914) : Colors.white70,
            fontSize: 12,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

    this.headerCrownSpotlightKey,
    this.vaultSpotlightKey,
    this.addSantriSpotlightKey,

  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<HomeFastWithdrawalScreen> createState() => _HomeFastWithdrawalScreenState();
}

class _HomeFastWithdrawalScreenState extends State<HomeFastWithdrawalScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin, AutomaticKeepAliveClientMixin {
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  bool _showBanner = true;
  late AnimationController _crownGlowController;
  Timer? _clockTimer;
  final ValueNotifier<DateTime> _clockNotifier =
      ValueNotifier<DateTime>(DateTime.now().toLocal());

  @override
  bool get wantKeepAlive => true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _crownGlowController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
    )..repeat(reverse: true);
    _clockTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 15), (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        _clockNotifier.value = DateTime.now().toLocal();
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _clockTimer?.cancel();
    _clockNotifier.dispose();
    _crownGlowController.dispose();
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _pickLogo() async {
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    if (!provider.isProUser) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: 'Kustomisasi Logo Pondok Resmi',
      );
      return;
    }
    final result = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(type: FileType.image);
    if (result != null && result.files.single.path != null) {
      await provider.updateLogoPath(result.files.single.path);
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('Logo pondok berhasil diperbarui!'),
            backgroundColor: Color(0xFF10B981),
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _scanQrAndOpenWithdrawal() async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    if (!provider.isProUser) {
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: 'Scan QR Kartu Santri (Mode Antrean Kilat 1 Detik)',
      );
      return;
    }

    final scannedCode = await QrScannerScreen.scan(context);
    if (scannedCode == null || !mounted) return;

    final status = provider.findStatusByQrCode(scannedCode);
    if (status == null) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('QR Code "$scannedCode" tidak cocok dengan santri aktif.'),
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    AppFeedback.success();
    FastWithdrawalBottomSheet.show(context, status);
  }

  Widget _buildFilterPill(
    String label,
    String filterKey,
    KasSantriProvider provider, {
    bool isRed = false,
    bool isAmber = false,
    bool isProGated = false,
  }) {
    final isSelected = provider.activeFilter == filterKey;
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () {
          AppFeedback.tap();
          if (isProGated && !provider.isProUser) {
            PaywallScreen.show(
              context,
              triggerFeature: 'Pantau Santri Saldo Kritis (< 3 Hari)',
            );
            return;
          }
          provider.setFilter(filterKey);
        },
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 4),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: isSelected
                ? (isRed
                    ? const LinearGradient(colors: [Color(0xFFF43F5E), Color(0xFFD946EF)])
                    : (isAmber
                        ? const LinearGradient(colors: [Color(0xFFFBBF24), Color(0xFFF97316)])
                        : const LinearGradient(colors: [Color(0xFF34D399), Color(0xFF38BDF8)])))
                : null,
            color: isSelected
                ? null
                : (isRed
                    ? const Color(0xFF3F0A18).withOpacity(0.5)
                    : (isAmber ? const Color(0xFF451A03).withOpacity(0.55) : const Color(0xFF0F172A))),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
            border: Border.all(
              color: isSelected
                  ? Colors.transparent
                  : (isRed
                      ? const Color(0xFFFB7185).withOpacity(0.4)
                      : (isAmber ? const Color(0xFFFBBF24).withOpacity(0.45) : Colors.white12)),
            ),
            boxShadow: isSelected
                ? [
                    BoxShadow(
                      color: (isRed
                              ? const Color(0xFFF43F5E)
                              : (isAmber ? const Color(0xFFF59E0B) : const Color(0xFF10B981)))
                          .withOpacity(0.4),
                      blurRadius: 8,
                      offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                    ),
                  ]
                : null,
          ),
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: TextStyle(
              color: isSelected
                  ? const Color(0xFF030712)
                  : (isRed
                      ? const Color(0xFFFECDD3)
                      : (isAmber ? const Color(0xFFFDE68A) : Colors.white70)),
              fontSize: 10.5,
              fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w900 : FontWeight.w700,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:ui';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../providers/kas_santri_provider.dart';
import '../providers/theme_wallpaper_provider.dart';
import '../services/auth_service.dart';
import '../services/tutorial_service.dart';
import '../utils/app_feedback.dart';
import '../widgets/guided_spotlight_tour.dart';
import 'home_fast_withdrawal_screen.dart';
import 'pin_lock_screen.dart';
import 'rekap/rekap_laporan_screen.dart';
import 'setoran/setoran_screen.dart';
import 'settings/system_tab_screen.dart';
import 'transaksi/riwayat_transaksi_screen.dart';

class MainNavigationScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const MainNavigationScreen({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<MainNavigationScreen> createState() => _MainNavigationScreenState();
}

class _MainNavigationScreenState extends State<MainNavigationScreen>
    with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  int _setoranSubTab = 0;
  String? _preselectedSetoranSantriId;
  late final PageController _pageController;

  // GlobalKey untuk 6 Langkah Guided Spotlight Tour
  final GlobalKey _spotHeaderCrownKey = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _spotVaultKey = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _spotAddSantriKey = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _spotSantriCardsKey = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _spotBottomNavKey = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _spotSystemHeaderKey = GlobalKey();

  late final List<SpotlightStepSpec> _tourSteps;
  bool _isTourActive = false;
  int _tourStepIndex = 0;
  KasSantriProvider? _providerRef;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _pageController = PageController(initialPage: 0);
    _tourSteps = [
      SpotlightStepSpec(
        targetKey: _spotHeaderCrownKey,
        tabIndex: 0,
        emoji: '👑',
        title: 'Identitas Pondok & Mahkota PRO',
        description:
            'Ketuk mahkota 👑 untuk coba PRO Gratis 14 Hari atau upgrade paket. Ketuk logo di kiri untuk memasang logo resmi pondok Anda.',
        accent: const Color(0xFFFBBF24),
      ),
      SpotlightStepSpec(
        targetKey: _spotVaultKey,
        tabIndex: 0,
        emoji: '🏦',
        title: 'Brankas Titipan & Multi-Dompet',
        description:
            'Pantau total uang titipan seluruh santri, pemisahan Kas Laci Tunai vs Rekening Bank, pengeluaran hari ini, dan total tunggakan.',
        accent: const Color(0xFF34D399),
      ),
      SpotlightStepSpec(
        targetKey: _spotAddSantriKey,
        tabIndex: 0,
        emoji: '➕',
        title: 'Tombol + Santri Baru',
        description:
            'Tambahkan data santri baru dengan ringkas (saldo awal Rp 0, lalu isi saldo lewat menu Setoran agar tercatat rapi di mutasi).',
        accent: const Color(0xFF6EE7B7),
      ),
      SpotlightStepSpec(
        targetKey: _spotSantriCardsKey,
        tabIndex: 0,
        emoji: '💸',
        title: 'Kartu Santri 2 Kotak & Scan QR',
        description:
            'Ketuk kartu santri untuk mencatat ambil uang harian 3 detik, ketuk 📷 QR untuk mode antrean, atau geser layar kanan/kiri untuk pindah menu.',
        accent: const Color(0xFF38BDF8),
      ),
      SpotlightStepSpec(
        targetKey: _spotBottomNavKey,
        tabIndex: 0,
        emoji: '🧭',
        title: '5 Menu Utama Bawah',
        description:
            'Kas & Ambil (harian), Setoran (Sambangan/Top-Up & Buku Infak), Mutasi (riwayat & void), Rekap WA (laporan wali & yayasan), serta Sistem.',
        accent: const Color(0xFFA78BFA),
      ),
      SpotlightStepSpec(
        targetKey: _spotSystemHeaderKey,
        tabIndex: 4,
        emoji: '⚙️',
        title: 'Tab Sistem & Pengaturan Lengkap',
        description:
            'Gunakan ⚡ Akses Cepat Pengurus untuk Cash Opname, Kartu QR, Wallpaper, Backup, atau ketuk ⚙️ Pengaturan di kanan atas untuk aturan pondok.',
        accent: const Color(0xFF22D3EE),
      ),
    ];

    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final prov = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
      _providerRef = prov;
      prov.spotlightTourRequestNotifier.addListener(_onReplaySpotlightRequested);
      prov.tryAutoBackupDriveInBackground();
      _checkFirstTimeWalkthrough();
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _providerRef?.spotlightTourRequestNotifier
        .removeListener(_onReplaySpotlightRequested);
    _pageController.dispose();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _checkFirstTimeWalkthrough() async {
    final seen = await TutorialService.instance.hasSeenWalkthrough();
    if (!seen && mounted) {
      await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 420));
      if (mounted) {
        await _startSpotlightTour();
      }
    }
  }

  void _onReplaySpotlightRequested() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    _startSpotlightTour();
  }

  Future<void> _startSpotlightTour() async {
    await _navigateToTourStep(0);
  }

  Future<void> _navigateToTourStep(int stepIdx) async {
    if (stepIdx < 0 || stepIdx >= _tourSteps.length) {
      await _finishSpotlightTour();
      return;
    }

    final spec = _tourSteps[stepIdx];
    if (_currentIndex != spec.tabIndex) {
      _goToPage(spec.tabIndex);
      await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 320));
    }

    if (!mounted) return;
    final targetCtx = spec.targetKey.currentContext;
    if (targetCtx != null) {
      try {
        await Scrollable.ensureVisible(
          targetCtx,
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
          alignment: 0.20,
        );
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _isTourActive = true;
      _tourStepIndex = stepIdx;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _finishSpotlightTour() async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    await TutorialService.instance.markWalkthroughSeen();
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _isTourActive = false;
      _tourStepIndex = 0;
    });
    if (_currentIndex != 0) {
      _goToPage(0);
    }
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    if (state == AppLifecycleState.paused) {
      AuthService.instance.updateLastActive();
    } else if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed) {
      _checkLockOnResume();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _checkLockOnResume() async {
    final shouldLock = await AuthService.instance.shouldLockApp();
    if (shouldLock && mounted) {
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const PinLockScreen(isUnlockingSession: true)),
      );
    }
  }

  void _goToPage(int index) {
    if (_pageController.hasClients) {
      _pageController.animateToPage(
        index,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 280),
        curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      );
    } else {
      setState(() => _currentIndex = index);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final bottomSafe = MediaQuery.of(context).padding.bottom;
    final cardOpacity = Provider.of<ThemeWallpaperProvider>(context).cardOpacity;
    final navBgOpacity = (cardOpacity * 0.95).clamp(0.45, 0.94);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      body: Stack(
        children: [
          // 5 Tab Utama yang mendukung gestur geser kiri/kanan (Swipeable Tabs)
          PageView(
            controller: _pageController,
            physics: _isTourActive
                ? const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics()
                : const ClampingScrollPhysics(),
            onPageChanged: (idx) {
              if (_currentIndex != idx) {
                setState(() => _currentIndex = idx);
              }
            },
            children: [
              HomeFastWithdrawalScreen(
                headerCrownSpotlightKey: _spotHeaderCrownKey,
                vaultSpotlightKey: _spotVaultKey,
                addSantriSpotlightKey: _spotAddSantriKey,
                cardsAreaSpotlightKey: _spotSantriCardsKey,
                onOpenBukuInfak: () {
                  setState(() => _setoranSubTab = 1);
                  _goToPage(1);
                },
                onOpenSetoranForSantri: (santriId) {
                  setState(() {
                    _setoranSubTab = 0;
                    _preselectedSetoranSantriId = santriId;
                  });
                  _goToPage(1);
                },
              ),
              SetoranScreen(
                activeSubTab: _setoranSubTab,
                preselectedSantriId: _preselectedSetoranSantriId,
                onSubTabChanged: (sub) => setState(() => _setoranSubTab = sub),
                onSaved: () => _goToPage(0),
              ),
              const RiwayatTransaksiScreen(),
              const RekapLaporanScreen(),
              SystemTabScreen(
                headerSpotlightKey: _spotSystemHeaderKey,
              ),
            ],
          ),

          // Floating Glass Bottom Navigation Bar (1-satunya BackdropFilter yang diisolasi RepaintBoundary)
          Positioned(
            left: 16,
            right: 16,
            bottom: 12 + bottomSafe,
            child: RepaintBoundary(
              key: _spotBottomNavKey,
              child: ClipRRect(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
                child: BackdropFilter(
                  filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 14, sigmaY: 14),
                  child: Container(
                    height: 62,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 6),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      gradient: LinearGradient(
                        colors: [
                          const Color(0xFF071A2C).withValues(alpha: navBgOpacity),
                          const Color(0xFF0B1328).withValues(alpha: navBgOpacity),
                        ],
                      ),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
                      border: Border.all(
                        color: const Color(0xFF38BDF8).withValues(alpha: 0.32),
                      ),
                      boxShadow: [
                        BoxShadow(
                          color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.55),
                          blurRadius: 22,
                          offset: const Offset(0, 8),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceAround,
                      children: [
                        _buildNavItem(0, '💸', 'Kas & Ambil'),
                        _buildNavItem(1, '📥', 'Setoran'),
                        _buildNavItem(2, '📜', 'Mutasi'),
                        _buildNavItem(3, '📊', 'Rekap WA'),
                        _buildNavItem(4, '⚙️', 'Sistem'),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),

          // Guided Spotlight Tour 6 Langkah
          if (_isTourActive)
            Positioned.fill(
              child: GuidedSpotlightOverlay(
                steps: _tourSteps,
                currentStep: _tourStepIndex,
                onNext: () {
                  AppFeedback.tap();
                  _navigateToTourStep(_tourStepIndex + 1);
                },
                onPrev: () {
                  AppFeedback.tap();
                  if (_tourStepIndex > 0) {
                    _navigateToTourStep(_tourStepIndex - 1);
                  }
                },
                onSkip: _finishSpotlightTour,
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNavItem(int index, String emoji, String label) {
    final isSelected = _currentIndex == index;
    return Expanded(
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () {
          AppFeedback.tap();
          _goToPage(index);
        },
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isSelected ? const Color(0xFF10B981).withValues(alpha: 0.2) : Colors.transparent,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            border: isSelected
                ? Border.all(color: const Color(0xFF34D399).withValues(alpha: 0.45), width: 1)

          ),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Text(
                emoji,
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 2),
              Text(
                label,
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: isSelected ? const Color(0xFF34D399) : Colors.white60,
                  fontSize: 9.5,
                  fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w900 : FontWeight.w600,
                ),
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'main_navigation_screen.dart';

class OnboardingScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final bool isReplayMode;

  const OnboardingScreen({
    Key? key,
    this.isReplayMode = false,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<OnboardingScreen> createState() => _OnboardingScreenState();
}

class _OnboardingScreenState extends State<OnboardingScreen> {
  final PageController _pageController = PageController();
  late final TextEditingController _namaPondokController;
  late final TextEditingController _namaPengurusController;
  late final TextEditingController _jatahDefaultController;

  int _currentSlide = 0;
  int _pembulatanJatah = 500;
  bool _useSimulationData = false;
  bool _isSubmitting = false;

  static const List<_OnboardingSlideSpec> _introSlides = [
    _OnboardingSlideSpec(
      emoji: '🕌',
      badge: 'SELAMAT DATANG DI KAS-SANTRI',
      title: 'Selamat Datang di Kas-Santri',
      description:
          'Kelola uang jajan santri, infak bulanan, dan brankas pondok tanpa pusing & tanpa selisih.',
      highlights: [
        '✨ Tampilan bening modern yang lega & tidak bikin mata lelah',
        '🔒 Aman 100% offline di HP pengurus maupun cadangan cloud',
        '⚡ Dirancang khusus mengikuti ritme harian bendahara pesantren',
      ],
      accent: Color(0xFF34D399),
      secondaryAccent: Color(0xFF06B6D4),
    ),
    _OnboardingSlideSpec(
      emoji: '⚡',
      badge: 'TRANSAKSI HARIAN KILAT',
      title: 'Ambil Uang 3 Detik & Scan QR',
      description:
          'Ketuk kartu 2 kotak atau pindai QR santri saat antrean padat; sisa jatah harian terhitung otomatis.',
      highlights: [
        '⊞ Pilihan tampilan 2 Kotak ringkas atau 1 Baris detail',
        '📷 Pindai Kartu QR santri langsung membuka nominal siap cair',
        '↩️ Salah pencet? Tersedia tombol Undo otomatis 5 detik',
      ],
      accent: Color(0xFF38BDF8),
      secondaryAccent: Color(0xFF818CF8),
    ),
    _OnboardingSlideSpec(
      emoji: '🎁',
      badge: 'SMART SPLIT & BUKU INFAK',
      title: 'Setoran Sambangan & Buku Infak',
      description:
          'Uang sambangan wali langsung terbagi otomatis ke Infak Masak, Listrik, Beras (Liter/Rp), dan Saldo Jajan.',
      highlights: [
        '🎁 Mode Sambangan memotong pos infak & tunggakan otomatis',
        '➕ Mode Top-Up Jajan murni menambah saldo saku & jatah harian',
        '🌾 Buku Infak memantau beras gudang & serah terima yayasan',
      ],
      accent: Color(0xFFFBBF24),
      secondaryAccent: Color(0xFF10B981),
    ),
    _OnboardingSlideSpec(
      emoji: '📲',
      badge: 'AKUNTABEL & TRANSPARAN',
      title: 'Bebas Selisih & 1-Klik WA Wali',
      description:
          'Cek Cash Opname malam hari, kirim laporan mutasi santun ke WA orang tua, & cetak PDF/Excel resmi yayasan.',
      highlights: [
        '🧮 Kalkulator pecahan fisik Cash Opname mencegah uang selisih',
        '💬 Pesan WhatsApp otomatis santun lengkap rincian keluar-masuk',
        '📄 Cetak Laporan PDF berkop pondok & Excel multi-sheet rapi',
      ],
      accent: Color(0xFFE879F9),
      secondaryAccent: Color(0xFF38BDF8),
    ),
  ];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    final peng = provider.pengaturan;
    final initialPondok =
        (peng.namaPondok.trim().isNotEmpty && peng.namaPondok != 'Nama Pondok')
            ? peng.namaPondok
            : (widget.isReplayMode ? peng.namaPondok : '');
    _namaPondokController = TextEditingController(text: initialPondok);
    _namaPengurusController = TextEditingController(
      text: peng.namaPengurus.trim().isNotEmpty
          ? peng.namaPengurus
          : 'Pengurus Kas & Keuangan',
    );
    _jatahDefaultController = TextEditingController(
      text: CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(
        peng.defaultJatahHarian > 0 ? peng.defaultJatahHarian : 10000,
      ),
    );
    _pembulatanJatah = peng.pembulatanJatah == 1000 ? 1000 : 500;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pageController.dispose();
    _namaPondokController.dispose();
    _namaPengurusController.dispose();
    _jatahDefaultController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _goToSlide(int index) {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    _pageController.animateToPage(
      index.clamp(0, 4),
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
    );
  }

  void _handleSkip() {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    if (widget.isReplayMode) {
      Navigator.pop(context);
      return;
    }
    _goToSlide(4);
  }

  Future<void> _submitSetup() async {
    if (_isSubmitting) return;
    final rawPondok = _namaPondokController.text.trim();
    final finalNamaPondok = rawPondok.isNotEmpty ? rawPondok : 'Nama Pondok';
    final finalPengurus = _namaPengurusController.text.trim().isNotEmpty
        ? _namaPengurusController.text.trim()
        : 'Pengurus Kas & Keuangan';
    final parsedJatah = CurrencyFormatter.parse(_jatahDefaultController.text);
    final finalJatah = parsedJatah > 0 ? parsedJatah : 10000;

    setState(() => _isSubmitting = true);
    AppFeedback.success();

    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    await TutorialService.instance.markOnboardingSeen();

    if (widget.isReplayMode) {
      await provider.savePengaturan(
        provider.pengaturan.copyWith(
          namaPondok: finalNamaPondok,
          namaPengurus: finalPengurus,
          defaultJatahHarian: finalJatah,
          pembulatanJatah: _pembulatanJatah,
        ),
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      Navigator.pop(context);
      return;
    }

    await provider.completeOnboarding(
      namaPondok: finalNamaPondok,
      namaPengurus: finalPengurus,
      defaultJatahHarian: finalJatah,
      pembulatanJatah: _pembulatanJatah,
      useSimulationData: _useSimulationData,
    );

    final quickAcc = await AccountAuthService.instance.enterOfflineQuickMode(
      namaLengkap: finalPengurus,
      jabatan: 'Bendahara Pondok',
      rememberSession: true,
    );
    await provider.syncActiveAccountToPengaturan(quickAcc);

    if (!mounted) return;
    Navigator.pushReplacement(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const MainNavigationScreen()),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AppBackgroundWrapper(
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: Column(
            children: [
              // Top bar: Indikator Slide + Tombol Lewati
              Padding(

                      ),
                      child: Text(

                        style: const TextStyle(
                          color: Color(0xFF67E8F9),

                      ),
                    ),
                    if (_currentSlide < 4 || widget.isReplayMode)
                      TextButton(
                        onPressed: _handleSkip,
                        style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                          foregroundColor: Colors.white70,

                      ),
                  ],

              ),

              // 5 Slide PageView
              Expanded(
                child: PageView(

                  onPageChanged: (idx) => setState(() => _currentSlide = idx),
                  children: [

                  ],

              // Bottom Controls: Dots + Back/Next (untuk slide 1-4)
              Padding(

                  children: [
                    Row(

                      children: List.generate(5, (idx) {

  static Widget _statusRow(String label, String value, Color valueColor) {
    return Row(
      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
      children: [
        Text(label, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white54, fontSize: 11.5)),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        Flexible(
          child: Text(
            value,
            textAlign: TextAlign.right,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: TextStyle(
              color: valueColor,
              fontSize: 11.5,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  @override
  State<PaywallScreen> createState() => _PaywallScreenState();
}

class _PaywallScreenState extends State<PaywallScreen> {
  String _selectedPlan = 'YEARLY'; // YEARLY, MONTHLY, LIFETIME
  String _selectedPaymentMethod = 'QRIS';
  List<SubscriptionPlanOffer> _offers = SubscriptionService.defaultFallbackOffers();
  bool _isProcessingPurchase = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadPlayStoreOffers();
  }

  Future<void> _loadPlayStoreOffers() async {
    final loaded = await SubscriptionService.instance.loadOffers();
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() => _offers = loaded);
    }
  }

  SubscriptionPlanOffer get _selectedOffer {
    for (final offer in _offers) {
      if (offer.planKey == _selectedPlan) return offer;
    }
    return _offers.first;
  }

  String get _selectedDurationLabel {
    switch (_selectedPlan) {
      case 'MONTHLY':
        return '1 bulan';
      case 'LIFETIME':
        return 'Selamanya';
      case 'YEARLY':
      default:
        return '12 bulan';
    }
  }

  void _showFloatingSnackBar(
    String message, {
    Color backgroundColor = const Color(0xFF10B981),
  }) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(message, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
        backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 92),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _handleStartTrial() async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    final res = await provider.startFreeTrial14Days();
    if (!mounted) return;

    if (!res.success) {
      _showFloatingSnackBar(res.message, backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF59E0B));
      return;
    }

    AppFeedback.success();
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0E1422),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
          side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF34D399), width: 1.5),
        ),
        title: const Row(
          children: [
            Text('🎉 ', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 24)),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                'Uji Coba PRO 14 Hari Aktif!',
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: Color(0xFF34D399),
                  fontSize: 16.5,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        content: const Text(
          'Alhamdulillah! Seluruh fitur Kas-Santri PRO kini terbuka penuh selama 14 hari ke depan:\n\n'
          '• Santri Tanpa Batas\n'
          '• Multi-Dompet Tunai Laci vs Rekening Bank\n'
          '• Kalkulator Cash Opname Fisik\n'
          '• Scan & Cetak Kartu QR Santri\n'
          '• Ekspor Excel & PDF Berkop Logo\n'
          '• WA 1-Klik, Struk Gambar PNG, Biometrik & Google Drive',
          style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12.5, height: 1.45),
        ),
        actions: [
          SizedBox(
            width: double.infinity,
            height: 44,
            child: ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () {
                AppFeedback.tap();
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
              },
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
                foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF030712),
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
              ),
              child: const Text(
                'Mulai Gunakan Kas-Santri PRO',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (mounted) {
      Navigator.pop(context);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _handleRestore() async {
    if (_isProcessingPurchase) return;
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);

    if (!kIsPlayStoreBuild) {
      setState(() => _isProcessingPurchase = true);
      try {
        await provider.syncSubscriptionEntitlement();
        if (!mounted) return;
        if (provider.activeLicense != null && provider.activeLicense!.isValid) {
          AppFeedback.success();
          _showFloatingSnackBar(
            'Lisensi Kas-Santri PRO aktif di perangkat ini (${provider.proStatusSummaryLabel})',
          );
          Navigator.pop(context);
          return;
        }
      } finally {
        if (mounted) setState(() => _isProcessingPurchase = false);
      }

      if (!mounted) return;
      final activated = await DirectDanaPaymentSheet.show(
        context,
        offer: _selectedOffer,
        focusActivationInput: true,
      );
      if (activated && mounted) {
        _showFloatingSnackBar('Alhamdulillah! Kas-Santri PRO berhasil diaktifkan.');
        Navigator.pop(context);
      }
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isProcessingPurchase = true);
    try {
      final res = await SubscriptionService.instance.restorePurchases();
      if (res.success && mounted) {
        await provider.activatePro(plan: res.planKey ?? 'YEARLY');
        AppFeedback.success();
        if (mounted) {
          _showFloatingSnackBar(res.message);
          Navigator.pop(context);
        }
        return;
      }

      if (mounted) {
        if (provider.hasProAccess) {
          _showFloatingSnackBar('Lisensi Kas-Santri PRO sudah aktif di perangkat ini!');
        } else {
          _showFloatingSnackBar(res.message, backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF06B6D4));
        }
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isProcessingPurchase = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _handleProceedPayment() async {
    if (_isProcessingPurchase) return;
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final offer = _selectedOffer;
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);

    // Jalur 1: Direct APK -> Pembayaran langsung DANA 082130678956 / QRIS + Kode Lisensi PRO
    if (!kIsPlayStoreBuild) {
      final activated = await DirectDanaPaymentSheet.show(
        context,
        offer: offer,
      );
      if (activated && mounted) {
        _showFloatingSnackBar('Alhamdulillah! ${offer.title} berhasil diaktifkan.');
        Navigator.pop(context);
      }
      return;
    }

    // Jalur 2: Google Play Store (.aab) -> RevenueCat & Google Play Billing Resmi
    if (SubscriptionService.instance.isConfigured && offer.rcPackage != null) {
      setState(() => _isProcessingPurchase = true);
      try {
        final res = await SubscriptionService.instance.purchasePackage(offer);
        if (!mounted) return;
        if (res.success) {
          await provider.activatePro(plan: res.planKey ?? offer.planKey);
          AppFeedback.success();
          if (mounted) {
            _showFloatingSnackBar(res.message);
            Navigator.pop(context);
          }
        } else if (!res.cancelled) {
          AppFeedback.alert();
          _showFloatingSnackBar(res.message, backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48));
        }
      } finally {
        if (mounted) setState(() => _isProcessingPurchase = false);
      }
      return;
    }

    // Fallback UI Play Store Sheet (khusus mode Play Store saat offline/debug)
    _openGooglePlaySheet();
  }
