```dart
  Widget _buildPaymentOption(
    void Function(void Function()) setModalState, {
    required String id,
    required String badge,
    required Color badgeBg,
    required Color badgeText,
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
  }) {
    final isSelected = _selectedPaymentMethod == id;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        AppFeedback.tap();
        setModalState(() => _selectedPaymentMethod = id);
        setState(() => _selectedPaymentMethod = id);
      },
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected ? const Color(0xFF064E3B).withOpacity(0.35) : const Color(0xFF1F242E),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          border: Border.all(
            color: isSelected ? const Color(0xFF10B981) : Colors.white12,
            width: isSelected ? 1.4 : 1,
          ),
        ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Container(
              width: 40,
              height: 26,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: badgeBg,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
              ),
              alignment: Alignment.center,
              child: Text(
                badge,
                style: TextStyle(color: badgeText, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    title,
                    style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
                  Text(
                    subtitle,
                    style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white54, fontSize: 10),
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            Icon(
              isSelected ? Icons.radio_button_checked : Icons.radio_button_off,
              color: isSelected ? const Color(0xFF34D399) : Colors.white38,
              size: 20,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _openQrisConfirmSheet() {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final offer = _selectedOffer;

            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
            border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFF34D399), width: 1.3),
            boxShadow: [
              BoxShadow(
                color: const Color(0xFF10B981).withOpacity(0.22),
                blurRadius: 14,
              ),
            ],
          ),
          child: const Row(
            children: [
              Text('🎁', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 22)),
              SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      'Aktifkan Uji Coba PRO Gratis 14 Hari (Tanpa Bayar Dulu)',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: Color(0xFF6EE7B7),

                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                      ),
                    ),
                    SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      'Buka seluruh fitur PRO sekarang • 1x per perangkat',
                      style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 10.5),

                  ],
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class PinLockScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final bool isUnlockingSession;

  const PinLockScreen({Key? key, this.isUnlockingSession = true}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<PinLockScreen> createState() => _PinLockScreenState();
}

class _PinLockScreenState extends State<PinLockScreen> {
  String _pin = '';
  String? _errorMessage;
  bool _isChecking = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _tryBiometricsIfAllowed(silentIfDisabled: true);
    });
  }

  Future<void> _tryBiometricsIfAllowed({bool silentIfDisabled = false}) async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    final bioAllowed = provider.isProUser && provider.pengaturan.isBiometricEnabled;
    if (!bioAllowed) {
      if (!silentIfDisabled && mounted) {
        AppFeedback.alert();
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(
              provider.isProUser
                  ? 'Aktifkan saklar Biometrik di Tab Sistem untuk memakai sidik jari.'
                  : 'Buka kunci dengan sidik jari tersedia khusus Kas-Santri PRO 👑.',
            ),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF59E0B),
          ),
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    final canBio = await AuthService.instance.isBiometricsAvailable();
    if (canBio) {
      final success = await AuthService.instance.authenticateWithBiometrics();
      if (success && mounted) {
        await _onUnlockSuccess();
      }
    }
  }

  void _onKeyPress(String num) {
    if (_isChecking || _pin.length >= 6) return;
    AppFeedback.tap();
    setState(() {
      _errorMessage = null;
      _pin += num;
    });

    if (_pin.length >= 4) {
      _verifyInput(autoCheckOnly: _pin.length < 6);
    }
  }

  void _onBackspace() {
    if (_isChecking) return;
    if (_pin.isNotEmpty) {
      AppFeedback.tap();
      setState(() {
        _errorMessage = null;
        _pin = _pin.substring(0, _pin.length - 1);
      });
    }
  }

  void _onClear() {
    if (_isChecking) return;
    AppFeedback.tap();
    setState(() {
      _errorMessage = null;
      _pin = '';
    });
  }

  Future<void> _verifyInput({bool autoCheckOnly = false}) async {
    setState(() => _isChecking = true);
    final valid = await AuthService.instance.verifyPin(_pin);
    if (!mounted) return;

    if (valid) {
      await _onUnlockSuccess();
    } else {
      if (_pin.length >= 6 || !autoCheckOnly) {
        AppFeedback.alert();
        setState(() {
          _errorMessage = 'PIN tidak cocok. Silakan coba lagi.';
          _pin = '';
          _isChecking = false;
        });
      } else {
        setState(() => _isChecking = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _onUnlockSuccess() async {
    AppFeedback.success();
    setState(() {
      _errorMessage = null;
      _isChecking = false;
    });
    await AuthService.instance.updateLastActive();
    if (!mounted) return;

    if (widget.isUnlockingSession) {
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const MainNavigationScreen()),
      );
    } else {
      Navigator.pop(context, true);

  }
```

### [54/123] `lib/screens/rekap/cash_opname_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../../providers/kas_santri_provider.dart';
import '../../utils/app_feedback.dart';
import '../../utils/currency_formatter.dart';
import '../paywall_screen.dart';

class CashOpnameScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const CashOpnameScreen({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  static Future<void> show(BuildContext context) async {
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    if (!provider.hasProAccess) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: 'Kalkulator Cash Opname Pecahan Uang Fisik',
      );
      return;
    }
    await Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const CashOpnameScreen()),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<CashOpnameScreen> createState() => _CashOpnameScreenState();
}

class _CashOpnameScreenState extends State<CashOpnameScreen> {
  static const List<int> _denominations = [
    100000,
    50000,
    20000,
    10000,
    5000,
    2000,
    1000,
    500,
  ];

  final Map<int, TextEditingController> _qtyControllers = {};
  final TextEditingController _catatanController = TextEditingController();
  bool _isSaving = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    for (final d in _denominations) {
      _qtyControllers[d] = TextEditingController(text: '0');
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    for (final c in _qtyControllers.values) {
      c.dispose();
    }
    _catatanController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  int _qtyFor(int denom) {
    final text = _qtyControllers[denom]?.text.trim() ?? '';
    return int.tryParse(text) ?? 0;
  }

  int get _totalFisik {
    int sum = 0;
    for (final d in _denominations) {
      sum += d * _qtyFor(d);
    }
    return sum;
  }

  Map<int, int> get _rincianMap {
    final map = <int, int>{};
    for (final d in _denominations) {
      final qty = _qtyFor(d);
      if (qty > 0) map[d] = qty;
    }
    return map;
  }

  void _stepQty(int denom, int delta) {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final next = (_qtyFor(denom) + delta).clamp(0, 999999);
    setState(() {
      _qtyControllers[denom]?.text = next.toString();
    });
  }

  void _resetAll() {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    setState(() {
      for (final d in _denominations) {
        _qtyControllers[d]?.text = '0';
      }
      _catatanController.clear();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _saveOpname() async {
    if (_isSaving) return;
    setState(() => _isSaving = true);

    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    final totalSistem = provider.targetUangFisikDiLaci;
    final totalFisik = _totalFisik;
    final selisih = totalFisik - totalSistem;

    await provider.simpanCashOpname(
      totalSistem: totalSistem,
      totalFisik: totalFisik,
      rincianPecahan: _rincianMap,
      catatan: _catatanController.text.trim(),
    );

    if (selisih == 0) {
      AppFeedback.success();
    } else {
      AppFeedback.alert();
    }

    if (mounted) {
      setState(() => _isSaving = false);
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            selisih == 0
                ? 'Cash Opname tersimpan: Cocok (Terverifikasi Fisik ✓)'
                : 'Cash Opname tersimpan dengan selisih ${CurrencyFormatter.format(selisih)}.',
          ),
          backgroundColor: selisih == 0 ? const Color(0xFF10B981) : const Color(0xFFF59E0B),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                );
              }),

          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _opnameBreakdownRow(
    String label,
    String val,
    Color color, {
    bool isBold = false,
  }) {
    return Row(
      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: TextStyle(
              color: isBold ? Colors.white : Colors.white60,
              fontSize: 10.5,
              fontWeight: isBold ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600,
            ),
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        Text(
          val,
          style: TextStyle(
            color: color,
            fontSize: 11,
            fontWeight: isBold ? FontWeight.w900 : FontWeight.w700,
            fontFamily: 'monospace',
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
  Future<void> _loadAnalytics() async {
    setState(() => _loading = true);
    try {
      final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
      final db = DatabaseHelper.instance;
      final txRows = await db.getTransaksiByDateRange();
      final setoranRows = await db.getAllSetoranByDateRange();

      final summary = ExecutiveAnalyticsService.computeSummary(
        activeSantri: provider.santriStatusList.map((e) => e.santri).toList(),
        transaksiRows: txRows,
        setoranRows: setoranRows,
        infakPeriodeList: provider.infakPeriodeList,
        opnameLogs: provider.opnameLogs,
        totalBrankas: provider.totalBrankasFisik,
        kasTunai: provider.kasLaciTunai,
        kasRekening: provider.rekeningBank,
        totalTunggakan: provider.totalTunggakanPondok,
      );
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _summary = summary;
          _loading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _exportPdf({bool share = false}) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    if (!provider.isProUser) {
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: 'Laporan Eksekutif Pengasuh & Yayasan 1 Halaman (PDF)',
      );
      return;

    final summary = _summary;

    setState(() => _exportingPdf = true);
    try {
      final bytes =
          await ExecutiveAnalyticsService.instance.buildExecutiveOnePagePdfBytes(
        pengaturan: provider.pengaturan,
        summary: summary,

      if (share) {
        final dir = await getTemporaryDirectory();
        final file = File(
          p.join(
            dir.path,
            'ringkasan_eksekutif_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.pdf',
          ),
        );
        await file.writeAsBytes(bytes, flush: true);
        await Share.shareXFiles(
          [XFile(file.path)],
          text: 'Ringkasan Eksekutif Yayasan — ${provider.pengaturan.namaPondok}',
        );
      } else {
        await Printing.layoutPdf(
          onLayout: (_) async => bytes,
          name: 'Ringkasan_Eksekutif_${provider.pengaturan.namaPondok}.pdf',
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Gagal ekspor PDF Eksekutif: $e'),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),

          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

            Text(
              title,
              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white60, fontSize: 10.5),

            Text(
              val,
              style: TextStyle(
                color: accent,
                fontSize: 16,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
              ),
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 2),

              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white54, fontSize: 10),

}

class _LegendDot extends StatelessWidget {
  final Color color;
  final String label;

  const _LegendDot({required this.color, required this.label});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Row(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        Container(
          width: 9,
          height: 9,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(color: color, shape: BoxShape.circle),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 4),
        Text(label, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 10.5)),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _CashflowBarChart extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<CashflowBucket> buckets;

  const _CashflowBarChart({required this.buckets});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    var peak = 1;
    for (final b in buckets) {
      if (b.maxVal > peak) peak = b.maxVal;
    }

    return SizedBox(
      height: 150,
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
        children: buckets.map((b) {
          double h(int v) => v <= 0 ? 3.0 : (v / peak) * 105.0 + 4.0;
          return Expanded(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.end,
              children: [
                Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                  children: [
                    _bar(h(b.setoranMasuk), const Color(0xFF34D399)),
                    const SizedBox(width: 2),
                    _bar(h(b.jajanKeluar), const Color(0xFFFB7185)),
                    const SizedBox(width: 2),
                    _bar(h(b.infakMasuk), const Color(0xFFFBBF24)),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Text(
                  b.label,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.white60,
                    fontSize: 9.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        }).toList(),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _bar(double height, Color color) {
    return Container(
      width: 7,
      height: height,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: color,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
class _RekapLaporanScreenState extends State<RekapLaporanScreen>

  String _generateWaText(
    SantriStatusHariIni status,
    String namaPondok, {
    bool isProUser = false,
  }) {
    final santri = status.santri;
    final todayStr = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(DateTime.now());
    final txList = status.transaksiHariIni;

    final rincianList = txList.isNotEmpty
        ? txList.map((t) {
            final kat = TimeCategoryHelper.getDbString(t.kategoriWaktu);
            final jam = '${t.waktuAmbil.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${t.waktuAmbil.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
            final nom = CurrencyFormatter.format(t.nominal);
            final note = t.catatan != null && t.catatan!.isNotEmpty ? t.catatan! : 'Jajan Harian';
            return '   • $kat ($jam): $nom ($note)';
          }).join('\n')
        : '   • _Belum ada pengambilan uang saku hari ini_';

    final infoTunggakan = santri.tunggakan > 0
        ? '🚨 *Catatan Administrasi/Tunggakan:* ${CurrencyFormatter.format(santri.tunggakan)} (${santri.catatanTunggakan.isNotEmpty ? santri.catatanTunggakan : 'Talangan Kas Pondok'})'
        : '✅ *Status Administrasi:* Bersih / Tidak Ada Tunggakan';

    return '''*Assalamu’alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh* 🌸

Yth. *Bapak/Ibu Wali Santri*
dari ananda tercinta: *${santri.namaLengkap}* (Kamar / Kelas: ${santri.kamar})
di Tempat.

Semoga Bapak/Ibu sekeluarga senantiasa berada dalam lindungan, rahmat, dan keberkahan dari Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala.

Izin menyampaikan laporan mutasi keluar-masuk uang saku ananda per hari ini ($todayStr):

📊 *RINGKASAN UANG SAKU HARI INI:*
• Jatah Harian Ananda: *${CurrencyFormatter.format(santri.jatahHarian)} / hari*
• Pengambilan Hari Ini: *${CurrencyFormatter.format(status.totalAmbilHariIni)}*
• Sisa Kuota Hari Ini: *${CurrencyFormatter.format(status.sisaJatahHariIni < 0 ? 0 : status.sisaJatahHariIni)}*

📝 *RINCIAN PENGAMBILAN HARI INI:*
$rincianList

💰 *STATUS SALDO TITIPAN SANTRI:*
• Sisa Saldo Titipan: *${CurrencyFormatter.format(santri.saldoTotal)}*
• Estimasi Ketahanan: ±*${santri.estimasiHari} hari* ke depan
$infoTunggakan

Demikian laporan ini kami sampaikan dengan penuh amanah demi kenyamanan ananda dalam menuntut ilmu di *$namaPondok*. 

Apabila Bapak/Ibu hendak menitipkan setoran tambahan atau mengonfirmasi keperluan ananda, silakan hubungi pengurus kas pondok.

*Jazakumullah Khairan Katsiran*
*Wassalamu’alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh* 🙏

Salam hormat & ta'dzim,
*Pengurus Kas & Keuangan Santri*
*$namaPondok*${isProUser ? '' : '\n\n_Dicatat dengan Kas-Santri_'}''';
  }

  Future<void> _sendWaDirect(Santri santri, String message) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    if (!provider.isProUser) {
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: 'Kirim Laporan WhatsApp 1-Klik & Tanpa Watermark',
      );
      return;
    }
    final phone = ReportService.normalizeWaPhone(santri.noWaWali);
    if (phone.isEmpty) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(
              'Nomor WhatsApp wali ${santri.namaLengkap} belum diisi. Lengkapi terlebih dahulu di menu Edit Data Santri.',
            ),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF59E0B),
          ),
        );
      }
      return;
    }
    final launched = await ReportService.instance.openWhatsAppDirect(
      rawPhone: phone,
      message: message,
    );
    if (!launched && mounted) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Tidak dapat membuka aplikasi WhatsApp di perangkat ini.'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFFE11D48),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _runOfficialExport({required bool isExcel}) async {
    if (_isExporting) return;
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    if (!provider.isProUser) {
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: isExcel
            ? 'Ekspor Laporan Excel Multi-Sheet (.xlsx)'
            : 'Ekspor Laporan Resmi PDF Berkop Logo',
      );
      return;
    }
    setState(() => _isExporting = true);
    try {
      if (isExcel) {
        await YayasanExportService.instance.exportExcelMultiSheet(
          pengaturan: provider.pengaturan,
          santriList: provider.allSantri,
          totalBrankasFisik: provider.totalBrankasFisik,
          kasLaciTunai: provider.kasLaciTunai,
          rekeningBank: provider.rekeningBank,
          totalTunggakanPondok: provider.totalTunggakanPondok,
          opnameLogs: provider.opnameLogs,
          period: _exportPeriod,
          customStart: _customStart,
          customEnd: _customEnd,
        );
      } else {
        await YayasanExportService.instance.exportPdfResmiYayasan(
          pengaturan: provider.pengaturan,
          santriList: provider.allSantri,
          totalBrankasFisik: provider.totalBrankasFisik,
          kasLaciTunai: provider.kasLaciTunai,
          rekeningBank: provider.rekeningBank,
          totalTunggakanPondok: provider.totalTunggakanPondok,
          period: _exportPeriod,
          customStart: _customStart,
          customEnd: _customEnd,
        );
      }
      AppFeedback.success();
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Gagal mengekspor laporan: $e'),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),
          ),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isExporting = false);
    }
  }

  Widget _buildSaldoKritisCard(KasSantriProvider provider, double cardOpacity) {
    final kritisList = provider.saldoKritisList;
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          colors: [
            const Color(0xFF33140A).withValues(alpha: (0.86 * cardOpacity).clamp(0.45, 0.92)),
            const Color(0xFF180C24).withValues(alpha: (0.90 * cardOpacity).clamp(0.48, 0.94)),
          ],
          begin: Alignment.topLeft,
          end: Alignment.bottomRight,
        ),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),
        border: Border.all(
          color: kritisList.isNotEmpty
              ? const Color(0xFFF59E0B).withValues(alpha: 0.50)
              : const Color(0xFFFB7185).withValues(alpha: 0.35),
          width: 1.2,
        ),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: const Color(0xFFF59E0B).withValues(alpha: 0.14),
            blurRadius: 18,
            offset: const Offset(0, 6),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              const Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      'DETEKSI DINI SALDO',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: Color(0xFFFBBF24),
                        fontSize: 9.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                        letterSpacing: 1.2,
                      ),
                    ),
                    SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      'Prioritas Saldo Kritis (< 3 Hari)',
                      style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: const Color(0xFF451A03),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFFBBF24).withOpacity(0.6)),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  provider.isProUser ? '${kritisList.length} Santri' : '👑 PRO',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    color: Color(0xFFFDE68A),
                    fontSize: 10.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          if (!provider.isProUser)
            InkWell(
              onTap: () {
                AppFeedback.tap();
                PaywallScreen.show(
                  context,
                  triggerFeature: 'Pantau Saldo Kritis (< 3 Hari) & Pengingat WA',
                );
              },
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
              child: Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: const Color(0xFF060B14),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                  border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFFBBF24).withOpacity(0.45)),
                ),
                child: const Row(
                  children: [
                    Text('🔒', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
                    SizedBox(width: 10),
```

```dart
    }

  Future<void> _sendItem(
    KasSantriProvider provider,
    ReminderQueueItem item,
  ) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    if (!provider.isProUser) {
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: 'Pusat Antrean Pengingat WA Cerdas (1-Klik Anti-Spam)',
      );
      return;
    }

    final msg = SmartWaReminderService.composePoliteMessage(
      item: item,
      namaPondok: provider.pengaturan.namaPondok,
    );
    final phone = ReportService.normalizeWaPhone(item.santri.noWaWali);
    if (phone.isEmpty) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(

    final launched = await ReportService.instance.openWhatsAppDirect(
      rawPhone: item.santri.noWaWali,
      message: msg,

    if (launched) {
      final updated =
          await SmartWaReminderService.instance.markSentToday(item.uniqueKey);
      if (mounted) {

  Future<void> _sendNextInQueue(

    final pendingWithPhone = items.where((item) {
```

```dart
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;
import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';
import 'package:printing/printing.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:share_plus/share_plus.dart';
import '../../models/santri.dart';
import '../../providers/kas_santri_provider.dart';
import '../../services/qr_card_pdf_service.dart';
import '../../utils/app_feedback.dart';
import '../../widgets/app_background_wrapper.dart';
import '../paywall_screen.dart';

enum _QrPrintScope { semua, perKamar, pilihan }

class CetakKartuQrScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const CetakKartuQrScreen({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<CetakKartuQrScreen> createState() => _CetakKartuQrScreenState();
}

class _CetakKartuQrScreenState extends State<CetakKartuQrScreen> {
  _QrPrintScope _scope = _QrPrintScope.semua;
  String? _selectedKamar;
  final Set<String> _manualIds = {};
  String _search = '';
  bool _isGenerating = false;

  List<Santri> _resolveSelected(KasSantriProvider provider) {
    final active = provider.santriStatusList.map((s) => s.santri).toList();
    switch (_scope) {
      case _QrPrintScope.semua:
        return active;
      case _QrPrintScope.perKamar:
        final k = _selectedKamar ?? (provider.kamars.isNotEmpty ? provider.kamars.first : null);
        if (k == null) return [];
        return active.where((s) => s.kamar == k).toList();
      case _QrPrintScope.pilihan:
        return active.where((s) => _manualIds.contains(s.id)).toList();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _previewAndPrint(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    if (!provider.isProUser) {
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: 'Cetak Massal Kartu Santri QR Siap Laminating (PDF A4)',
      );
      return;
    }

    final targets = _resolveSelected(provider);
    if (targets.isEmpty) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Pilih minimal 1 santri untuk dicetak.'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFFF59E0B),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isGenerating = true);
    try {
      final bytes = await QrCardPdfService.instance.buildBulkQrCardsPdfBytes(
        pengaturan: provider.pengaturan,
        santriList: targets,
      );
      await Printing.layoutPdf(
        onLayout: (_) async => bytes,
        name: 'Kartu_Santri_QR_${provider.pengaturan.namaPondok}.pdf',
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Gagal membuat PDF Kartu QR: $e'),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),
          ),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isGenerating = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _sharePdf(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    if (!provider.isProUser) {
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: 'Cetak Massal Kartu Santri QR Siap Laminating (PDF A4)',
      );
      return;
    }

    final targets = _resolveSelected(provider);
    if (targets.isEmpty) return;

    setState(() => _isGenerating = true);
    try {
      final bytes = await QrCardPdfService.instance.buildBulkQrCardsPdfBytes(
        pengaturan: provider.pengaturan,
        santriList: targets,
      );
      final dir = await getTemporaryDirectory();
      final file = File(
        p.join(
          dir.path,
          'kartu_qr_santri_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.pdf',
        ),
      );
      await file.writeAsBytes(bytes, flush: true);
      AppFeedback.success();
      await Share.shareXFiles(
        [XFile(file.path)],
        text: 'Kartu QR Santri Siap Cetak A4 (${targets.length} Santri)',
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Gagal membagikan PDF: $e'),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),
          ),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isGenerating = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context);
    if (!provider.hasProAccess) {
      return AppBackgroundWrapper(
        child: Scaffold(
          backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
          appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Cetak Kartu QR Massal (A4)')),
          body: SafeArea(
            child: Center(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),

                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      const Text('🪪', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 40)),
                      const SizedBox(height: 10),
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: const Color(0xFFF59E0B).withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFFBBF24)),
                        ),
                        child: const Text(
                          '🔒 FITUR KHUSUS PRO',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            color: Color(0xFFFDE68A),
                            fontSize: 10,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                            letterSpacing: 1.0,

                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),

                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      const Text(
                        'Susun otomatis 8 Kartu ID QR Santri per halaman A4 lengkap dengan garis potong siap laminating untuk Scan Antrean 1 Detik.',
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white70,
                          fontSize: 12,
                          height: 1.4,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 18),
                      SizedBox(
                        width: double.infinity,
                        child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                          onPressed: () => PaywallScreen.show(
                            context,
                            triggerFeature:
                                'Cetak Massal Kartu Santri QR Siap Laminating (PDF A4)',
                          ),
                          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFFBBF24),
                            foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF030712),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13),

                          icon: const Icon(Icons.workspace_premium_rounded, size: 18),
```

```dart
import 'dart:io';

import '../paywall_screen.dart';

class ImportSantriExcelScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ImportSantriExcelScreen({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<ImportSantriExcelScreen> createState() =>
      _ImportSantriExcelScreenState();
}

class _ImportSantriExcelScreenState extends State<ImportSantriExcelScreen> {
  String _sumberDompet = 'TUNAI';
  bool _isBusy = false;
  BulkExcelParseResult? _parseResult;
  String? _pickedFileName;

  Future<void> _downloadTemplate(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    setState(() => _isBusy = true);
    try {
      final bytes = await BulkSantriExcelService.instance
          .buildTemplateExcelBytesAsync(
        namaPondok: provider.pengaturan.namaPondok,
      );
      final dir = await getTemporaryDirectory();
      final file = File(
        p.join(dir.path, 'template_import_santri_kas_santri.xlsx'),
      );
      await file.writeAsBytes(bytes, flush: true);
      AppFeedback.success();
      await Share.shareXFiles(
        [XFile(file.path)],
        text: 'Template Import Santri Massal Kas-Santri (.xlsx)',
      );
    } catch (e) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Gagal membuat template Excel: $e'),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),
          ),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isBusy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pickAndParseExcel(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    try {
      final res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: ['xlsx'],
      );
      if (res == null || res.files.single.path == null) return;
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isBusy = true);
      final file = File(res.files.single.path!);
      final bytes = await file.readAsBytes();
      final parsed = await BulkSantriExcelService.instance
          .parseAndValidateExcelBytesAsync(
        bytes: bytes,
        existingSantri: provider.allSantri,
        isProUser: provider.isProUser,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _pickedFileName = p.basename(file.path);
        _parseResult = parsed;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Gagal membaca file Excel: $e'),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),
          ),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isBusy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _executeImport(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    final parsed = _parseResult;
    if (parsed == null || parsed.validRows.isEmpty) return;

    if (parsed.exceedsFreeQuota) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature:
            'Import Massal ${parsed.validRows.length} Santri (Mode Gratis maksimal ${KasSantriProvider.maxFreeSantriQuota} santri aktif)',
      );
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isBusy = true);
    try {
      final count = await provider.importSantriMassal(
        parsed.santriList,
        sumberDompet: _sumberDompet,
      );
      if (mounted) {
        AppFeedback.success();
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Alhamdulillah! $count santri berhasil diimpor.'),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
          ),
        );
        Navigator.pop(context, count);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Gagal impor santri: $e'),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),
          ),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isBusy = false);
    }
  }
```

```dart
class QrScannerScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const QrScannerScreen({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

    );

  @override
  State<QrScannerScreen> createState() => _QrScannerScreenState();
}

class _QrScannerScreenState extends State<QrScannerScreen> {
  final MobileScannerController _controller = MobileScannerController(
    detectionSpeed: DetectionSpeed.noDuplicates,
  );
  bool _hasScanned = false;
  bool _torchEnabled = false;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onDetect(BarcodeCapture capture) {
    if (_hasScanned) return;
    for (final barcode in capture.barcodes) {
      final raw = barcode.rawValue;
      if (raw != null && raw.trim().isNotEmpty) {
        _hasScanned = true;
        AppFeedback.tap();
        Navigator.of(context).pop(raw.trim());
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF030712),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Stack(
          children: [
            MobileScanner(
              controller: _controller,
              onDetect: _onDetect,
            ),

            // Overlay bingkai scan
            Center(
              child: Container(
                width: 250,
                height: 250,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: const Color(0xFF34D399),
                    width: 3,
                  ),
                  boxShadow: [
                    BoxShadow(
                      color: const Color(0xFF10B981).withOpacity(0.35),
                      blurRadius: 24,
                      spreadRadius: 2,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),

            // Header bar
            Positioned(
              top: 12,
              left: 16,
              right: 16,
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Material(
                    color: const Color(0xFF0F172A).withOpacity(0.85),
                    shape: const CircleBorder(),
                    child: IconButton(
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close, color: Colors.white),
                      onPressed: () {
                        AppFeedback.tap();
                        Navigator.of(context).pop();
                      },
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: const Color(0xFF0F172A).withOpacity(0.85),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                        border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFF10B981).withOpacity(0.5)),
                      ),
                      child: const Row(
                        children: [
                          Text('📷', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 15)),
                          SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              'Scan QR Kartu Santri',
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white,
                                fontSize: 13,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Material(
                    color: _torchEnabled
                        ? const Color(0xFFF59E0B)
                        : const Color(0xFF0F172A).withOpacity(0.85),
                    shape: const CircleBorder(),
                    child: IconButton(
                      icon: Icon(
                        _torchEnabled ? Icons.flash_on_rounded : Icons.flash_off_rounded,
                        color: _torchEnabled ? const Color(0xFF030712) : Colors.white,
                      ),
                      onPressed: () async {
                        AppFeedback.tap();
                        await _controller.toggleTorch();
                        if (mounted) {
                          setState(() => _torchEnabled = !_torchEnabled);
                        }
                      },
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                  Material(
                    color: const Color(0xFF0F172A).withOpacity(0.85),
                    shape: const CircleBorder(),
                    child: IconButton(
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.cameraswitch_rounded, color: Colors.white),
                      onPressed: () async {
                        AppFeedback.tap();
                        await _controller.switchCamera();
                      },
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),

            // Footer hint
            Positioned(
              left: 20,
              right: 20,
              bottom: 28,
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: const Color(0xFF0F172A).withOpacity(0.9),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                  border: Border.all(color: Colors.white12),
                ),
                child: const Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      '⚡ MODE ANTREAN KILAT (< 1 DETIK)',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: Color(0xFF34D399),

                      ),
                    ),
                    SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(

                    ),
```

```dart
class SantriDetailScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final String santriId;

class _SantriDetailScreenState extends State<SantriDetailScreen> {
  String _filterPeriode = 'SEMUA'; // 'SEMUA', 'HARI_INI', '7_HARI', 'BULAN_INI'
  List<TransaksiHarian> _mutasiList = [];
  bool _isLoadingMutasi = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadMutasi();
  }

  Future<void> _loadMutasi() async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _isLoadingMutasi = true);
    final now = DateTime.now();
    String? start;
    String? end;

    if (_filterPeriode == 'HARI_INI') {
      start = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(now);
      end = start;
    } else if (_filterPeriode == '7_HARI') {
      final sevenDaysAgo = now.subtract(const Duration(days: 7));
      start = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(sevenDaysAgo);
      end = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(now);
    } else if (_filterPeriode == 'BULAN_INI') {
      final firstDay = DateTime(now.year, now.month, 1);
      start = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(firstDay);
      end = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(now);
    }

    final list = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getBukuMutasiSantri(
      widget.santriId,
      tanggalMulai: start,
      tanggalSelesai: end,
    );

    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _mutasiList = list;
        _isLoadingMutasi = false;
      });
    }
  }

  void _confirmDelete(BuildContext context, Santri santri) {
    bool confirmedCheck = false;
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setDialogState) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0F172A),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
            side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFF43F5E), width: 1.2),
          ),
          title: Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: const Color(0xFF4C0519),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                ),
                child: const Text('🗑️', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  'Hapus ${santri.namaLengkap}?',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.white,
                    fontSize: 15,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          content: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  'Tindakan ini akan menghapus santri ${santri.namaLengkap} (${santri.kamar}) secara permanen beserta seluruh riwayat mutasinya.',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.white70,
                    fontSize: 12,
                    height: 1.4,
                  ),
                ),
                if (santri.saldoTotal > 0 || santri.tunggakan > 0) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: const Color(0xFF451A03).withValues(alpha: 0.55),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      border: Border.all(
                        color: const Color(0xFFFBBF24).withValues(alpha: 0.65),
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      santri.saldoTotal > 0
                          ? '⚠️ Santri ini masih memiliki saldo titipan sebesar ${CurrencyFormatter.format(santri.saldoTotal)}.\n'
                              'Jika dihapus permanen, saldo tersebut dianggap dikembalikan tunai kepada santri/wali dan otomatis dicatat KELUAR pada Kas Laci Tunai (mutasi_dompet) serta Jejak Audit.'
                          : '⚠️ Santri ini masih memiliki catatan tunggakan sebesar ${CurrencyFormatter.format(santri.tunggakan)}. Sebaiknya arsipkan sebagai Boyong/Lulus agar riwayat tetap tersimpan.',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        color: Color(0xFFFDE68A),
                        fontSize: 11,
                        height: 1.38,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                      foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF6EE7B7),
                      side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF34D399)),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      ),
                    ),
                    onPressed: () async {
                      final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
                      final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(
                        context,
                        listen: false,
                      );
                      Navigator.pop(ctx);
                      Navigator.pop(context);
                      AppFeedback.tap();
                      await provider.tutupBukuArsipSantri(
                        [santri.id],
                        statusTujuan: Santri.statusAlumniVal,
                      );
                      messenger.showSnackBar(
                        SnackBar(
                          content: Text(
                            '${santri.namaLengkap} diarsipkan sebagai Boyong/Lulus.',
                          ),
                          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.archive_outlined, size: 16),
                    label: const Text(
                      '📦 Arsipkan sebagai Boyong / Lulus (Aman)',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                InkWell(
                  onTap: () {
                    AppFeedback.tap();
                    setDialogState(() => confirmedCheck = !confirmedCheck);
                  },
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                      horizontal: 10,
                      vertical: 8,
                    ),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: const Color(0xFF4C0519).withValues(alpha: 0.45),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      border: Border.all(
                        color: confirmedCheck
                            ? const Color(0xFFFB7185)
                            : Colors.white12,
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        Checkbox(
                          value: confirmedCheck,
                          activeColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),
                          onChanged: (v) {
                            AppFeedback.tap();
                            setDialogState(() => confirmedCheck = v ?? false);
                          },
                        ),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Text(
                            santri.saldoTotal > 0
                                ? 'Saya paham saldo ${CurrencyFormatter.format(santri.saldoTotal)} dianggap dikembalikan & ingin menghapus permanen.'
                                : 'Saya paham & yakin ingin menghapus data santri ini permanen.',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              color: Color(0xFFFECDD3),
                              fontSize: 11,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () {
                AppFeedback.tap();
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
              },
              child: const Text(
                'Batal',
                style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white60),
              ),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor:
                    confirmedCheck ? const Color(0xFFE11D48) : Colors.white12,
                foregroundColor:
                    confirmedCheck ? Colors.white : Colors.white38,
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
              ),
              onPressed: !confirmedCheck
                  ? null
                  : () async {
                      final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
                      final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(
                        context,
                        listen: false,
                      );
                      Navigator.pop(ctx);
                      Navigator.pop(context);
                      AppFeedback.tap();
                      await provider.deleteSantri(santri.id);
                      messenger.showSnackBar(
                        SnackBar(
                          content: Text(
                            'Santri ${santri.namaLengkap} berhasil dihapus dari daftar.',
                          ),
                          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
              child: const Text(
                'Ya, Hapus Permanen',
                style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
}

class _BukuInfakViewState extends State<BukuInfakView> {
  String _selectedKategori = 'ALL'; // ALL, SANTRIYIN, SANTRIYAT, SANTRI_BARU
  String _selectedStatusFilter = 'ALL'; // ALL, BELUM, CICIL, JATUH_TEMPO, PULANG_PINDAH
  bool _isExporting = false;

  String _searchQuery = '';

    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  static const List<String> _bulanNames = [
    '',
    'Januari',
    'Februari',
    'Maret',
    'April',
    'Mei',
    'Juni',
    'Juli',
    'Agustus',
    'September',
    'Oktober',
    'November',
    'Desember',
  ];

  String _formatPeriodeLabel(String ym) {
    final parts = ym.split('-');
    if (parts.length != 2) return ym;
    final y = int.tryParse(parts[0]) ?? DateTime.now().year;
    final m = (int.tryParse(parts[1]) ?? 1).clamp(1, 12);
    return '${_bulanNames[m]} $y';
  }

  bool _isJatuhTempoSoon(InfakSantriModel? infak) {
    if (infak == null || infak.tglHabis.isEmpty) return false;
    final habis = DateFormatter.parseLocalDate(infak.tglHabis);
    final today = DateFormatter.parseLocalDate(DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(DateTime.now()));
    final diff = habis.difference(today).inDays;
    return diff <= 3;
  }

  @override

    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context);
    final cardOpacity = Provider.of<ThemeWallpaperProvider>(context).cardOpacity;

    final byKategori = _selectedKategori == 'ALL'
        ? allSantri
        : allSantri.where((s) => s.kategoriSantri == _selectedKategori).toList();

    int totalMasak = 0;
    int totalListrik = 0;
    int totalBerasUang = 0;
    double totalBerasLiter = 0.0;
    int countLunas = 0;
    int countAktifTarget = 0;

    for (final s in byKategori) {
      if (s.isAktifDiPondok) countAktifTarget++;
      final inf = provider.getInfakForSantri(s.id);
      if (inf != null) {
        if (!inf.isMasakBebas) totalMasak += inf.nominalMasak;
        if (!inf.isListrikBebas) totalListrik += inf.nominalListrik;
        if (inf.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasUangVal) {
          totalBerasUang += inf.berasUang;
        } else if (inf.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasFisik) {

        if (s.isAktifDiPondok && inf.statusLunas == InfakSantriModel.statusLunasVal) {
          countLunas++;

    final q = _searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();

            s.kamar.toLowerCase().contains(q);
        if (!match) return false;

      final inf = provider.getInfakForSantri(s.id);
      final isPulangOrPindah = s.isPulang || s.isPindah;
      if (_selectedStatusFilter == 'PULANG_PINDAH') {

  Future<void> _exportPdfWithScope(
    KasSantriProvider provider,
    List<Santri> allSantri,
    InfakPrintScope scope,
  ) async {
    setState(() => _isExporting = true);
    try {
      await YayasanExportService.instance.exportPdfBukuInfak(
        pengaturan: provider.pengaturan,
        periodeBulan: provider.selectedInfakPeriode,
        santriList: allSantri,
        scope: scope,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('Gagal membuat PDF Buku Infak: $e'),
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF991B1B),
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isExporting = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _exportExcel4Sheet(
    KasSantriProvider provider,
    List<Santri> allSantri,
  ) async {
    setState(() => _isExporting = true);
    try {
      await YayasanExportService.instance.exportExcelBukuInfak(
        pengaturan: provider.pengaturan,
        periodeBulan: provider.selectedInfakPeriode,
        santriList: allSantri,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('Gagal mengekspor Excel 4-Sheet: $e'),
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF991B1B),
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isExporting = false);
      }
    }
  }

  void _showPdfScopeSheet(
    BuildContext context,
    KasSantriProvider provider,
    List<Santri> allSantri,
  ) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0F172A),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
      ),
      builder: (sheetCtx) {
        final bottomPad = MediaQuery.of(sheetCtx).padding.bottom;
        return SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 16 + bottomPad),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                const Text(
                  '📄 Pilih Kelompok Cetak PDF Buku Infak',
                  style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(
                  'Periode ${_formatPeriodeLabel(provider.selectedInfakPeriode)} • TA ${provider.pengaturan.tahunAjaran}',
                  style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white60, fontSize: 11.5),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                _pdfScopeOption(
                  sheetCtx,
                  emoji: '👦',
                  title: 'Santriyin',
                  subtitle: 'Cetak khusus daftar infak Santriyin',
                  onTap: () {
                    Navigator.pop(sheetCtx);
                    _exportPdfWithScope(provider, allSantri, InfakPrintScope.santriyin);
                  },
                ),
                _pdfScopeOption(
                  sheetCtx,
                  emoji: '👧',
                  title: 'Santriyat',
                  subtitle: 'Cetak khusus daftar infak Santriyat',
                  onTap: () {
                    Navigator.pop(sheetCtx);
                    _exportPdfWithScope(provider, allSantri, InfakPrintScope.santriyat);
                  },
                ),
                _pdfScopeOption(
                  sheetCtx,
                  emoji: '🆕',
                  title: 'Santri Baru',
                  subtitle: 'Cetak khusus daftar infak Santri Baru',
                  onTap: () {
                    Navigator.pop(sheetCtx);
                    _exportPdfWithScope(provider, allSantri, InfakPrintScope.santriBaru);
                  },
                ),
                _pdfScopeOption(

  Widget _buildInfakSantriCard(
    BuildContext context,
    Santri s,
    InfakSantriModel? inf,
    String periode,
    PengaturanAplikasi peng,
    bool isPro,
    double cardOpacity,
  ) {
    final String badgeText;
    final Color badgeColor;
    if (s.isPulang) {
      badgeText = 'PULANG';
      badgeColor = const Color(0xFF34D399);
    } else if (s.isPindah) {
      badgeText = 'PINDAH';
      badgeColor = const Color(0xFF94A3B8);
    } else if (inf == null || inf.statusLunas == InfakSantriModel.statusBelumVal) {
      badgeText = 'BELUM';
      badgeColor = const Color(0xFFF43F5E);
    } else if (inf.statusLunas == InfakSantriModel.statusCicilVal) {
      badgeText = 'CICIL';
      badgeColor = const Color(0xFFFBBF24);
    } else {
      badgeText = 'LUNAS';
      badgeColor = const Color(0xFF10B981);
    }

    final masakStr = inf == null
        ? '-'
        : (inf.isMasakBebas ? '✓ Bebas' : CurrencyFormatter.format(inf.nominalMasak));
    final listrikStr = inf == null
        ? '-'
        : (inf.isListrikBebas ? '✓ Bebas' : CurrencyFormatter.format(inf.nominalListrik));
    final String berasStr;
    if (inf == null || inf.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasBelum) {
      berasStr = 'Belum';
    } else if (inf.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasBebas) {
      berasStr = '✓ Bebas';
    } else if (inf.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasFisik) {
      final l = inf.berasLiter;
      berasStr = '${l == l.roundToDouble() ? l.toInt() : l} L';
    } else {
      berasStr = CurrencyFormatter.format(inf.berasUang);
    }

    final topTint = Color.lerp(const Color(0xFF081426), badgeColor, 0.20)!
        .withValues(alpha: (0.86 * cardOpacity).clamp(0.45, 0.90));
    final bottomTint = const Color(0xFF0A1222)
        .withValues(alpha: (0.90 * cardOpacity).clamp(0.48, 0.92));

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          colors: [topTint, bottomTint],
          begin: Alignment.topLeft,
          end: Alignment.bottomRight,
        ),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(color: badgeColor.withValues(alpha: 0.45)),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: badgeColor.withValues(alpha: 0.10),
            blurRadius: 14,
            offset: const Offset(0, 5),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        child: InkWell(
          onTap: () {
            AppFeedback.tap();
            InfakEditBottomSheet.show(
              context,
              santri: s,
              periodeBulan: periode,
              existingInfak: inf,
            );
          },
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            s.namaLengkap,
                            style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 13.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 2),
                          Text(
                            '${s.kategoriLabel}${s.kamar.trim().isNotEmpty ? ' • ${s.kamar}' : ''}',
                            style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white60, fontSize: 10.5),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 4),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: badgeColor.withOpacity(0.18),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                        border: Border.all(color: badgeColor),
                      ),
                      child: Text(
                        badgeText,
                        style: TextStyle(color: badgeColor, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Row(
                  children: [
                    _miniPos('Masak', masakStr),
                    _miniPos('Listrik', listrikStr),
                    _miniPos('Beras', berasStr),
                  ],
                ),
                if (inf != null) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        '📅 ${inf.tglMasuk} → ${inf.tglHabis}',
                        style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF7DD3FC), fontSize: 10.5, fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                      ),
                      if (inf.catatan != null && inf.catatan!.isNotEmpty)
                        Flexible(
                          child: Text(
                            inf.catatan!,
                            style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white54, fontSize: 10, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          ),
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ] else ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  const Text(
                    'Ketuk untuk catat / lengkapi pembayaran infak bulan ini →',
                    style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white54, fontSize: 10.5),
                  ),
                ],
                if (!s.isPulang &&
                    !s.isPindah &&
                    (_selectedStatusFilter == 'JATUH_TEMPO' ||
                        _isJatuhTempoSoon(inf) ||
                        inf == null ||
                        inf.statusLunas != InfakSantriModel.statusLunasVal)) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                      onPressed: () async {
                        AppFeedback.tap();
                        if (!isPro) {
                          PaywallScreen.show(
                            context,
                            triggerFeature: 'Pengingat Jatuh Tempo Infak via WA',
                          );
                          return;
                        }
                        final phone = ReportService.normalizeWaPhone(s.noWaWali);
                        if (phone.isEmpty) {
                          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                            const SnackBar(
                              content: Text('Nomor WA wali belum diisi di profil santri ini.'),
                              backgroundColor: Color(0xFF991B1B),
                            ),
                          );
                          return;
                        }
                        final msg = ReportService.instance.generateInfakReminderText(
                          santri: s,
                          pengaturan: peng,
                          periodeBulan: periode,
                          infak: inf,
                        );
                        final ok = await ReportService.instance.openWhatsAppDirect(
                          rawPhone: s.noWaWali,
                          message: msg,
                        );
                        if (!ok && mounted) {
                          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                            const SnackBar(
                              content: Text('Tidak dapat membuka WhatsApp di perangkat ini.'),
                              backgroundColor: Color(0xFF991B1B),
                            ),
                          );
                        }
                      },
                      icon: const Text('💬', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13)),
                      label: Text(
                        isPro ? 'Ingatkan Wali via WA' : 'Ingatkan Wali via WA 👑',
                        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                      ),
                      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                        foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF34D399),
                        side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF10B981)),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _miniPos(String label, String val) {
    return Expanded(
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 6),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: const Color(0xFF060B14),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
          border: Border.all(color: Colors.white10),
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(label, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white54, fontSize: 9)),
            const SizedBox(height: 2),
            Text(
              val,
              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../utils/date_formatter.dart';
```
