import '../../widgets/searchable_santri_picker.dart';
import '../paywall_screen.dart';
import 'buku_infak_view.dart';

class SetoranScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final VoidCallback? onSaved;
  final int activeSubTab;
  final ValueChanged<int>? onSubTabChanged;
  final String? preselectedSantriId;

  const SetoranScreen({
    Key? key,
    this.onSaved,
    this.activeSubTab = 0,
    this.onSubTabChanged,
    this.preselectedSantriId,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<SetoranScreen> createState() => _SetoranScreenState();
}

class _SetoranScreenState extends State<SetoranScreen>
    with AutomaticKeepAliveClientMixin {
  @override
  bool get wantKeepAlive => true;
  String? _selectedSantriId;
  TipeSetoran _tipeSetoran = TipeSetoran.sambanganSplit;
  bool _potongTunggakan = true;
  String _sumberDompet = 'TUNAI'; // 'TUNAI' atau 'REKENING'

  final TextEditingController _nominalController = TextEditingController(text: '500.000');
  final TextEditingController _durasiController = TextEditingController(text: '30');
  final TextEditingController _catatanController = TextEditingController();

  // Smart Split Sambangan controllers & states
  bool _sambanganDefaultsLoaded = false;
  bool _isMasakChecked = true;
  bool _isMasakBebas = false;
  bool _isListrikChecked = true;
  bool _isListrikBebas = false;
  String _sambanganJenisBeras = InfakSantriModel.berasUangVal;
  late DateTime _tglMasuk;
  late String _tglHabisYmd;
  final TextEditingController _masakController = TextEditingController(text: '130.000');
  final TextEditingController _listrikController = TextEditingController(text: '20.000');
  final TextEditingController _berasLiterController = TextEditingController(text: '15');
  final TextEditingController _berasUangController = TextEditingController(text: '150.000');

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _selectedSantriId = widget.preselectedSantriId;
    _tglMasuk = DateTime.now().toLocal();
    _tglHabisYmd =
        InfakSantriModel.hitungTglHabis(DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(_tglMasuk));
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant SetoranScreen oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (widget.preselectedSantriId != null &&
        widget.preselectedSantriId != oldWidget.preselectedSantriId) {
      setState(() {
        _selectedSantriId = widget.preselectedSantriId;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    if (!_sambanganDefaultsLoaded) {
      final peng = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false).pengaturan;
      _masakController.text =
          CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(peng.defaultInfakMasak);
      _listrikController.text =
          CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(peng.defaultInfakListrik);
      final l = peng.defaultInfakBerasLiter;
      _berasLiterController.text =
          l == l.roundToDouble() ? l.toInt().toString() : l.toString();
      _berasUangController.text =
          CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(peng.defaultInfakBerasUang);
      _sambanganDefaultsLoaded = true;
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nominalController.dispose();
    _durasiController.dispose();
    _catatanController.dispose();
    _masakController.dispose();
    _listrikController.dispose();
    _berasLiterController.dispose();
    _berasUangController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  int get _nominal => CurrencyFormatter.parse(_nominalController.text);
  int get _durasi => int.tryParse(_durasiController.text.trim()) ?? 30;

  int get _sambanganMasak => (_isMasakChecked && !_isMasakBebas)
      ? CurrencyFormatter.parse(_masakController.text)
      : 0;
  int get _sambanganListrik => (_isListrikChecked && !_isListrikBebas)
      ? CurrencyFormatter.parse(_listrikController.text)
      : 0;
  int get _sambanganBerasUang =>
      _sambanganJenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasUangVal
          ? CurrencyFormatter.parse(_berasUangController.text)
          : 0;
  double get _sambanganBerasLiter =>
      _sambanganJenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasFisik
          ? (double.tryParse(
                _berasLiterController.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.'),
              ) ??
              0.0)
          : 0.0;

  int get _totalPotonganInfakUang =>
      _sambanganMasak + _sambanganListrik + _sambanganBerasUang;

  int _sambanganSisaJajan(Santri? santri) {
    int rem = _nominal - _totalPotonganInfakUang;
    if (rem <= 0) return rem;
    if (_potongTunggakan && santri != null && santri.tunggakan > 0) {
      rem = (rem - santri.tunggakan).clamp(0, rem);
    }
    return rem;
  }

  int _nominalBersih(Santri? santri) {
    if (_tipeSetoran == TipeSetoran.sambanganSplit) {
      final raw = _sambanganSisaJajan(santri);
      return raw < 0 ? 0 : raw;
    }
    int net = _nominal;
    if (_potongTunggakan && santri != null && santri.tunggakan > 0) {
      net = (_nominal - santri.tunggakan).clamp(0, double.infinity).toInt();
    }
    return net;
  }

  int _hitungJatahPresisi(Santri? santri, {int kelipatan = 500}) {
    if (_durasi <= 0) return 0;
    return CurrencyFormatter.hitungJatahHarianBulat(
      _nominalBersih(santri),
      _durasi,
      kelipatan: kelipatan,
    );
  }

  void _setQuick(int nominal, int durasi) {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    setState(() {
      _nominalController.text = CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(nominal);
      _durasiController.text = durasi.toString();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _pickSambanganDate({required bool isMasuk}) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final initial = isMasuk
        ? _tglMasuk
        : DateFormatter.parseLocalDate(_tglHabisYmd);
    final picked = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: initial,
      firstDate: DateTime(2020),
      lastDate: DateTime(2035),
      builder: (ctx, child) {
        return Theme(
          data: Theme.of(ctx).copyWith(
            colorScheme: const ColorScheme.dark(
              primary: Color(0xFF10B981),
              onPrimary: Color(0xFF040914),
              surface: Color(0xFF0F172A),
              onSurface: Colors.white,
            ),
            dialogBackgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0F172A),
          ),
          child: child ?? const SizedBox.shrink(),
        );
      },
    );
    if (picked != null && mounted) {
      final localPicked = DateTime(picked.year, picked.month, picked.day);
      setState(() {
        if (isMasuk) {
          _tglMasuk = localPicked;
          _tglHabisYmd = InfakSantriModel.hitungTglHabis(
            DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(localPicked),
          );
        } else {
          _tglHabisYmd = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(localPicked);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _simpan() async {
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    final santriList = provider.allSantri.where((s) => s.statusAktif).toList();

    final targetId =
        _selectedSantriId ?? (santriList.isNotEmpty ? santriList.first.id : null);
    if (targetId == null) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Pilih santri terlebih dahulu!'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFFF43F5E),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    if (_nominal <= 0) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Nominal setoran harus lebih dari Rp 0!'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFFF43F5E),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final santri = santriList.firstWhere((s) => s.id == targetId);

    if (_tipeSetoran == TipeSetoran.sambanganSplit) {
      if (_totalPotonganInfakUang > _nominal) {
        AppFeedback.alert();
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text(
              'Total potongan infak melebihi total uang diterima dari wali!',
            ),
            backgroundColor: Color(0xFFE11D48),
          ),
        );
        return;
      }

      try {
        final res = await provider.catatSambanganSmartSplit(
          santriId: targetId,
          totalUangDiterima: _nominal,
          tanggalMasuk: _tglMasuk,
          tglHabisYmd: _tglHabisYmd,
          nominalMasak: _sambanganMasak,
          isMasakBebas: _isMasakBebas,
          nominalListrik: _sambanganListrik,
          isListrikBebas: _isListrikBebas,
          jenisBeras: _sambanganJenisBeras,
          berasLiter: _sambanganBerasLiter,
          berasUang: _sambanganBerasUang,
          durasiHari: _durasi,
          potongTunggakan: _potongTunggakan,
          sumberDompet: _sumberDompet,
          catatan: _catatanController.text.trim(),
        );
        AppFeedback.success();
        if (mounted) {
          await SambanganReceiptDialog.show(
            context,
            santri: santri,
            infak: res.infak,
            totalDiterima: _nominal,
            sisaJajan: res.sisaJajan,
            jatahBaru: res.jatahBaru,
            nominalPotongTunggakan: res.nominalPotongTunggakan,
          );
        }
      } catch (e) {
        AppFeedback.alert();
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(
              content: Text('Gagal menyimpan sambangan: $e'),
              backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),
            ),
          );
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    final catatan = _catatanController.text.trim().isNotEmpty
        ? _catatanController.text.trim()
        : 'Top-Up Jajan';

    await provider.catatSetoran(
      santriId: targetId,
      nominalSetoran: _nominal,
      durasiHari: _durasi,
      jatahHarianHitung: _hitungJatahPresisi(
        santri,
        kelipatan: provider.pengaturan.pembulatanJatah,
      ),
      tipeSetoran: _tipeSetoran,
      tanggalSetor: DateTime.now(),
      catatan: catatan,
      potongTunggakan: _potongTunggakan,
      metodeBayar: _sumberDompet,
    );

    AppFeedback.success();
    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            'Setoran ${santri.namaLengkap} (${CurrencyFormatter.format(_nominal)}) berhasil disimpan!',
          ),
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
        ),
      );
      widget.onSaved?.call();
    }
  }

    super.build(context);
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context);
    final cardOpacity = Provider.of<ThemeWallpaperProvider>(context).cardOpacity;

    if (_selectedSantriId == null && santriList.isNotEmpty) {
      _selectedSantriId = santriList.first.id;
    }
    final selectedSantri =
        santriList.where((s) => s.id == _selectedSantriId).firstOrNull;
    final kelipatan = provider.pengaturan.pembulatanJatah;
    final netMasuk = _nominalBersih(selectedSantri);

  Widget _buildSubTabPill({
    required String label,
    required bool selected,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    return Expanded(
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () {
          AppFeedback.tap();
          onTap();
        },
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10, horizontal: 6),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: selected
                ? const LinearGradient(colors: [Color(0xFF10B981), Color(0xFF06B6D4)])
                : null,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          ),
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: FittedBox(
            fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
            child: Text(
              label,
              style: TextStyle(
                color: selected ? const Color(0xFF030712) : Colors.white70,
                fontSize: 11.5,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTipeChip(
    String label,
    TipeSetoran tipe,
    Color accent, {
    required int defaultNominal,
  }) {
    final isSelected = _tipeSetoran == tipe;
    return Expanded(
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () {
          AppFeedback.tap();
          setState(() {
            final prev = _tipeSetoran;
            _tipeSetoran = tipe;
            if (prev != tipe) {
              if (tipe == TipeSetoran.sambanganSplit && _nominal <= 300000) {
                _nominalController.text =
                    CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(defaultNominal);
              } else if (tipe == TipeSetoran.susulanTopUp && _nominal == 500000) {
                _nominalController.text =
                    CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(defaultNominal);
              }
            }
          });
        },
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 11, horizontal: 8),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: isSelected
                ? LinearGradient(
                    colors: [
                      accent.withValues(alpha: 0.28),
                      accent.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                    ],
                  )
                : null,
            color: isSelected ? null : const Color(0xFF070D1B).withValues(alpha: 0.72),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
            border: Border.all(
              color: isSelected ? accent : Colors.white12,
              width: isSelected ? 1.3 : 1,
            ),
          ),
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: FittedBox(
            fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
            child: Text(
              label,
              style: TextStyle(
                color: isSelected ? accent : Colors.white70,
                fontSize: 11.5,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildInfakToggleField({
    required String label,
    required bool checked,
    required bool bebas,
    required TextEditingController controller,
    required ValueChanged<bool> onToggleCheck,
    required VoidCallback onToggleBebas,
  }) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: const Color(0xFF0F172A),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.white10),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Checkbox(
            value: checked,
            activeColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
            visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
            onChanged: (v) {
              AppFeedback.tap();
              onToggleCheck(v ?? false);
            },
          ),
          Expanded(
            flex: 3,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(label, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                InkWell(
                  onTap: () {
                    AppFeedback.tap();
                    onToggleBebas();
                  },
                  child: Text(
                    bebas ? '✓ Bebas (Rp 0)' : 'Ketuk untuk Bebas ✓',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: bebas ? const Color(0xFF34D399) : Colors.white54,
                      fontSize: 9.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          SizedBox(
            width: 112,
            child: TextField(
              controller: controller,
              enabled: checked && !bebas,
              keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
              inputFormatters: [RibuanInputFormatter()],
              textAlign: TextAlign.right,
              style: const TextStyle(
                color: Colors.white,
                fontSize: 12.5,
                fontFamily: 'monospace',
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
              ),
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                isDense: true,
                prefixText: bebas ? null : 'Rp ',
                hintText: bebas ? 'Bebas' : '0',
                contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 8),
              ),
              onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _berasModeChip(String label, String value, Color accent) {
    final selected = _sambanganJenisBeras == value;
    return InkWell(
      onTap: () {
        AppFeedback.tap();
        setState(() => _sambanganJenisBeras = value);
      },
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 6),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: selected ? accent.withOpacity(0.18) : const Color(0xFF0F172A),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
          border: Border.all(color: selected ? accent : Colors.white12),
        ),
        child: Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(
            color: selected ? accent : Colors.white60,
            fontSize: 10.5,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _splitRow(String label, String val, Color color, {bool isBold = false}) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [
          Text(label, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 11)),
          Text(
            val,
            style: TextStyle(
              color: color,
              fontSize: isBold ? 13 : 11.5,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
              fontFamily: 'monospace',
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDompetChip(String label, String value, Color accent) {
    final isPro = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context).hasProAccess;
    final isLockedRekening = value == 'REKENING' && !isPro;
    final isSelected = _sumberDompet == value && !isLockedRekening;
    final displayLabel = isLockedRekening ? '$label 👑' : label;
    return Expanded(
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () {
          AppFeedback.tap();
          if (isLockedRekening) {
            PaywallScreen.show(
              context,
              triggerFeature: 'Multi-Dompet: Pisah Kas Laci Tunai vs Rekening Bank',
            );
            setState(() => _sumberDompet = 'TUNAI');
            return;
          }
          setState(() => _sumberDompet = value);
        },
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isSelected ? accent.withOpacity(0.18) : const Color(0xFF070B14),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
            border: Border.all(
              color: isSelected
                  ? accent
                  : (isLockedRekening
                      ? const Color(0xFFFBBF24).withValues(alpha: 0.45)
                      : Colors.white12),
            ),
          ),
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: Text(
            displayLabel,
            style: TextStyle(
              color: isSelected
                  ? accent
                  : (isLockedRekening ? const Color(0xFFFDE68A) : Colors.white60),
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildQuickBtn(String label, int nominal, int durasi) {
    return Expanded(
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () => _setQuick(nominal, durasi),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: const Color(0xFF070B14),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            border: Border.all(color: Colors.white12),
          ),
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class AuditLogScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const AuditLogScreen({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<AuditLogScreen> createState() => _AuditLogScreenState();
}

class _AuditLogScreenState extends State<AuditLogScreen> {
  bool _loading = true;
  List<AuditLogEntry> _entries = const [];
  AuditLogVerificationResult? _verification;
  String _selectedFilter = 'SEMUA';

  static const List<({String code, String label})> _filters = [
    (code: 'SEMUA', label: 'Semua'),
    (code: 'VOID_TRANSAKSI', label: 'Void'),
    (code: 'EDIT_TRANSAKSI', label: 'Edit Transaksi'),
    (code: 'HAPUS_SANTRI', label: 'Hapus Santri'),
    (code: 'SERAH_TERIMA_INFAK', label: 'Serah Infak'),
    (code: 'RESTORE_BACKUP', label: 'Restore'),
    (code: 'RESET_DATA', label: 'Reset'),
    (code: 'UBAH_PENGATURAN', label: 'Pengaturan'),
  ];

    super.initState();
    _loadAudit();
  }

  Future<void> _loadAudit() async {
    setState(() => _loading = true);
    try {
      final verification = await DatabaseHelper.instance.verifyAuditLogIntegrity();
      final logs = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getAuditLogs(
        limit: 300,
        actionFilter: _selectedFilter == 'SEMUA' ? null : _selectedFilter,
      );
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _verification = verification;
          _entries = logs;
          _loading = false;
        });

      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _loading = false);
      }
    }
  }

      return const Color(0xFFFBBF24);

    if (action.contains('LISENSI') || action.contains('SERAH_TERIMA')) {
      return const Color(0xFF34D399);
    }
    return const Color(0xFF38BDF8);

                  children: [

                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    const Text(
                      'Fitur log keamanan rantai hash SHA-256 tersedia eksklusif pada Kas-Santri PRO atau selama masa Uji Coba Gratis 14 Hari.',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12, height: 1.4),

                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    ElevatedButton.icon(
                      onPressed: () => PaywallScreen.show(

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../../providers/kas_santri_provider.dart';
import '../../services/auth_service.dart';
import '../../utils/app_feedback.dart';

class PinSettingsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const PinSettingsScreen({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<PinSettingsScreen> createState() => _PinSettingsScreenState();
}

class _PinSettingsScreenState extends State<PinSettingsScreen> {
  final _oldPinController = TextEditingController();
  final _newPinController = TextEditingController();
  final _confirmPinController = TextEditingController();

  bool _hasExistingPin = false;
  bool _isLoading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _checkExisting();
  }

  Future<void> _checkExisting() async {
    final hasPin = await AuthService.instance.hasPin();
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _hasExistingPin = hasPin;
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _oldPinController.dispose();
    _newPinController.dispose();
    _confirmPinController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _savePin() async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    if (_hasExistingPin) {
      final oldValid = await AuthService.instance.verifyPin(_oldPinController.text.trim());
      if (!oldValid) {
        AppFeedback.alert();
        if (!mounted) return;
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('PIN lama salah!'), backgroundColor: Colors.red),
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    final newPin = _newPinController.text.trim();
    final confirm = _confirmPinController.text.trim();

    if (!AuthService.isValidPinFormat(newPin)) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('PIN harus terdiri dari 4 sampai 6 digit angka (0–9)'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFFF59E0B),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    if (newPin != confirm) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Konfirmasi PIN tidak cocok!'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFFE11D48),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    await AuthService.instance.setPin(newPin);
    await AuthService.instance.updateLastActive();
    await provider.loadAllData();
    if (!mounted) return;
    AppFeedback.success();
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      const SnackBar(
        content: Text('Kunci PIN aman berhasil diperbarui!'),
        backgroundColor: Color(0xFF10B981),
      ),
    );
    Navigator.pop(context);
  }

  Future<void> _removePin() async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Hapus Kunci PIN?'),
        content: const Text('Aplikasi tidak akan terkunci lagi saat dibuka.'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false), child: const Text('Batal')),
          ElevatedButton(
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: Colors.red),
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Hapus PIN'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirm == true) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
      await AuthService.instance.setPin(null);
      await provider.loadAllData();
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('Kunci PIN berhasil dinonaktifkan')),
      );
      Navigator.pop(context);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_isLoading) {
      return const Scaffold(body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()));
    }

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF060A12),
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(_hasExistingPin ? 'Ganti PIN Pengurus' : 'Pasang Kunci PIN'),
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          children: [
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: const Color(0xFF0F172A).withOpacity(0.9),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
                border: Border.all(color: Colors.white12),
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  const Row(
                    children: [
                      Icon(Icons.security, color: Color(0xFF34D399)),
                      SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Text(
                        'Keamanan Aplikasi (PIN 4–6 Digit)',
                        style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, fontSize: 15, color: Colors.white),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  const Text(
                    'Kunci PIN menjaga agar santri tidak dapat mengubah saldo ketika HP pengurus tergeletak.',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.white60),
                  ),
                  const Divider(height: 24, color: Colors.white12),

                  if (_hasExistingPin) ...[
                    TextField(
                      controller: _oldPinController,
                      keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                      obscureText: true,
                      maxLength: 6,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Masukkan PIN Lama',
                        prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.lock_open),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  ],

                  TextField(
                    controller: _newPinController,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    obscureText: true,
                    maxLength: 6,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'PIN Baru (4-6 Digit)',
                      prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.lock_outline),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),

                  TextField(
                    controller: _confirmPinController,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    obscureText: true,
                    maxLength: 6,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Ulangi PIN Baru',
                      prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.lock),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 20),

                  ElevatedButton(
                    onPressed: _savePin,
                    style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
                      foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF030712),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                      minimumSize: const Size.fromHeight(48),
                    ),
                    child: const Text('Simpan Kunci PIN', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)),
                  ),

                  if (_hasExistingPin) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    OutlinedButton(
                      onPressed: _removePin,
                      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                        foregroundColor: const Color(0xFFFB7185),
                        side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFF43F5E)),
                        minimumSize: const Size.fromHeight(48),
                      ),
                      child: const Text('Nonaktifkan Kunci PIN', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'audit_log_screen.dart';

import 'tahun_ajaran_screen.dart';

class SettingsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SettingsScreen({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<SettingsScreen> createState() => _SettingsScreenState();
}

class _SettingsScreenState extends State<SettingsScreen> {
  late TextEditingController _namaPondokController;
  late TextEditingController _tahunAjaranController;
  late TextEditingController _defaultJatahController;
  late TextEditingController _defaultDurasiController;
  late TextEditingController _infakMasakController;
  late TextEditingController _infakListrikController;
  late TextEditingController _infakBerasLiterController;
  late TextEditingController _infakBerasUangController;
  bool _isDriveBusy = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final s = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false).pengaturan;
    _namaPondokController = TextEditingController(text: s.namaPondok);
    _tahunAjaranController = TextEditingController(text: s.tahunAjaran);
    _defaultJatahController = TextEditingController(
      text: CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(s.defaultJatahHarian),
    );
    _defaultDurasiController = TextEditingController(
      text: s.defaultDurasiHari.toString(),
    );
    _infakMasakController = TextEditingController(
      text: CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(s.defaultInfakMasak),
    );
    _infakListrikController = TextEditingController(
      text: CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(s.defaultInfakListrik),
    );
    final literStr = s.defaultInfakBerasLiter == s.defaultInfakBerasLiter.roundToDouble()
        ? s.defaultInfakBerasLiter.toInt().toString()
        : s.defaultInfakBerasLiter.toString();
    _infakBerasLiterController = TextEditingController(text: literStr);
    _infakBerasUangController = TextEditingController(
      text: CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(s.defaultInfakBerasUang),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _namaPondokController.dispose();
    _tahunAjaranController.dispose();
    _defaultJatahController.dispose();
    _defaultDurasiController.dispose();
    _infakMasakController.dispose();
    _infakListrikController.dispose();
    _infakBerasLiterController.dispose();
    _infakBerasUangController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _savePondokDanAturan(
    KasSantriProvider provider,
    PengaturanAplikasi settings,
  ) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final pondok = _namaPondokController.text.trim().isNotEmpty
        ? _namaPondokController.text.trim()
        : settings.namaPondok;
    final ta = _tahunAjaranController.text.trim().isNotEmpty
        ? _tahunAjaranController.text.trim()
        : settings.tahunAjaran;
    final jatah = CurrencyFormatter.parse(_defaultJatahController.text);
    final durasi = int.tryParse(_defaultDurasiController.text.trim()) ?? settings.defaultDurasiHari;
    final masak = CurrencyFormatter.parse(_infakMasakController.text);
    final listrik = CurrencyFormatter.parse(_infakListrikController.text);
    final liter = double.tryParse(
          _infakBerasLiterController.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.'),
        ) ??
        settings.defaultInfakBerasLiter;
    final berasUang = CurrencyFormatter.parse(_infakBerasUangController.text);

    await provider.savePengaturan(
      settings.copyWith(
        namaPondok: pondok,
        tahunAjaran: ta,
        defaultJatahHarian: jatah > 0 ? jatah : settings.defaultJatahHarian,
        defaultDurasiHari: durasi > 0 ? durasi : settings.defaultDurasiHari,
        defaultInfakMasak: masak > 0 ? masak : settings.defaultInfakMasak,
        defaultInfakListrik: listrik > 0 ? listrik : settings.defaultInfakListrik,
        defaultInfakBerasLiter: liter > 0 ? liter : settings.defaultInfakBerasLiter,
        defaultInfakBerasUang: berasUang > 0 ? berasUang : settings.defaultInfakBerasUang,
      ),
    );
    AppFeedback.success();
    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Pengaturan Pondok, Aturan Kas & Tarif Infak tersimpan!'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFF10B981),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pickCustomWallpaper(ThemeWallpaperProvider wp) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(type: FileType.image);
    if (res != null && res.files.single.path != null) {
      try {
        await wp.setCustomWallpaperFromFile(res.files.single.path!);
        if (mounted) {
          AppFeedback.success();
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(
              content: Text('Wallpaper galeri diterapkan secara permanen!'),
              backgroundColor: Color(0xFF10B981),
            ),
          );
        }
      } catch (e) {
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(content: Text('Gagal memasang wallpaper: $e'), backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48)),
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pickLogo(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    if (!provider.isProUser) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: 'Upload Logo Pondok & Kop Resmi Yayasan',
      );
      return;
    }
    final result = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(type: FileType.image);
    if (result != null && result.files.single.path != null) {
      await provider.updateLogoPath(result.files.single.path);
      if (mounted) {
        AppFeedback.success();
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('Logo pondok berhasil diperbarui!'),
            backgroundColor: Color(0xFF10B981),
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _showEditBendaharaDialog(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final acc = provider.activeAccount;
    final namaCtrl = TextEditingController(text: provider.activeOperatorName);
    final jabatanCtrl = TextEditingController(text: provider.activeOperatorRole);
    String? pickedFoto = acc?.fotoPath;

    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setDlg) => AlertDialog(
          title: const Text('Edit Profil & Foto Bendahara', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 15.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)),
          content: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              OutlinedButton.icon(
                onPressed: () async {
                  final res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(type: FileType.image);
                  if (res != null && res.files.single.path != null) {
                    setDlg(() => pickedFoto = res.files.single.path);
                  }
                },
                icon: const Icon(Icons.photo_camera_outlined, size: 16),
                label: Text(pickedFoto != null ? 'Ganti Foto Bendahara' : 'Pilih Foto Bendahara'),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              TextField(
                controller: namaCtrl,
                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 13),
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Nama Bendahara', isDense: true),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              TextField(
                controller: jabatanCtrl,
                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 13),
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Jabatan', isDense: true),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
              child: const Text('Batal', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
              child: const Text('Simpan'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    final nama = namaCtrl.text.trim();
    final jab = jabatanCtrl.text.trim();
    namaCtrl.dispose();
    jabatanCtrl.dispose();

    if (ok == true && mounted) {
      await provider.updateBendaharaProfile(
        namaLengkap: nama.isNotEmpty ? nama : provider.activeOperatorName,
        jabatan: jab.isNotEmpty ? jab : provider.activeOperatorRole,
        sourceFotoPath: pickedFoto != acc?.fotoPath ? pickedFoto : null,
      );
      if (mounted) {
        AppFeedback.success();
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Profil Bendahara diperbarui!'), backgroundColor: Color(0xFF10B981)),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _showChangePasswordDialog(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    final acc = provider.activeAccount;
    if (acc == null || acc.authMode != BendaharaAccount.modeLocal) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Ganti password hanya berlaku untuk akun login lokal (Username & Password).'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFFF59E0B),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final oldCtrl = TextEditingController();
    final newCtrl = TextEditingController();
    final confirmCtrl = TextEditingController();
    String? err;

    final changed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setDlg) => AlertDialog(
          title: const Text('Ganti Password Akun', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 15.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)),
          content: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              TextField(
                controller: oldCtrl,
                obscureText: true,
                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 13),
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Password Lama', isDense: true),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              TextField(
                controller: newCtrl,
                obscureText: true,
                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 13),
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Password Baru (min. 6 karakter)', isDense: true),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              TextField(
                controller: confirmCtrl,
                obscureText: true,
                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 13),
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Konfirmasi Password Baru', isDense: true),
              ),
              if (err != null) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Text(err!, style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFFDA4AF), fontSize: 11.5)),
              ],
            ],
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
              child: const Text('Batal', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () async {
                if (newCtrl.text != confirmCtrl.text) {
                  setDlg(() => err = 'Konfirmasi password baru tidak cocok.');
                  return;
                }
                try {
                  await AccountAuthService.instance.changePassword(
                    oldPassword: oldCtrl.text,
                    newPassword: newCtrl.text,
                  );
                  if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx, true);
                } catch (e) {
                  setDlg(() => err = e.toString().replaceFirst('Exception: ', ''));
                }
              },
              child: const Text('Simpan Password'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    oldCtrl.dispose();
    newCtrl.dispose();
    confirmCtrl.dispose();

    if (changed == true && mounted) {
      AppFeedback.success();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Password bendahara berhasil diperbarui!'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFF10B981),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _logoutFromSettings(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    await provider.logoutBendahara();
    if (!mounted) return;
    Navigator.pushAndRemoveUntil(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const LoginScreen()),
      (_) => false,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _lockAppNow(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    if (provider.pengaturan.pinKeamanan == null || provider.pengaturan.pinKeamanan!.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Pasang Kunci PIN terlebih dahulu sebelum mengunci aplikasi.'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFFF59E0B),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    await AuthService.instance.lockSession();
    if (!mounted) return;
    Navigator.pushReplacement(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const PinLockScreen(isUnlockingSession: true)),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _confirmDisablePinDialog() async {
    final pinController = TextEditingController();
    final verified = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Nonaktifkan Kunci PIN?', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 15.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            const Text('Masukkan PIN saat ini untuk mematikan kunci aplikasi:', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12)),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextField(
              controller: pinController,
              keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
              obscureText: true,
              maxLength: 6,
              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
              decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'PIN Saat Ini (4–6 Digit)', isDense: true),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false), child: const Text('Batal', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70))),
          ElevatedButton(
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF43F5E)),
            onPressed: () async {
              final ok = await AuthService.instance.verifyPin(pinController.text.trim());
              if (!ok) {
                AppFeedback.alert();
                if (ctx.mounted) {
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(ctx).showSnackBar(
                    const SnackBar(content: Text('PIN tidak cocok!'), backgroundColor: Color(0xFFE11D48)),
                  );
                }
                return;
              }
              if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx, true);
            },
            child: const Text('Matikan PIN'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    pinController.dispose();

    if (verified == true && mounted) {
      await AuthService.instance.setPin(null);
      if (!mounted) return;
      await Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false).loadAllData();
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Kunci PIN dinonaktifkan.'), backgroundColor: Color(0xFFF59E0B)),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _backupJson() async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    try {
      final dump = await DatabaseHelper.instance.dumpBackupJson();
      final jsonStr = const JsonEncoder.withIndent('  ').convert(dump);
      final dir = await getTemporaryDirectory();
      final file = File('${dir.path}/backup_kas_santri_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.json');
      await file.writeAsString(jsonStr);
      AppFeedback.success();
      await Share.shareXFiles([XFile(file.path)], text: 'Backup Kas Santri (.JSON)');
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Gagal backup: $e'), backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF43F5E)),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _showConfirmRestoreDialog({
    required String sourceLabel,
    required BackupValidationResult validation,
    DateTime? cloudModifiedTime,
  }) async {
    final exportedDt = validation.exportedAt != null ? DateTime.tryParse(validation.exportedAt!) : null;
    final dateText = cloudModifiedTime != null
        ? DateFormatter.formatFullDateTime(cloudModifiedTime)
        : (exportedDt != null ? DateFormatter.formatFullDateTime(exportedDt) : '-');

    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Pulihkan Data Backup?', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)),
        content: Text(
          'Sumber: $sourceLabel\nTanggal: $dateText\n\n'
          '• Santri: ${validation.santriCount} • Setoran: ${validation.setoranCount}\n'
          '• Transaksi: ${validation.transaksiCount} • Mutasi Dompet: ${validation.mutasiDompetCount}\n'
          '• Infak Santri: ${validation.infakCount} • Serah Terima: ${validation.serahTerimaInfakCount}\n\n'
          'Seluruh data lokal saat ini akan ditimpa dengan data backup.',
          style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false), child: const Text('Batal', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70))),
          ElevatedButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true), child: const Text('Ya, Pulihkan')),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirm == true && mounted) {
      final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
      await provider.restoreFromBackupJson(validation.parsedData!);
      if (mounted) {
        AppFeedback.success();
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Alhamdulillah! Data berhasil dipulihkan.'), backgroundColor: Color(0xFF10B981)),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  void _confirmReset() {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Reset Data Simulasi?'),
        content: const Text(
          'Seluruh data santri dan transaksi akan dikembalikan ke data awal simulasi Kas-Santri.',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx), child: const Text('Batal', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70))),
          ElevatedButton(
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF43F5E)),
            onPressed: () async {
              final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
              await provider.resetToInitialData();
              if (ctx.mounted) {
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
              }
              if (mounted) {
                ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                  const SnackBar(content: Text('Data simulasi berhasil di-reset!'), backgroundColor: Color(0xFF10B981)),
                );
              }
            },
            child: const Text('Ya, Reset Simulasi'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _showGoogleDriveFriendlyDialog(Object error) async {
    AppFeedback.alert();
    final friendly = GoogleDriveBackupService.mapAuthError(error);
    if (!mounted) return;

    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dlgCtx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0A182B),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
          side: BorderSide(
            color: const Color(0xFFFBBF24).withValues(alpha: 0.50),
          ),
        ),
        title: Row(
          children: [
            const Icon(Icons.cloud_sync_rounded, color: Color(0xFFFDE68A), size: 22),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                friendly.title,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  fontSize: 15,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        content: Text(
          friendly.message,
          style: const TextStyle(
            color: Colors.white70,
            fontSize: 12.5,
            height: 1.42,
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dlgCtx),
            child: const Text('Tutup', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white60)),
          ),
          OutlinedButton.icon(
            onPressed: () {
              Navigator.pop(dlgCtx);
              _backupJson();
            },
            style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
              side: BorderSide(color: const Color(0xFF38BDF8).withValues(alpha: 0.55)),
            ),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.download_rounded, size: 15, color: Color(0xFF67E8F9)),
            label: const Text(
              'Backup Lokal (.JSON)',
              style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF67E8F9), fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
            ),
          ),
          ElevatedButton.icon(
            onPressed: () {
              Navigator.pop(dlgCtx);
              EncryptedBackupHelper.backupEncryptedKsbak(context);
            },
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
              foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF030712),
            ),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.enhanced_encryption_rounded, size: 15),
            label: const Text(
              'Backup Lokal (.KSBAK)',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _sectionHeader(String tag, String title, Color accent) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(
          tag,
          style: TextStyle(color: accent, fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, letterSpacing: 1.2),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 2),
        Text(
          title,
          style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _sliderRow({
    required String label,
    required String valueText,
    required double value,
    required double min,
    required double max,
    required ValueChanged<double> onChanged,
  }) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
          children: [
            Text(label, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            Text(
              valueText,
              style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF67E8F9), fontSize: 11, fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        SliderTheme(
          data: SliderTheme.of(context).copyWith(
            trackHeight: 4,
            thumbShape: const RoundSliderThumbShape(enabledThumbRadius: 7),
          ),
          child: Slider(
            value: value.clamp(min, max),
            min: min,
            max: max,
            activeColor: const Color(0xFF34D399),
            inactiveColor: Colors.white12,
            onChanged: onChanged,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _switchBox({
    required String title,
    required bool value,
    required ValueChanged<bool> onChanged,
  }) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 4),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.28),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.white12),
      ),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [
          Expanded(
            child: Text(title, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
          ),
          Switch(
            value: value,
            activeColor: const Color(0xFF34D399),
            onChanged: onChanged,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

  Future<void> _pickBendaharaPhoto(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final result = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(type: FileType.image);
    if (result != null && result.files.single.path != null) {
      await provider.updateBendaharaProfile(
        sourceFotoPath: result.files.single.path,
      );
      if (mounted) {
        AppFeedback.success();
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('Foto profil bendahara berhasil diperbarui!'),
            backgroundColor: Color(0xFF10B981),

      }
    }

  Future<void> _handleLogout(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final hasUnsaved = provider.hasUnbackedUpLocalChanges;
    final proceed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(
          hasUnsaved ? '⚠️ Ada Data Belum Dicadangkan' : 'Logout / Ganti Akun?',
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
        ),
        content: Text(
          hasUnsaved
              ? 'Terdapat data transaksi lokal yang belum dicadangkan ke Google Drive. Data santri di perangkat ini tetap aman saat Anda ganti akun, namun sebaiknya cadangkan dahulu.\n\nTetap keluar dari akun bendahara saat ini?'
              : 'Anda akan keluar dari sesi bendahara saat ini dan diarahkan ke layar Login / Ganti Akun. Data kas santri tetap tersimpan aman di perangkat.',
          style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Batal', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF43F5E)),
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Keluar / Ganti Akun'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (proceed != true || !mounted) return;

    await provider.logoutBendahara();
    if (!mounted) return;
    Navigator.pushAndRemoveUntil(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const LoginScreen()),
      (_) => false,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _lockAppNow(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final hasPin =
        provider.pengaturan.pinKeamanan != null && provider.pengaturan.pinKeamanan!.isNotEmpty;
    if (!hasPin) {
      Navigator.push(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const PinSettingsScreen()),
      );
      return;
    }
    await AuthService.instance.lockSession();
    if (!mounted) return;
    Navigator.pushReplacement(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const PinLockScreen(isUnlockingSession: true)),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildVibrantQuickCard(_QuickAccessSpec spec, double cardOpacity) {
    final topColor = Color.lerp(const Color(0xFF071324), spec.accent, 0.24)!
        .withValues(alpha: (0.86 * cardOpacity).clamp(0.48, 0.90));
    final bottomColor = const Color(0xFF091120)
        .withValues(alpha: (0.90 * cardOpacity).clamp(0.52, 0.94));

    return Material(
      color: Colors.transparent,
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: spec.onTap,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: LinearGradient(
              colors: [topColor, bottomColor],
              begin: Alignment.topLeft,
              end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            ),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
            border: Border.all(
              color: spec.accent.withValues(alpha: 0.45),
              width: 1.1,
            ),
            boxShadow: [
              BoxShadow(
                color: spec.accent.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                blurRadius: 12,
                offset: const Offset(0, 4),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Row(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                children: [
                  Container(
                    width: 34,
                    height: 34,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: spec.accent.withValues(alpha: 0.18),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11),
                      border: Border.all(
                        color: spec.accent.withValues(alpha: 0.45),
                      ),
                    ),
                    alignment: Alignment.center,
                    child: Text(spec.emoji, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 17)),
                  ),
                  if (spec.isProLocked)
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        gradient: const LinearGradient(
                          colors: [Color(0xFFF59E0B), Color(0xFFFDE047)],
                        ),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      ),
                      child: const Text(
                        '🔒 PRO',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: Color(0xFF030712),
                          fontSize: 8.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                        ),
                      ),
                    )
                  else
                    Icon(
                      Icons.arrow_forward_ios_rounded,
                      size: 11,
                      color: spec.accent.withValues(alpha: 0.75),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
              Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    spec.title,
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      fontSize: 12.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
                  Text(
                    spec.subtitle,
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white70,
                      fontSize: 10,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _QuickAccessSpec {
  final String emoji;
  final String title;
  final String subtitle;
  final Color accent;
  final bool isProLocked;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  const _QuickAccessSpec({
    required this.emoji,
    required this.title,
    required this.subtitle,
    required this.accent,
    required this.isProLocked,
    required this.onTap,
  });
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class TahunAjaranScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const TahunAjaranScreen({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<TahunAjaranScreen> createState() => _TahunAjaranScreenState();
}

class _TahunAjaranScreenState extends State<TahunAjaranScreen> {
  int _tabIdx = 0; // 0: Tahun Ajaran, 1: Pindah Kamar, 2: Tutup Buku / Alumni
  late TextEditingController _tahunCtrl;
  final TextEditingController _targetKamarCtrl = TextEditingController();
  String? _filterKamar;
  final Set<String> _selectedIds = {};
  String _archiveStatus = Santri.statusAlumniVal;
  bool _busy = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final cur = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false)
        .pengaturan
        .tahunAjaran;
    _tahunCtrl = TextEditingController(text: cur);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _tahunCtrl.dispose();
    _targetKamarCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String _suggestNextTahunAjaran(String current) {
    final m = RegExp(r'(\d{4})\s*/\s*(\d{4})').firstMatch(current);
    if (m != null) {
      final y1 = int.parse(m.group(1)!) + 1;
      final y2 = int.parse(m.group(2)!) + 1;
      return current.replaceFirst(m.group(0)!, '$y1/$y2');
    }
    final nowYear = DateTime.now().year;
    return '$nowYear/${nowYear + 1}';
  }

  Future<void> _saveNewTahunAjaran(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    final nextVal = _tahunCtrl.text.trim();
    if (nextVal.isEmpty) return;
    AppFeedback.tap();
    setState(() => _busy = true);
    try {
      await provider.mulaiTahunAjaranBaru(nextVal);
      if (mounted) {
        AppFeedback.success();
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Tahun Ajaran diperbarui ke $nextVal!'),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
          ),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _moveSelectedKamar(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    final targetKamar = _targetKamarCtrl.text.trim();
    if (_selectedIds.isEmpty || targetKamar.isEmpty) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Pilih minimal 1 santri dan isi nama kamar/kelas tujuan.'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFFF59E0B),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    AppFeedback.tap();
    setState(() => _busy = true);
    try {
      final moved = await provider.pindahKamarMassal(
        _selectedIds.toList(),
        targetKamar,
      );
      if (mounted) {
        AppFeedback.success();
        setState(() {
          _selectedIds.clear();
          _filterKamar = null;
        });
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('$moved santri berhasil dipindahkan ke "$targetKamar".'),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
          ),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _archiveSelected(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    if (_selectedIds.isEmpty) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Pilih santri yang akan diluluskan / diarsipkan.'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFFF59E0B),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final statusLabel = _archiveStatus == Santri.statusAlumniVal
        ? 'Alumni / Lulus'
        : 'Pindah';
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(
          'Arsipkan ${_selectedIds.length} Santri?',
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
        ),
        content: Text(
          'Status santri terpilih akan diubah menjadi "$statusLabel".\n\n'
          'Saldo akhir dan riwayat mutasi/infak mereka TETAP TERSIMPAN AMAN di arsip audit database, namun tidak lagi memenuhi antrean harian.',
          style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Batal', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Ya, Tutup Buku & Arsipkan'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true) return;

    setState(() => _busy = true);
    try {
      final count = await provider.tutupBukuArsipSantri(
        _selectedIds.toList(),
        statusTujuan: _archiveStatus,
      );
      if (mounted) {
        AppFeedback.success();
        setState(() => _selectedIds.clear());
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('$count santri diarsipkan sebagai $statusLabel.'),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
          ),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

                          dense: true,
                          contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                          value: checked,
                          onChanged: (v) {

                                _selectedIds.remove(s.id);

                        );
                      }),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      SizedBox(
                        width: double.infinity,
                        child: ElevatedButton.icon(

                              : () => _tabIdx == 1
                                  ? _moveSelectedKamar(provider)
                                  : _archiveSelected(provider),
                          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: _tabIdx == 1
                                ? const Color(0xFF38BDF8)
                                : const Color(0xFFF59E0B),
                            foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF04121A),
                          ),
                          icon: Icon(
                            _tabIdx == 1
                                ? Icons.drive_file_move_rounded
                                : Icons.inventory_2_outlined,
                          ),
                          label: Text(
                            _tabIdx == 1
                                ? 'Pindahkan ${_selectedIds.length} Santri Sekarang'
                                : 'Arsipkan ${_selectedIds.length} Santri (Tutup Buku)',
                            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                if (_tabIdx == 2 && archivedSantri.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  GlassCard(
                    borderRadius: 20,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'ARSIP ALUMNI / PINDAH (${archivedSantri.length} SANTRI)',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            color: Colors.white70,
                            fontSize: 10.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        ...archivedSantri.take(20).map(
                              (s) => Padding(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
                                child: Row(
                                  children: [
                                    Expanded(
                                      child: Text(
                                        '${s.namaLengkap} (${s.kamar})',
                                        style: const TextStyle(
                                          color: Colors.white70,
                                          fontSize: 12,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    Text(
                                      s.statusSantriLabel,
                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                        color: Color(0xFFFDE68A),
                                        fontSize: 11,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _segBtn(int index, String label) {
    final active = _tabIdx == index;
    return Expanded(
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () {
          AppFeedback.tap();
          setState(() {
            _tabIdx = index;
            _selectedIds.clear();
          });
        },
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10, horizontal: 4),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: active
                ? const Color(0xFF10B981).withOpacity(0.25)
                : Colors.transparent,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
            border: active
                ? Border.all(color: const Color(0xFF34D399).withOpacity(0.55))
                : null,
          ),
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: TextStyle(
              color: active ? const Color(0xFF6EE7B7) : Colors.white60,
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            ),
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../providers/kas_santri_provider.dart';
import '../services/account_auth_service.dart';
import '../services/auth_service.dart';
import '../services/tutorial_service.dart';
import '../widgets/app_background_wrapper.dart';
import 'auth/login_screen.dart';
import 'onboarding_screen.dart';
import 'pin_lock_screen.dart';
import 'main_navigation_screen.dart';

class SplashScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SplashScreen({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<SplashScreen> createState() => _SplashScreenState();
}

class _SplashScreenState extends State<SplashScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _bootstrap();
  }

  Future<void> _bootstrap() async {
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    await provider.init();

    await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 600));

    final shouldLock = await AuthService.instance.shouldLockApp();

    if (!mounted) return;

    if (!provider.pengaturan.onboardingDone) {
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const OnboardingScreen()),
      );
      return;
    }

    final seenOnboarding = await TutorialService.instance.hasSeenOnboarding();
    if (!seenOnboarding) {
      await TutorialService.instance.markOnboardingSeen();
    }

    final remember = await AccountAuthService.instance.getRememberSession();
    final loggedOut = await AccountAuthService.instance.isExplicitlyLoggedOut();
    if (!mounted) return;

    if (provider.activeAccount == null || loggedOut || !remember) {
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const LoginScreen()),
      );
      return;
    }

    if (shouldLock) {
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (_) => const PinLockScreen(isUnlockingSession: true),
        ),
      );
    } else {
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const MainNavigationScreen()),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      body: Stack(
        children: [
          // Ambient aurora lights
          Positioned(
            top: -50,
            left: -50,
            child: Container(
              width: 250,
              height: 250,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                color: const Color(0xFF10B981).withOpacity(0.2),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Positioned(
            bottom: -50,
            right: -50,
            child: Container(
              width: 250,
              height: 250,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                color: const Color(0xFF06B6D4).withOpacity(0.2),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Center(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
              children: [
                Container(
                  width: 90,
                  height: 90,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    gradient: const LinearGradient(
                      colors: [Color(0xFF10B981), Color(0xFF06B6D4)],
                    ),
                    boxShadow: [
                      BoxShadow(
                        color: const Color(0xFF10B981).withOpacity(0.4),
                        blurRadius: 25,
                        offset: const Offset(0, 4),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  child: const KasSantriLogoMark(

                const Text(
                  'KAS-SANTRI',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.white,

                    letterSpacing: 1.8,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                const Text(
                  'MANAJEMEN UANG SAKU & INFAK PONDOK',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: Color(0xFF34D399),

                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                    letterSpacing: 1.5,
                  ),

                const SizedBox(height: 36),
