```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../../database/database_helper.dart';
import '../../models/transaksi.dart';
import '../../providers/kas_santri_provider.dart';
import '../../providers/theme_wallpaper_provider.dart';
import '../../utils/currency_formatter.dart';
import '../../utils/date_formatter.dart';
import '../../utils/time_category_helper.dart';
import '../../utils/app_feedback.dart';
import '../../services/yayasan_export_service.dart';
import '../../widgets/searchable_santri_picker.dart';
import '../paywall_screen.dart';

class RiwayatTransaksiScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const RiwayatTransaksiScreen({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<RiwayatTransaksiScreen> createState() => _RiwayatTransaksiScreenState();
}

class _RiwayatTransaksiScreenState extends State<RiwayatTransaksiScreen>
    with AutomaticKeepAliveClientMixin {
  String _selectedSantriId = 'ALL';
  String _selectedWaktu = 'ALL';
  ExportPeriod _dateFilter = ExportPeriod.semua;
  DateTime? _customStart;
  DateTime? _customEnd;
  List<TransaksiHarian> _list = [];
  bool _isLoading = true;

  @override
  bool get wantKeepAlive => true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _fetch();
  }

  Future<void> _exportFromMutasi({required bool isExcel}) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    if (!provider.isProUser) {
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: isExcel
            ? 'Ekspor Laporan Excel Multi-Sheet (.xlsx)'
            : 'Ekspor Laporan Resmi PDF Berkop Logo',
      );
      return;
    }
    try {
      if (isExcel) {
        await YayasanExportService.instance.exportExcelMultiSheet(
          pengaturan: provider.pengaturan,
          santriList: provider.allSantri,
          totalBrankasFisik: provider.totalBrankasFisik,
          kasLaciTunai: provider.kasLaciTunai,
          rekeningBank: provider.rekeningBank,
          totalTunggakanPondok: provider.totalTunggakanPondok,
          opnameLogs: provider.opnameLogs,
          period: _dateFilter,
          customStart: _customStart,
          customEnd: _customEnd,
        );
      } else {
        await YayasanExportService.instance.exportPdfResmiYayasan(
          pengaturan: provider.pengaturan,
          santriList: provider.allSantri,
          totalBrankasFisik: provider.totalBrankasFisik,
          kasLaciTunai: provider.kasLaciTunai,
          rekeningBank: provider.rekeningBank,
          totalTunggakanPondok: provider.totalTunggakanPondok,
          period: _dateFilter,
          customStart: _customStart,
          customEnd: _customEnd,
        );
      }
      AppFeedback.success();
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Gagal mengekspor laporan: $e'),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _fetch() async {
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    final range = YayasanExportService.resolveRange(
      _dateFilter,
      customStart: _customStart,
      customEnd: _customEnd,
    );
    final results = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getAllTransaksi(
      santriId: _selectedSantriId,
      kategoriWaktu: _selectedWaktu,
      tanggalMulai: range.mulai,
      tanggalSelesai: range.selesai,
    );
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _list = results;
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pickCustomDateRange() async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final now = DateTime.now().toLocal();
    final initialRange = DateTimeRange(
      start: _customStart ?? now.subtract(const Duration(days: 6)),
      end: _customEnd ?? now,
    );
    final picked = await showDateRangePicker(
      context: context,
      firstDate: DateTime(2020),
      lastDate: DateTime(2035),
      initialDateRange: initialRange,
      builder: (ctx, child) {
        return Theme(
          data: Theme.of(ctx).copyWith(
            colorScheme: const ColorScheme.dark(
              primary: Color(0xFF10B981),
              onPrimary: Color(0xFF040914),
              surface: Color(0xFF0F172A),
              onSurface: Colors.white,
            ),
            dialogBackgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0F172A),
          ),
          child: child ?? const SizedBox.shrink(),
        );
      },
    );
    if (picked != null && mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _customStart = DateTime(picked.start.year, picked.start.month, picked.start.day);
        _customEnd = DateTime(picked.end.year, picked.end.month, picked.end.day);
        _dateFilter = ExportPeriod.rentangKhusus;
      });
      await _fetch();
    }
  }

  void _confirmVoid(TransaksiHarian tx, String namaSantri) {
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    final santri =
        provider.allSantri.where((s) => s.id == tx.santriId).firstOrNull;
    final isSetoran = tx.tipe == TipeTransaksi.setoran;
    final saldoSaatIni = santri?.saldoTotal ?? 0;
    final bool isSaldoSetoranTerpakai = isSetoran && saldoSaatIni < tx.nominal;
    final int estimasiTalangan =
        isSaldoSetoranTerpakai ? (tx.nominal - saldoSaatIni) : 0;

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(
          isSetoran ? 'Batalkan Setoran Ini?' : 'Batalkan Transaksi Ini?',
        ),
        content: Text(
          isSaldoSetoranTerpakai
              ? 'Setoran $namaSantri sebesar ${CurrencyFormatter.format(tx.nominal)} akan dibatalkan.\n\n'
                  '⚠️ Perhatian: Saldo santri saat ini tinggal ${CurrencyFormatter.format(saldoSaatIni)} karena sebagian uang setoran sudah terpakai jajan. Selisih yang sudah terpakai (hingga ${CurrencyFormatter.format(estimasiTalangan)}) akan otomatis tercatat sebagai Tunggakan / Talangan Kas Pondok agar Brankas & Multi-Dompet tetap 100% seimbang.'
              : 'Transaksi $namaSantri sebesar ${CurrencyFormatter.format(tx.nominal)} akan dibatalkan dan saldo santri serta mutasi dompet akan disesuaikan otomatis.',
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, height: 1.4),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
            child: const Text('Tutup', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF43F5E)),
            onPressed: () async {
              final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
              await provider.voidTransaksi(tx.id);
              if (ctx.mounted) {
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
              }
              await _fetch();
              if (!mounted) return;
              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                const SnackBar(
                  content: Text('Transaksi dibatalkan & saldo dikembalikan.'),
                  backgroundColor: Color(0xFF10B981),
                ),
              );
            },
            child: const Text('Ya, Batalkan Transaksi'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

    super.build(context);
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context);

    return SafeArea(

          await provider.loadAllData();
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';
import '../models/bendahara_account.dart';
import 'google_drive_backup_service.dart';

class AccountAuthService {
  static final AccountAuthService instance = AccountAuthService._init();
  AccountAuthService._init();

  static const String _keyAccountsJson = 'ks_v32_bendahara_accounts';
  static const String _keyActiveAccountId = 'ks_v32_active_account_id';
  static const String _keyRememberSession = 'ks_v32_remember_session';
  static const String _keyExplicitlyLoggedOut = 'ks_v32_explicitly_logged_out';

  static final FlutterSecureStorage _secureStorage = const FlutterSecureStorage(
    aOptions: AndroidOptions(encryptedSharedPreferences: true),
  );

  static String _generateSalt16Base64() {
    final rng = Random.secure();
    final bytes = List<int>.generate(16, (_) => rng.nextInt(256));
    return base64UrlEncode(bytes);
  }

  /// Hash password dengan random 16-byte salt per akun (`v33:<salt>:<sha256>`).
  static String hashPassword(String usernameOrEmail, String password, {String? salt}) {
    final normalized = usernameOrEmail.trim().toLowerCase();
    final s = salt ?? _generateSalt16Base64();
    final bytes = utf8.encode('ks_v33_pwd:$s:$normalized:$password');
    final digest = sha256.convert(bytes).toString();
    return 'v33:$s:$digest';
  }

  /// Format hash legacy v3.2 untuk kompatibilitas migrasi akun lama.
  static String _hashLegacyV32Password(String usernameOrEmail, String password) {
    final normalized = usernameOrEmail.trim().toLowerCase();
    final bytes = utf8.encode('ks_v32_pwd:$normalized:$password');
    return sha256.convert(bytes).toString();
  }

  static bool verifyPasswordHash({
    required String usernameOrEmail,
    required String password,
    required String? storedHash,
  }) {
    if (storedHash == null || storedHash.isEmpty) return false;
    if (storedHash.startsWith('v33:')) {
      final parts = storedHash.split(':');
      if (parts.length != 3 || parts[1].isEmpty) return false;
      return hashPassword(usernameOrEmail, password, salt: parts[1]) == storedHash;
    }
    return storedHash == _hashLegacyV32Password(usernameOrEmail, password);
  }

  Future<String?> _readSecureOrPref(String key) async {
    try {
      final sec = await _secureStorage.read(key: key);
      if (sec != null && sec.isNotEmpty) return sec;
    } catch (_) {}
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getString(key);
  }

  Future<void> _writeSecureAndClearPref(String key, String value) async {
    bool written = false;
    try {
      await _secureStorage.write(key: key, value: value);
      written = true;
    } catch (_) {
      written = false;
    }
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (written) {
      await prefs.remove(key);
    } else {
      await prefs.setString(key, value);
    }
  }

  Future<List<BendaharaAccount>> getAllAccounts() async {
    final raw = await _readSecureOrPref(_keyAccountsJson);
    if (raw == null || raw.trim().isEmpty) return [];
    // Migrasi transparan dari SharedPreferences ke SecureStorage jika baru dibaca dari prefs
    await _writeSecureAndClearPref(_keyAccountsJson, raw);
    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
      if (decoded is! List) return [];
      return decoded
          .whereType<Map>()
          .map((m) => BendaharaAccount.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic>.from(m)))
          .toList();
    } catch (_) {
      return [];
    }
  }

  Future<void> _saveAccounts(List<BendaharaAccount> list) async {
    final encoded = jsonEncode(list.map((a) => a.toMap()).toList());
    await _writeSecureAndClearPref(_keyAccountsJson, encoded);
  }

  Future<bool> getRememberSession() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getBool(_keyRememberSession) ?? true;
  }

  Future<bool> isExplicitlyLoggedOut() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getBool(_keyExplicitlyLoggedOut) ?? false;
  }

  Future<BendaharaAccount?> getActiveAccount() async {
    final activeId = await _readSecureOrPref(_keyActiveAccountId);
    if (activeId == null || activeId.isEmpty) return null;
    final accounts = await getAllAccounts();
    for (final acc in accounts) {
      if (acc.id == activeId) return acc;
    }
    return null;
  }

  Future<void> _setActiveSession(
    String accountId, {
    required bool rememberSession,
  }) async {
    await _writeSecureAndClearPref(_keyActiveAccountId, accountId);
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setBool(_keyRememberSession, rememberSession);
    await prefs.setBool(_keyExplicitlyLoggedOut, false);
  }

  /// Menjamin pengguna upgrade lama (onboardingDone = true) tetap langsung masuk tanpa terkunci
  Future<BendaharaAccount?> ensureLegacySessionIfNeeded(
    String fallbackNamaPengurus,
  ) async {
    final active = await getActiveAccount();
    if (active != null) return active;

    final explicitlyLoggedOut = await isExplicitlyLoggedOut();
    if (explicitlyLoggedOut) return null;

    return await enterOfflineQuickMode(
      namaLengkap: fallbackNamaPengurus.trim().isNotEmpty
          ? fallbackNamaPengurus.trim()
          : 'Pengurus Kas & Keuangan',
      jabatan: 'Bendahara Pondok',
      rememberSession: true,
    );
  }

  Future<BendaharaAccount> registerLocalAccount({
    required String namaLengkap,
    required String jabatan,
    required String username,
    required String password,
    bool rememberSession = true,
  }) async {
    final cleanName = namaLengkap.trim();
    final cleanJabatan =
        jabatan.trim().isNotEmpty ? jabatan.trim() : 'Bendahara Pondok';
    final cleanUser = username.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (cleanName.isEmpty) {
      throw Exception('Nama lengkap bendahara wajib diisi.');
    }
    if (cleanUser.length < 3) {
      throw Exception('Username atau email minimal 3 karakter.');
    }
    if (password.length < 6) {
      throw Exception('Password minimal 6 karakter.');
    }

    final accounts = await getAllAccounts();
    final duplicate = accounts.any(
      (a) =>
          a.authMode == BendaharaAccount.modeLocal &&
          ((a.username?.toLowerCase() == cleanUser) ||
              (a.email?.toLowerCase() == cleanUser)),
    );
    if (duplicate) {
      throw Exception('Username / email "$cleanUser" sudah terdaftar.');
    }

    final account = BendaharaAccount(
      id: const Uuid().v4(),
      namaLengkap: cleanName,
      jabatan: cleanJabatan,
      username: cleanUser,
      email: cleanUser.contains('@') ? cleanUser : null,
      passwordHash: hashPassword(cleanUser, password),
      authMode: BendaharaAccount.modeLocal,
    );

    accounts.add(account);
    await _saveAccounts(accounts);
    await _setActiveSession(account.id, rememberSession: rememberSession);
    return account;
  }

  Future<BendaharaAccount> loginLocal({
    required String username,
    required String password,
    bool rememberSession = true,
  }) async {
    final cleanUser = username.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (cleanUser.isEmpty || password.isEmpty) {
      throw Exception('Username/email dan password wajib diisi.');
    }

    final accounts = await getAllAccounts();

    for (var i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
      final acc = accounts[i];
      if (acc.authMode != BendaharaAccount.modeLocal) continue;
      final matchUser = (acc.username?.toLowerCase() == cleanUser) ||
          (acc.email?.toLowerCase() == cleanUser);
      if (matchUser &&
          verifyPasswordHash(
            usernameOrEmail: cleanUser,
            password: password,
            storedHash: acc.passwordHash,
          )) {
        var resolved = acc;
        // Auto-upgrade hash legacy ke random 16-byte salted v3.3
        if (acc.passwordHash == null || !acc.passwordHash!.startsWith('v33:')) {
          resolved = acc.copyWith(passwordHash: hashPassword(cleanUser, password));
          accounts[i] = resolved;
          await _saveAccounts(accounts);
        }
        await _setActiveSession(resolved.id, rememberSession: rememberSession);
        return resolved;
      }
    }

    throw Exception('Username/email atau password salah.');
  }

  Future<BendaharaAccount> loginWithGoogle({
    bool rememberSession = true,
  }) async {
    final googleAccount = await GoogleDriveBackupService.instance.signInInteractive();
    if (googleAccount == null) {
      throw Exception('Login Google dibatalkan atau gagal tersambung.');
    }

    final email = googleAccount.email.trim().toLowerCase();
    final displayName = (googleAccount.displayName?.trim().isNotEmpty == true)
        ? googleAccount.displayName!.trim()
        : email.split('@').first;

    final accounts = await getAllAccounts();
    final existingIdx = accounts.indexWhere(
      (a) =>
          a.authMode == BendaharaAccount.modeGoogle &&
          a.email?.toLowerCase() == email,
    );

    final BendaharaAccount account;
    if (existingIdx >= 0) {
      account = accounts[existingIdx].copyWith(
        namaLengkap: displayName,
        email: email,
      );
      accounts[existingIdx] = account;
    } else {
      account = BendaharaAccount(
        id: const Uuid().v4(),
        namaLengkap: displayName,
        jabatan: 'Bendahara Pondok',
        email: email,
        username: email,
        authMode: BendaharaAccount.modeGoogle,
      );
      accounts.add(account);
    }

    await _saveAccounts(accounts);
    await _setActiveSession(account.id, rememberSession: rememberSession);
    return account;
  }

  Future<BendaharaAccount> enterOfflineQuickMode({
    required String namaLengkap,
    String jabatan = 'Bendahara Pondok',
    bool rememberSession = true,
  }) async {
    final cleanName = namaLengkap.trim().isNotEmpty
        ? namaLengkap.trim()
        : 'Bendahara Cepat (Offline)';
    final cleanJabatan =
        jabatan.trim().isNotEmpty ? jabatan.trim() : 'Bendahara Pondok';

    final accounts = await getAllAccounts();
    final existingIdx = accounts.indexWhere(
      (a) => a.authMode == BendaharaAccount.modeOfflineQuick,
    );

    final BendaharaAccount account;
    if (existingIdx >= 0) {
      account = accounts[existingIdx].copyWith(
        namaLengkap: cleanName,
        jabatan: cleanJabatan,
      );
      accounts[existingIdx] = account;
    } else {
      account = BendaharaAccount(
        id: const Uuid().v4(),
        namaLengkap: cleanName,
        jabatan: cleanJabatan,
        authMode: BendaharaAccount.modeOfflineQuick,
      );
      accounts.add(account);
    }

    await _saveAccounts(accounts);
    await _setActiveSession(account.id, rememberSession: rememberSession);
    return account;
  }

  Future<void> changePassword({
    required String oldPassword,
    required String newPassword,
  }) async {
    final active = await getActiveAccount();
    if (active == null || active.authMode != BendaharaAccount.modeLocal) {
      throw Exception('Ganti password hanya tersedia untuk akun login lokal.');
    }
    final userKey = (active.username ?? active.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!verifyPasswordHash(
      usernameOrEmail: userKey,
      password: oldPassword,
      storedHash: active.passwordHash,
    )) {
      throw Exception('Password lama tidak cocok.');
    }
    if (newPassword.length < 6) {
      throw Exception('Password baru minimal 6 karakter.');
    }

    final accounts = await getAllAccounts();
    final idx = accounts.indexWhere((a) => a.id == active.id);
    if (idx < 0) {
      throw Exception('Akun aktif tidak ditemukan.');
    }
    accounts[idx] = accounts[idx].copyWith(
      passwordHash: hashPassword(userKey, newPassword),
    );
    await _saveAccounts(accounts);
  }

  Future<BendaharaAccount> updateActiveProfile({
    String? namaLengkap,
    String? jabatan,
    String? fotoPath,
    bool clearFoto = false,
  }) async {
    final active = await getActiveAccount();
    if (active == null) {
      throw Exception('Belum ada sesi bendahara yang aktif.');
    }

    final accounts = await getAllAccounts();
    final idx = accounts.indexWhere((a) => a.id == active.id);
    if (idx < 0) {
      throw Exception('Akun bendahara tidak ditemukan.');
    }

    final updated = accounts[idx].copyWith(
      namaLengkap: namaLengkap != null && namaLengkap.trim().isNotEmpty
          ? namaLengkap.trim()
          : accounts[idx].namaLengkap,
      jabatan: jabatan != null && jabatan.trim().isNotEmpty
          ? jabatan.trim()
          : accounts[idx].jabatan,
      fotoPath: fotoPath,
      clearFoto: clearFoto,
    );
    accounts[idx] = updated;
    await _saveAccounts(accounts);
    return updated;
  }

  Future<void> logout() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.remove(_keyActiveAccountId);
    await prefs.setBool(_keyExplicitlyLoggedOut, true);
  }

  Future<void> clearAllForTesting() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.remove(_keyAccountsJson);
    await prefs.remove(_keyActiveAccountId);
    await prefs.remove(_keyRememberSession);
    await prefs.remove(_keyExplicitlyLoggedOut);
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart';
import 'package:local_auth/local_auth.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../database/database_helper.dart';

class AuthService {
  static final AuthService instance = AuthService._init();
  final LocalAuthentication _localAuth = LocalAuthentication();
  final FlutterSecureStorage _secureStorage = const FlutterSecureStorage(
    aOptions: AndroidOptions(encryptedSharedPreferences: true),
  );

  AuthService._init();

  static const String keyLastActive = 'auth_last_active_time';
  static const String keyIsUnlocked = 'auth_is_session_unlocked';
  static const String keySecurePinHash = 'kas_santri_secure_pin_hash';

  /// Validasi format PIN harus 4–6 digit angka
  static bool isValidPinFormat(String pin) {
    return RegExp(r'^\d{4,6}$').hasMatch(pin);
  }

  static String _generateSalt16Base64() {
    final rng = Random.secure();
    final bytes = List<int>.generate(16, (_) => rng.nextInt(256));
    return base64UrlEncode(bytes);
  }

  /// Hash PIN 4-6 digit dengan random 16-byte salt per perangkat (`v33:<salt>:<sha256>`)
  String hashPin(String pin, {String? salt}) {
    final s = salt ?? _generateSalt16Base64();
    final bytes = utf8.encode('ks_v33_pin:$s:$pin');
    final digest = sha256.convert(bytes);
    return 'v33:$s:$digest';
  }

  /// Hash kompatibilitas v2.5–v3.2 (fixed salt)
  String hashLegacyV25Pin(String pin) {
    final bytes = utf8.encode('ks_v25_pin:$pin');
    return sha256.convert(bytes).toString();
  }

  /// Hash kompatibilitas versi lama (unsalted SHA-256)
  String hashLegacyPin(String pin) {
    final bytes = utf8.encode(pin);
    return sha256.convert(bytes).toString();
  }

  bool verifyPinAgainstStored(String pin, String stored) {
    if (stored.startsWith('v33:')) {
      final parts = stored.split(':');
      if (parts.length != 3 || parts[1].isEmpty) return false;
      return hashPin(pin, salt: parts[1]) == stored;
    }
    return stored == hashLegacyV25Pin(pin) ||
        stored == hashLegacyPin(pin) ||
        stored == pin;
  }

  Future<String?> _readSecurePinHash() async {
    try {
      final val = await _secureStorage.read(key: keySecurePinHash);
      if (val != null && val.trim().isNotEmpty) return val.trim();
    } catch (_) {}
    return null;
  }

  Future<void> _writeSecurePinHash(String? hash) async {
    try {
      if (hash == null || hash.isEmpty) {
        await _secureStorage.delete(key: keySecurePinHash);
      } else {
        await _secureStorage.write(key: keySecurePinHash, value: hash);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Sinkronkan hash PIN hasil restore ke flutter_secure_storage
  Future<void> syncRestoredPinToSecureStorage(String? restoredPinHash) async {
    await _writeSecurePinHash(restoredPinHash);
  }

  /// Cek apakah kunci PIN aktif di secure storage atau database
  Future<bool> hasPin() async {
    final secureHash = await _readSecurePinHash();
    if (secureHash != null && secureHash.isNotEmpty) return true;
    final settings = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getPengaturan();
    return settings.pinKeamanan != null && settings.pinKeamanan!.isNotEmpty;
  }

  /// Verifikasi kecocokan input PIN dengan hash di flutter_secure_storage / DB
  Future<bool> verifyPin(String pin) async {
    final secureHash = await _readSecurePinHash();
    final settings = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getPengaturan();
    final stored = secureHash ?? settings.pinKeamanan;

    if (stored == null || stored.isEmpty) {
      return true;
    }

    final matched = verifyPinAgainstStored(pin, stored);

    // Auto-upgrade hash PIN lama / belum ada di secure storage ke random-salted v3.3
    if (matched && (secureHash == null || !stored.startsWith('v33:'))) {
      final upgradedHash = hashPin(pin);
      await _writeSecurePinHash(upgradedHash);
      await DatabaseHelper.instance.updatePengaturan(
        settings.copyWith(pinKeamanan: upgradedHash),
      );
    }
    return matched;
  }

  /// Simpan atau ubah PIN baru (null untuk menonaktifkan kunci PIN)
  Future<void> setPin(String? newPin) async {
    final settings = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getPengaturan();
    if (newPin != null && newPin.isNotEmpty) {
      if (!isValidPinFormat(newPin)) {
        throw const FormatException('PIN harus berupa 4–6 digit angka.');
      }
      final hashed = hashPin(newPin);
      await _writeSecurePinHash(hashed);
      await DatabaseHelper.instance.updatePengaturan(
        settings.copyWith(pinKeamanan: hashed),
      );
    } else {
      await _writeSecurePinHash(null);
      await DatabaseHelper.instance.updatePengaturan(
        settings.copyWith(clearPin: true, isBiometricEnabled: false),
      );
    }
  }

  /// Periksa ketersediaan biometrik di perangkat
  Future<bool> isBiometricsAvailable() async {
    try {
      final canAuthenticateWithBiometrics = await _localAuth.canCheckBiometrics;
      final canAuthenticate = canAuthenticateWithBiometrics || await _localAuth.isDeviceSupported();
      return canAuthenticate;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Autentikasi menggunakan biometrik
  Future<bool> authenticateWithBiometrics() async {
    try {
      final isAvailable = await isBiometricsAvailable();
      if (!isAvailable) return false;

      return await _localAuth.authenticate(
        localizedReason: 'Buka Kunci Aplikasi Kas Santri',
        options: const AuthenticationOptions(
          stickyAuth: true,
          biometricOnly: false,
        ),
      );
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Cek apakah sesi saat ini terkunci berdasarkan autoLockMinutes
  Future<bool> shouldLockApp() async {
    final pinActive = await hasPin();
    if (!pinActive) {
      return false;
    }

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final isUnlocked = prefs.getBool(keyIsUnlocked) ?? false;
    if (!isUnlocked) return true;

    final settings = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getPengaturan();
    final lastActiveStr = prefs.getString(keyLastActive);
    if (lastActiveStr == null) return true;

    final lastActive = DateTime.tryParse(lastActiveStr);
    if (lastActive == null) return true;

    final lockDuration = Duration(minutes: settings.autoLockMinutes);
    final isExpired = DateTime.now().difference(lastActive) > lockDuration;
    return isExpired;
  }

  /// Perbarui waktu aktif terakhir
  Future<void> updateLastActive() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(keyLastActive, DateTime.now().toIso8601String());
    await prefs.setBool(keyIsUnlocked, true);
  }

  /// Kunci aplikasi secara manual
  Future<void> lockSession() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setBool(keyIsUnlocked, false);
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:cryptography/cryptography.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show compute;

class BackupValidationResult {
  final bool isValid;
  final String? errorMessage;
  final int santriCount;
  final int setoranCount;
  final int transaksiCount;
  final int tunggakanLogCount;
  final int mutasiDompetCount;
  final int cashOpnameCount;
  final int infakCount;
  final int serahTerimaInfakCount;
  final String? exportedAt;
  final Map<String, dynamic>? parsedData;

  const BackupValidationResult({
    required this.isValid,
    this.errorMessage,
    this.santriCount = 0,
    this.setoranCount = 0,
    this.transaksiCount = 0,
    this.tunggakanLogCount = 0,
    this.mutasiDompetCount = 0,
    this.cashOpnameCount = 0,
    this.infakCount = 0,
    this.serahTerimaInfakCount = 0,
    this.exportedAt,
    this.parsedData,
  });

  factory BackupValidationResult.invalid(String message) {
    return BackupValidationResult(
      isValid: false,
      errorMessage: message,
    );
  }
}

class BackupService {
  static const List<String> requiredTables = [
    'santri',
    'setoran_bulanan',
    'transaksi_harian',
    'tunggakan_log',
    'mutasi_dompet',
    'cash_opname_logs',
    'pengaturan_aplikasi',
  ];

  static const List<String> optionalV3Tables = [
    'infak_santri',
    'serah_terima_infak',
    'audit_log',
  ];

  static BackupValidationResult validateJsonString(String rawJson) {
    if (rawJson.trim().isEmpty) {
      return BackupValidationResult.invalid('File backup kosong.');
    }
    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(rawJson);
      if (decoded is! Map) {
        return BackupValidationResult.invalid(
          'Format JSON tidak valid: root harus berupa objek backup Kas-Santri.',
        );
      }
      final map = Map<String, dynamic>.from(decoded);
      return validateBackupMap(map);
    } catch (e) {
      return BackupValidationResult.invalid('File JSON rusak atau tidak dapat dibaca ($e).');
    }
  }

  static BackupValidationResult validateBackupMap(Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    for (final table in requiredTables) {
      if (!data.containsKey(table)) {
        return BackupValidationResult.invalid(
          'Struktur backup tidak lengkap: tabel "$table" tidak ditemukan.',
        );
      }
      final rows = data[table];
      if (rows is! List) {
        return BackupValidationResult.invalid(
          'Struktur backup tidak valid: tabel "$table" harus berupa daftar/array.',
        );
      }
      for (int i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
        if (rows[i] is! Map) {
          return BackupValidationResult.invalid(
            'Baris ke-${i + 1} pada tabel "$table" bukan objek data yang valid.',
          );
        }
      }
    }

    for (final table in optionalV3Tables) {
      if (!data.containsKey(table) || data[table] == null) continue;
      final rows = data[table];
      if (rows is! List) {
        return BackupValidationResult.invalid(
          'Struktur backup tidak valid: tabel "$table" harus berupa daftar/array.',
        );
      }
      for (int i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
        if (rows[i] is! Map) {
          return BackupValidationResult.invalid(
            'Baris ke-${i + 1} pada tabel "$table" bukan objek data yang valid.',
          );
        }
      }
    }

    final santriList = data['santri'] as List;
    final setoranList = data['setoran_bulanan'] as List;
    final txList = data['transaksi_harian'] as List;
    final tunggakanList = data['tunggakan_log'] as List;
    final dompetList = data['mutasi_dompet'] as List;
    final opnameList = data['cash_opname_logs'] as List;
    final infakList = (data['infak_santri'] as List?) ?? const [];
    final serahTerimaList = (data['serah_terima_infak'] as List?) ?? const [];

    return BackupValidationResult(
      isValid: true,
      santriCount: santriList.length,
      setoranCount: setoranList.length,
      transaksiCount: txList.length,
      tunggakanLogCount: tunggakanList.length,
      mutasiDompetCount: dompetList.length,
      cashOpnameCount: opnameList.length,
      infakCount: infakList.length,
      serahTerimaInfakCount: serahTerimaList.length,
      exportedAt: data['exported_at']?.toString(),
      parsedData: data,
    );
  }

  static const String ksbakMagic = 'KSBAK1';
  static const int _pbkdf2Iterations = 60000;

  static bool isEncryptedKsbakBytes(List<int> bytes) {
    if (bytes.length > ksbakMagic.length) {
      final header = utf8.decode(bytes.sublist(0, ksbakMagic.length), allowMalformed: true);
      if (header == ksbakMagic) return true;
    }
    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(bytes));
      return decoded is Map && decoded['format'] == ksbakMagic;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  static Future<SecretKey> _deriveBackupKey(String password, List<int> salt) async {
    final pbkdf2 = Pbkdf2(
      macAlgorithm: Hmac.sha256(),
      iterations: _pbkdf2Iterations,
      bits: 256,
    );
    return pbkdf2.deriveKeyFromPassword(
      password: password,
      nonce: salt,
    );
  }

  /// Mengenkripsi payload JSON backup menggunakan PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM
  /// menjadi format portabel `.ksbak` (UTF-8 JSON envelope terenkripsi) di background isolate.
  static Future<Uint8List> encryptBackupToKsbak({
    required Map<String, dynamic> backupData,
    required String password,
  }) async {
    if (password.trim().length < 4) {
      throw const FormatException('Password enkripsi backup minimal 4 karakter.');
    }
    return compute<Map<String, dynamic>, Uint8List>(
      _encryptBackupToKsbakIsolate,
      <String, dynamic>{
        'backupData': backupData,
        'password': password,
      },
    );
  }

  static Future<Uint8List> _encryptBackupToKsbakIsolate(
    Map<String, dynamic> request,
  ) async {
    final backupData = request['backupData'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
    final password = request['password'] as String;
    final rng = Random.secure();
    final salt = List<int>.generate(16, (_) => rng.nextInt(256));
    final key = await _deriveBackupKey(password, salt);

    final aesGcm = AesGcm.with256bits();
    final nonce = aesGcm.newNonce();
    final plainBytes = utf8.encode(jsonEncode(backupData));
    final secretBox = await aesGcm.encrypt(
      plainBytes,
      secretKey: key,
      nonce: nonce,
    );

    final envelope = <String, dynamic>{
      'format': ksbakMagic,
      'kdf': 'PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256',
      'iterations': _pbkdf2Iterations,
      'cipher': 'AES-256-GCM',
      'salt': base64Encode(salt),
      'nonce': base64Encode(secretBox.nonce),
      'mac': base64Encode(secretBox.mac.bytes),
      'ciphertext': base64Encode(secretBox.cipherText),
      'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
    };
    return Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(envelope)));
  }

  /// Mendekripsi file `.ksbak` dengan password lalu memvalidasi struktur tabel Kas-Santri
  /// di background isolate agar UI tidak pernah freeze.
  static Future<BackupValidationResult> decryptAndValidateKsbak({
    required Uint8List bytes,
    required String password,
  }) async {
    if (password.isEmpty) {
      return BackupValidationResult.invalid('Password dekripsi wajib diisi.');
    }
    return compute<Map<String, dynamic>, BackupValidationResult>(
      _decryptAndValidateKsbakIsolate,
      <String, dynamic>{
        'bytes': bytes,
        'password': password,
      },
    );
  }

  static Future<BackupValidationResult> _decryptAndValidateKsbakIsolate(
    Map<String, dynamic> request,
  ) async {
    final bytes = request['bytes'] as Uint8List;
    final password = request['password'] as String;
    try {
      final rawStr = utf8.decode(bytes);
      final envelope = jsonDecode(rawStr);
      if (envelope is! Map || envelope['format'] != ksbakMagic) {
        return BackupValidationResult.invalid('Format file .ksbak tidak dikenali.');
      }

      final salt = base64Decode(envelope['salt'].toString());
      final nonce = base64Decode(envelope['nonce'].toString());
      final macBytes = base64Decode(envelope['mac'].toString());
      final cipherText = base64Decode(envelope['ciphertext'].toString());
      final iterations = (envelope['iterations'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? _pbkdf2Iterations;

      final pbkdf2 = Pbkdf2(
        macAlgorithm: Hmac.sha256(),
        iterations: iterations,
        bits: 256,
      );
      final key = await pbkdf2.deriveKeyFromPassword(
        password: password,
        nonce: salt,
      );

      final aesGcm = AesGcm.with256bits();
      final clearBytes = await aesGcm.decrypt(
        SecretBox(cipherText, nonce: nonce, mac: Mac(macBytes)),
        secretKey: key,
      );
      final jsonStr = utf8.decode(clearBytes);
      return validateJsonString(jsonStr);
    } on SecretBoxAuthenticationError {
      return BackupValidationResult.invalid(
        'Password salah atau file backup .ksbak telah dimodifikasi/rusak.',
      );
    } catch (e) {
      return BackupValidationResult.invalid(
        'Gagal membuka file backup terenkripsi .ksbak ($e).',
      );
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:excel/excel.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show compute;
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';
import '../config/app_config.dart';
import '../models/santri.dart';

class ParsedSantriRow {
  final int rowNumber;
  final Santri santri;

  const ParsedSantriRow({
    required this.rowNumber,
    required this.santri,
  });
}

class BulkExcelParseResult {
  final List<ParsedSantriRow> validRows;
  final List<String> duplicateNames;
  final List<String> invalidRows;
  final int totalRowsRead;
  final bool exceedsFreeQuota;
  final int remainingFreeSlots;

  const BulkExcelParseResult({
    required this.validRows,
    required this.duplicateNames,
    required this.invalidRows,
    required this.totalRowsRead,
    required this.exceedsFreeQuota,
    required this.remainingFreeSlots,
  });

  List<Santri> get santriList => validRows.map((e) => e.santri).toList();
}

/// Layanan Pembuatan Template & Impor Massal Santri dari Excel (.xlsx) v4.0.
class BulkSantriExcelService {
  static final BulkSantriExcelService instance = BulkSantriExcelService._init();
  BulkSantriExcelService._init();

  static const List<String> templateHeaders = [
    'Nama Lengkap',
    'Nama Panggilan',
    'Kategori (SANTRIYIN/SANTRIYAT/SANTRI_BARU)',
    'Kamar / Kelas',
    'No WA Wali',
    'Saldo Awal (Rp)',
    'Jatah Harian (Rp)',
    'Tunggakan Awal (Rp)',
  ];

  /// Menghasilkan file `.xlsx` template rapi siap isi untuk pondok besar.
  Uint8List buildTemplateExcelBytes({
    String namaPondok = 'Nama Pondok',
  }) {
    return _buildTemplateExcelBytesIsolate(namaPondok);
  }

  /// Menghasilkan file `.xlsx` template di background isolate agar UI tetap 120 FPS.
  Future<Uint8List> buildTemplateExcelBytesAsync({
    String namaPondok = 'Nama Pondok',
  }) {
    return compute<String, Uint8List>(
      _buildTemplateExcelBytesIsolate,
      namaPondok,
    );
  }

  static Uint8List _buildTemplateExcelBytesIsolate(String namaPondok) {
    final excel = Excel.createExcel();
    const sheetName = 'Template Santri';
    final defaultSheet = excel.getDefaultSheet();
    if (defaultSheet != null && defaultSheet != sheetName) {
      excel.rename(defaultSheet, sheetName);
    }
    final sheet = excel[sheetName];

    final headerStyle = CellStyle(
      bold: true,
      fontSize: 10,
      fontColorHex: ExcelColor.fromHexString('#FFFFFF'),
      backgroundColorHex: ExcelColor.fromHexString('#0F766E'),
      horizontalAlign: HorizontalAlign.Center,
      verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.Center,
      textWrapping: TextWrapping.WrapText,
    );

    final exampleStyle = CellStyle(
      fontSize: 10,
      fontColorHex: ExcelColor.fromHexString('#0F172A'),
      backgroundColorHex: ExcelColor.fromHexString('#F8FAFC'),
    );

    for (var c = 0; c < templateHeaders.length; c++) {
      final cell = sheet.cell(
        CellIndex.indexByColumnRow(columnIndex: c, rowIndex: 0),
      );
      cell.value = TextCellValue(templateHeaders[c]);
      cell.cellStyle = headerStyle;
    }

    final samples = <List<CellValue>>[
      [
        TextCellValue('Ahmad Zaki Mubarroq'),
        TextCellValue('Zaki'),
        TextCellValue('SANTRIYIN'),
        TextCellValue('Kamar 1A'),
        TextCellValue('081234567890'),
        IntCellValue(300000),
        IntCellValue(10000),
        IntCellValue(0),
      ],
      [
        TextCellValue('Aisyah Putri Rahmawati'),
        TextCellValue('Aisyah'),
        TextCellValue('SANTRIYAT'),
        TextCellValue('Putri 2B'),
        TextCellValue('085612345678'),
        IntCellValue(250000),
        IntCellValue(10000),
        IntCellValue(25000),
      ],
    ];

    for (var r = 0; r < samples.length; r++) {
      for (var c = 0; c < samples[r].length; c++) {
        final cell = sheet.cell(
          CellIndex.indexByColumnRow(columnIndex: c, rowIndex: r + 1),
        );
        cell.value = samples[r][c];
        cell.cellStyle = exampleStyle;
      }
    }

    sheet.setColumnWidth(0, 26);
    sheet.setColumnWidth(1, 16);
    sheet.setColumnWidth(2, 24);
    sheet.setColumnWidth(3, 18);
    sheet.setColumnWidth(4, 18);
    sheet.setColumnWidth(5, 16);
    sheet.setColumnWidth(6, 16);
    sheet.setColumnWidth(7, 16);

    final encoded = excel.encode();
    if (encoded == null) {
      throw StateError('Gagal membuat file template Excel untuk $namaPondok.');
    }
    return Uint8List.fromList(encoded);
  }

  static String _extractExcelSpanText(TextSpan span) {
    final buf = StringBuffer(span.text ?? '');
    final kids = span.children;
    if (kids != null) {
      for (final child in kids) {
        buf.write(_extractExcelSpanText(child));
      }
    }
    return buf.toString();
  }

  static String _cellToString(Data? cell) {
    final val = cell?.value;
    if (val == null) return '';
    return switch (val) {
      TextCellValue() => _extractExcelSpanText(val.value).trim(),
      IntCellValue() => val.value.toString(),
      DoubleCellValue() => val.value.toString(),
      BoolCellValue() => val.value ? 'true' : 'false',
      FormulaCellValue() => val.formula.trim(),
      _ => val.toString().trim(),
    };
  }

  static int _cellToInt(Data? cell, {int fallback = 0}) {
    final val = cell?.value;
    if (val == null) return fallback;
    if (val is IntCellValue) return val.value;
    if (val is DoubleCellValue) return val.value.round();
    final raw = _cellToString(cell);
    final digits = raw.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9\-]'), '');
    return int.tryParse(digits) ?? fallback;
  }

  static String _parseKategori(String raw) {
    final u = raw.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (u.contains('YAT') || u.contains('PUTRI')) {
      return Santri.kategoriSantriyat;
    }
    if (u.contains('BARU') || u.contains('NEW')) {
      return Santri.kategoriSantriBaru;
    }
    return Santri.kategoriSantriyin;
  }

  /// Membaca, memvalidasi, dan mendeteksi duplikat dari file `.xlsx` unggahan pengurus.
  BulkExcelParseResult parseAndValidateExcelBytes({
    required Uint8List bytes,
    required List<Santri> existingSantri,
    required bool isProUser,
    int maxFreeQuota = AppConfig.maxFreeSantriQuota,
  }) {
    return _parseAndValidateExcelBytesIsolate(<String, dynamic>{
      'bytes': bytes,
      'existingSantri': existingSantri,
      'isProUser': isProUser,
      'maxFreeQuota': maxFreeQuota,
    });
  }

  /// Membaca, memvalidasi, dan mendeteksi duplikat `.xlsx` di background isolate
  /// sehingga ratusan baris Excel tidak membekukan UI thread.
  Future<BulkExcelParseResult> parseAndValidateExcelBytesAsync({
    required Uint8List bytes,
    required List<Santri> existingSantri,
    required bool isProUser,
    int maxFreeQuota = AppConfig.maxFreeSantriQuota,
  }) {
    return compute<Map<String, dynamic>, BulkExcelParseResult>(
      _parseAndValidateExcelBytesIsolate,
      <String, dynamic>{
        'bytes': bytes,
        'existingSantri': existingSantri,
        'isProUser': isProUser,
        'maxFreeQuota': maxFreeQuota,
      },
    );
  }

  static BulkExcelParseResult _parseAndValidateExcelBytesIsolate(
    Map<String, dynamic> request,
  ) {
    final bytes = request['bytes'] as Uint8List;
    final existingSantri = request['existingSantri'] as List<Santri>;
    final isProUser = request['isProUser'] as bool;
    final maxFreeQuota = request['maxFreeQuota'] as int;
    final excel = Excel.decodeBytes(bytes);
    if (excel.tables.isEmpty) {
      return const BulkExcelParseResult(
        validRows: [],
        duplicateNames: [],
        invalidRows: ['File Excel tidak memiliki sheet data.'],
        totalRowsRead: 0,
        exceedsFreeQuota: false,
        remainingFreeSlots: 0,
      );
    }

    final sheet = excel.tables.values.first;
    final rows = sheet.rows;
    final existingNames = existingSantri
        .map((s) => s.namaLengkap.trim().toLowerCase())
        .toSet();
    final seenInSheet = <String>{};

    final validRows = <ParsedSantriRow>[];
    final duplicateNames = <String>[];
    final invalidRows = <String>[];
    var totalRead = 0;

    for (var idx = 0; idx < rows.length; idx++) {
      final row = rows[idx];
      if (row.isEmpty) continue;

      final col0 = _cellToString(row.isNotEmpty ? row[0] : null);
      final col1 = _cellToString(row.length > 1 ? row[1] : null);
      final col2 = _cellToString(row.length > 2 ? row[2] : null);
      final col3 = _cellToString(row.length > 3 ? row[3] : null);
      final col4 = _cellToString(row.length > 4 ? row[4] : null);

      final allBlank = [col0, col1, col2, col3, col4].every((e) => e.isEmpty);
      if (allBlank) continue;

      // Lewati baris header
      if (idx == 0 && col0.toLowerCase().contains('nama')) {
        continue;
      }

      totalRead++;
      final humanRow = idx + 1;
      if (col0.trim().isEmpty) {
        invalidRows.add('Baris $humanRow: Nama Lengkap kosong.');
        continue;
      }

      final normalizedKey = col0.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (existingNames.contains(normalizedKey) || seenInSheet.contains(normalizedKey)) {
        duplicateNames.add('Baris $humanRow: "$col0" sudah ada / duplikat.');
        continue;
      }
      seenInSheet.add(normalizedKey);

      final panggilan = col1.trim().isNotEmpty
          ? col1.trim()
          : col0.trim().split(RegExp(r'\s+')).first;
      final kategori = _parseKategori(col2);
      final kamar = col3.trim().isNotEmpty ? col3.trim() : 'Kamar 1';
      final waClean = col4.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9+]'), '');
      final saldoAwal = _cellToInt(row.length > 5 ? row[5] : null, fallback: 0);
      final jatahRaw = _cellToInt(row.length > 6 ? row[6] : null, fallback: 10000);
      final tunggakanAwal = _cellToInt(row.length > 7 ? row[7] : null, fallback: 0);

      if (saldoAwal < 0 || jatahRaw < 0 || tunggakanAwal < 0) {
        invalidRows.add('Baris $humanRow ($col0): Nominal tidak boleh negatif.');
        continue;
      }

      final santri = Santri(
        id: const Uuid().v4(),
        namaLengkap: col0.trim(),
        namaPanggilan: panggilan,
        kategoriSantri: kategori,
        statusSantri: Santri.statusAktifVal,
        kamar: kamar,
        noWaWali: waClean.isNotEmpty ? waClean : null,
        saldoTotal: saldoAwal,
        setoranAwal: saldoAwal,
        jatahHarian: jatahRaw > 0 ? jatahRaw : 10000,
        tunggakan: tunggakanAwal,
        catatanTunggakan: tunggakanAwal > 0 ? 'Tunggakan Awal (Excel)' : '',
      );

      validRows.add(ParsedSantriRow(rowNumber: humanRow, santri: santri));
    }

    final activeExistingCount = existingSantri.where((s) => s.statusAktif).length;
    final remainingSlots = isProUser
        ? 999999
        : (maxFreeQuota - activeExistingCount).clamp(0, maxFreeQuota);
    final exceedsQuota = !isProUser && (validRows.length > remainingSlots);

    return BulkExcelParseResult(
      validRows: validRows,
      duplicateNames: duplicateNames,
      invalidRows: invalidRows,
      totalRowsRead: totalRead,
      exceedsFreeQuota: exceedsQuota,
      remainingFreeSlots: remainingSlots,
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../config/app_config.dart';

class AppRemoteConfig {
  final String latestVersion;
  final String minVersion;
  final String announcementTitle;
  final String announcementBody;
  final bool promoBannerActive;
  final String updateUrl;

  const AppRemoteConfig({
    this.latestVersion = AppConfig.appVersion,
    this.minVersion = '3.0.0',
    this.announcementTitle = '',
    this.announcementBody = '',
    this.promoBannerActive = false,
    this.updateUrl = '',
  });

  bool isUpdateAvailable(String currentVersion) =>
      CustomerSyncService.compareSemver(latestVersion, currentVersion) > 0;

  bool get hasBannerContent =>
      isUpdateAvailable(AppConfig.appVersion) ||
      (promoBannerActive &&
          (announcementTitle.trim().isNotEmpty ||
              announcementBody.trim().isNotEmpty));

  factory AppRemoteConfig.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return AppRemoteConfig(
      latestVersion:
          (map['latest_version']?.toString().trim().isNotEmpty == true)
              ? map['latest_version'].toString().trim()
              : AppConfig.appVersion,
      minVersion: (map['min_version']?.toString().trim().isNotEmpty == true)
          ? map['min_version'].toString().trim()
          : '3.0.0',
      announcementTitle: map['announcement_title']?.toString().trim() ?? '',
      announcementBody: map['announcement_body']?.toString().trim() ?? '',
      promoBannerActive: map['promo_banner_active'] == true,
      updateUrl: map['update_url']?.toString().trim() ?? '',
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'latest_version': latestVersion,
        'min_version': minVersion,
        'announcement_title': announcementTitle,
        'announcement_body': announcementBody,
        'promo_banner_active': promoBannerActive,
        'update_url': updateUrl,
      };
}

class CustomerSyncResult {
  final bool synced;
  final bool isRevoked;
  final AppRemoteConfig? remoteConfig;
  final String? message;

  const CustomerSyncResult({
    required this.synced,
    this.isRevoked = false,
    this.remoteConfig,
    this.message,
  });
}

/// Sinkronisasi Telemetri Non-Sensitif & Remote Revoke (Privacy-First).
///
/// PRIVASI KETAT PESANTREN:
/// - HANYA mengirim metadata lisensi perangkat (`device_id`, `nama_pondok`,
///   `nama_bendahara`, `no_wa`, `tier`, `expiry_date`, `app_version`, `payment_channel`).
/// - TIDAK PERNAH mengirim data santri, saldo, transaksi, mutasi dompet, maupun infak.
/// - Berjalan pasif di background saat online dengan timeout singkat (5 detik).
class CustomerSyncService {
  static final CustomerSyncService instance = CustomerSyncService._init();
  CustomerSyncService._init();

  static const String _keyRevoked = 'ks_v34_license_revoked';
  static const String _keyRemoteConfig = 'ks_v34_remote_config';

  final FlutterSecureStorage _secureStorage = const FlutterSecureStorage(
    aOptions: AndroidOptions(encryptedSharedPreferences: true),
  );

  static int compareSemver(String a, String b) {
    List<int> parseParts(String raw) {
      final clean = raw.trim().replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^[vV]'), '').split('+').first.split('-').first;
      return clean
          .split('.')
          .map((e) => int.tryParse(e.trim()) ?? 0)
          .toList();
    }

    final pa = parseParts(a);
    final pb = parseParts(b);
    final len = pa.length > pb.length ? pa.length : pb.length;
    for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) {
      final va = i < pa.length ? pa[i] : 0;
      final vb = i < pb.length ? pb[i] : 0;
      if (va > vb) return 1;
      if (va < vb) return -1;
    }
    return 0;
  }

  /// Membangun payload telemetri non-sensitif yang terjamin bebas data santri/saldo.
  /// Pada build Google Play Store (`isPlayStoreBuild == true`), `p_nama_bendahara` dan `p_no_wa`
  /// dikosongkan agar tidak mengumpulkan Personal Identifiers (nama & nomor telepon).
  static Map<String, dynamic> buildTelemetryPayload({
    required String deviceId,
    required String namaPondok,
    required String namaBendahara,
    required String noWaPengurus,
    required String tier,
    DateTime? expiryDate,
    String appVersion = AppConfig.appVersion,
    String paymentChannel = 'FREE',
    bool isPlayStoreBuild = kIsPlayStoreBuild,
  }) {
    return {
      'p_device_id': deviceId.trim().toUpperCase(),
      'p_nama_pondok': namaPondok.trim(),
      'p_nama_bendahara': isPlayStoreBuild ? '' : namaBendahara.trim(),
      'p_no_wa': isPlayStoreBuild ? '' : noWaPengurus.trim(),
      'p_tier': tier.trim().toUpperCase(),
      'p_expiry_date': expiryDate?.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
      'p_app_version': appVersion.trim(),
      'p_payment_channel': paymentChannel.trim().toUpperCase(),
    };
  }

  Future<bool> getCachedRevokedStatus() async {
    try {
      final sec = await _secureStorage.read(key: _keyRevoked);
      if (sec != null) return sec == '1';
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      return prefs.getBool(_keyRevoked) ?? false;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> setCachedRevokedStatus(bool revoked) async {
    bool savedSecure = false;
    try {
      await _secureStorage.write(key: _keyRevoked, value: revoked ? '1' : '0');
      savedSecure = true;
    } catch (_) {
      savedSecure = false;
    }
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      if (savedSecure) {
        await prefs.remove(_keyRevoked);
      } else {
        await prefs.setBool(_keyRevoked, revoked);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<AppRemoteConfig?> getCachedRemoteConfig() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final raw = prefs.getString(_keyRemoteConfig);
      if (raw == null || raw.trim().isEmpty) return null;
      final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
      if (decoded is Map<String, dynamic>) {
        return AppRemoteConfig.fromJson(decoded);
      }
      if (decoded is Map) {
        return AppRemoteConfig.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(decoded));
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return null;
  }

  Future<void> _saveCachedRemoteConfig(AppRemoteConfig cfg) async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setString(_keyRemoteConfig, jsonEncode(cfg.toJson()));
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<CustomerSyncResult> syncDeviceInBackground({
    required String deviceId,
    required String namaPondok,
    required String namaBendahara,
    required String noWaPengurus,
    required String tier,
    DateTime? expiryDate,
    String appVersion = AppConfig.appVersion,
    String paymentChannel = 'FREE',
    http.Client? client,
    String? supabaseUrlOverride,
    String? supabaseAnonKeyOverride,
    Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 5),
  }) async {
    final baseUrl =
        (supabaseUrlOverride ?? AppConfig.supabaseUrl).trim().replaceAll(RegExp(r'/+$'), '');
    final anonKey = (supabaseAnonKeyOverride ?? AppConfig.supabaseAnonKey).trim();

    if (!baseUrl.startsWith('https://') || anonKey.length <= 20) {
      return const CustomerSyncResult(
        synced: false,
        message: 'Supabase remote sync belum dikonfigurasi (Mode Offline murni).',
      );
    }

    final httpClient = client ?? http.Client();
    try {
      final payload = buildTelemetryPayload(
        deviceId: deviceId,
        namaPondok: namaPondok,
        namaBendahara: namaBendahara,
        noWaPengurus: noWaPengurus,
        tier: tier,
        expiryDate: expiryDate,
        appVersion: appVersion,
        paymentChannel: paymentChannel,
      );

      final uri = Uri.parse('$baseUrl/rest/v1/rpc/sync_device_telemetry');
      final response = await httpClient
          .post(
            uri,
            headers: {
              'apikey': anonKey,
              'Authorization': 'Bearer $anonKey',
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            },
            body: jsonEncode(payload),
          )
          .timeout(timeout);

      if (response.statusCode < 200 || response.statusCode >= 300) {
        return CustomerSyncResult(
          synced: false,
          message: 'Server merespons HTTP ${response.statusCode}.',
        );
      }

      final decoded = jsonDecode(response.body);
      if (decoded is! Map) {
        return const CustomerSyncResult(
          synced: false,
          message: 'Respons RPC tidak valid.',
        );
      }

      final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(decoded);
      final isRevoked = data['is_revoked'] == true;
      await setCachedRevokedStatus(isRevoked);

      AppRemoteConfig? remoteCfg;
      if (data['remote_config'] is Map) {
        remoteCfg = AppRemoteConfig.fromJson(
          Map<String, dynamic>.from(data['remote_config'] as Map),
        );
        await _saveCachedRemoteConfig(remoteCfg);
      }

      return CustomerSyncResult(
        synced: true,
        isRevoked: isRevoked,
        remoteConfig: remoteCfg,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      return CustomerSyncResult(
        synced: false,
        message: 'Mode offline / gagal sinkronisasi: $e',
      );
    } finally {
      if (client == null) {
        httpClient.close();
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:pdf/pdf.dart';
import 'package:pdf/widgets.dart' as pw;
import '../models/cash_opname_log.dart';
import '../models/infak_santri.dart';
import '../models/pengaturan.dart';
import '../models/santri.dart';
import '../utils/currency_formatter.dart';
import '../utils/date_formatter.dart';

class CashflowBucket {
  final String label;
  final int setoranMasuk;
  final int jajanKeluar;
  final int infakMasuk;

  const CashflowBucket({
    required this.label,
    required this.setoranMasuk,
    required this.jajanKeluar,
    required this.infakMasuk,
  });

  int get maxVal {
    var m = setoranMasuk;
    if (jajanKeluar > m) m = jajanKeluar;
    if (infakMasuk > m) m = infakMasuk;
    return m;
  }
}

class InfakCategoryCompliance {
  final String kategori;
  final String label;
  final int totalSantri;
  final int lunasCount;
  final int cicilCount;
  final int belumCount;

  const InfakCategoryCompliance({
    required this.kategori,
    required this.label,
    required this.totalSantri,
    required this.lunasCount,
    required this.cicilCount,
    required this.belumCount,
  });

  double get percent =>
      totalSantri <= 0 ? 0.0 : (lunasCount / totalSantri) * 100.0;
}

class ExecutiveAnalyticsSummary {
  final List<CashflowBucket> dailyTrend7d;
  final List<CashflowBucket> monthlyTrend6m;
  final List<InfakCategoryCompliance> complianceByCategory;
  final int totalBrankas;
  final int kasTunai;
  final int kasRekening;
  final int totalTunggakan;
  final int voidCount7d;
  final CashOpnameLog? latestOpname;
  final int criticalSantriCount;
  final int activeSantriCount;
  final List<String> anomalyAlerts;

  const ExecutiveAnalyticsSummary({
    required this.dailyTrend7d,
    required this.monthlyTrend6m,
    required this.complianceByCategory,
    required this.totalBrankas,
    required this.kasTunai,
    required this.kasRekening,
    required this.totalTunggakan,
    required this.voidCount7d,
    required this.latestOpname,
    required this.criticalSantriCount,
    required this.activeSantriCount,
    required this.anomalyAlerts,
  });

  double get overallCompliancePercent {
    final total =
        complianceByCategory.fold<int>(0, (sum, c) => sum + c.totalSantri);
    final lunas =
        complianceByCategory.fold<int>(0, (sum, c) => sum + c.lunasCount);
    if (total <= 0) return 0.0;
    return (lunas / total) * 100.0;
  }
}

/// Mesin Analitik Eksekutif Yayasan & Ringkasan PDF 1 Halaman (v4.0).
class ExecutiveAnalyticsService {
  static final ExecutiveAnalyticsService instance =
      ExecutiveAnalyticsService._init();
  ExecutiveAnalyticsService._init();

  static int _infakMoneyTotal(InfakSantriModel inf) {
    final masak = inf.isMasakBebas ? 0 : inf.nominalMasak;
    final listrik = inf.isListrikBebas ? 0 : inf.nominalListrik;
    final beras =
        inf.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasUangVal ? inf.berasUang : 0;
    return masak + listrik + beras;
  }

  static ExecutiveAnalyticsSummary computeSummary({
    required List<Santri> activeSantri,
    required List<Map<String, dynamic>> transaksiRows,
    required List<Map<String, dynamic>> setoranRows,
    required List<InfakSantriModel> infakPeriodeList,
    required List<CashOpnameLog> opnameLogs,
    required int totalBrankas,
    required int kasTunai,
    required int kasRekening,
    required int totalTunggakan,
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    final refNow = (now ?? DateTime.now()).toLocal();
    final todayDate = DateTime(refNow.year, refNow.month, refNow.day);

    // 1. Tren 7 Hari Terakhir
    final daily7d = <CashflowBucket>[];
    for (var i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {
      final d = todayDate.subtract(Duration(days: i));
      final ymd = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(d);
      final label = '${d.day}/${d.month}';

      var setoran = 0;
      for (final s in setoranRows) {
        final tgl = (s['tanggal_setor'] ?? '').toString();
        if (tgl.startsWith(ymd)) {
          setoran += (s['nominal_setoran'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
        }
      }

      var jajan = 0;
      for (final tx in transaksiRows) {
        final isVoid = (tx['is_void'] as num?)?.toInt() == 1;
        final tipe = (tx['tipe'] ?? 'PENGAMBILAN').toString().toUpperCase();
        final tgl = (tx['tanggal_lokal'] ?? '').toString();
        if (!isVoid && tipe == 'PENGAMBILAN' && tgl == ymd) {
          jajan += (tx['nominal'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
        }
      }

      var infak = 0;
      for (final inf in infakPeriodeList) {
        if (inf.tglMasuk == ymd) {
          infak += _infakMoneyTotal(inf);
        }
      }

      daily7d.add(
        CashflowBucket(
          label: label,
          setoranMasuk: setoran,
          jajanKeluar: jajan,
          infakMasuk: infak,
        ),
      );
    }

    // 2. Tren 6 Bulan Terakhir
    final monthly6m = <CashflowBucket>[];
    const monthNames = [
      'Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'Mei', 'Jun',
      'Jul', 'Agu', 'Sep', 'Okt', 'Nov', 'Des',
    ];
    for (var i = 5; i >= 0; i--) {
      final mDate = DateTime(refNow.year, refNow.month - i, 1);
      final ym =
          '${mDate.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-${mDate.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
      final label = monthNames[mDate.month - 1];

      var setoran = 0;
      for (final s in setoranRows) {
        final tgl = (s['tanggal_setor'] ?? '').toString();
        if (tgl.startsWith(ym)) {
          setoran += (s['nominal_setoran'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
        }
      }

      var jajan = 0;
      for (final tx in transaksiRows) {
        final isVoid = (tx['is_void'] as num?)?.toInt() == 1;
        final tipe = (tx['tipe'] ?? 'PENGAMBILAN').toString().toUpperCase();
        final tgl = (tx['tanggal_lokal'] ?? '').toString();
        if (!isVoid && tipe == 'PENGAMBILAN' && tgl.startsWith(ym)) {
          jajan += (tx['nominal'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
        }
      }

      var infak = 0;
      for (final inf in infakPeriodeList) {
        if (inf.periodeBulan == ym || inf.tglMasuk.startsWith(ym)) {
          infak += _infakMoneyTotal(inf);
        }
      }

      monthly6m.add(
        CashflowBucket(
          label: label,
          setoranMasuk: setoran,
          jajanKeluar: jajan,
          infakMasuk: infak,
        ),
      );
    }

    // 3. Kepatuhan Infak per Kategori
    final infakBySantriId = <String, InfakSantriModel>{
      for (final inf in infakPeriodeList) inf.santriId: inf,
    };
    const categories = [
      (Santri.kategoriSantriyin, 'Santriyin'),
      (Santri.kategoriSantriyat, 'Santriyat'),
      (Santri.kategoriSantriBaru, 'Santri Baru'),
    ];
    final compliance = <InfakCategoryCompliance>[];
    for (final cat in categories) {
      final members = activeSantri
          .where((s) => s.isAktifDiPondok && s.kategoriSantri == cat.$1)
          .toList();
      var lunas = 0;
      var cicil = 0;
      var belum = 0;
      for (final s in members) {
        final inf = infakBySantriId[s.id];
        if (inf == null || inf.statusLunas == InfakSantriModel.statusBelumVal) {
          belum++;
        } else if (inf.statusLunas == InfakSantriModel.statusLunasVal) {
          lunas++;
        } else {
          cicil++;
        }
      }
      compliance.add(
        InfakCategoryCompliance(
          kategori: cat.$1,
          label: cat.$2,
          totalSantri: members.length,
          lunasCount: lunas,
          cicilCount: cicil,
          belumCount: belum,
        ),
      );
    }

    // 4. Kesehatan Kas & Radar Anomali
    final sevenDaysAgo = todayDate.subtract(const Duration(days: 6));
    var voidCount7d = 0;
    for (final tx in transaksiRows) {
      final isVoid = (tx['is_void'] as num?)?.toInt() == 1;
      if (!isVoid) continue;
      final tgl = DateTime.tryParse((tx['waktu_ambil'] ?? '').toString()) ??
          DateTime.tryParse((tx['tanggal_lokal'] ?? '').toString());
      if (tgl != null && !tgl.isBefore(sevenDaysAgo)) {
        voidCount7d++;
      }
    }

    final latestOpname = opnameLogs.isNotEmpty ? opnameLogs.first : null;
    final criticalCount =
        activeSantri.where((s) => s.isAktifDiPondok && s.estimasiHari < 3).length;

    final alerts = <String>[];
    if (latestOpname == null) {
      alerts.add('Belum ada riwayat Cash Opname fisik.');
    } else if (!latestOpname.isCocok) {
      alerts.add(
        'Selisih Cash Opname terakhir (${latestOpname.tanggalLokal}): ${CurrencyFormatter.format(latestOpname.selisih)}.',
      );
    }
    if (voidCount7d >= 3) {
      alerts.add('Terdapat $voidCount7d pembatalan (Void) transaksi dalam 7 hari terakhir.');
    }
    if (criticalCount > 0) {
      alerts.add('$criticalCount santri bersaldo kritis (< 3 hari).');
    }
    if (totalTunggakan > 0) {
      alerts.add('Total piutang/tunggakan santri aktif: ${CurrencyFormatter.format(totalTunggakan)}.');
    }

    return ExecutiveAnalyticsSummary(
      dailyTrend7d: daily7d,
      monthlyTrend6m: monthly6m,
      complianceByCategory: compliance,
      totalBrankas: totalBrankas,
      kasTunai: kasTunai,
      kasRekening: kasRekening,
      totalTunggakan: totalTunggakan,
      voidCount7d: voidCount7d,
      latestOpname: latestOpname,
      criticalSantriCount: criticalCount,
      activeSantriCount: activeSantri.where((s) => s.isAktifDiPondok).length,
      anomalyAlerts: alerts,
    );
  }

  Future<Uint8List?> _loadLogoBytes(PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan) async {
    try {
      final path = pengaturan.logoPath;
      if (path != null && path.isNotEmpty) {
        final f = File(path);
        if (await f.exists()) return await f.readAsBytes();
      }
      return null;
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /// Menghasilkan Ringkasan Eksekutif Yayasan 1 Halaman PDF siap rapat pengasuh.
```

```dart
import 'dart:io';

import '../yayasan_export_service.dart';

class YayasanExcelExporter {
  const YayasanExcelExporter();

  static final Border _thinCellBorder = Border(
    borderStyle: BorderStyle.Thin,
    borderColorHex: ExcelColor.fromHexString('#CBD5E1'),
  );
  static final Border _headerCellBorder = Border(
    borderStyle: BorderStyle.Thin,
    borderColorHex: ExcelColor.fromHexString('#0F766E'),
  );
  static final Border _totalTopBorder = Border(
    borderStyle: BorderStyle.Medium,
    borderColorHex: ExcelColor.fromHexString('#0F766E'),
  );
  static final NumFormat _rupiahNumFormat = CustomNumericNumFormat(
    formatCode: '"Rp "#,##0',
  );
  static final NumFormat _literNumFormat = CustomNumericNumFormat(
    formatCode: '0.0" L"',
  );

  static const List<String> bulanNames = [
    '',
    'Januari',
    'Februari',
    'Maret',
    'April',
    'Mei',
    'Juni',
    'Juli',
    'Agustus',
    'September',
    'Oktober',
    'November',
    'Desember',
  ];

  static String formatPeriodeId(String ym) {
    final parts = ym.split('-');
    if (parts.length != 2) return ym;
    final y = int.tryParse(parts[0]) ?? DateTime.now().year;
    final m = (int.tryParse(parts[1]) ?? 1).clamp(1, 12);
    return '${bulanNames[m]} $y';
  }

  static String formatTanggalId(DateTime dt) {
    return '${dt.day} ${bulanNames[dt.month.clamp(1, 12)]} ${dt.year}';
  }

  static String formatLiter(double liter) {
    return liter == liter.roundToDouble()
        ? liter.toInt().toString()
        : liter.toStringAsFixed(1);
  }

  static String buildKetCicil(
    InfakSantriModel inf,
    PengaturanAplikasi peng,
  ) {
    final kurang = <String>[];
    if (!inf.isMasakBebas && inf.nominalMasak < peng.defaultInfakMasak) {
      final sisaM = peng.defaultInfakMasak - inf.nominalMasak;
      kurang.add('Msk -${CurrencyFormatter.format(sisaM)}');
    }
    if (!inf.isListrikBebas && inf.nominalListrik < peng.defaultInfakListrik) {
      final sisaL = peng.defaultInfakListrik - inf.nominalListrik;
      kurang.add('Lst -${CurrencyFormatter.format(sisaL)}');
    }
    if (inf.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasBelum) {
      kurang.add('Beras Belum');
    } else if (inf.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasFisik &&
        inf.berasLiter < peng.defaultInfakBerasLiter) {
      final sisaB = peng.defaultInfakBerasLiter - inf.berasLiter;
      kurang.add('Brs -${formatLiter(sisaB)} L');
    } else if (inf.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasUangVal &&
        inf.berasUang < peng.defaultInfakBerasUang) {
      final sisaBu = peng.defaultInfakBerasUang - inf.berasUang;
      kurang.add('Brs -${CurrencyFormatter.format(sisaBu)}');
    }

    final catatan = inf.catatan?.trim() ?? '';
    if (kurang.isNotEmpty) {
      return 'CICIL (${kurang.join(', ')})';
    }
    if (catatan.isNotEmpty) {
      return 'CICIL - $catatan';
    }
    return 'CICIL';
  }

  static ({
    List<Santri> sorted,
    int totalMasak,
    int totalListrik,
    int totalBerasUang,
    double totalBerasLiter,
    int grandTotalUang,
    int countLunas,
    int countCicil,
    int countBelum,
    int countPulangPindah,
  }) summarizeGroupInfak({
    required String kategori,
    required List<Santri> santriList,
    required Map<String, InfakSantriModel> infakBySantriId,
  }) {
    final filtered = santriList
        .where((s) => s.statusAktif && s.kategoriSantri == kategori)
        .toList()
      ..sort(
        (a, b) => a.namaLengkap
            .toLowerCase()
            .compareTo(b.namaLengkap.toLowerCase()),
      );

    int totalMasak = 0;
    int totalListrik = 0;
    int totalBerasUang = 0;
    double totalBerasLiter = 0.0;
    int countLunas = 0;
    int countCicil = 0;
    int countBelum = 0;
    int countPulangPindah = 0;

    for (final s in filtered) {
      final inf = infakBySantriId[s.id];
      if (inf != null) {
        if (!inf.isMasakBebas) totalMasak += inf.nominalMasak;
        if (!inf.isListrikBebas) totalListrik += inf.nominalListrik;
        if (inf.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasUangVal) {
          totalBerasUang += inf.berasUang;
        } else if (inf.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasFisik) {
          totalBerasLiter += inf.berasLiter;
        }
      }

      if (s.isPulang || s.isPindah) {
        countPulangPindah++;
      } else if (inf == null ||
          inf.statusLunas == InfakSantriModel.statusBelumVal) {
        countBelum++;
      } else if (inf.statusLunas == InfakSantriModel.statusCicilVal) {
        countCicil++;
      } else {
        countLunas++;
      }
    }

    return (
      sorted: filtered,
      totalMasak: totalMasak,
      totalListrik: totalListrik,
      totalBerasUang: totalBerasUang,
      totalBerasLiter: totalBerasLiter,
      grandTotalUang: totalMasak + totalListrik + totalBerasUang,
      countLunas: countLunas,
      countCicil: countCicil,
      countBelum: countBelum,
      countPulangPindah: countPulangPindah,
    );
  }

  static ({String bgHex, String fontHex}) _statusPalette(String status) {
    switch (status.toUpperCase()) {
      case 'LUNAS':
      case 'SAH':
      case 'COCOK':
      case 'BEBAS':
        return (bgHex: '#DCFCE7', fontHex: '#166534');
      case 'CICIL':
      case 'SELISIH':
        return (bgHex: '#FEF3C7', fontHex: '#92400E');
      case 'BELUM':
      case 'VOID':
      case 'VOID (DIBATALKAN)':
        return (bgHex: '#FFE4E6', fontHex: '#9F1239');
      case 'PULANG':
      case 'PINDAH':
        return (bgHex: '#E2E8F0', fontHex: '#334155');
      default:
        return (bgHex: '#F8FAFC', fontHex: '#0F172A');
    }
  }

  static void _writeMergedBanner(
    Sheet sheet, {
    required int row,
    required int lastCol,
    required String text,
    required CellStyle style,
  }) {
    final start = CellIndex.indexByColumnRow(columnIndex: 0, rowIndex: row);
    final end = CellIndex.indexByColumnRow(columnIndex: lastCol, rowIndex: row);
    sheet.cell(start).value = TextCellValue(text);
    sheet.merge(start, end);
    for (int c = 0; c <= lastCol; c++) {
      sheet
          .cell(CellIndex.indexByColumnRow(columnIndex: c, rowIndex: row))
          .cellStyle = style;
    }
  }

  static void _writeStyledRow(
    Sheet sheet, {
    required int row,
    required List<CellValue> values,
    required List<CellStyle> styles,
  }) {
    for (int c = 0; c < values.length; c++) {
      final cell = sheet.cell(
        CellIndex.indexByColumnRow(columnIndex: c, rowIndex: row),
      );
      cell.value = values[c];
      if (c < styles.length) {
        cell.cellStyle = styles[c];
      }
    }
  }

  static void _applyColumnWidths(Sheet sheet, List<double> widths) {
    for (int c = 0; c < widths.length; c++) {
      sheet.setColumnWidth(c, widths[c]);
    }
  }

  static void _writeSignatureBlock(
    Sheet sheet, {
    required int startRow,
    required int lastCol,
    required PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan,
    required String printDate,
    required String bendaharaRole,
  }) {
    final signStyle = CellStyle(
      fontSize: 10,
      fontColorHex: ExcelColor.fromHexString('#0F172A'),
      horizontalAlign: HorizontalAlign.Center,
      verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.Center,
    );
    final signBold = CellStyle(
      bold: true,
      fontSize: 10,
      fontColorHex: ExcelColor.fromHexString('#0F172A'),
      horizontalAlign: HorizontalAlign.Center,
      verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.Center,
    );

    final leftEnd = (lastCol ~/ 2).clamp(1, lastCol);
    final rightStart = (leftEnd + 1).clamp(1, lastCol);

    void mergePair(int r, String leftText, String rightText, CellStyle st) {
      final ls = CellIndex.indexByColumnRow(columnIndex: 0, rowIndex: r);
      final le = CellIndex.indexByColumnRow(columnIndex: leftEnd, rowIndex: r);
      sheet.cell(ls).value = TextCellValue(leftText);
      if (leftEnd > 0) sheet.merge(ls, le);
      for (int c = 0; c <= leftEnd; c++) {
        sheet
            .cell(CellIndex.indexByColumnRow(columnIndex: c, rowIndex: r))
            .cellStyle = st;
      }

      if (rightStart <= lastCol) {
        final rs = CellIndex.indexByColumnRow(
          columnIndex: rightStart,
          rowIndex: r,
        );
        final re = CellIndex.indexByColumnRow(
          columnIndex: lastCol,
          rowIndex: r,
        );
        sheet.cell(rs).value = TextCellValue(rightText);
        if (lastCol > rightStart) sheet.merge(rs, re);
        for (int c = rightStart; c <= lastCol; c++) {
          sheet
              .cell(CellIndex.indexByColumnRow(columnIndex: c, rowIndex: r))
              .cellStyle = st;
        }
      }
    }

    mergePair(startRow, 'Mengetahui,', 'Dicetak: $printDate', signStyle);
    mergePair(startRow + 1, 'Pengasuh Pondok,', bendaharaRole, signBold);
    mergePair(
      startRow + 4,
      '( ........................................ )',
      '( ${pengaturan.namaPengurus} )',
      signBold,
    );
  }

  Future<List<int>> buildExcelYayasanBytes({
    required PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan,
    required List<Santri> santriList,
    required List<Map<String, dynamic>> mutasiRows,
    required List<Map<String, dynamic>> dompetRows,
    required int totalBrankasFisik,
    required int kasLaciTunai,
    required int rekeningBank,
    required int totalTunggakanPondok,
    required List<CashOpnameLog> opnameLogs,
    required String periodeLabel,
  }) async {
    return compute<Map<String, dynamic>, List<int>>(
      _buildExcelYayasanBytesIsolate,
      <String, dynamic>{
        'pengaturan': pengaturan,
        'santriList': santriList,
        'mutasiRows': mutasiRows,
        'dompetRows': dompetRows,
        'totalBrankasFisik': totalBrankasFisik,
        'kasLaciTunai': kasLaciTunai,
        'rekeningBank': rekeningBank,
        'totalTunggakanPondok': totalTunggakanPondok,
        'opnameLogs': opnameLogs,
        'periodeLabel': periodeLabel,
      },
    );
  }

  static List<int> _buildExcelYayasanBytesIsolate(
    Map<String, dynamic> request,
  ) {
    final pengaturan = request['pengaturan'] as PengaturanAplikasi;
    final santriList = request['santriList'] as List<Santri>;
    final mutasiRows = request['mutasiRows'] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
    final dompetRows = request['dompetRows'] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
    final totalBrankasFisik = request['totalBrankasFisik'] as int;
    final kasLaciTunai = request['kasLaciTunai'] as int;
    final rekeningBank = request['rekeningBank'] as int;
    final totalTunggakanPondok = request['totalTunggakanPondok'] as int;
    final opnameLogs = request['opnameLogs'] as List<CashOpnameLog>;
    final periodeLabel = request['periodeLabel'] as String;
    final excel = Excel.createExcel();
    final printDate = formatTanggalId(DateTime.now().toLocal());

    final sheet1 = excel['Rekap Santri'];
    _applyColumnWidths(sheet1, [6, 26, 14, 16, 16, 15, 18, 16, 13, 18, 24]);

    int r1 = 0;
    _writeMergedBanner(
      sheet1,
      row: r1++,
      lastCol: 10,
      text: pengaturan.namaPondok.toUpperCase(),
      style: _kopTitleStyle(),
    );
    _writeMergedBanner(
      sheet1,
      row: r1++,
      lastCol: 10,
      text: 'LAPORAN REKAPITULASI SALDO TITIPAN & TUNGGAKAN SANTRI',
      style: _kopSubStyle(),
    );
    _writeMergedBanner(
      sheet1,
      row: r1++,
      lastCol: 10,
      text:
          'Periode: $periodeLabel  |  TA: ${pengaturan.tahunAjaran}  |  Bendahara: ${pengaturan.namaPengurus}  |  Dicetak: $printDate',
      style: _kopMetaStyle(),
    );
    r1++;

    _writeStyledRow(
      sheet1,
      row: r1++,
      values: [
        TextCellValue('No'),
        TextCellValue('Nama Lengkap'),
        TextCellValue('Panggilan'),
        TextCellValue('Kamar / Kelas'),
        TextCellValue('No WA Wali'),
        TextCellValue('Kode QR'),
        TextCellValue('Saldo Titipan'),
        TextCellValue('Jatah Harian'),
        TextCellValue('Estimasi (Hr)'),
        TextCellValue('Tunggakan'),
        TextCellValue('Catatan Tunggakan'),
      ],
      styles: List.filled(11, _tableHeaderStyle(bgHex: '#0F172A')),
    );

    int sumSaldo = 0;
    int sumTunggakan = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < santriList.length; i++) {
      final s = santriList[i];
      sumSaldo += s.saldoTotal;
      sumTunggakan += s.tunggakan;
      final rowBg = i.isEven ? '#FFFFFF' : '#F8FAFC';
```
