  Future<File> exportExcelMultiSheet({
    required PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan,
    required List<Santri> santriList,
    required int totalBrankasFisik,
    required int kasLaciTunai,
    required int rekeningBank,
    required int totalTunggakanPondok,
    required List<CashOpnameLog> opnameLogs,
    required ExportPeriod period,
    DateTime? customStart,
    DateTime? customEnd,
    bool shareAfterCreate = true,
  }) async {
    final range = YayasanExportService.resolveRange(
      period,
      customStart: customStart,
      customEnd: customEnd,
    );
    final mutasiRows = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getTransaksiByDateRange(
      tanggalMulai: range.mulai,
      tanggalSelesai: range.selesai,
    );
    final dompetRows = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getAllMutasiDompet(
      tanggalMulai: range.mulai,
      tanggalSelesai: range.selesai,
    );

    final encoded = await buildExcelYayasanBytes(
      pengaturan: pengaturan,
      santriList: santriList,
      mutasiRows: mutasiRows,
      dompetRows: dompetRows,
      totalBrankasFisik: totalBrankasFisik,
      kasLaciTunai: kasLaciTunai,
      rekeningBank: rekeningBank,
      totalTunggakanPondok: totalTunggakanPondok,
      opnameLogs: opnameLogs,
      periodeLabel: range.label,
    );

    final dir = await getTemporaryDirectory();
    final safePondok = pengaturan.namaPondok
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_]'), '_')
        .toLowerCase();
    final file = File(
      p.join(
        dir.path,
        'laporan_yayasan_${safePondok}_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.xlsx',
      ),
    );
    await file.writeAsBytes(encoded, flush: true);

    if (shareAfterCreate) {
      await Share.shareXFiles(
        [XFile(file.path)],
        text: 'Laporan Resmi Yayasan ${pengaturan.namaPondok} — ${range.label}',
      );
    }
    return file;
  }

  Future<List<int>> buildExcelBukuInfakBytes({
    required PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan,
    required String periodeBulan,
    required List<Santri> santriList,
    required List<InfakSantriModel> infakList,
    required List<SerahTerimaInfakModel> serahTerimaList,
    required Map<String, dynamic> saldoKantongInfak,
  }) async {
    return compute<Map<String, dynamic>, List<int>>(
      _buildExcelBukuInfakBytesIsolate,
      <String, dynamic>{
        'pengaturan': pengaturan,
        'periodeBulan': periodeBulan,
        'santriList': santriList,
        'infakList': infakList,
        'serahTerimaList': serahTerimaList,
        'saldoKantongInfak': saldoKantongInfak,
      },
    );
  }

  static List<int> _buildExcelBukuInfakBytesIsolate(
    Map<String, dynamic> request,
  ) {
    final pengaturan = request['pengaturan'] as PengaturanAplikasi;
    final periodeBulan = request['periodeBulan'] as String;
    final santriList = request['santriList'] as List<Santri>;
    final infakList = request['infakList'] as List<InfakSantriModel>;
    final serahTerimaList =
        request['serahTerimaList'] as List<SerahTerimaInfakModel>;
    final saldoKantongInfak =
        request['saldoKantongInfak'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
    final infakBySantriId = <String, InfakSantriModel>{
      for (final item in infakList) item.santriId: item,
    };
    final periodeLabel = formatPeriodeId(periodeBulan);
    final taLabel = DateFormatter.formatAcademicYearForPeriode(
      periodeBulan,
      configuredTa: pengaturan.tahunAjaran,
    );
    final printDate = formatTanggalId(DateTime.now().toLocal());
    final excel = Excel.createExcel();

    final groups = [
      (
        kategori: Santri.kategoriSantriyin,
        sheetName: 'Santriyin',
        title: 'DATA INFAK SANTRIYIN',
      ),
      (
        kategori: Santri.kategoriSantriyat,
        sheetName: 'Santriyat',
        title: 'DATA INFAK SANTRIYAT',
      ),
      (
        kategori: Santri.kategoriSantriBaru,
        sheetName: 'Santri Baru',
        title: 'DATA INFAK SANTRI BARU',
      ),
    ];

    final groupSummaries = <({
      String label,
      int totalSantri,
      int totalMasak,
      int totalListrik,
      int totalBerasUang,
      double totalBerasLiter,
      int grandTotalUang,
      int countLunas,
      int countCicil,
      int countBelum,
      int countPulangPindah,
    })>[];

    for (final g in groups) {
      final sum = summarizeGroupInfak(
        kategori: g.kategori,
        santriList: santriList,
        infakBySantriId: infakBySantriId,
      );
      groupSummaries.add((
        label: g.sheetName,
        totalSantri: sum.sorted.length,
        totalMasak: sum.totalMasak,
        totalListrik: sum.totalListrik,
        totalBerasUang: sum.totalBerasUang,
        totalBerasLiter: sum.totalBerasLiter,
        grandTotalUang: sum.grandTotalUang,
        countLunas: sum.countLunas,
        countCicil: sum.countCicil,
        countBelum: sum.countBelum,
        countPulangPindah: sum.countPulangPindah,
      ));
    }

    final rekapSheet = excel['Rekap Total & Serah Terima'];
    _applyColumnWidths(rekapSheet, [18, 12, 9, 9, 9, 13, 18, 18, 19, 20, 17]);

    int rr = 0;
    _writeMergedBanner(
      rekapSheet,
      row: rr++,
      lastCol: 10,
      text: pengaturan.namaPondok.toUpperCase(),
      style: _kopTitleStyle(),
    );
    _writeMergedBanner(
      rekapSheet,
      row: rr++,
      lastCol: 10,
      text: 'REKAP TOTAL BUKU INFAK & SERAH TERIMA DAPUR / YAYASAN',
      style: _kopSubStyle(),
    );
    _writeMergedBanner(
      rekapSheet,
      row: rr++,
      lastCol: 10,
      text:
          'Bulan: $periodeLabel  |  Tahun Ajaran: $taLabel  |  Bendahara: ${pengaturan.namaPengurus}  |  Dicetak: $printDate',
      style: _kopMetaStyle(),
    );
    rr++;

    _writeStyledRow(
      rekapSheet,
      row: rr++,
      values: [
        TextCellValue('Kelompok'),
        TextCellValue('Jml Santri'),
        TextCellValue('Lunas'),
        TextCellValue('Cicil'),
        TextCellValue('Belum'),
        TextCellValue('Pulang/Pindah'),
        TextCellValue('Total Masak'),
        TextCellValue('Total Listrik'),
        TextCellValue('Total Beras Uang'),
        TextCellValue('Grand Total Uang'),
        TextCellValue('Beras Fisik (L)'),
      ],
      styles: List.filled(11, _tableHeaderStyle(bgHex: '#0F766E')),
    );

    int allSantri = 0;
    int allLunas = 0;
    int allCicil = 0;
    int allBelum = 0;
    int allPp = 0;
    int allMasak = 0;
    int allListrik = 0;
    int allBerasUang = 0;
    int allGrandUang = 0;
    double allBerasLiter = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < groupSummaries.length; i++) {
      final gs = groupSummaries[i];
      allSantri += gs.totalSantri;
      allLunas += gs.countLunas;
      allCicil += gs.countCicil;
      allBelum += gs.countBelum;
      allPp += gs.countPulangPindah;
      allMasak += gs.totalMasak;
      allListrik += gs.totalListrik;
      allBerasUang += gs.totalBerasUang;
      allGrandUang += gs.grandTotalUang;
      allBerasLiter += gs.totalBerasLiter;

      final bg = i.isEven ? '#FFFFFF' : '#F8FAFC';
      _writeStyledRow(
        rekapSheet,
        row: rr++,
        values: [
          TextCellValue(gs.label),
          IntCellValue(gs.totalSantri),
          IntCellValue(gs.countLunas),
          IntCellValue(gs.countCicil),
          IntCellValue(gs.countBelum),
          IntCellValue(gs.countPulangPindah),
          IntCellValue(gs.totalMasak),
          IntCellValue(gs.totalListrik),
          IntCellValue(gs.totalBerasUang),
          IntCellValue(gs.grandTotalUang),
          DoubleCellValue(gs.totalBerasLiter),
        ],
        styles: [
          _dataStyle(bgHex: bg, bold: true),
          _dataStyle(align: HorizontalAlign.Center, bgHex: bg),
          _dataStyle(
            align: HorizontalAlign.Center,
            bgHex: '#DCFCE7',
            fontHex: '#166534',
            bold: true,
          ),
          _dataStyle(
            align: HorizontalAlign.Center,
            bgHex: '#FEF3C7',
            fontHex: '#92400E',
            bold: true,
          ),
          _dataStyle(
            align: HorizontalAlign.Center,
            bgHex: '#FFE4E6',
            fontHex: '#9F1239',
            bold: true,
          ),
          _dataStyle(
            align: HorizontalAlign.Center,

      _writeSignatureBlock(

    if (excel.sheets.containsKey('Sheet1')) {

    final encoded = excel.save();
    if (encoded == null) {

  Future<File> exportExcelBukuInfak({
    required PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan,
    required String periodeBulan,
    required List<Santri> santriList,
    bool shareAfterCreate = true,
  }) async {
    final infakList = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getInfakByPeriode(
      periodeBulan,
    );
    final serahTerimaList = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getSerahTerimaInfak(
      periodeBulan: periodeBulan,
    );
    final saldoKantong = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getSaldoKantongInfak();

    final encoded = await buildExcelBukuInfakBytes(
      pengaturan: pengaturan,
      periodeBulan: periodeBulan,
      santriList: santriList,
      infakList: infakList,
      serahTerimaList: serahTerimaList,
      saldoKantongInfak: saldoKantong,
    );

    final dir = await getTemporaryDirectory();
    final safePondok = pengaturan.namaPondok
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_]'), '_')
        .toLowerCase();
    final file = File(
      p.join(
        dir.path,
        'buku_infak_4sheet_${safePondok}_${periodeBulan}_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.xlsx',
      ),
    );
    await file.writeAsBytes(encoded, flush: true);

    if (shareAfterCreate) {
      await Share.shareXFiles(
        [XFile(file.path)],
        text:
            'Buku Infak 4-Sheet ${pengaturan.namaPondok} (${formatPeriodeId(periodeBulan)})',
      );
    }
    return file;
  }
}

                  _pdfMetric(
                    'Total Titipan',
                    CurrencyFormatter.format(totalBrankasFisik),
                  ),
                  _pdfMetric(
                    'Kas Laci Tunai',
                    CurrencyFormatter.format(kasLaciTunai),
                  ),
                  _pdfMetric(
                    'Rekening Bank',
                    CurrencyFormatter.format(rekeningBank),
                  ),
                  _pdfMetric(
                    'Total Tunggakan',
                    CurrencyFormatter.format(totalTunggakanPondok),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 14),
            pw.Text(
              'A. Rekapitulasi Saldo & Tunggakan Santri (${santriList.length} Santri)',
              style: pw.TextStyle(
                fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                fontSize: 11,
                color: PdfColors.teal900,
              ),
            ),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
            pw.TableHelper.fromTextArray(
              context: context,
              headers: [
                'No',
                'Nama Santri',
                'Kamar / Kelas',
                'Saldo',
                'Jatah/Hr',
                'Est.',
                'Tunggakan',

              headerDecoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(color: PdfColors.teal800),

                vertical: 4,

              data: List.generate(santriList.length, (i) {
                final s = santriList[i];
                return [
                  '${i + 1}',
                  s.namaLengkap,
                  s.kamar,
                  CurrencyFormatter.format(s.saldoTotal),
                  CurrencyFormatter.format(s.jatahHarian),
                  '${s.estimasiHari} hr',
                  s.tunggakan > 0 ? CurrencyFormatter.format(s.tunggakan) : '-',
                ];
              }),
            ),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 16),
            pw.Text(
              'B. Buku Mutasi Transaksi Periode (${mutasiRows.length} catatan)',
              style: pw.TextStyle(
                fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                fontSize: 11,
                color: PdfColors.teal900,
              ),
            ),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
            if (mutasiRows.isEmpty)
              pw.Text(
                'Tidak ada transaksi pada periode yang dipilih.',
                style: const pw.TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 9.5,
                  color: PdfColors.grey600,
                ),
              )
            else
              pw.TableHelper.fromTextArray(
                context: context,
                headers: [
                  'Tanggal',
                  'Santri',
                  'Tipe / Sesi',
                  'Dompet',
                  'Nominal',
                  'Status',
                  'Catatan',
                ],
                headerStyle: pw.TextStyle(
                  fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                  color: PdfColors.white,
                  fontSize: 8,
                ),
                headerDecoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(
                  color: PdfColors.blueGrey800,
                ),
                cellStyle: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 8),
                cellPadding: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: 4,
                  vertical: 3.5,
                ),
                data: mutasiRows.take(120).map((row) {
                  final isVoid = (row['is_void'] as num?)?.toInt() == 1 ||
                      (row['is_voided'] as num?)?.toInt() == 1;
                  final nom = (row['nominal'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
                  return [
                    (row['tanggal_lokal'] ?? '-').toString(),
                    (row['nama_lengkap'] ?? '-').toString(),
                    '${row['tipe'] ?? ''} (${row['kategori_waktu'] ?? ''})',
                    (row['sumber_dompet'] ?? 'TUNAI').toString(),
                    CurrencyFormatter.format(nom),
                    isVoid ? 'VOID' : 'SAH',
                    (row['catatan'] ?? '-').toString(),
                  ];
                }).toList(),
              ),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 28),
            pw.Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                pw.Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    pw.Text(
                      'Mengetahui,',
                      style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9.5),
                    ),
                    pw.Text(
                      'Pengasuh Pondok,',
                      style: pw.TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 9.5,
                        fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 46),
                    pw.Text(
                      '( ........................................ )',
                      style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9.5),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                pw.Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    pw.Text(
                      'Dicetak: ${DateFormatter.formatDisplayDate(DateTime.now())}',
                      style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9),

                    pw.Text(
                      'Bendahara Kas,',

                        fontSize: 9.5,
                        fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,

                    pw.Text(

                        fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ];
        },
      ),
    );

    final safePondok = pengaturan.namaPondok
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_]'), '_')
        .toLowerCase();
    await Printing.layoutPdf(
      onLayout: (PdfPageFormat format) async => pdf.save(),
      name:
          'Laporan_Yayasan_${safePondok}_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.pdf',
    );
  }

  Future<Uint8List> buildBukuInfakPdfBytes({
    required PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan,
    required String periodeBulan,
    required List<Santri> santriList,
    required List<InfakSantriModel> infakList,
    required List<SerahTerimaInfakModel> serahTerimaList,
    required Map<String, dynamic> saldoKantongInfak,
    required InfakPrintScope scope,
    Uint8List? logoBytesOverride,
    bool loadAssetLogo = true,
  }) async {
    final Uint8List? logoBytes =
        logoBytesOverride ??
            (loadAssetLogo ? await _loadLogoBytes(pengaturan) : null);
    final infakBySantriId = <String, InfakSantriModel>{
      for (final item in infakList) item.santriId: item,
    };

    final List<({String kategori, String title})> sections;
    switch (scope) {
      case InfakPrintScope.santriyin:
        sections = [
          (
            kategori: Santri.kategoriSantriyin,
            title: 'DATA INFAK SANTRIYIN',
          ),
        ];
        break;
      case InfakPrintScope.santriyat:
        sections = [
          (
            kategori: Santri.kategoriSantriyat,
            title: 'DATA INFAK SANTRIYAT',
          ),
        ];
        break;
      case InfakPrintScope.santriBaru:
        sections = [
          (
            kategori: Santri.kategoriSantriBaru,
            title: 'DATA INFAK SANTRI BARU',
          ),
        ];
        break;
      case InfakPrintScope.semuaTerpisah:
        sections = [
          (
            kategori: Santri.kategoriSantriyin,
            title: 'DATA INFAK SANTRIYIN',
          ),
          (
            kategori: Santri.kategoriSantriyat,
            title: 'DATA INFAK SANTRIYAT',
          ),
          (
            kategori: Santri.kategoriSantriBaru,
            title: 'DATA INFAK SANTRI BARU',
          ),
        ];
        break;
    }

    int disetorUangPeriode = 0;
    double disetorBerasPeriode = 0.0;
    for (final st in serahTerimaList) {
      if (st.periodeBulan == periodeBulan) {
        disetorUangPeriode += st.nominalUang;
        disetorBerasPeriode += st.jumlahBerasLiter;
      }
    }
    final sisaKasInfakTotal =
        (saldoKantongInfak['total_uang'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
    final sisaKasInfakTunai =
        (saldoKantongInfak['tunai'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
    final sisaKasInfakBank =
        (saldoKantongInfak['rekening'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
    final stokBerasGudang =
        (saldoKantongInfak['beras_stok'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
    final periodeLabel = YayasanExcelExporter.formatPeriodeId(periodeBulan);
    final printDateLabel = YayasanExcelExporter.formatTanggalId(DateTime.now());

    final pdf = pw.Document();

    for (final section in sections) {
      final summary = YayasanExcelExporter.summarizeGroupInfak(
        kategori: section.kategori,
        santriList: santriList,
        infakBySantriId: infakBySantriId,
      );

      pdf.addPage(
        pw.MultiPage(
          pageFormat: PdfPageFormat.a4,
          margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(22),
          build: (pw.Context context) {
            return [
              pw.Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  _buildPdfLogoOrEmblem(logoBytes, size: 44),
                  pw.Expanded(
                    child: pw.Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        pw.Text(
                          pengaturan.namaPondok.toUpperCase(),
                          style: pw.TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 12,
                            fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                            color: PdfColors.teal900,
                          ),
                        ),
                        pw.SizedBox(height: 2),
                        pw.Text(
                          section.title,
                          style: pw.TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 16,
                            fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                            color: PdfColors.black,
                          ),
                        ),
                        pw.SizedBox(height: 2),
                        pw.Text(
                          'Tahun Ajaran: ${pengaturan.tahunAjaran}   |   Bulan: $periodeLabel',
                          style: const pw.TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 9,
                            color: PdfColors.grey700,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
              pw.Divider(thickness: 1.8, color: PdfColors.teal800),
              pw.SizedBox(height: 8),
              pw.Table(
                border: pw.TableBorder.all(
                  color: PdfColors.grey400,
                  width: 0.6,
                ),
                columnWidths: {
                  0: const pw.FixedColumnWidth(24),
                  1: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(2.4),
                  2: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.3),
                  3: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.2),
                  4: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.3),
                  5: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.25),
                  6: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.25),
                  7: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(2.1),
                },
                children: [
                  pw.TableRow(
                    decoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(color: PdfColors.teal800),
                    children: [
                      _pdfHeaderCell('NO', align: pw.TextAlign.center),
                      _pdfHeaderCell('NAMA SANTRI'),
                      _pdfHeaderCell('MASAK', align: pw.TextAlign.right),
                      _pdfHeaderCell('LISTRIK', align: pw.TextAlign.right),
                      _pdfHeaderCell('BERAS', align: pw.TextAlign.right),
                      _pdfHeaderCell('TGL MASUK', align: pw.TextAlign.center),
                      _pdfHeaderCell('TGL HABIS', align: pw.TextAlign.center),
                      _pdfHeaderCell('KET'),
                    ],
                  ),
                  if (summary.sorted.isEmpty)
                    pw.TableRow(
                      decoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(
                        color: PdfColors.grey100,
                      ),
                      children: [
                        _pdfDataCell('-', align: pw.TextAlign.center),
                        _pdfDataCell(
                          'Belum ada data santri pada kelompok ini.',
                        ),
                        _pdfDataCell('-'),
                        _pdfDataCell('-'),
                        _pdfDataCell('-'),
                        _pdfDataCell('-'),
                        _pdfDataCell('-'),
                        _pdfDataCell('-'),
                      ],
                    )
                  else
                    ...List.generate(summary.sorted.length, (i) {
                      final s = summary.sorted[i];
                      final inf = infakBySantriId[s.id];

                      final PdfColor rowBg;
                      final String ketText;
                      final PdfColor ketColor;
                      if (s.isPulang) {
                        rowBg = PdfColor.fromInt(0xFFD1FAE5);
                        ketText = 'PULANG';
                        ketColor = PdfColors.teal900;
                      } else if (s.isPindah) {
                        rowBg = PdfColor.fromInt(0xFFE2E8F0);
                        ketText = 'PINDAH';
                        ketColor = PdfColors.blueGrey800;
                      } else if (inf != null &&
                          inf.statusLunas == InfakSantriModel.statusLunasVal) {
                        rowBg = PdfColor.fromInt(0xFFECFDF5);
                        ketText = 'LUNAS';
                        ketColor = PdfColors.green800;
                      } else if (inf != null &&
                          inf.statusLunas == InfakSantriModel.statusCicilVal) {
                        rowBg = PdfColor.fromInt(0xFFFEF3C7);
                        ketText = YayasanExcelExporter.buildKetCicil(
                          inf,
                          pengaturan,
                        );
                        ketColor = PdfColors.amber900;
                      } else {
                        rowBg = i.isEven
                            ? PdfColors.white
                            : PdfColor.fromInt(0xFFF8FAFC);
                        ketText = 'BELUM BAYAR';
                        ketColor = PdfColors.red800;
                      }

                      final masakCell = inf == null
                          ? '-'
                          : (inf.isMasakBebas
                              ? 'BEBAS'
                              : CurrencyFormatter.format(inf.nominalMasak));
                      final listrikCell = inf == null
                          ? '-'
                          : (inf.isListrikBebas
                              ? 'BEBAS'
                              : CurrencyFormatter.format(inf.nominalListrik));
                      final String berasCell;
                      if (inf == null ||
                          inf.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasBelum) {
                        berasCell = '-';
                      } else if (inf.jenisBeras ==
                          InfakSantriModel.berasBebas) {
                        berasCell = 'BEBAS';
                      } else if (inf.jenisBeras ==
                          InfakSantriModel.berasFisik) {
                        berasCell =
                            '${YayasanExcelExporter.formatLiter(inf.berasLiter)} L';
                      } else {
                        berasCell = CurrencyFormatter.format(inf.berasUang);
                      }

                      final tglMasukCell =
                          inf != null && inf.tglMasuk.isNotEmpty
                              ? inf.tglMasuk
                              : '-';
                      final tglHabisCell =
                          inf != null && inf.tglHabis.isNotEmpty
                              ? inf.tglHabis
                              : '-';
                      final kamarSuffix =
                          s.kamar.trim().isNotEmpty ? ' (${s.kamar})' : '';

                      return pw.TableRow(
                        decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(color: rowBg),
                        children: [
                          _pdfDataCell('${i + 1}', align: pw.TextAlign.center),
                          _pdfDataCell('${s.namaLengkap}$kamarSuffix'),
                          _pdfDataCell(
                            masakCell,
                            align: pw.TextAlign.right,
                            color: masakCell == 'BEBAS'
                                ? PdfColors.green800
                                : PdfColors.black,
                            bold: masakCell == 'BEBAS',
                          ),
                          _pdfDataCell(
                            listrikCell,
                            align: pw.TextAlign.right,
                            color: listrikCell == 'BEBAS'
                                ? PdfColors.green800
                                : PdfColors.black,
                            bold: listrikCell == 'BEBAS',
                          ),
                          _pdfDataCell(
                            berasCell,
                            align: pw.TextAlign.right,
                            color: berasCell == 'BEBAS'
                                ? PdfColors.green800
                                : PdfColors.black,
                            bold: berasCell == 'BEBAS',
                          ),
                          _pdfDataCell(
                            tglMasukCell,
                            align: pw.TextAlign.center,
                          ),
                          _pdfDataCell(
                            tglHabisCell,
                            align: pw.TextAlign.center,
                          ),
                          _pdfDataCell(ketText, color: ketColor, bold: true),
                        ],
                      );
                    }),
                ],
              ),
              pw.SizedBox(height: 12),
              pw.Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  pw.Expanded(
                    flex: 11,
                    child: pw.Container(
                      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                        color: PdfColors.teal50,
                        border: pw.Border.all(
                          color: PdfColors.teal300,
                          width: 0.8,
                        ),
                        borderRadius: const pw.BorderRadius.all(
                          pw.Radius.circular(4),
                        ),
                      ),
                      child: pw.Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          pw.Text(
                            'REKAP TOTAL KELOMPOK (${summary.sorted.length} SANTRI)',
                            style: pw.TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 8.5,
                              fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                              color: PdfColors.teal900,
                            ),
                          ),
                          pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                          _pdfKeyValueRow(
                            'Total Uang Masak',
                            CurrencyFormatter.format(summary.totalMasak),
                          ),
                          _pdfKeyValueRow(
                            'Total Uang Listrik',
                            CurrencyFormatter.format(summary.totalListrik),
                          ),
                          _pdfKeyValueRow(
                            'Total Uang Beras',
                            CurrencyFormatter.format(summary.totalBerasUang),
                          ),
                          _pdfKeyValueRow(
                            'Total Beras Fisik',
                            '${YayasanExcelExporter.formatLiter(summary.totalBerasLiter)} Liter',
                          ),
                          pw.Divider(color: PdfColors.teal300, height: 6),
                          _pdfKeyValueRow(
                            'GRAND TOTAL UANG INFAK',
                            CurrencyFormatter.format(summary.grandTotalUang),
                            bold: true,
                          ),
                          pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                          pw.Text(
                            'Status: Lunas ${summary.countLunas} | Cicil ${summary.countCicil} | Belum ${summary.countBelum} | Pulang/Pindah ${summary.countPulangPindah}',
                            style: const pw.TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 7.5,
                              color: PdfColors.grey800,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  pw.SizedBox(width: 8),
                  pw.Expanded(
                    flex: 10,
                    child: pw.Container(
                      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                        color: PdfColors.amber50,
                        border: pw.Border.all(
                          color: PdfColors.amber300,
                          width: 0.8,
                        ),
                        borderRadius: const pw.BorderRadius.all(
                          pw.Radius.circular(4),
                        ),
                      ),
                      child: pw.Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          pw.Text(
                            'SERAH TERIMA DAPUR / YAYASAN ($periodeLabel)',
                            style: pw.TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 8.5,
                              fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                              color: PdfColors.amber900,
                            ),
                          ),
                          pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                          _pdfKeyValueRow(
                            'Sudah Disetor (Uang)',
                            CurrencyFormatter.format(disetorUangPeriode),
                          ),
                          _pdfKeyValueRow(
                            'Sudah Disetor (Beras)',
                            '${YayasanExcelExporter.formatLiter(disetorBerasPeriode)} Liter',
                          ),
                          _pdfKeyValueRow(
                            'Sisa Kas Infak di Bendahara',

                            bold: true,

                          _pdfKeyValueRow(
                            'Rincian Sisa (Tunai / Bank)',
                            '${CurrencyFormatter.format(sisaKasInfakTunai)} / ${CurrencyFormatter.format(sisaKasInfakBank)}',
                          ),
                          _pdfKeyValueRow(
                            'Sisa Beras di Gudang',
                            '${YayasanExcelExporter.formatLiter(stokBerasGudang)} Liter',
                          ),
                          if (serahTerimaList.isNotEmpty) ...[
                            pw.Divider(color: PdfColors.amber300, height: 6),
                            ...serahTerimaList.take(3).map((st) {
                              final nilaiStr = st.nominalUang > 0
                                  ? CurrencyFormatter.format(st.nominalUang)
                                  : '${YayasanExcelExporter.formatLiter(st.jumlahBerasLiter)} L';
                              return pw.Text(
                                '- ${st.tanggalSerah} -> ${st.penerima}: $nilaiStr',
                                style: const pw.TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 7.2,
                                  color: PdfColors.grey800,
                                ),
                              );
                            }),
                          ],

                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              pw.SizedBox(height: 22),
              pw.Row(
                mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                children: [
                  pw.Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      pw.Text(
                        'Mengetahui,',
                        style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9),
                      ),
                      pw.Text(
                        'Pengasuh Pondok,',
                        style: pw.TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 9,
                          fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                        ),
                      ),
                      pw.SizedBox(height: 40),
                      pw.Text(
                        '( ........................................ )',
                        style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  pw.Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      pw.Text(
                        'Dicetak: $printDateLabel',
                        style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 8.5),

                      pw.Text(

                        style: pw.TextStyle(

                        ),
                      ),
                    ],

          },

    }

    return await pdf.save();
  }

  Future<void> exportPdfBukuInfak({
    required PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan,
    required String periodeBulan,
    required List<Santri> santriList,
    required InfakPrintScope scope,
  }) async {
    final infakList = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getInfakByPeriode(
      periodeBulan,
    );
    final serahTerimaList = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getSerahTerimaInfak(
      periodeBulan: periodeBulan,
    );
    final saldoKantong = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getSaldoKantongInfak();

    final pdfBytes = await buildBukuInfakPdfBytes(
      pengaturan: pengaturan,
      periodeBulan: periodeBulan,
      santriList: santriList,
      infakList: infakList,
      serahTerimaList: serahTerimaList,
      saldoKantongInfak: saldoKantong,
      scope: scope,
    );

    final safePondok = pengaturan.namaPondok
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_]'), '_')
        .toLowerCase();
    await Printing.layoutPdf(
      onLayout: (PdfPageFormat format) async => pdfBytes,
      name:
          'Buku_Infak_${safePondok}_${periodeBulan}_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.pdf',
    );
  }
}

    this.isCanceled = false,
  });

  @override
  String toString() => message;
}

class _GoogleAuthClient extends http.BaseClient {
  final Map<String, String> _headers;
  final http.Client _inner = http.Client();

  _GoogleAuthClient(this._headers);

  @override
  Future<http.StreamedResponse> send(http.BaseRequest request) {
    request.headers.addAll(_headers);
    return _inner.send(request);
  }

  @override
  void close() {
    _inner.close();
  }
}

class GoogleDriveBackupService {
  static final GoogleDriveBackupService instance =
      GoogleDriveBackupService._init();
  GoogleDriveBackupService._init();

  static const String backupFileName = 'kas_santri_cloud_backup.json';

  final GoogleSignIn _googleSignIn = GoogleSignIn(
    scopes: <String>[
      'email',
      'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.appdata',
    ],
  );

  static GoogleAuthFriendlyException mapAuthError(Object error) {
    if (error is GoogleAuthFriendlyException) return error;

    if (error is PlatformException) {
      final raw =
          '${error.code} ${error.message ?? ''} ${error.details ?? ''}'
              .toLowerCase();
      if (error.code == 'sign_in_canceled' || raw.contains('canceled')) {
        return const GoogleAuthFriendlyException(
          title: 'Login Google Dibatalkan',
          message:
              'Pemilihan akun Google dibatalkan. Anda tetap dapat memakai Mode Bendahara Lokal atau Backup Lokal (.JSON / .KSBAK) kapan saja.',
          isCanceled: true,
        );
      }
      if (raw.contains('apiexception: 10') ||
          raw.contains(' 10:') ||
          raw.contains(', 10,') ||
          raw.contains('developer_error') ||
          error.code == 'sign_in_failed') {
        return const GoogleAuthFriendlyException(
          title: 'OAuth Google Belum Aktif di Build Rilis Ini',
          message:
              'Google Sign-In memerlukan pendaftaran sertifikat SHA-1 Android (paket com.pondok.kassantri) pada Google Cloud Console untuk APK rilis.\n\nData kas pondok Anda tetap 100% aman di perangkat. Silakan gunakan tombol alternatif instan di bawah ini:',
          isSha1ConfigError: true,
        );
      }
      if (error.code == 'network_error' || raw.contains('network')) {
        return const GoogleAuthFriendlyException(
          title: 'Koneksi Internet Belum Stabil',
          message:
              'Tidak dapat menghubungi layanan Google saat ini. Pastikan internet aktif atau gunakan Backup Lokal (.JSON / .KSBAK) / Mode Bendahara Lokal.',
        );
      }
    }

    if (error is TimeoutException) {
      return const GoogleAuthFriendlyException(
        title: 'Waktu Sambungan Habis',
        message:
            'Koneksi ke Google memerlukan waktu terlalu lama. Anda dapat langsung menggunakan Backup Lokal (.JSON / .KSBAK) atau Mode Bendahara Lokal.',
      );
    }

    final text = error.toString();
    final lower = text.toLowerCase();
    if (lower.contains('apiexception: 10') ||
        lower.contains('developer_error') ||
        lower.contains('sign_in_failed')) {
      return const GoogleAuthFriendlyException(
        title: 'OAuth Google Belum Aktif di Build Rilis Ini',
        message:
            'Google Sign-In memerlukan pendaftaran sertifikat SHA-1 Android (paket com.pondok.kassantri) pada Google Cloud Console untuk APK rilis.\n\nSilakan gunakan Backup Lokal (.JSON / .KSBAK) atau Mode Bendahara Lokal.',
        isSha1ConfigError: true,
      );
    }

    return const GoogleAuthFriendlyException(
      title: 'Belum Dapat Terhubung ke Google',
      message:
          'Layanan Google belum dapat diakses pada perangkat ini. Pastikan koneksi internet aktif, atau gunakan fitur Backup Lokal (.JSON / .KSBAK) & Mode Bendahara Lokal.',
    );
  }

  Future<GoogleSignInAccount?> getCurrentOrSilentAccount() async {
    try {
      if (_googleSignIn.currentUser != null) {
        return _googleSignIn.currentUser;
      }
      return await _googleSignIn.signInSilently().timeout(
            const Duration(seconds: 10),
            onTimeout: () => null,
          );
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<GoogleSignInAccount?> signInInteractive() async {
    try {
      final account = await _googleSignIn.signIn().timeout(
            const Duration(seconds: 30),
          );
      if (account == null) {
        throw const GoogleAuthFriendlyException(
          title: 'Login Google Dibatalkan',
          message:
              'Pemilihan akun Google dibatalkan. Anda dapat langsung melanjutkan dengan Mode Bendahara Lokal atau Backup Lokal (.JSON / .KSBAK).',
          isCanceled: true,
        );
      }
      return account;
    } catch (e) {
      throw mapAuthError(e);
    }
  }

  Future<void> signOut() async {
    try {
      await _googleSignIn.disconnect();
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
      await _googleSignIn.signOut();
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<DateTime> uploadBackupJson(Map<String, dynamic> payload) async {
    var account = await getCurrentOrSilentAccount();
    account ??= await signInInteractive();
    if (account == null) {
      throw const GoogleAuthFriendlyException(
        title: 'Akun Google Belum Terhubung',
        message:
            'Silakan tautkan akun Google terlebih dahulu atau gunakan Backup Lokal (.JSON / .KSBAK).',
        isCanceled: true,
      );
    }

    final authHeaders = await account.authHeaders;
    final client = _GoogleAuthClient(authHeaders);
    try {
      final driveApi = drive.DriveApi(client);
      final existingList = await driveApi.files
          .list(
            spaces: 'appDataFolder',
            q: "name = '$backupFileName' and trashed = false",
            $fields: 'files(id, name, modifiedTime)',
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 20));

      final jsonStr = const JsonEncoder.withIndent('  ').convert(payload);
      final bytes = utf8.encode(jsonStr);
      final media = drive.Media(Stream.value(bytes), bytes.length);

      if (existingList.files != null && existingList.files!.isNotEmpty) {
        final existingId = existingList.files!.first.id!;
        await driveApi.files
            .update(
              drive.File()..name = backupFileName,
              existingId,
              uploadMedia: media,
            )
            .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 30));
      } else {
        final fileMeta = drive.File()
          ..name = backupFileName
          ..parents = <String>['appDataFolder'];
        await driveApi.files
            .create(fileMeta, uploadMedia: media)
            .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 30));
      }

      return DateTime.now();
    } on GoogleAuthFriendlyException {
      rethrow;
    } catch (e) {
      throw mapAuthError(e);
    } finally {
      client.close();
    }
  }

  Future<({BackupValidationResult validation, DateTime? modifiedTime})>
      downloadAndValidateBackup() async {
    var account = await getCurrentOrSilentAccount();
    account ??= await signInInteractive();
    if (account == null) {
      throw const GoogleAuthFriendlyException(
        title: 'Akun Google Belum Terhubung',
        message:
            'Silakan tautkan akun Google terlebih dahulu atau pulihkan dari file Backup Lokal (.JSON / .KSBAK).',
        isCanceled: true,
      );
    }

    final authHeaders = await account.authHeaders;
    final client = _GoogleAuthClient(authHeaders);
    try {
      final driveApi = drive.DriveApi(client);
      final existingList = await driveApi.files
          .list(
            spaces: 'appDataFolder',
            q: "name = '$backupFileName' and trashed = false",
            $fields: 'files(id, name, modifiedTime)',
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 20));

      if (existingList.files == null || existingList.files!.isEmpty) {
        throw GoogleAuthFriendlyException(
          title: 'Belum Ada Cadangan di Drive',
          message:
              'Belum ditemukan file cadangan Kas-Santri pada Google Drive akun ${account.email}. Anda juga dapat memulihkan dari file lokal (.JSON / .KSBAK).',
        );
      }

      final targetFile = existingList.files!.first;
      final dynamic downloaded = await driveApi.files
          .get(
            targetFile.id!,
            downloadOptions: drive.DownloadOptions.fullMedia,
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 30));

      if (downloaded is! drive.Media) {
        throw const GoogleAuthFriendlyException(
          title: 'Unduhan Cadangan Gagal',
          message: 'Gagal mengunduh isi file backup dari Google Drive.',
        );
      }

      final chunks = <int>[];
      await for (final chunk in downloaded.stream) {
        chunks.addAll(chunk);
      }
      final rawJson = utf8.decode(chunks);
      final validation = BackupService.validateJsonString(rawJson);
      if (!validation.isValid) {
        throw FormatException(
          validation.errorMessage ?? 'File backup di Google Drive tidak valid.',
        );
      }

      return (
        validation: validation,
        modifiedTime: targetFile.modifiedTime?.toLocal(),
      );
    } on GoogleAuthFriendlyException {
      rethrow;
    } on FormatException {
      rethrow;
    } catch (e) {
      throw mapAuthError(e);
    } finally {
      client.close();
    }
  }

  /// Menjalankan auto-backup harian secara senyap saat aplikasi aktif & terhubung internet
  Future<DateTime?> runDailyAutoBackupIfDue({
    required PengaturanAplikasi settings,
    required Future<Map<String, dynamic>> Function() dumpPayload,
  }) async {
    if (!SubscriptionService.instance.hasProAccess || !settings.autoDriveBackup) {
      return null;
    }
    if (settings.driveAccountEmail == null ||
        settings.driveAccountEmail!.isEmpty) {
      return null;
    }

    if (settings.lastDriveBackupAt != null) {
      final last = DateTime.tryParse(settings.lastDriveBackupAt!);
      if (last != null &&
          DateTime.now().difference(last) < const Duration(hours: 24)) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    try {
      final account = await getCurrentOrSilentAccount();
      if (account == null) return null;
      final payload = await dumpPayload();
      return await uploadBackupJson(payload);
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:cryptography/cryptography.dart';
import 'package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class LicenseVerificationResult {
  final bool isValid;
  final bool isExpired;
  final String? planKey; // MONTHLY, YEARLY, LIFETIME
  final String? tipe; // M1, Y1, LT
  final String? deviceId;
  final DateTime? expiryDate;
  final String message;

  const LicenseVerificationResult({
    required this.isValid,
    this.isExpired = false,
    this.planKey,
    this.tipe,
    this.deviceId,
    this.expiryDate,
    required this.message,
  });
}

/// Layanan Verifikasi Lisensi PRO Offline berbasis Kriptografi Asimetris Ed25519 (Anti-Keygen).
///
/// KEAMANAN v3.3:
/// - APK HANYA menyimpan Public Key Ed25519 (32-byte raw public key Base64).
/// - Private Key TIDAK PERNAH ada di folder lib/ atau assets/.
/// - Format kode lisensi: KSPRO-<PAYLOAD_BASE32>-<SIGNATURE_BASE32>
///   dengan payload UTF-8: <DEVICE_ID>|<TIER>|<EXPIRY_EPOCH_SEC>
class LicenseService {
  static final LicenseService instance = LicenseService._init();
  LicenseService._init();

  /// Public Key Ed25519 (32-byte raw Base64) untuk memverifikasi tanda tangan lisensi.
  /// Dapat disuntikkan saat build release melalui:
  /// `--dart-define=KAS_SANTRI_ED25519_PUBKEY=<BASE64_32_BYTE_PUBLIC_KEY>`
  /// Fallback default menggunakan RFC 8032 test vector agar unit test berjalan deterministik.
  static const String defaultPublicKeyBase64 = String.fromEnvironment(
    'KAS_SANTRI_ED25519_PUBKEY',
    defaultValue: '11qYAYKxCrfVS/7TyWQHOg7hcvPapiMlrwIaaPcHURo=',
  );

  static const String _keyDeviceId = 'ks_device_id';
  static const String _keyLicenseCode = 'ks_pro_license_code';
  static const String _b32Alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567';

  static final Ed25519 _ed25519 = Ed25519();

  final FlutterSecureStorage _secureStorage = const FlutterSecureStorage(
    aOptions: AndroidOptions(encryptedSharedPreferences: true),
  );

  Future<String?> _readSecureOrPref(String key) async {
    try {
      final secVal = await _secureStorage.read(key: key);
      if (secVal != null && secVal.isNotEmpty) return secVal;
    } catch (_) {
      // Fallback di unit test / environment tanpa channel native
    }
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getString(key);
  }

  Future<void> _writeSecureAndClearLegacyPref(String key, String value) async {
    bool savedToSecure = false;
    try {
      await _secureStorage.write(key: key, value: value);
      savedToSecure = true;
    } catch (_) {
      savedToSecure = false;
    }
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (savedToSecure) {
      await prefs.remove(key);
    } else {
      await prefs.setString(key, value);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _deleteSecureAndPref(String key) async {
    try {
      await _secureStorage.delete(key: key);
    } catch (_) {}
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.remove(key);
  }

  static String normalizeLicenseCode(String raw) => raw
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase()
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), '');

  static String planKeyFromTipe(String tipe) {
    switch (tipe.toUpperCase()) {
      case 'M1':
      case 'MONTHLY':
        return 'MONTHLY';
      case 'LT':
      case 'LIFETIME':
        return 'LIFETIME';
      case 'Y1':
      case 'YEARLY':
      default:
        return 'YEARLY';
    }
  }

  static String tipeFromTier(String tier) {
    switch (tier.toUpperCase()) {
      case 'MONTHLY':
      case 'M1':
        return 'M1';
      case 'LIFETIME':
      case 'LT':
        return 'LT';
      case 'YEARLY':
      case 'Y1':
      default:
        return 'Y1';
    }
  }

  static Uint8List decodeBase32(String input) {
    final clean = input.trim().toUpperCase().replaceAll('=', '');
    if (clean.isEmpty) {
      throw const FormatException('Base32 kosong.');
    }
    final bytes = <int>[];
    var buffer = 0;
    var bitsLeft = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < clean.length; i++) {
      final idx = _b32Alphabet.indexOf(clean[i]);
      if (idx < 0) {
        throw FormatException('Karakter Base32 tidak valid: ${clean[i]}');
      }
      buffer = (buffer << 5) | idx;
      bitsLeft += 5;
      if (bitsLeft >= 8) {
        bytes.add((buffer >> (bitsLeft - 8)) & 0xff);
        bitsLeft -= 8;
      }
    }
    return Uint8List.fromList(bytes);
  }

  /// Verifikasi murni berbasis Ed25519 Public Key.
  /// Format yang sah: `KSPRO-<PAYLOAD_B32>-<SIGNATURE_B32>`
  /// dengan payload UTF-8: `<DEVICE_ID>|<TIER>|<EXPIRY_EPOCH_SEC>`
  static Future<LicenseVerificationResult> verifyCodeAsync({
    required String code,
    required String deviceId,
    DateTime? now,
    String? publicKeyBase64Override,
  }) async {
    final normalizedCode = normalizeLicenseCode(code);
    final parts = normalizedCode.split('-');
    if (parts.length != 3 ||
        parts[0] != 'KSPRO' ||
        parts[1].isEmpty ||
        parts[2].isEmpty) {
      return const LicenseVerificationResult(
        isValid: false,
        message: 'Format kode lisensi tidak valid. Gunakan kode resmi KSPRO-....',
      );
    }

    final Uint8List payloadBytes;
    final Uint8List signatureBytes;
    try {
      payloadBytes = decodeBase32(parts[1]);
      signatureBytes = decodeBase32(parts[2]);
    } catch (_) {
      return const LicenseVerificationResult(
        isValid: false,
        message: 'Kode lisensi rusak atau mengandung karakter tidak sah.',
      );
    }

    if (signatureBytes.length != 64) {
      return const LicenseVerificationResult(
        isValid: false,
        message: 'Tanda tangan digital lisensi tidak valid.',
      );
    }

    final pubB64 = (publicKeyBase64Override ?? defaultPublicKeyBase64).trim();
    late final SimplePublicKey publicKey;
    try {
      final pubBytes = base64Decode(pubB64);
      if (pubBytes.length != 32) {
        return const LicenseVerificationResult(
          isValid: false,
          message: 'Konfigurasi public key verifikasi tidak valid.',
        );
      }
      publicKey = SimplePublicKey(pubBytes, type: KeyPairType.ed25519);
    } catch (_) {
      return const LicenseVerificationResult(
        isValid: false,
        message: 'Konfigurasi public key verifikasi tidak valid.',
      );
    }

    final verified = await _ed25519.verify(
      payloadBytes,
      signature: Signature(signatureBytes, publicKey: publicKey),
    );
    if (!verified) {
      return const LicenseVerificationResult(
        isValid: false,
        message: 'Tanda tangan digital tidak cocok. Kode bukan lisensi resmi.',
      );
    }

    final String payloadStr;
    try {
      payloadStr = utf8.decode(payloadBytes);
    } catch (_) {
      return const LicenseVerificationResult(
        isValid: false,
        message: 'Isi payload lisensi tidak dapat dibaca.',
      );
    }

    final fields = payloadStr.split('|');
    if (fields.length != 3) {
      return const LicenseVerificationResult(
        isValid: false,
        message: 'Struktur payload lisensi tidak valid.',
      );
    }

    final tokenDevice = fields[0].trim().toUpperCase();
    final tier = fields[1].trim().toUpperCase();
    final expiryEpochSec = int.tryParse(fields[2].trim());
    if (expiryEpochSec == null ||
        (tier != 'MONTHLY' && tier != 'YEARLY' && tier != 'LIFETIME')) {
      return const LicenseVerificationResult(
        isValid: false,
        message: 'Data paket atau masa berlaku lisensi tidak valid.',
      );
    }

    final currentDevice = deviceId.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (tokenDevice != currentDevice) {
      return LicenseVerificationResult(
        isValid: false,
        deviceId: tokenDevice,
        message:
            'Kode lisensi ini terdaftar untuk perangkat lain ($tokenDevice).',
      );
    }

    final tipe = tipeFromTier(tier);
    final planKey = planKeyFromTipe(tier);
    if (tier == 'LIFETIME' || expiryEpochSec == 0) {
      return LicenseVerificationResult(
        isValid: true,
        planKey: planKey,
        tipe: tipe,
        deviceId: tokenDevice,
        message: 'Lisensi Kas-Santri PRO Lifetime (Selamanya) aktif.',
      );
    }

    final expiry = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(
      expiryEpochSec * 1000,
      isUtc: true,
    ).toLocal();
    final refNow = now ?? DateTime.now();
    if (refNow.isAfter(expiry)) {
      return LicenseVerificationResult(
        isValid: false,
        isExpired: true,
        planKey: planKey,
        tipe: tipe,
        deviceId: tokenDevice,
        expiryDate: expiry,
        message: 'Masa aktif lisensi PRO sudah berakhir. Silakan perpanjang.',
      );
    }

    return LicenseVerificationResult(
      isValid: true,
      planKey: planKey,
      tipe: tipe,
      deviceId: tokenDevice,
      expiryDate: expiry,
      message: 'Lisensi Kas-Santri PRO ($planKey) aktif terverifikasi Ed25519.',
    );
  }

  /// Menghasilkan ID perangkat stabil seperti KS-9F4A2B1C (disimpan di SecureStorage)
  Future<String> getOrCreateDeviceId() async {
    final existing = await _readSecureOrPref(_keyDeviceId);
    if (existing != null && existing.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      final clean = existing.trim().toUpperCase();
      // Pastikan migrasi dari pref lama ke secure storage berjalan mulus
      await _writeSecureAndClearLegacyPref(_keyDeviceId, clean);
      return clean;
    }

    final rng = Random.secure();
    const chars = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
    final buf = StringBuffer('KS-');
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      buf.write(chars[rng.nextInt(chars.length)]);
    }
    final generated = buf.toString();
    await _writeSecureAndClearLegacyPref(_keyDeviceId, generated);
    return generated;
  }

  Future<LicenseVerificationResult> activateLicense(
    String rawCode, {
    DateTime? now,
  }) async {
    final deviceId = await getOrCreateDeviceId();
    final res = await verifyCodeAsync(
      code: rawCode,
      deviceId: deviceId,
      now: now,
    );
    if (res.isValid) {
      await _writeSecureAndClearLegacyPref(
        _keyLicenseCode,
        normalizeLicenseCode(rawCode),
      );
    }
    return res;
  }

  Future<LicenseVerificationResult?> checkSavedLicense({DateTime? now}) async {
    final savedCode = await _readSecureOrPref(_keyLicenseCode);
    if (savedCode == null || savedCode.trim().isEmpty) return null;

    // Migrasi aman jika sebelumnya tersimpan di SharedPreferences
    await _writeSecureAndClearLegacyPref(
      _keyLicenseCode,
      normalizeLicenseCode(savedCode),
    );

    final deviceId = await getOrCreateDeviceId();
    return verifyCodeAsync(
      code: savedCode,
      deviceId: deviceId,
      now: now,
    );
  }

  Future<void> clearLicense() async {
    await _deleteSecureAndPref(_keyLicenseCode);
  }
}

import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:pdf/pdf.dart';
import 'package:pdf/widgets.dart' as pw;
import '../models/pengaturan.dart';
import '../models/santri.dart';

/// Generator PDF A4 Cetak Massal Kartu Santri QR Siap Laminating (8 Kartu / Halaman).
class QrCardPdfService {
  static final QrCardPdfService instance = QrCardPdfService._init();
  QrCardPdfService._init();

  Future<Uint8List?> _loadLogoBytes(PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan) async {
    try {
      final path = pengaturan.logoPath;
      if (path != null && path.isNotEmpty) {
        final file = File(path);
        if (await file.exists()) return await file.readAsBytes();
      }
      return null;
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<Uint8List?> _loadFotoBytes(String? fotoPath) async {
    if (fotoPath == null || fotoPath.trim().isEmpty) return null;
    try {
      final f = File(fotoPath);
      if (await f.exists()) return await f.readAsBytes();
    } catch (_) {}
    return null;
  }

  String _initials(String nama) {
    final parts = nama
        .trim()
        .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
        .where((e) => e.isNotEmpty)
        .toList();
    if (parts.isEmpty) return 'KS';
    if (parts.length == 1) return parts.first.substring(0, 1).toUpperCase();
    return '${parts.first[0]}${parts[1][0]}'.toUpperCase();
  }

  /// Menghasilkan PDF A4 dengan 8 kartu ukuran standar ID Card per halaman (2 kolom x 4 baris).
  Future<Uint8List> buildBulkQrCardsPdfBytes({
    required PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan,
    required List<Santri> santriList,
  }) async {
    final doc = pw.Document();
    final logoBytes = await _loadLogoBytes(pengaturan);
    final logoImage = logoBytes != null ? pw.MemoryImage(logoBytes) : null;

    final fotoCache = <String, pw.MemoryImage>{};
    for (final s in santriList) {
      final b = await _loadFotoBytes(s.fotoPath);
      if (b != null) {
        fotoCache[s.id] = pw.MemoryImage(b);
      }
    }

    const cardsPerPage = 8;
    final totalPages =
        santriList.isEmpty ? 1 : (santriList.length / cardsPerPage).ceil();

    for (var pIdx = 0; pIdx < totalPages; pIdx++) {
      final start = pIdx * cardsPerPage;
      final end = (start + cardsPerPage) > santriList.length
          ? santriList.length
          : (start + cardsPerPage);
      final chunk = santriList.sublist(start, end);

      doc.addPage(
        pw.Page(
          pageFormat: PdfPageFormat.a4,
          margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(18),
          build: (context) {
            return pw.Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                pw.Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                  children: [
                    pw.Text(
                      'KARTU SANTRI QR — ${pengaturan.namaPondok.toUpperCase()}',
                      style: pw.TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 8.5,
                        fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,

    }

    return doc.save();

import 'package:pdf/pdf.dart';
import 'package:pdf/widgets.dart' as pw;
import 'package:printing/printing.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';
import 'package:share_plus/share_plus.dart';
import '../models/santri.dart';
import '../models/transaksi.dart';
import '../models/pengaturan.dart';
import '../models/infak_santri.dart';
import '../models/serah_terima_infak.dart';
import '../utils/currency_formatter.dart';
import '../utils/date_formatter.dart';
import '../utils/time_category_helper.dart';

class ReportService {
  static final ReportService instance = ReportService._init();
  ReportService._init();

  /// Normalisasi nomor WhatsApp Indonesia (08xxx -> 628xxx, hapus karakter non-digit)
  static String normalizeWaPhone(String? rawPhone) {
    if (rawPhone == null) return '';
    var phone = rawPhone.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), '');
    if (phone.isEmpty) return '';
    if (phone.startsWith('0')) {
      phone = '62${phone.substring(1)}';
    } else if (phone.startsWith('8')) {
      phone = '62$phone';
    }
    return phone;
  }

  /// Membuka WhatsApp langsung ke nomor wali dengan pesan terisi otomatis
  Future<bool> openWhatsAppDirect({
    required String? rawPhone,
    required String message,
  }) async {
    final phone = normalizeWaPhone(rawPhone);
    if (phone.isEmpty) return false;
    final uri = Uri.parse('https://wa.me/$phone?text=${Uri.encodeComponent(message)}');
    if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
      await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  /// Menghasilkan format pesan teks WhatsApp rapi untuk wali santri
  String generateWhatsAppText({
    required Santri santri,
    required List<TransaksiHarian> mutasiList,
    required PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan,
    bool isProUser = false,
  }) {
    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    final todayStr = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(DateTime.now());

    buffer.writeln('*Assalamu’alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh* 🌸\n');
    buffer.writeln('Yth. *Bapak/Ibu Wali Santri*');
    buffer.writeln('dari ananda tercinta: *${santri.namaLengkap}* (${santri.namaPanggilan})');
    buffer.writeln('Kamar / Kelas: *${santri.kamar}*\n');
    buffer.writeln('Semoga Bapak/Ibu senantiasa dalam keadaan sehat wal afiat dan selalu dalam lindungan Allah SWT. Aamiin.\n');
    buffer.writeln('Izin menyampaikan laporan rekapitulasi mutasi buku kas santri per $todayStr:\n');
    buffer.writeln('💰 *STATUS TITIPAN & JATAH SANTRI:*');
    buffer.writeln('• Sisa Saldo Titipan: *${CurrencyFormatter.format(santri.saldoTotal)}*');
    buffer.writeln('• Standar Jatah Harian: *${CurrencyFormatter.format(santri.jatahHarian)} / hari*');
    buffer.writeln('• Estimasi Ketahanan: ±*${santri.estimasiHari} hari* ke depan');
    if (santri.tunggakan > 0) {
      final ket = santri.catatanTunggakan.isNotEmpty ? ' (${santri.catatanTunggakan})' : '';
      buffer.writeln('• 🚨 *Catatan Tunggakan/Talangan:* *${CurrencyFormatter.format(santri.tunggakan)}*$ket');
    } else {
      buffer.writeln('• ✅ *Status Administrasi:* Bersih / Bebas Tunggakan');
    }
    buffer.writeln('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
    buffer.writeln('📜 *Riwayat Transaksi Terbaru:*');

    final displayList = mutasiList.take(8).toList();
    if (displayList.isEmpty) {
      buffer.writeln('  _Belum ada riwayat transaksi pada periode ini._');
    } else {
      for (var tx in displayList) {
        if (tx.isVoided) continue;
        final icon = tx.tipe == TipeTransaksi.setoran ? '📥 [Setoran]' : '📤 [Ambil]';
        final waktu = DateFormatter.formatFullDateTime(tx.waktuAmbil);
        final nominal = CurrencyFormatter.format(tx.nominal);
        final ket = tx.catatan != null && tx.catatan!.isNotEmpty ? ' (${tx.catatan})' : '';
        buffer.writeln('  • $icon $waktu');
        buffer.writeln('    Nominal: *$nominal*$ket | Sisa: ${CurrencyFormatter.format(tx.saldoSetelahTransaksi)}');
      }
    }

    buffer.writeln('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
    buffer.writeln('Demikian laporan buku mutasi ini kami sampaikan dengan amanah demi transparansi keuangan santri di *${pengaturan.namaPondok}*.\n');
    buffer.writeln('*Jazakumullah Khairan Katsiran*');
    buffer.writeln('*Wassalamu’alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh* 🙏\n');
    buffer.writeln('Pengurus Kas: *${pengaturan.namaPengurus}*');
    if (pengaturan.kontakPengurus.isNotEmpty) {
      buffer.writeln('Kontak: ${pengaturan.kontakPengurus}');
    }
    if (!isProUser) {
      buffer.writeln('\n_Dicatat dengan Kas-Santri_');
    }

    return buffer.toString();
  }

  /// Pesan pengingat sopan saat saldo santri kritis (< 3 hari) atau memiliki tunggakan
  String generateCriticalReminderText({
    required Santri santri,
    required String namaPondok,
    required String namaPengurus,
  }) {
    final statusTunggakan = santri.tunggakan > 0
        ? '• 🚨 Tunggakan Talangan: *${CurrencyFormatter.format(santri.tunggakan)}*${santri.catatanTunggakan.isNotEmpty ? ' (${santri.catatanTunggakan})' : ''}\n'
        : '';
    return '''*Assalamu’alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh* 🌸

Yth. *Bapak/Ibu Wali Santri* dari ananda *${santri.namaLengkap}* (${santri.kamar}),

Menginformasikan dengan penuh takdzim bahwa saldo titipan uang saku ananda saat ini berada pada status *Kritis (< 3 Hari)*:
• 💰 Sisa Saldo: *${CurrencyFormatter.format(santri.saldoTotal)}*
• 📆 Estimasi Ketahanan: ±*${santri.estimasiHari} hari* (Jatah ${CurrencyFormatter.format(santri.jatahHarian)}/hari)
$statusTunggakan
Mohon kiranya Bapak/Ibu dapat menyiapkan setoran lanjutan agar kebutuhan harian ananda di *$namaPondok* tetap berjalan lancar.

*Jazakumullah Khairan Katsiran*
*Wassalamu’alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh* 🙏
— *$namaPengurus ($namaPondok)*''';
  }

  /// Kirim langsung via WhatsApp (jika nomor wali tersedia) atau Share Sheet
  Future<void> sendWhatsAppReport({
    required Santri santri,
    required List<TransaksiHarian> mutasiList,
    required PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan,
  }) async {
    final text = generateWhatsAppText(
      santri: santri,
      mutasiList: mutasiList,
      pengaturan: pengaturan,
    );

    if (santri.noWaWali != null && santri.noWaWali!.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      var phone = santri.noWaWali!.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), '');
      if (phone.startsWith('0')) {
        phone = '62${phone.substring(1)}';
      }
      final uri = Uri.parse('https://wa.me/$phone?text=${Uri.encodeComponent(text)}');
      if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
        await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
        return;
      }
    }

    // Jika tidak ada nomor WA atau gagal membuka WA langsung, buka sheet share
    await Share.share(
      text,
      subject: 'Laporan Uang Saku Santri - ${santri.namaLengkap}',
    );
  }

  /// Format pesan teks WhatsApp Struk Pembagian Setoran Sambangan (Infak + Uang Jajan)
  String generateSambanganReceiptText({
    required Santri santri,
    required InfakSantriModel infak,
    required PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan,
    required int totalDiterima,
    required int sisaJajan,
    required int jatahBaru,
    int nominalPotongTunggakan = 0,
    bool isProUser = false,
  }) {
    final masakLabel = infak.isMasakBebas
        ? '✓ Bebas / Ikut Saudara'
        : CurrencyFormatter.format(infak.nominalMasak);
    final listrikLabel = infak.isListrikBebas
        ? '✓ Bebas / Ikut Saudara'
        : CurrencyFormatter.format(infak.nominalListrik);
    final String berasLabel;
    if (infak.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasBebas) {
      berasLabel = '✓ Bebas Beras';
    } else if (infak.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasFisik) {
      final literStr = infak.berasLiter == infak.berasLiter.roundToDouble()
          ? infak.berasLiter.toInt().toString()
          : infak.berasLiter.toString();
      berasLabel = '🌾 Fisik $literStr Liter (Rp 0)';
    } else if (infak.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasUangVal) {
      berasLabel = CurrencyFormatter.format(infak.berasUang);
    } else {
      berasLabel = '⏳ Belum Setor Beras';
    }

    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    buffer.writeln('*Assalamu’alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh* 🌸\n');
    buffer.writeln('Alhamdulillah, telah kami terima titipan *Setoran Sambangan* dari Wali Santri ananda:');
    buffer.writeln('• Nama: *${santri.namaLengkap}* (${santri.kategoriLabel})');
    if (santri.kamar.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      buffer.writeln('• Kamar / Kelas: *${santri.kamar}*');
    }
    buffer.writeln('• Total Uang Diterima: *${CurrencyFormatter.format(totalDiterima)}* (${infak.sumberDompet})');
    buffer.writeln('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
    buffer.writeln('🌾 *RINCIAN POS INFAK BULANAN (${infak.periodeBulan}):*');
    buffer.writeln('• Infak Masak / Makan: $masakLabel');
    buffer.writeln('• Infak Listrik: $listrikLabel');
    buffer.writeln('• Infak Beras: $berasLabel');
    buffer.writeln('• Masa Berlaku: *${infak.tglMasuk}* s.d. *${infak.tglHabis}*');
    buffer.writeln('• Status Infak: *${infak.statusLunas}*');
    if (nominalPotongTunggakan > 0) {
      buffer.writeln('• 🚨 Potong Tunggakan: *${CurrencyFormatter.format(nominalPotongTunggakan)}*');
    }
    buffer.writeln('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');

    buffer.writeln('— *${pengaturan.namaPengurus} (${pengaturan.namaPondok})*');

import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class ClockTamperCheckResult {
  final bool isTampered;
  final String? reason;
  final String message;
  final DateTime effectiveNow;
  final int driftMinutes;

  const ClockTamperCheckResult({
    required this.isTampered,
    this.reason,
    required this.message,
    required this.effectiveNow,
    this.driftMinutes = 0,
  });
}

class AppIntegrityReport {
  final bool isReleaseBuild;
  final bool isDebuggable;
  final bool hasTestKeys;
  final bool hasRootBinary;
  final bool isEmulator;
  final String signingCertSha256;
  final List<String> warnings;

  const AppIntegrityReport({
    required this.isReleaseBuild,
    required this.isDebuggable,
    required this.hasTestKeys,
    required this.hasRootBinary,
    required this.isEmulator,
    required this.signingCertSha256,
    required this.warnings,
  });

  bool get hasRiskSignals =>
      (isReleaseBuild && isDebuggable) || hasTestKeys || hasRootBinary;

  String get statusLabel {
    if (!hasRiskSignals) {
      return isReleaseBuild
          ? 'Terlindungi (Release Hardened)'
          : 'Mode Pengembangan (Debug Build)';
    }
    return 'Perlu Perhatian (${warnings.length} indikator)';
  }
}

/// Penjaga Keamanan v3.3:
/// 1. Anti-Clock Tampering (Monotonic timestamp di SecureStorage + HTTP Date sync)
/// 2. Mode Privasi Layar / Blokir Screenshot (`FLAG_SECURE` Android)
/// 3. Pemeriksaan integritas build/perangkat saat startup
class SecurityGuardService {
  static final SecurityGuardService instance = SecurityGuardService._init();
  SecurityGuardService._init();

  static const String _keyLastKnownTsMs = 'last_known_timestamp';
  static const String _keyScreenPrivacy = 'ks_v33_screen_privacy';
  static const MethodChannel _channel =
      MethodChannel('com.pondok.kassantri/security');

  static const Duration defaultTolerance = Duration(minutes: 15);
  static const String clockTamperWarningMessage =
      'Jam perangkat tidak sinkron. Aktifkan Tanggal & Waktu Otomatis untuk melanjutkan.';

  final FlutterSecureStorage _secureStorage = const FlutterSecureStorage(
    aOptions: AndroidOptions(encryptedSharedPreferences: true),
  );

  Future<String?> _readSecureOrPref(String key) async {
    try {
      final sec = await _secureStorage.read(key: key);
      if (sec != null && sec.isNotEmpty) return sec;
    } catch (_) {}
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getString(key);
  }

  Future<void> _writeSecureAndClearPref(String key, String value) async {
    bool written = false;
    try {
      await _secureStorage.write(key: key, value: value);
      written = true;
    } catch (_) {
      written = false;
    }
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (written) {
      await prefs.remove(key);
    } else {
      await prefs.setString(key, value);
    }
  }

  /// Fungsi murni (unit-testable) untuk mendeteksi manipulasi jam perangkat.
  static ClockTamperCheckResult evaluateClockTamper({
    required DateTime currentNow,
    required int? lastKnownEpochMs,
    DateTime? networkNow,
    Duration tolerance = defaultTolerance,
  }) {
    final currentMs = currentNow.millisecondsSinceEpoch;
    final tolMs = tolerance.inMilliseconds;

    if (lastKnownEpochMs != null && currentMs < lastKnownEpochMs - tolMs) {
      final diffMin = ((lastKnownEpochMs - currentMs) / 60000).ceil();
      return ClockTamperCheckResult(
        isTampered: true,
        reason: 'CLOCK_REWIND',
        message: clockTamperWarningMessage,
        effectiveNow: DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(lastKnownEpochMs),
        driftMinutes: diffMin,
      );
    }

    if (networkNow != null) {
      final diffMs = (currentMs - networkNow.millisecondsSinceEpoch).abs();
      if (diffMs > tolMs) {
        final diffMin = (diffMs / 60000).ceil();
        return ClockTamperCheckResult(
          isTampered: true,
          reason: 'NETWORK_DRIFT',
          message: clockTamperWarningMessage,
          effectiveNow: networkNow.toLocal(),
          driftMinutes: diffMin,
        );
      }
    }

    return ClockTamperCheckResult(
      isTampered: false,
      message: 'Waktu perangkat sinkron.',
      effectiveNow: currentNow,
      driftMinutes: 0,
    );
  }

  /// Cek jam perangkat terhadap monotonic timestamp & optional network time,
  /// lalu memajukan `last_known_timestamp` secara aman (tidak pernah mundur).
  Future<ClockTamperCheckResult> checkAndAdvanceClock({
    DateTime? nowOverride,
    DateTime? networkNowOverride,
    bool allowNetworkSync = false,
  }) async {
    final currentNow = nowOverride ?? DateTime.now();
    final rawLast = await _readSecureOrPref(_keyLastKnownTsMs);
    final lastMs = rawLast != null ? int.tryParse(rawLast) : null;

    DateTime? netNow = networkNowOverride;
    if (netNow == null && allowNetworkSync) {
      netNow = await syncTrustedTimeFromNetwork();
    }

    final result = evaluateClockTamper(
      currentNow: currentNow,
      lastKnownEpochMs: lastMs,
      networkNow: netNow,
    );

    if (!result.isTampered) {
      final candidates = <int>[
        currentNow.millisecondsSinceEpoch,
        if (lastMs != null) lastMs,
        if (netNow != null) netNow.millisecondsSinceEpoch,
      ];
      final maxEpochMs = candidates.reduce((a, b) => a > b ? a : b);
      await _writeSecureAndClearPref(_keyLastKnownTsMs, maxEpochMs.toString());
    } else if (netNow != null) {
      // Saat terdeteksi mundur namun punya waktu jaringan yang lebih baru, tetap kunci batas minimum ke network time.
      final floorMs = [
        if (lastMs != null) lastMs,
        netNow.millisecondsSinceEpoch,
      ].reduce((a, b) => a > b ? a : b);
      await _writeSecureAndClearPref(_keyLastKnownTsMs, floorMs.toString());
    }

    return result;
  }

  /// Sinkronisasi waktu pasif melalui HTTP header `Date` (hanya berjalan jika online, gagal sunyi saat offline).
  Future<DateTime?> syncTrustedTimeFromNetwork({
    http.Client? client,
    Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 4),
  }) async {
    final httpClient = client ?? http.Client();
    const urls = [
      'https://www.google.com/generate_204',
      'https://cloudflare.com/cdn-cgi/trace',
    ];
    try {
      for (final rawUrl in urls) {
        try {
          final resp = await httpClient
              .head(Uri.parse(rawUrl))
              .timeout(timeout);
          final dateHeader = resp.headers['date'];
          if (dateHeader != null && dateHeader.trim().isNotEmpty) {
            return HttpDate.parse(dateHeader.trim()).toUtc();
          }
        } catch (_) {
          // Lanjutkan kandidat endpoint berikutnya atau kembali offline secara sunyi
        }
      }
      return null;
    } finally {
      if (client == null) {
        httpClient.close();
      }
    }
  }

  Future<bool> getScreenPrivacyEnabled() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getBool(_keyScreenPrivacy) ?? false;
  }

  Future<void> setScreenPrivacyEnabled(bool enabled) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setBool(_keyScreenPrivacy, enabled);
    await _applyFlagSecureNative(enabled);
  }

  Future<void> applySavedScreenPrivacy() async {
    final enabled = await getScreenPrivacyEnabled();
    await _applyFlagSecureNative(enabled);
  }

  Future<void> _applyFlagSecureNative(bool enabled) async {
    try {
      await _channel.invokeMethod<bool>('setSecureScreen', {
        'enabled': enabled,
      });
    } catch (_) {
      // Aman di platform non-Android / unit test
    }
  }

  Future<AppIntegrityReport> checkAppIntegrity() async {
    bool isDebuggable = kDebugMode;
    bool hasTestKeys = false;
    bool hasRootBinary = false;
    bool isEmulator = false;
    String signingCert = '';

    try {
      final raw = await _channel
          .invokeMapMethod<String, dynamic>('checkDeviceIntegrity');
      if (raw != null) {
        isDebuggable = (raw['isDebuggable'] as bool?) ?? isDebuggable;
        hasTestKeys = (raw['hasTestKeys'] as bool?) ?? false;
        hasRootBinary = (raw['hasRootBinary'] as bool?) ?? false;
        isEmulator = (raw['isEmulator'] as bool?) ?? false;
        signingCert = (raw['signingCertSha256'] as String?) ?? '';
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Tidak memblokir jika channel belum tersedia
    }

    final warnings = <String>[];
    if (kReleaseMode && isDebuggable) {
      warnings.add('Build rilis memiliki flag debuggable aktif');
    }
    if (hasTestKeys) {
      warnings.add('Sistem Android menggunakan test-keys');
    }
    if (hasRootBinary) {
      warnings.add('Terdeteksi biner su/root pada sistem');
    }

    return AppIntegrityReport(
      isReleaseBuild: kReleaseMode,
      isDebuggable: isDebuggable,
      hasTestKeys: hasTestKeys,
      hasRootBinary: hasRootBinary,
      isEmulator: isEmulator,
      signingCertSha256: signingCert,
      warnings: warnings,
    );
  }
}
