import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../models/infak_santri.dart';
import '../models/santri.dart';
import '../utils/currency_formatter.dart';
import '../utils/date_formatter.dart';

enum ReminderCategory { saldoKritis, infakJatuhTempo, tunggakan }

class ReminderQueueItem {
  final ReminderCategory category;
  final Santri santri;
  final InfakSantriModel? infak;
  final String badgeText;
  final String priorityDetail;

  const ReminderQueueItem({
    required this.category,
    required this.santri,
    this.infak,
    required this.badgeText,
    required this.priorityDetail,
  });

  String get uniqueKey => '${category.name}:${santri.id}';
}

/// Mesin Antrean Pengingat WA Cerdas (Smart WA Reminder Queue) v4.0.
/// Mengelompokkan prioritas tanpa spam & menyimpan tanda kirim harian di lokal.
class SmartWaReminderService {
  static final SmartWaReminderService instance =
      SmartWaReminderService._init();
  SmartWaReminderService._init();

  static String _prefsKeyForDate(DateTime date) =>
      'ks_v40_wa_sent_${DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(date)}';

  static Map<ReminderCategory, List<ReminderQueueItem>> buildPriorityQueues({
    required List<Santri> activeSantri,
    required List<InfakSantriModel> infakPeriodeList,
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    final refNow = (now ?? DateTime.now()).toLocal();
    final today = DateTime(refNow.year, refNow.month, refNow.day);

    final infakMap = <String, InfakSantriModel>{
      for (final i in infakPeriodeList) i.santriId: i,
    };

    final kritis = <ReminderQueueItem>[];
    final infakTempo = <ReminderQueueItem>[];
    final tunggakanList = <ReminderQueueItem>[];

    for (final s in activeSantri) {
      if (!s.isAktifDiPondok) continue;

      // 1. Saldo Kritis (< 3 hari)
      if (s.estimasiHari < 3) {
        kritis.add(
          ReminderQueueItem(
            category: ReminderCategory.saldoKritis,
            santri: s,
            badgeText: 'Sisa ${s.estimasiHari} Hari',
            priorityDetail:
                'Saldo tersisa ${CurrencyFormatter.format(s.saldoTotal)} (Jatah ${CurrencyFormatter.format(s.jatahHarian)}/hari)',
          ),
        );
      }

      // 2. Infak Jatuh Tempo (H-3 s.d. lewat tgl habis, atau belum lunas)
      final inf = infakMap[s.id];
      if (inf == null || inf.statusLunas != InfakSantriModel.statusLunasVal) {
        final badge = inf == null
            ? 'Belum Bayar'
            : (inf.statusLunas == InfakSantriModel.statusCicilVal
                ? 'Masih Cicil'
                : 'Belum Lunas');
        infakTempo.add(
          ReminderQueueItem(
            category: ReminderCategory.infakJatuhTempo,
            santri: s,
            infak: inf,
            badgeText: badge,
            priorityDetail: inf == null
                ? 'Infak bulan ini belum tercatat lunas'
                : 'Infak periode ${inf.periodeBulan} berstatus $badge',
          ),
        );
      } else {
        final habis = DateTime.tryParse(inf.tglHabis);
        if (habis != null) {
          final habisDate = DateTime(habis.year, habis.month, habis.day);
          final diffDays = habisDate.difference(today).inDays;
          if (diffDays <= 3) {
            infakTempo.add(
              ReminderQueueItem(
                category: ReminderCategory.infakJatuhTempo,
                santri: s,
                infak: inf,
                badgeText: diffDays < 0
                    ? 'Lewat ${diffDays.abs()}h'
                    : (diffDays == 0 ? 'Jatuh Tempo' : 'H-$diffDays'),
                priorityDetail: 'Tgl habis infak: ${inf.tglHabis}',
              ),
            );
          }
        }
      }

      // 3. Tunggakan Aktif
      if (s.tunggakan > 0) {
        tunggakanList.add(
          ReminderQueueItem(
            category: ReminderCategory.tunggakan,
            santri: s,
            badgeText: CurrencyFormatter.format(s.tunggakan),
            priorityDetail: s.catatanTunggakan.isNotEmpty
                ? s.catatanTunggakan
                : 'Talangan kas pondok belum dilunasi',
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    return {
      ReminderCategory.saldoKritis: kritis,
      ReminderCategory.infakJatuhTempo: infakTempo,
      ReminderCategory.tunggakan: tunggakanList,
    };
  }

  /// Menyusun pesan pengingat santun berbahasa pesantren dengan nominal akurat.
  static String composePoliteMessage({
    required ReminderQueueItem item,
    required String namaPondok,
  }) {
    final s = item.santri;
    final header = '*Assalamu’alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh* 🌸\n\n'
        'Yth. *Bapak/Ibu Wali Santri* dari ananda *${s.namaLengkap}* (${s.kamar}),\n'
        'Semoga Bapak/Ibu sekeluarga selalu diberi kesehatan dan keberkahan.\n\n';
    final footer =
        '\n\nApabila hendak mengirimkan titipan atau konfirmasi, silakan membalas pesan ini. '
        'Jazakumullah khairan katsiran.\n'
        '*Wassalamu’alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh* 🙏\n'
        '_Pengurus Kas & Keuangan ${namaPondok}_';

    switch (item.category) {
      case ReminderCategory.saldoKritis:
        return '${header}Dengan hormat kami menginformasikan bahwa saldo titipan uang saku ananda saat ini tersisa '
            '*${CurrencyFormatter.format(s.saldoTotal)}* (estimasi cukup sekitar *${s.estimasiHari} hari* dengan jatah ${CurrencyFormatter.format(s.jatahHarian)}/hari).\n'
            'Mohon berkenan menyiapkan kiriman setoran berikutnya agar kebutuhan harian ananda tetap lancar.$footer';
      case ReminderCategory.infakJatuhTempo:
        final tglInfo = item.infak != null
            ? ' (jatuh tempo: *${item.infak!.tglHabis}*)'
            : '';
        return '${header}Dengan hormat kami mengingatkan kewajiban *Infak Bulanan Pondok* (Masak, Listrik & Beras) '
            'ananda saat ini berstatus *${item.badgeText}*$tglInfo.\n'
            'Kami ucapkan terima kasih atas perhatian dan kerja sama Bapak/Ibu.$footer';
      case ReminderCategory.tunggakan:
        final ket = s.catatanTunggakan.isNotEmpty ? ' (${s.catatanTunggakan})' : '';
        return '${header}Dengan hormat kami menyampaikan informasi bahwa ananda masih memiliki catatan administrasi/tunggakan '
            'sebesar *${CurrencyFormatter.format(s.tunggakan)}*$ket.\n'
            'Pelunasan dapat dititipkan saat sambangan atau digabungkan dengan setoran berikutnya.$footer';
    }
  }

  Future<Set<String>> getSentKeysToday({DateTime? now}) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final key = _prefsKeyForDate(now ?? DateTime.now());
    return (prefs.getStringList(key) ?? const []).toSet();
  }

  Future<Set<String>> markSentToday(String uniqueKey, {DateTime? now}) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final key = _prefsKeyForDate(now ?? DateTime.now());
    final set = (prefs.getStringList(key) ?? const []).toSet();
    set.add(uniqueKey);
    await prefs.setStringList(key, set.toList());
    return set;
  }
}

/// Flag compile-time pembeda jalur distribusi:
/// - `false` (default): Build Direct APK (pembayaran langsung ke DANA 082130678956 + Kode Lisensi PRO)
/// - `true`: Build Google Play Store AAB (Google Play Billing resmi tanpa menu DANA/kode luar)

class TrialStatus {
  final bool hasUsedTrial;
  final bool isActive;
  final bool isExpired;
  final int remainingDays;
  final DateTime? startedAt;
  final DateTime? expiresAt;

  const TrialStatus({

    this.isActive = false,
    this.isExpired = false,
    this.remainingDays = 0,
    this.startedAt,
    this.expiresAt,
  });
}

class SubscriptionPlanOffer {
  final String planKey; // YEARLY, MONTHLY, LIFETIME
  final String productId;
  final String title;
  final String priceString;
  final int fallbackPriceInt;
  final String periodText;
  final String subtitle;
  final String? strikePrice;
  final String? badgeText;
  final bool isPopularBadge;
  final String tagText;
  final Package? rcPackage;

  const SubscriptionPlanOffer({
    required this.planKey,
    required this.productId,
    required this.title,
    required this.priceString,
    required this.fallbackPriceInt,
    required this.periodText,
    required this.subtitle,
    this.strikePrice,
    this.badgeText,
    this.isPopularBadge = true,
    required this.tagText,
    this.rcPackage,
  });

  SubscriptionPlanOffer copyWith({
    String? priceString,
    Package? rcPackage,
  }) {
    return SubscriptionPlanOffer(
      planKey: planKey,
      productId: productId,
      title: title,
      priceString: priceString ?? this.priceString,
      fallbackPriceInt: fallbackPriceInt,
      periodText: periodText,
      subtitle: subtitle,
      strikePrice: strikePrice,
      badgeText: badgeText,
      isPopularBadge: isPopularBadge,
      tagText: tagText,
      rcPackage: rcPackage ?? this.rcPackage,
    );
  }
}

class SubscriptionPurchaseResult {
  final bool success;
  final bool cancelled;
  final String? planKey;
  final String message;

  const SubscriptionPurchaseResult({
    required this.success,
    this.cancelled = false,
    this.planKey,
    required this.message,
  });
}

class SubscriptionService {
  static final SubscriptionService instance = SubscriptionService._init();
  SubscriptionService._init();

  static const int trialDurationDays = 14;
  static const String _keyTrialStartedAt = 'kas_santri_trial_started_at_v1';
  static const String _keyTrialExpiresAt = 'kas_santri_trial_expires_at_v1';
  static const String _keyHasUsedTrial = 'kas_santri_has_used_trial_v1';

  final FlutterSecureStorage _secureStorage = const FlutterSecureStorage(
    aOptions: AndroidOptions(encryptedSharedPreferences: true),
  );

  bool _isConfigured = false;
  bool get isConfigured => _isConfigured;

  bool _isProActive = false;
  bool _isTrialActive = false;

  /// Status paket PRO berbayar/lisensi aktif (selain trial).
  bool get isProActive => _isProActive;

  /// Status Uji Coba Gratis 14 Hari aktif.
  bool get isTrialActive => _isTrialActive;

  /// Gerbang pengecekan terpusat akses fitur PRO di seluruh aplikasi.
  bool get hasProAccess => isProActive || isTrialActive;

  void updateAccessState({
    required bool isProActive,
    required bool isTrialActive,
  }) {
    _isProActive = isProActive;
    _isTrialActive = isTrialActive;
  }

  static String qrisAssetForPlan(String planKey) {
    switch (planKey.toUpperCase()) {
      case 'MONTHLY':
        return 'assets/qris_dana_25k.jpg';
      case 'LIFETIME':
        return 'assets/qris_dana_399k.jpg';
      case 'YEARLY':
      default:
        return 'assets/qris_dana_179k.jpg';
    }
  }

  static TrialStatus evaluateTrial({
    required bool hasUsedTrial,
    DateTime? startedAt,
    DateTime? expiresAt,
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    if (!hasUsedTrial || expiresAt == null) {
      return TrialStatus(
        hasUsedTrial: hasUsedTrial,
        isActive: false,
        isExpired: false,
        remainingDays: 0,
        startedAt: startedAt,
        expiresAt: expiresAt,
      );
    }

    final refNow = now ?? DateTime.now();
    if (refNow.isBefore(expiresAt)) {
      final diffSeconds = expiresAt.difference(refNow).inSeconds;
      final days = (diffSeconds / 86400).ceil().clamp(1, trialDurationDays);
      return TrialStatus(
        hasUsedTrial: true,
        isActive: true,
        isExpired: false,
        remainingDays: days,
        startedAt: startedAt,
        expiresAt: expiresAt,
      );
    }

    return TrialStatus(
      hasUsedTrial: true,
      isActive: false,
      isExpired: true,
      remainingDays: 0,
      startedAt: startedAt,
      expiresAt: expiresAt,
    );
  }

  Future<TrialStatus> getTrialStatus({
    bool? fallbackHasUsed,
    String? fallbackStartedAt,
    String? fallbackExpiresAt,
    DateTime? now,
  }) async {
    String? startedRaw;
    String? expiresRaw;
    String? usedRaw;

    try {
      startedRaw = await _secureStorage.read(key: _keyTrialStartedAt);
      expiresRaw = await _secureStorage.read(key: _keyTrialExpiresAt);
      usedRaw = await _secureStorage.read(key: _keyHasUsedTrial);
    } catch (_) {}

    if (usedRaw == null || expiresRaw == null) {
      try {
        final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
        startedRaw ??= prefs.getString(_keyTrialStartedAt);
        expiresRaw ??= prefs.getString(_keyTrialExpiresAt);
        if (usedRaw == null && prefs.containsKey(_keyHasUsedTrial)) {
          usedRaw = (prefs.getBool(_keyHasUsedTrial) ?? false) ? '1' : '0';
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    final hasUsed = usedRaw == '1' || (fallbackHasUsed ?? false);
    final startedAt = DateTime.tryParse(startedRaw ?? fallbackStartedAt ?? '');
    final expiresAt = DateTime.tryParse(expiresRaw ?? fallbackExpiresAt ?? '');

    if (hasUsed && expiresAt != null) {
      await _persistTrialData(
        startedAt: startedAt ?? expiresAt.subtract(const Duration(days: trialDurationDays)),
        expiresAt: expiresAt,
      );
    }

    final evaluated = evaluateTrial(
      hasUsedTrial: hasUsed,
      startedAt: startedAt,
      expiresAt: expiresAt,
      now: now,
    );
    _isTrialActive = evaluated.isActive;
    return evaluated;
  }

  Future<void> _persistTrialData({
    required DateTime startedAt,
    required DateTime expiresAt,
  }) async {
    final sStr = startedAt.toIso8601String();
    final eStr = expiresAt.toIso8601String();
    bool savedToSecure = false;
    try {
      await _secureStorage.write(key: _keyTrialStartedAt, value: sStr);
      await _secureStorage.write(key: _keyTrialExpiresAt, value: eStr);
      await _secureStorage.write(key: _keyHasUsedTrial, value: '1');
      savedToSecure = true;
    } catch (_) {
      savedToSecure = false;
    }
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      if (savedToSecure) {
        // Hapus salinan plaintext di SharedPreferences setelah aman di Keystore
        await prefs.remove(_keyTrialStartedAt);
        await prefs.remove(_keyTrialExpiresAt);
        await prefs.remove(_keyHasUsedTrial);
      } else {
        await prefs.setString(_keyTrialStartedAt, sStr);
        await prefs.setString(_keyTrialExpiresAt, eStr);
        await prefs.setBool(_keyHasUsedTrial, true);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<({bool success, TrialStatus status, String message})> startFreeTrial14Days({
    bool? fallbackHasUsed,
    String? fallbackStartedAt,
    String? fallbackExpiresAt,
    DateTime? now,
  }) async {
    final current = await getTrialStatus(
      fallbackHasUsed: fallbackHasUsed,
      fallbackStartedAt: fallbackStartedAt,
      fallbackExpiresAt: fallbackExpiresAt,
      now: now,
    );

    if (current.hasUsedTrial) {
      if (current.isActive) {
        return (
          success: false,
          status: current,
          message: 'Uji coba PRO 14 hari sudah aktif (sisa ${current.remainingDays} hari).',
        );
      }
      return (
        success: false,
        status: current,
        message: 'Uji coba gratis 14 hari sudah pernah digunakan pada perangkat ini.',
      );
    }

    final effectiveNow = now ?? DateTime.now();
    final expiresAt = effectiveNow.add(const Duration(days: trialDurationDays));
    await _persistTrialData(startedAt: effectiveNow, expiresAt: expiresAt);
    final activeStatus = evaluateTrial(
      hasUsedTrial: true,
      startedAt: effectiveNow,
      expiresAt: expiresAt,
      now: effectiveNow,
    );
    _isTrialActive = activeStatus.isActive;

    return (
      success: true,
      status: activeStatus,
      message: 'Uji Coba PRO 14 Hari Aktif! Seluruh fitur premium terbuka penuh.',
    );
  }

  static String planKeyFromProductId(String? productId) {
    if (productId == AppConfig.productIdMonthly) return 'MONTHLY';
    if (productId == AppConfig.productIdLifetime) return 'LIFETIME';
    return 'YEARLY';
  }

  static String planDisplayName(String? planKey) {
    switch (planKey) {
      case 'TRIAL_14D':
        return 'Uji Coba Gratis (14 Hari)';
      case 'MONTHLY':
        return 'Pro Bulanan (1 Bulan)';
      case 'LIFETIME':
        return 'Pro Selamanya (Lifetime)';
      case 'YEARLY':
      default:
        return 'Pro Tahun Ajaran (12 Bulan)';
    }
  }

  static List<SubscriptionPlanOffer> defaultFallbackOffers() {
    return const [
      SubscriptionPlanOffer(
        planKey: 'YEARLY',
        productId: AppConfig.productIdYearly,
        title: 'Pro Tahun Ajaran (12 Bulan)',
        priceString: 'Rp 179.000',
        fallbackPriceInt: 179000,
        periodText: '/ tahun',
        subtitle: 'Setara Rp 14.900/bulan',
        strikePrice: 'Rp 300.000',
        badgeText: '🔥 PALING LARIS • HEMAT 40%',
        isPopularBadge: true,
        tagText: 'Prabayar • Bisa QRIS & VA Bank',
      ),
      SubscriptionPlanOffer(
        planKey: 'MONTHLY',
        productId: AppConfig.productIdMonthly,
        title: 'Pro Bulanan (1 Bulan)',
        priceString: 'Rp 25.000',
        fallbackPriceInt: 25000,
        periodText: '/ bulan',
        subtitle: 'Cocok untuk coba dulu 1 bulan',
        tagText: 'Prabayar • Tidak perpanjang otomatis',
      ),
      SubscriptionPlanOffer(
        planKey: 'LIFETIME',
        productId: AppConfig.productIdLifetime,
        title: 'Pro Selamanya (Lifetime)',
        priceString: 'Rp 399.000',
        fallbackPriceInt: 399000,
        periodText: 'sekali bayar',
        subtitle: 'Sekali beli untuk akun pondok',
        badgeText: '👑 SEKALI BAYAR',
        isPopularBadge: false,
        tagText: 'Aktif permanen • Bebas biaya tahunan',
      ),
    ];
  }

  Future<void> init() async {
    if (_isConfigured) return;
    if (!AppConfig.isRevenueCatConfigured) return;
    if (kIsWeb || !Platform.isAndroid) return;

    try {
      await Purchases.configure(
        PurchasesConfiguration(AppConfig.revenueCatAndroidApiKey),
      );
      _isConfigured = true;
    } catch (_) {
      _isConfigured = false;
    }
  }

  /// Mengambil paket dari Play Store via RevenueCat dengan fallback harga default lokal
  Future<List<SubscriptionPlanOffer>> loadOffers() async {
    final baseOffers = defaultFallbackOffers();
    await init();
    if (!_isConfigured) return baseOffers;

    try {
      final offerings = await Purchases.getOfferings();
      final available = offerings.current?.availablePackages ?? const <Package>[];
      if (available.isEmpty) return baseOffers;

      return baseOffers.map((offer) {
        Package? matched;
        for (final pkg in available) {
          if (pkg.storeProduct.identifier == offer.productId) {
            matched = pkg;
            break;
          }
        }
        if (matched == null) return offer;
        return offer.copyWith(
          priceString: matched.storeProduct.priceString,
          rcPackage: matched,
        );
      }).toList();
    } catch (_) {
      return baseOffers;
    }
  }

  Future<({bool isPro, String? planKey})> checkEntitlementStatus() async {
    await init();
    if (!_isConfigured) return (isPro: false, planKey: null);

    try {
      final info = await Purchases.getCustomerInfo();
      final entitlement = info.entitlements.active[AppConfig.entitlementId];
      if (entitlement == null) {
        return (isPro: false, planKey: null);
      }
      return (
        isPro: true,
        planKey: planKeyFromProductId(entitlement.productIdentifier),
      );
    } catch (_) {
      return (isPro: false, planKey: null);
    }
  }

  Future<SubscriptionPurchaseResult> purchasePackage(
    SubscriptionPlanOffer offer,
  ) async {
    await init();
    if (!_isConfigured) {
      return const SubscriptionPurchaseResult(
        success: false,
        message:
            'Google Play Billing belum aktif (API Key RevenueCat belum dikonfigurasi).',
      );
    }
    if (offer.rcPackage == null) {
      return SubscriptionPurchaseResult(
        success: false,
        message:
            'Paket ${offer.productId} belum tersedia di Offering Google Play Console saat ini.',
      );
    }

    try {
      final dynamic result = await Purchases.purchasePackage(offer.rcPackage!);
      final CustomerInfo customerInfo = result is CustomerInfo
          ? result
          : (result.customerInfo as CustomerInfo);
      final entitlement =
          customerInfo.entitlements.active[AppConfig.entitlementId];
      if (entitlement != null) {
        return SubscriptionPurchaseResult(
          success: true,
          planKey: planKeyFromProductId(entitlement.productIdentifier),
          message: 'Alhamdulillah! ${offer.title} berhasil diaktifkan.',
        );
      }
      return const SubscriptionPurchaseResult(
        success: false,
        message: 'Pembelian diproses, namun entitlement PRO belum aktif.',
      );
    } on PlatformException catch (e) {
      final code = PurchasesErrorHelper.getErrorCode(e);
      if (code == PurchasesErrorCode.purchaseCancelledError) {
        return const SubscriptionPurchaseResult(
          success: false,
          cancelled: true,
          message: 'Pembayaran dibatalkan oleh pengguna.',
        );
      }
      return SubscriptionPurchaseResult(
        success: false,
        message: e.message ?? 'Terjadi kendala saat memproses Google Play Billing.',
      );
    } catch (e) {
      return SubscriptionPurchaseResult(
        success: false,
        message: 'Gagal memulai pembayaran Google Play: $e',
      );
    }
  }

  Future<SubscriptionPurchaseResult> restorePurchases() async {
    await init();
    if (!_isConfigured) {
      return const SubscriptionPurchaseResult(
        success: false,
        message:
            'Sinkronisasi Google Play Billing membutuhkan koneksi internet & API Key RevenueCat aktif.',
      );
    }

    try {
      final info = await Purchases.restorePurchases();
      final entitlement = info.entitlements.active[AppConfig.entitlementId];
      if (entitlement != null) {
        final planKey = planKeyFromProductId(entitlement.productIdentifier);
        return SubscriptionPurchaseResult(
          success: true,
          planKey: planKey,
          message:
              'Alhamdulillah! Langganan ${planDisplayName(planKey)} berhasil dipulihkan.',
        );
      }
      return const SubscriptionPurchaseResult(
        success: false,
        message: 'Belum ditemukan pembelian PRO aktif pada akun Google Play ini.',
      );
    } catch (e) {
      return SubscriptionPurchaseResult(
        success: false,
        message: 'Gagal memulihkan pembelian Google Play: $e',
      );
    }
  }
}

/// Facade ekspor laporan resmi Yayasan & Buku Infak Kas-Santri v4.2 yang
/// mendelegasikan pembuatan Excel (`.xlsx` via background isolate `compute()`)
/// ke `YayasanExcelExporter` dan dokumen PDF A4 ke `YayasanPdfExporter`.
class YayasanExportService {
  static final YayasanExportService instance = YayasanExportService._init();
  YayasanExportService._init();

  final YayasanExcelExporter excelExporter = const YayasanExcelExporter();
  final YayasanPdfExporter pdfExporter = const YayasanPdfExporter();

  static String periodLabel(
    ExportPeriod period, {
    DateTime? customStart,
    DateTime? customEnd,
  }) {
    switch (period) {
      case ExportPeriod.hariIni:
        return 'Hari Ini';
      case ExportPeriod.kemarin:
        return 'Kemarin';
      case ExportPeriod.tujuhHari:
        return '7 Hari Terakhir';
      case ExportPeriod.bulanIni:
        return 'Bulan Ini';
      case ExportPeriod.rentangKhusus:
        if (customStart != null && customEnd != null) {
          return '${DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(customStart)} s.d. ${DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(customEnd)}';
        }
        return '📅 Rentang Khusus';
      case ExportPeriod.semua:
        return 'Semua Riwayat';
    }
  }

  static ({String? mulai, String? selesai, String label}) resolveRange(
    ExportPeriod period, {
    DateTime? customStart,
    DateTime? customEnd,
  }) {
    final now = DateTime.now().toLocal();
    final today = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(now);
    switch (period) {
      case ExportPeriod.hariIni:
        return (mulai: today, selesai: today, label: 'Hari Ini ($today)');
      case ExportPeriod.kemarin:
        final yest = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(
          now.subtract(const Duration(days: 1)),
        );
        return (mulai: yest, selesai: yest, label: 'Kemarin ($yest)');
      case ExportPeriod.tujuhHari:
        final start = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(
          now.subtract(const Duration(days: 6)),
        );
        return (
          mulai: start,
          selesai: today,
          label: '7 Hari ($start s.d. $today)',
        );
      case ExportPeriod.bulanIni:
        final start = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(
          DateTime(now.year, now.month, 1),
        );
        return (
          mulai: start,
          selesai: today,
          label: 'Bulan Ini ($start s.d. $today)',
        );
      case ExportPeriod.rentangKhusus:
        final sDate = customStart ?? now;
        final eDate = customEnd ?? sDate;
        final startStr = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(sDate);
        final endStr = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(eDate);
        return (
          mulai: startStr,
          selesai: endStr,
          label: 'Rentang ($startStr s.d. $endStr)',
        );
      case ExportPeriod.semua:
        return (mulai: null, selesai: null, label: 'Semua Periode');
    }
  }

      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

class CurrencyFormatter {
  static final NumberFormat _formatter = NumberFormat.currency(
    locale: 'id_ID',
    symbol: 'Rp ',
    decimalDigits: 0,
  );

  static final NumberFormat _compactFormatter = NumberFormat.compactCurrency(
    locale: 'id_ID',
    symbol: 'Rp ',
    decimalDigits: 0,
  );

  /// Format angka integer ke string Rupiah, contoh: 10000 -> "Rp 10.000"
  static String format(int amount) {
    return _formatter.format(amount);
  }

  /// Format tanpa prefix Rp, contoh: 10000 -> "10.000"
  static String formatWithoutSymbol(int amount) {
    final formatNumber = NumberFormat('#,###', 'id_ID');
    return formatNumber.format(amount);
  }

  /// Format ringkas, contoh: 1500000 -> "Rp 1,5 jt"
  static String formatCompact(int amount) {
    return _compactFormatter.format(amount);
  }

  /// Parsing input string angka dengan pemisah titik menjadi integer murni
  static int parse(String text) {
    final cleanText = text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), '');
    if (cleanText.isEmpty) return 0;
    return int.tryParse(cleanText) ?? 0;
  }

  /// Hitung jatah harian dengan pembulatan otomatis ke bawah (kelipatan Rp 500 atau Rp 1.000)
  /// agar tidak muncul pecahan ganjil seperti Rp 8.333/hari. Selisih pembulatan tetap utuh di saldo santri.
  static int hitungJatahHarianBulat(int nominalBersih, int durasiHari, {int kelipatan = 500}) {
    if (nominalBersih <= 0 || durasiHari <= 0) return 0;
    final step = kelipatan <= 0 ? 500 : kelipatan;
    final raw = nominalBersih ~/ durasiHari;
    final rounded = (raw ~/ step) * step;
    return rounded > 0 ? rounded : raw;
  }

  /// Hitung selisih pembulatan yang tetap tersimpan utuh di saldo santri
  static int hitungSelisihPembulatan(int nominalBersih, int durasiHari, int jatahBulat) {
    if (nominalBersih <= 0 || durasiHari <= 0) return 0;
    return (nominalBersih - (jatahBulat * durasiHari)).clamp(0, nominalBersih);
  }
}

/// TextInputFormatter untuk memformat pemisah ribuan titik otomatis saat mengetik (misal: 10.000)
class RibuanInputFormatter extends TextInputFormatter {
  @override
  TextEditingValue formatEditUpdate(TextEditingValue oldValue, TextEditingValue newValue) {
    final digitsOnly = newValue.text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), '');
    if (digitsOnly.isEmpty) {
      return const TextEditingValue(
        text: '',
        selection: TextSelection.collapsed(offset: 0),
      );
    }

    final number = int.tryParse(digitsOnly) ?? 0;
    final formatted = CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(number);
    return TextEditingValue(
      text: formatted,
      selection: TextSelection.collapsed(offset: formatted.length),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

class DateFormatter {
  static final DateFormat _localDateFormat = DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd');
  static final DateFormat _displayDateFormat = DateFormat('d MMMM yyyy', 'id_ID');
  static final DateFormat _fullDateTimeFormat = DateFormat('d MMM yyyy, HH:mm', 'id_ID');
  static final DateFormat _timeOnlyFormat = DateFormat('HH:mm', 'id_ID');
  static final DateFormat _monthYearFormat = DateFormat('MMMM yyyy', 'id_ID');

  /// Menghasilkan format YYYY-MM-DD murni waktu lokal perangkat (anti-geser UTC)
  static String toLocalDateString(DateTime date) {
    final local = date.toLocal();
    return _localDateFormat.format(DateTime(local.year, local.month, local.day));
  }

  /// Parse YYYY-MM-DD menjadi DateTime tengah malam lokal
  static DateTime parseLocalDate(String ymd) {
    final parts = ymd.trim().split('-');
    if (parts.length == 3) {
      final y = int.tryParse(parts[0]);
      final m = int.tryParse(parts[1]);
      final d = int.tryParse(parts[2]);
      if (y != null && m != null && d != null) {
        return DateTime(y, m, d);
      }
    }
    return DateTime.tryParse(ymd)?.toLocal() ?? DateTime.now();
  }

  /// Menghasilkan format periode YYYY-MM berdasarkan waktu lokal perangkat
  static String formatPeriodeBulan(DateTime dt) {
    final local = dt.toLocal();
    return '${local.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-${local.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  /// Menghitung Tahun Ajaran Masehi akurat untuk periode YYYY-MM
  /// (Juli–Desember = Y/(Y+1), Januari–Juni = (Y-1)/Y)
  static String formatAcademicYearForPeriode(
    String ym, {
    String? configuredTa,
  }) {
    final parts = ym.trim().split('-');
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final y = parts.length == 2 ? (int.tryParse(parts[0]) ?? now.year) : now.year;
    final m = parts.length == 2 ? (int.tryParse(parts[1]) ?? now.month).clamp(1, 12) : now.month;

    final startYear = m >= 7 ? y : y - 1;
    final endYear = startYear + 1;
    final span = '$startYear/$endYear';

    final trimmedTa = configuredTa?.trim() ?? '';
    if (trimmedTa.isNotEmpty && trimmedTa.contains(span)) {
      return trimmedTa;
    }
    if (trimmedTa.isNotEmpty) {
      final replaced = trimmedTa.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'\d{4}/\d{4}'), span);
      if (replaced != trimmedTa) return replaced;
    }
    return '$span M';
  }

  /// Menghasilkan format tanggal Indonesia, contoh: "23 November 2026"
  static String formatDisplayDate(DateTime date) {
    return _displayDateFormat.format(date.toLocal());
  }

  /// Menghasilkan format tanggal dan waktu lokal, contoh: "23 Nov 2026, 12:45"
  static String formatFullDateTime(DateTime date) {
    return _fullDateTimeFormat.format(date.toLocal());
  }

  /// Menghasilkan jam presisi lokal dengan WIB, contoh: "12:45 WIB"
  static String formatTimeWithWIB(DateTime date) {
    return '${_timeOnlyFormat.format(date.toLocal())} WIB';
  }

  /// Format Bulan dan Tahun lokal, contoh: "November 2026"
  static String formatMonthYear(DateTime date) {
    return _monthYearFormat.format(date.toLocal());
  }
}

enum TimeCategory { pagi, siang, sore, malam, setoran }

class TimeCategoryHelper {
  /// Mengelompokkan waktu pengambilan:
  /// - PAGI: 05:00 - 10:59
  /// - SIANG: 11:00 - 14:59
  /// - SORE: 15:00 - 17:59
  /// - MALAM: 18:00 - 04:59
  static TimeCategory fromDateTime(DateTime dateTime) {
    final hour = dateTime.hour;
    if (hour >= 5 && hour < 11) {
      return TimeCategory.pagi;
    } else if (hour >= 11 && hour < 15) {
      return TimeCategory.siang;
    } else if (hour >= 15 && hour < 18) {
      return TimeCategory.sore;
    } else {
      return TimeCategory.malam;
    }
  }

  static String toDbString(TimeCategory category) {
    switch (category) {
      case TimeCategory.pagi:
        return 'PAGI';
      case TimeCategory.siang:
        return 'SIANG';
      case TimeCategory.sore:
        return 'SORE';
      case TimeCategory.malam:
        return 'MALAM';
      case TimeCategory.setoran:
        return 'SETORAN';
    }
  }

  static String getDbString(TimeCategory category) => toDbString(category);

  static TimeCategory fromDbString(String str) {
    switch (str.toUpperCase()) {
      case 'PAGI':
        return TimeCategory.pagi;
      case 'SIANG':
        return TimeCategory.siang;
      case 'SORE':
        return TimeCategory.sore;
      case 'SETORAN':
        return TimeCategory.setoran;
      case 'MALAM':
      default:
        return TimeCategory.malam;
    }
  }

  static String getLabel(TimeCategory category) {
    switch (category) {
      case TimeCategory.pagi:
        return 'Pagi';
      case TimeCategory.siang:
        return 'Siang';
      case TimeCategory.sore:
        return 'Sore';
      case TimeCategory.malam:
        return 'Malam';
      case TimeCategory.setoran:
        return 'Setoran';
    }
  }

  static String getEmoji(TimeCategory category) {
    switch (category) {
      case TimeCategory.pagi:
        return '🌅';
      case TimeCategory.siang:
        return '☀️';
      case TimeCategory.sore:
        return '🌇';
      case TimeCategory.malam:
        return '🌙';
      case TimeCategory.setoran:
        return '📥';
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:ui';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../providers/theme_wallpaper_provider.dart';

/// Pembungkus latar global aplikasi 60–120 FPS:
/// - Blur dijalankan HANYA 1 kali di layer global terisolasi `RepaintBoundary`.
/// - Gambar dimuat hemat RAM memakai `ResizeImage(..., width: 1080)`.
/// - Dilapisi dark vignette lembut agar kontras teks di atas foto matahari terbit selalu tajam.
class AppBackgroundWrapper extends StatelessWidget {
  final Widget child;

  const AppBackgroundWrapper({Key? key, required this.child}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final wp = Provider.of<ThemeWallpaperProvider>(context);
    final spec = wp.activeSpec;
    final hasCustom = wp.hasValidCustomWallpaper;
    final topScrim = (wp.wallpaperDim + 0.14).clamp(0.28, 0.90);
    final midScrim = (wp.wallpaperDim * 0.86).clamp(0.18, 0.82);
    final botScrim = (wp.wallpaperDim + 0.22).clamp(0.38, 0.94);

    return Stack(
      fit: StackFit.expand,
      children: [
        RepaintBoundary(
          child: Stack(
            fit: StackFit.expand,
            children: [
              if (hasCustom)
                Image(
                  image: ResizeImage(
                    FileImage(File(wp.customWallpaperPath!)),
                    width: 1080,
                  ),
                  fit: BoxFit.cover,
                  filterQuality: FilterQuality.low,
                  errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _buildPresetCanvas(spec),
                )
              else if (spec.bundledAssetPath != null)
                Image(
                  image: ResizeImage(
                    AssetImage(spec.bundledAssetPath!),
                    width: 1080,
                  ),
                  fit: BoxFit.cover,
                  filterQuality: FilterQuality.low,
                  errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _buildPresetCanvas(spec),
                )
              else
                _buildPresetCanvas(spec),

              if (wp.wallpaperBlur > 0.25)
                Positioned.fill(
                  child: ClipRect(
                    child: BackdropFilter(
                      filter: ImageFilter.blur(
                        sigmaX: wp.wallpaperBlur,
                        sigmaY: wp.wallpaperBlur,
                      ),
                      child: const ColoredBox(color: Colors.transparent),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),

              // Dark vignette scrim 3-lapis agar teks putih & neon selalu kontras tajam
              Positioned.fill(
                child: DecoratedBox(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    gradient: LinearGradient(
                      begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                      end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                      colors: [
                        const Color(0xFF030712).withValues(alpha: topScrim),
                        const Color(0xFF040A18).withValues(alpha: midScrim),
                        const Color(0xFF020610).withValues(alpha: botScrim),
                      ],
                      stops: const [0.0, 0.48, 1.0],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        child,
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPresetCanvas(WallpaperPresetSpec spec) {
    return DecoratedBox(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          colors: spec.gradientColors,
          begin: Alignment.topLeft,
          end: Alignment.bottomRight,
        ),
      ),
      child: Stack(
        children: [
          Positioned(
            top: -80,
            left: -50,
            child: Container(
              width: 280,
              height: 280,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                gradient: RadialGradient(
                  colors: [
                    spec.glowPrimary.withValues(alpha: 0.34),
                    spec.glowPrimary.withValues(alpha: 0.0),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Positioned(
            bottom: 40,
            right: -60,
            child: Container(
              width: 300,
              height: 300,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                gradient: RadialGradient(
                  colors: [
                    spec.glowSecondary.withValues(alpha: 0.30),
                    spec.glowSecondary.withValues(alpha: 0.0),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Kartu Vibrant Translucent Glass (TANPA BackdropFilter di dalam list agar 60–120 FPS mulus).
class GlassCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final Widget child;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry? margin;
  final double borderRadius;
  final Color? borderColor;
  final List<Color>? gradientColors;
  final double blurSigma;
  final double opacityMultiplier;
  final Color baseColor;

  const GlassCard({
    Key? key,
    required this.child,
    this.padding = const EdgeInsets.all(18),
    this.margin,
    this.borderRadius = 24,
    this.borderColor,
    this.gradientColors,
    this.blurSigma = 0,
    this.opacityMultiplier = 1.0,
    this.baseColor = const Color(0xFF0A192F),
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cardOpacity = Provider.of<ThemeWallpaperProvider>(context).cardOpacity;
    final effectiveOpacity = (cardOpacity * opacityMultiplier).clamp(0.28, 0.94);
    final accent = borderColor ?? const Color(0xFF38BDF8);

    final List<Color> resolvedGradient;
    if (gradientColors != null && gradientColors!.length >= 2) {
      resolvedGradient = gradientColors!
          .map(
            (c) => c.withValues(
              alpha: (c.a * effectiveOpacity).clamp(0.18, 0.94),
            ),
          )
          .toList();
    } else {
      resolvedGradient = [
        Color.lerp(const Color(0xFF082032), accent, 0.24)!
            .withValues(alpha: (effectiveOpacity * 0.92).clamp(0.28, 0.90)),
        Color.lerp(baseColor, const Color(0xFF091326), 0.55)!
            .withValues(alpha: (effectiveOpacity * 0.98).clamp(0.34, 0.94)),
        Color.lerp(const Color(0xFF050B18), accent, 0.10)!
            .withValues(alpha: (effectiveOpacity * 1.02).clamp(0.38, 0.95)),
      ];
    }

    final resolvedBorder = borderColor != null
        ? borderColor!.withValues(alpha: (borderColor!.a * 0.95).clamp(0.32, 0.65))
        : const Color(0xFF38BDF8).withValues(alpha: 0.34);

    return RepaintBoundary(
      child: Container(
        margin: margin,
        padding: padding,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            colors: resolvedGradient,
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
          ),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(borderRadius),
          border: Border.all(color: resolvedBorder, width: 1.15),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: accent.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
              blurRadius: 18,
              offset: const Offset(0, 6),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: child,
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Logo Netral Resmi Kas-Santri (Multi-Pondok) dengan dukungan logo kustom PRO.
class KasSantriLogoMark extends StatelessWidget {

  const KasSantriLogoMark({
    Key? key,
    this.customLogoPath,
    this.size = 44,
    this.borderRadius = 14,
    this.circular = false,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final hasCustom =
        customLogoPath != null && customLogoPath!.trim().isNotEmpty;

    final Widget inner = hasCustom
        ? Image(
            image: ResizeImage(
              FileImage(File(customLogoPath!)),
              width: 256,
            ),
            fit: BoxFit.cover,
            errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _buildNeutralEmblem(),
          )
        : _buildNeutralEmblem();

    if (circular) {
      return SizedBox(
        width: size,
        height: size,
        child: ClipOval(child: inner),
      );
    }

    return SizedBox(
      width: size,
      height: size,
      child: ClipRRect(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(borderRadius),
        child: inner,
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNeutralEmblem() {
    return DecoratedBox(
      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          colors: [Color(0xFF064E3B), Color(0xFF0E7490), Color(0xFF1E1B4B)],

        child: Icon(
          Icons.mosque_rounded,
          color: const Color(0xFF6EE7B7),
          size: size * 0.54,
        ),
      ),

  }

    if (widget.focusActivationInput) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (mounted) _licenseFocus.requestFocus();
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _licenseController.dispose();
    _licenseFocus.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadDeviceId() async {
    final id = await LicenseService.instance.getOrCreateDeviceId();
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() => _deviceId = id);
    }
  }

  void _showSnack(String message, {Color color = const Color(0xFF10B981)}) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(message, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
        backgroundColor: color,
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 20),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _copyText(String text, String label) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text));
    _showSnack('$label ($text) berhasil disalin!');
  }

  Future<void> _shareQrisImage() async {
    if (_isSharingQris) return;
    AppFeedback.tap();
    setState(() => _isSharingQris = true);
    try {
      final assetPath = SubscriptionService.qrisAssetForPlan(widget.offer.planKey);
      final bytes = await rootBundle.load(assetPath);
      final dir = await getTemporaryDirectory();
      final fileName = 'qris_kas_santri_${widget.offer.planKey.toLowerCase()}.jpg';
      final file = File('${dir.path}/$fileName');
      await file.writeAsBytes(bytes.buffer.asUint8List());
      await Share.shareXFiles(
        [XFile(file.path)],
        text:
            'QRIS Pembayaran Kas-Santri PRO — ${widget.offer.title} (${widget.offer.priceString})\nMerchant: ${AppConfig.qrisMerchantName}',
      );
    } catch (e) {
      _showSnack(
        'Gagal membagikan gambar QRIS ($e). Silakan transfer ke DANA ${AppConfig.adminDanaNumber}.',
        color: const Color(0xFFF59E0B),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isSharingQris = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openWhatsAppAdmin() async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    final namaPondok = provider.pengaturan.namaPondok;
    final idPerangkat = _deviceId;

    final message = '''Assalamu'alaikum Admin Kas-Santri (${AppConfig.adminAccountName}),

Saya ingin mengonfirmasi pembayaran & meminta Kode Aktivasi Kas-Santri PRO:
• Nama Pondok: $namaPondok
• Paket Dipilih: ${widget.offer.title}
• Nominal Transfer: ${widget.offer.priceString}
• Tujuan: DANA / QRIS ${AppConfig.adminDanaNumber}
• ID Perangkat: $idPerangkat

Berikut saya lampirkan bukti transfernya. Terima kasih.''';

    final uri = Uri.parse(
      'https://wa.me/${AppConfig.adminWhatsappNumber}?text=${Uri.encodeComponent(message)}',
    );
    if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
      await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
    } else {
      await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: message));
      _showSnack(
        'WhatsApp tidak ditemukan. Pesan konfirmasi telah disalin—kirim ke ${AppConfig.adminDanaNumber}.',
        color: const Color(0xFFF59E0B),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pasteFromClipboard() async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final data = await Clipboard.getData(Clipboard.kTextPlain);
    final raw = data?.text?.trim() ?? '';
    if (raw.isEmpty) {
      _showSnack('Clipboard masih kosong.', color: const Color(0xFFF59E0B));
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _licenseController.text = LicenseService.normalizeLicenseCode(raw);
      _inlineError = null;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _activateLicenseCode() async {
    if (_isActivating) return;
    AppFeedback.tap();
    setState(() {
      _isActivating = true;
      _inlineError = null;
    });

    try {
      final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
      final res = await provider.activateOfflineLicense(_licenseController.text);
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (res.isValid) {
        AppFeedback.success();
        Navigator.pop(context, true);
      } else {
        AppFeedback.alert();
        setState(() => _inlineError = res.message);
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isActivating = false);
    }
  }

              if (errorMsg != null) ...[

            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () {
                final p1 = pwdCtrl.text;
                if (p1.trim().length < 4) {
                  setDlg(() => errorMsg = 'Password minimal 4 karakter.');
                  return;
                }
                if (confirmField && p1 != confirmCtrl.text) {
                  setDlg(() => errorMsg = 'Konfirmasi password tidak sama.');
                  return;
                }
                Navigator.pop(ctx, p1);
              },
              child: Text(actionLabel),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    return result;
  }

  static Future<void> backupEncryptedKsbak(BuildContext context) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    if (!provider.hasProAccess) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: 'Backup Terenkripsi Militer AES-256 (.KSBAK)',
      );
      return;
    }
    final password = await _promptBackupPassword(
      context,
      title: 'Buat Backup Terenkripsi (.KSBAK)',
      subtitle:
          'File akan dikunci dengan AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2-SHA256. Simpan password ini baik-baik karena tidak bisa dipulihkan jika lupa.',
      actionLabel: 'Enkripsi & Bagikan',
      confirmField: true,
    );
    if (password == null || !context.mounted) return;

    try {
      final dump = await DatabaseHelper.instance.dumpBackupJson();
      final encryptedBytes = await BackupService.encryptBackupToKsbak(
        backupData: dump,
        password: password,
      );
      final dir = await getTemporaryDirectory();
      final file = File(
        p.join(
          dir.path,
          'backup_kas_santri_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.ksbak',
        ),
      );
      await file.writeAsBytes(encryptedBytes, flush: true);
      AppFeedback.success();
      await Share.shareXFiles(
        [XFile(file.path)],
        text: 'Backup Terenkripsi Kas-Santri (.KSBAK)',
      );
    } catch (e) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      if (context.mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Gagal membuat backup .ksbak: $e'),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  static Future<void> restoreBackupAnyFormat(
    BuildContext context,
    KasSantriProvider provider,
  ) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    try {
      final result = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: ['json', 'ksbak'],
      );
      if (result == null || result.files.single.path == null) return;
      final filePath = result.files.single.path!;
      final Uint8List bytes = await File(filePath).readAsBytes();
      final isKsbak = filePath.toLowerCase().endsWith('.ksbak') ||
          BackupService.isEncryptedKsbakBytes(bytes);

      final BackupValidationResult validation;
      if (isKsbak) {
        if (!context.mounted) return;
        if (!provider.hasProAccess) {
          AppFeedback.alert();
          await PaywallScreen.show(
            context,
            triggerFeature: 'Buka & Pulihkan Backup Terenkripsi AES-256 (.KSBAK)',
          );
          return;
        }
        final password = await _promptBackupPassword(
          context,
          title: 'Buka Backup Terenkripsi (.KSBAK)',
          subtitle: 'Masukkan password enkripsi yang dipakai saat membuat file .ksbak ini.',
          actionLabel: 'Buka & Verifikasi',
        );
        if (password == null) return;
        validation = await BackupService.decryptAndValidateKsbak(
          bytes: bytes,
          password: password,
        );
      } else {
        final rawJson = await File(filePath).readAsString();
        validation = BackupService.validateJsonString(rawJson);
      }

      if (!context.mounted) return;
      if (!validation.isValid || validation.parsedData == null) {
        AppFeedback.alert();
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(
              validation.errorMessage ?? 'File backup tidak valid atau rusak.',
            ),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),
          ),
        );
        return;
      }

      final exportedDt = validation.exportedAt != null
          ? DateTime.tryParse(validation.exportedAt!)
          : null;
      final dateText = exportedDt != null
          ? DateFormatter.formatFullDateTime(exportedDt)
          : '-';

      final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
          title: const Text(
            'Pulihkan Data Backup?',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 15.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
          ),
          content: Text(
            'Format: ${isKsbak ? 'Terenkripsi (.KSBAK)' : 'Standar (.JSON)'}\n'
            'Tanggal Backup: $dateText\n\n'
            '• Santri: ${validation.santriCount} • Setoran: ${validation.setoranCount}\n'
            '• Transaksi: ${validation.transaksiCount} • Mutasi: ${validation.mutasiDompetCount}\n'
            '• Infak: ${validation.infakCount} • Serah Terima: ${validation.serahTerimaInfakCount}\n\n'
            'Data lokal saat ini akan diganti dengan data backup.',
            style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
              child: const Text('Batal', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
              child: const Text('Ya, Pulihkan'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );

      if (confirm == true && context.mounted) {
        await provider.restoreFromBackupJson(validation.parsedData!);
        if (context.mounted) {
          AppFeedback.success();
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(
              content: Text('Alhamdulillah! Data backup berhasil dipulihkan.'),
              backgroundColor: Color(0xFF10B981),
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      if (context.mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Gagal memulihkan backup: $e'),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }
}

    );
  }

  State<FastWithdrawalBottomSheet> createState() => _FastWithdrawalBottomSheetState();
}

class _FastWithdrawalBottomSheetState extends State<FastWithdrawalBottomSheet> {
  final TextEditingController _nominalController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _customKeperluanController = TextEditingController(text: 'Jajan Harian');
  TimeCategory _selectedWaktu = TimeCategory.malam;
  String _selectedKeperluan = 'Jajan Harian';
  OverlimitHandling _selectedPolicy = OverlimitHandling.potongBesok;

  final List<String> _tagChips = [
    'Jajan Pagi',
    'Jajan Siang',
    'Jajan Sore',
    'Jajan Malam',
    'Sabun/Cuci',
    'Obat',
    'Fotokopi',
    'Kitab',
    'Potong Rambut',
  ];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    // Default select time based on taken periods
    final txList = widget.statusSantri.transaksiHariIni;
    final takenPeriods = txList.map((t) => t.kategoriWaktu).toList();
    if (!takenPeriods.contains(TimeCategory.pagi)) {
      _selectedWaktu = TimeCategory.pagi;
    } else if (!takenPeriods.contains(TimeCategory.siang)) {
      _selectedWaktu = TimeCategory.siang;
    } else if (!takenPeriods.contains(TimeCategory.sore)) {
      _selectedWaktu = TimeCategory.sore;
    } else {
      _selectedWaktu = TimeCategory.malam;
    }

    final sisa = widget.statusSantri.sisaJatahHariIni;
    if (sisa > 0) {
      final initialVal = sisa >= 2000 ? 2000 : sisa;
      _nominalController.text = CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(initialVal);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nominalController.dispose();
    _customKeperluanController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  int get _nominal => CurrencyFormatter.parse(_nominalController.text);
  Santri get _santri => widget.statusSantri.santri;
  int get _sisaJatah => widget.statusSantri.sisaJatahHariIni;
  bool get _isOverlimit => _nominal > _sisaJatah;
  bool get _isSaldoKurang => _nominal > _santri.saldoTotal;

  void _addQuickChip(int amount) {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    setState(() {
      final cur = _nominal;
      _nominalController.text = CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(cur + amount);
    });
  }

  void _pasSisa() {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    setState(() {
      final val = _sisaJatah > 0 ? _sisaJatah : 0;
      _nominalController.text = val > 0 ? CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(val) : '0';
    });
  }

  String _getInitials(String name) {
    if (name.trim().isEmpty) return 'KS';
    final parts = name.trim().split(RegExp(r'\s+'));
    if (parts.length >= 2) return (parts[0][0] + parts[1][0]).toUpperCase();
    return parts[0].substring(0, parts[0].length >= 2 ? 2 : 1).toUpperCase();
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    if (_nominal <= 0) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Masukkan nominal pengambilan lebih dari Rp 0!'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFFF43F5E),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final String finalCatatan = _customKeperluanController.text.trim().isNotEmpty
        ? _customKeperluanController.text.trim()
        : _selectedKeperluan;

    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    await provider.catatPengambilan(
      santri: _santri,
      nominal: _nominal,
      catatan: finalCatatan,
      isOverlimit: _isOverlimit || _isSaldoKurang,
      overlimitHandling: _isOverlimit ? _selectedPolicy : null,
      waktuCategory: _selectedWaktu,
    );

    if (_isSaldoKurang) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
    } else {
      AppFeedback.success();
    }

    if (mounted) {
      final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
      final kekurangan = _nominal - _santri.saldoTotal;
      final isKurang = _isSaldoKurang;

      final bottomMargin = MediaQuery.of(context).padding.bottom + 84;

      Navigator.pop(context);
      UndoToastHelper.showPostWithdrawal(
        messenger: messenger,
        provider: provider,
        message: message,
        bottomMargin: bottomMargin,
        isWarning: isKurang,
      );
    }
  }

import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class SpotlightStepSpec {
  final GlobalKey targetKey;
  final int tabIndex;
  final String emoji;
  final String title;
  final String description;
  final Color accent;

  const SpotlightStepSpec({
    required this.targetKey,
    required this.tabIndex,
    required this.emoji,
    required this.title,
    required this.description,
    required this.accent,
  });
}

/// Overlay interaktif Guided Spotlight Tour (6 Langkah) murni CustomPainter
/// tanpa BackdropFilter agar 100% mulus 60-120 FPS di semua perangkat Android.
class GuidedSpotlightOverlay extends StatefulWidget {
  final List<SpotlightStepSpec> steps;
  final int currentStep;
  final VoidCallback onNext;
  final VoidCallback onPrev;
  final VoidCallback onSkip;

  const GuidedSpotlightOverlay({
    Key? key,
    required this.steps,
    required this.currentStep,
    required this.onNext,
    required this.onPrev,
    required this.onSkip,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<GuidedSpotlightOverlay> createState() => _GuidedSpotlightOverlayState();
}

class _GuidedSpotlightOverlayState extends State<GuidedSpotlightOverlay> {
  Rect? _targetRect;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _scheduleMeasure();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant GuidedSpotlightOverlay oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.currentStep != widget.currentStep) {
      _scheduleMeasure();
    }
  }

  void _scheduleMeasure() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      _measureTarget(retryIfNull: true);
    });
  }

  void _measureTarget({required bool retryIfNull}) {
    if (!mounted || widget.currentStep >= widget.steps.length) return;
    final spec = widget.steps[widget.currentStep];
    final targetCtx = spec.targetKey.currentContext;
    final overlayBox = context.findRenderObject() as RenderBox?;
    final targetBox = targetCtx?.findRenderObject() as RenderBox?;

    if (overlayBox != null &&
        targetBox != null &&
        overlayBox.hasSize &&
        targetBox.hasSize &&
        targetBox.attached) {
      final topLeft = targetBox.localToGlobal(Offset.zero, ancestor: overlayBox);
      final rect = topLeft & targetBox.size;
      setState(() => _targetRect = rect);
    } else {
      setState(() => _targetRect = null);
      if (retryIfNull) {
        Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 180), () {
          if (mounted) _measureTarget(retryIfNull: false);
        });
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (widget.currentStep < 0 || widget.currentStep >= widget.steps.length) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    final spec = widget.steps[widget.currentStep];
    final total = widget.steps.length;
    final isLast = widget.currentStep == total - 1;
    final mq = MediaQuery.of(context);
    final screenH = mq.size.height;
    final safeTop = mq.padding.top + 12;
    final safeBottom = mq.padding.bottom + 16;

    final spot = _targetRect;
    final bool placeBelow = spot == null || spot.center.dy < screenH * 0.52;

    double? cardTop;
    double? cardBottom;
    if (spot == null) {
      cardTop = screenH * 0.28;
    } else if (placeBelow) {
      cardTop = math.min(spot.bottom + 16, screenH - 270 - safeBottom);
      cardTop = math.max(cardTop, safeTop);
    } else {
      final fromBottom = (screenH - spot.top) + 16;
      cardBottom = math.max(fromBottom, safeBottom);
    }

    return Material(
      color: Colors.transparent,
      child: Stack(
        children: [
          // Scrim gelap dengan lubang sorotan (Tap di area luar lanjut ke step berikutnya)
          Positioned.fill(
            child: GestureDetector(
              behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
              onTap: widget.onNext,
              child: RepaintBoundary(
                child: CustomPaint(
                  painter: _SpotlightHolePainter(
                    targetRect: spot,
                    accentColor: spec.accent,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),

          // Kartu balon penjelasan Vibrant Glass
          Positioned(
            left: 16,
            right: 16,
            top: cardTop,
            bottom: cardBottom,
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: BoxConstraints(
                maxHeight: screenH - safeTop - safeBottom - 24,
              ),
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    gradient: LinearGradient(
                      colors: [
                        Color.lerp(const Color(0xFF071B2C), spec.accent, 0.22)!
                            .withValues(alpha: 0.96),
                        const Color(0xF6091120),
                      ],
                      begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                      end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                    ),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: spec.accent.withValues(alpha: 0.65),
                      width: 1.4,
                    ),
                    boxShadow: [
                      BoxShadow(
                        color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.65),
                        blurRadius: 24,
                        offset: const Offset(0, 10),
                      ),
                      BoxShadow(
                        color: spec.accent.withValues(alpha: 0.22),
                        blurRadius: 18,
                        spreadRadius: 1,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 10,
                              vertical: 4,
                            ),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: spec.accent.withValues(alpha: 0.20),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                              border: Border.all(
                                color: spec.accent.withValues(alpha: 0.55),
                              ),
                            ),
                            child: Text(
                              'Langkah ${widget.currentStep + 1} / $total',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                color: spec.accent,
                                fontSize: 10.5,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          InkWell(
                            onTap: widget.onSkip,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                            child: const Padding(
                              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 8,
                                vertical: 4,
                              ),
                              child: Text(
                                'Lewati Tutorial ✕',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  color: Colors.white60,
                                  fontSize: 11,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            width: 40,
                            height: 40,
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: spec.accent.withValues(alpha: 0.18),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                              border: Border.all(
                                color: spec.accent.withValues(alpha: 0.50),
                              ),
                            ),
                            alignment: Alignment.center,
                            child: Text(
                              spec.emoji,
                              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20),
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 12),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              spec.title,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white,
                                fontSize: 15,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                                height: 1.25,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 10),
                      Text(
                        spec.description,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          color: Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
                          fontSize: 12.2,
                          height: 1.42,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Row(
                            children: List.generate(total, (idx) {
                              final active = idx == widget.currentStep;
                              return Container(
                                margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 5),
                                width: active ? 18 : 6,
                                height: 6,
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: active ? spec.accent : Colors.white24,
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                                ),
                              );
                            }),
                          ),
                          const Spacer(),
                          if (widget.currentStep > 0) ...[
                            TextButton(
                              onPressed: widget.onPrev,
                              style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                                foregroundColor: Colors.white70,
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                  horizontal: 10,
                                  vertical: 8,
                                ),
                                minimumSize: Size.zero,
                                tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
                              ),
                              child: const Text(
                                '← Kembali',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 11.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 6),
                          ],
                          ElevatedButton(
                            onPressed: widget.onNext,
                            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                              backgroundColor: spec.accent,
                              foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF030712),
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 16,
                                vertical: 10,
                              ),
                              minimumSize: Size.zero,
                              tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
                              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                              ),
                            ),
                            child: Text(
                              isLast ? 'Selesai ✓' : 'Lanjut →',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _SpotlightHolePainter extends CustomPainter {
  final Rect? targetRect;
  final Color accentColor;

  const _SpotlightHolePainter({
    required this.targetRect,
    required this.accentColor,
  });

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final fullPath = Path()..addRect(Offset.zero & size);
    final scrimPaint = Paint()
      ..color = const Color(0xD6030712)
      ..style = PaintingStyle.fill;

    if (targetRect == null) {
      canvas.drawPath(fullPath, scrimPaint);
      return;
    }

    final padded = targetRect!.inflate(6);
    final rrect = RRect.fromRectAndRadius(padded, const Radius.circular(20));
    final holePath = Path()..addRRect(rrect);
    final cutout = Path.combine(PathOperation.difference, fullPath, holePath);
    canvas.drawPath(cutout, scrimPaint);

    // Glow halo + neon border around the highlighted element
    final haloPaint = Paint()
      ..color = accentColor.withValues(alpha: 0.28)
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = 6;
    canvas.drawRRect(rrect.inflate(2), haloPaint);

    final borderPaint = Paint()
      ..color = accentColor
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = 2.0;
    canvas.drawRRect(rrect, borderPaint);
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _SpotlightHolePainter oldDelegate) {
    return oldDelegate.targetRect != targetRect ||
        oldDelegate.accentColor != accentColor;
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';
import '../models/infak_santri.dart';
import '../models/santri.dart';
import '../providers/kas_santri_provider.dart';
import '../screens/paywall_screen.dart';
import '../utils/app_feedback.dart';
import '../utils/currency_formatter.dart';
import '../utils/date_formatter.dart';

class InfakEditBottomSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final Santri santri;
  final String periodeBulan;
  final InfakSantriModel? existingInfak;

  const InfakEditBottomSheet({
    Key? key,
    required this.santri,
    required this.periodeBulan,
    this.existingInfak,
  }) : super(key: key);

  static Future<void> show(
    BuildContext context, {
    required Santri santri,
    required String periodeBulan,
    InfakSantriModel? existingInfak,
  }) async {
    await showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      useSafeArea: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => InfakEditBottomSheet(
        santri: santri,
        periodeBulan: periodeBulan,
        existingInfak: existingInfak,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<InfakEditBottomSheet> createState() => _InfakEditBottomSheetState();
}

class _InfakEditBottomSheetState extends State<InfakEditBottomSheet> {
  late TextEditingController _masakController;
  late TextEditingController _listrikController;
  late TextEditingController _berasLiterController;
  late TextEditingController _berasUangController;
  late TextEditingController _catatanController;

  late bool _isMasakBebas;
  late bool _isListrikBebas;
  late String _jenisBeras;
  late String _sumberDompet;
  late String _tglMasuk;
  late String _tglHabis;
  bool _isSaving = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    final peng = provider.pengaturan;
    final ex = widget.existingInfak;

    final today = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(DateTime.now());
    _tglMasuk = ex?.tglMasuk.isNotEmpty == true ? ex!.tglMasuk : today;
    _tglHabis = ex?.tglHabis.isNotEmpty == true
        ? ex!.tglHabis
        : InfakSantriModel.hitungTglHabis(_tglMasuk);

    _isMasakBebas = ex?.isMasakBebas ?? false;
    _isListrikBebas = ex?.isListrikBebas ?? false;
    _jenisBeras = ex?.jenisBeras ?? InfakSantriModel.berasUangVal;
    _sumberDompet = provider.hasProAccess ? (ex?.sumberDompet ?? 'TUNAI') : 'TUNAI';

    final masakVal = ex != null ? ex.nominalMasak : peng.defaultInfakMasak;
    final listrikVal = ex != null ? ex.nominalListrik : peng.defaultInfakListrik;
    final literVal =
        ex != null && ex.berasLiter > 0 ? ex.berasLiter : peng.defaultInfakBerasLiter;
    final berasUangVal =
        ex != null && ex.berasUang > 0 ? ex.berasUang : peng.defaultInfakBerasUang;

    _masakController = TextEditingController(
      text: CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(masakVal),
    );
    _listrikController = TextEditingController(
      text: CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(listrikVal),
    );
    _berasLiterController = TextEditingController(
      text: literVal == literVal.roundToDouble()
          ? literVal.toInt().toString()
          : literVal.toString(),
    );
    _berasUangController = TextEditingController(
      text: CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(berasUangVal),
    );
    _catatanController = TextEditingController(text: ex?.catatan ?? '');
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _masakController.dispose();
    _listrikController.dispose();
    _berasLiterController.dispose();
    _berasUangController.dispose();
    _catatanController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _pickDate({required bool isMasuk}) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final current = DateTime.tryParse(isMasuk ? _tglMasuk : _tglHabis) ?? DateTime.now();
    final picked = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: current,
      firstDate: DateTime(2020),
      lastDate: DateTime(2035),
    );
    if (picked != null && mounted) {
      final ymd = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(picked);
      setState(() {
        if (isMasuk) {
          _tglMasuk = ymd;
          _tglHabis = InfakSantriModel.hitungTglHabis(ymd);
        } else {
          _tglHabis = ymd;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    if (_isSaving) return;
    setState(() => _isSaving = true);

    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    final peng = provider.pengaturan;
    final masak = _isMasakBebas ? 0 : CurrencyFormatter.parse(_masakController.text);
    final listrik =
        _isListrikBebas ? 0 : CurrencyFormatter.parse(_listrikController.text);
    final liter = _jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasFisik
        ? (double.tryParse(
              _berasLiterController.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.'),
            ) ??
            0.0)
        : 0.0;
    final berasUang = _jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasUangVal
        ? CurrencyFormatter.parse(_berasUangController.text)
        : 0;

    final model = InfakSantriModel(
      id: widget.existingInfak?.id ?? const Uuid().v4(),
      santriId: widget.santri.id,
      periodeBulan: widget.periodeBulan,
      tahunAjaran: peng.tahunAjaran,
      nominalMasak: masak,
      isMasakBebas: _isMasakBebas,
      nominalListrik: listrik,
      isListrikBebas: _isListrikBebas,
      jenisBeras: _jenisBeras,
      berasLiter: liter,
      berasUang: berasUang,
      tglMasuk: _tglMasuk,
      tglHabis: _tglHabis,
      sumberDompet: _sumberDompet,
      setoranId: widget.existingInfak?.setoranId,
      catatan: _catatanController.text.trim().isNotEmpty
          ? _catatanController.text.trim()
          : null,
    );

    await provider.simpanInfakSantri(model);
    AppFeedback.success();
    if (mounted) {
      Navigator.pop(context);
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('Data Infak ${widget.santri.namaLengkap} disimpan!'),
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        ),
      );
    }
  }
