  Widget _berasChip(String label, String value, Color accent) {
    final selected = _jenisBeras == value;
    return InkWell(
      onTap: () {
        AppFeedback.tap();
        setState(() => _jenisBeras = value);
      },
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 7),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: selected ? accent.withOpacity(0.2) : const Color(0xFF060B14),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
          border: Border.all(color: selected ? accent : Colors.white12),
        ),
        child: Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(
            color: selected ? accent : Colors.white70,
            fontSize: 10.5,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _dompetChip(String label, String value, Color accent) {
    final isPro = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context).hasProAccess;
    final isLockedRekening = value == 'REKENING' && !isPro;
    final selected = _sumberDompet == value && !isLockedRekening;
    final displayLabel = isLockedRekening ? '$label 👑' : label;
    return Expanded(
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () {
          AppFeedback.tap();
          if (isLockedRekening) {
            PaywallScreen.show(
              context,
              triggerFeature: 'Multi-Dompet: Pisah Kas Laci Tunai vs Rekening Bank',
            );
            setState(() => _sumberDompet = 'TUNAI');
            return;
          }
          setState(() => _sumberDompet = value);
        },
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 9),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: selected ? accent.withOpacity(0.18) : const Color(0xFF060B14),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            border: Border.all(
              color: selected
                  ? accent
                  : (isLockedRekening
                      ? const Color(0xFFFBBF24).withValues(alpha: 0.45)
                      : Colors.white12),
            ),
          ),
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: Text(
            displayLabel,
            style: TextStyle(
              color: selected
                  ? accent
                  : (isLockedRekening ? const Color(0xFFFDE68A) : Colors.white60),
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class KartuQrSantriDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  final Santri santri;
  final PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan;

  const KartuQrSantriDialog({
    Key? key,
    required this.santri,
    required this.pengaturan,
  }) : super(key: key);

  static Future<void> show(
    BuildContext context, {
    required Santri santri,
    required PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan,
  }) async {
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    if (!provider.hasProAccess) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: 'Cetak & Bagikan Kartu QR Digital Santri',
      );
      return;
    }
    await showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => KartuQrSantriDialog(
        santri: santri,
        pengaturan: pengaturan,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<KartuQrSantriDialog> createState() => _KartuQrSantriDialogState();
}

class _KartuQrSantriDialogState extends State<KartuQrSantriDialog> {
  final ScreenshotController _screenshotController = ScreenshotController();
  bool _isSharing = false;

  Future<void> _captureAndShare() async {
    if (_isSharing) return;
    setState(() => _isSharing = true);
    AppFeedback.tap();
    try {
      final bytes = await _screenshotController.capture(pixelRatio: 3.0);
      if (bytes == null) {
        throw Exception('Gagal menangkap gambar kartu QR.');
      }
      final dir = await getTemporaryDirectory();
      final safeName = widget.santri.namaLengkap
          .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_]'), '_')
          .toLowerCase();
      final file = File(p.join(dir.path, 'kartu_qr_$safeName.png'));
      await file.writeAsBytes(bytes);

      AppFeedback.success();
      await Share.shareXFiles(
        [XFile(file.path)],
        text: 'Kartu QR Kas-Santri — ${widget.santri.namaLengkap} (${widget.santri.kamar})',
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Gagal membagikan kartu QR: $e'),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),

        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isSharing = false);
    }
  }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class NumpadWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  final ValueChanged<String> onKeyPress;
  final VoidCallback onBackspace;
  final VoidCallback onClear;

  const NumpadWidget({
    Key? key,
    required this.onKeyPress,
    required this.onBackspace,
    required this.onClear,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        _buildRow(['1', '2', '3']),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        _buildRow(['4', '5', '6']),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        _buildRow(['7', '8', '9']),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        Row(
          children: [
            // Tombol Clear (C)
            Expanded(
              child: _buildButton(
                child: const Text(
                  'C',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 20,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: Colors.redAccent,
                  ),
                ),
                onTap: onClear,
                bgColor: Colors.red.shade50,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            // Tombol 0
            Expanded(
              child: _buildButton(
                child: const Text(
                  '0',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 22, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                ),
                onTap: () => onKeyPress('0'),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            // Tombol 000
            Expanded(
              child: _buildButton(
                child: const Text(
                  '000',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                ),
                onTap: () => onKeyPress('000'),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            // Tombol Backspace
            Expanded(
              child: _buildButton(
                child: const Icon(
                  Icons.backspace_outlined,
                  size: 22,
                  color: Colors.black87,
                ),
                onTap: onBackspace,
                bgColor: Colors.grey.shade100,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildRow(List<String> keys) {
    return Row(
      children: keys.map((key) {
        return Expanded(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4),
            child: _buildButton(
              child: Text(
                key,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 22,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: Colors.black87,
                ),
              ),
              onTap: () => onKeyPress(key),
            ),
          ),
        );
      }).toList(),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildButton({
    required Widget child,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
    Color? bgColor,
  }) {
    return Material(
      color: bgColor ?? Colors.grey.shade50,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: onTap,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        splashColor: Colors.teal.withOpacity(0.2),
        child: Container(
          height: 52,
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade200),
          ),
          child: child,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

                      ctx,

                      max: 0.85,
                      onChanged: themeProv.setWallpaperDim,
                    ),
                    _miniSlider(
                      ctx,
                      label: 'Efek Blur Latar',
                      valueText: themeProv.wallpaperBlur.toStringAsFixed(1),
                      value: themeProv.wallpaperBlur,
                      min: 0.0,
                      max: 16.0,
                      onChanged: themeProv.setWallpaperBlur,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }

  static Widget _miniSlider(
    BuildContext context, {
    required String label,
    required String valueText,
    required double value,
    required double min,
    required double max,
    required ValueChanged<double> onChanged,
  }) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
          children: [
            Text(
              label,
              style: const TextStyle(
                color: Colors.white70,
                fontSize: 11.5,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
              ),
            ),
            Text(
              valueText,
              style: const TextStyle(
                color: Color(0xFF67E8F9),
                fontSize: 11,
                fontFamily: 'monospace',
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        SliderTheme(
          data: SliderTheme.of(context).copyWith(
            trackHeight: 4,
            thumbShape: const RoundSliderThumbShape(enabledThumbRadius: 7),
          ),
          child: Slider(
            value: value.clamp(min, max),
            min: min,
            max: max,
            activeColor: const Color(0xFF34D399),
            inactiveColor: Colors.white12,
            onChanged: onChanged,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// Sheet cepat untuk Backup & Restore (.JSON gratis, .KSBAK AES-256 PRO, dan Google Drive PRO).
class QuickBackupRestoreSheet {
  static Future<void> show(BuildContext rootContext) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: rootContext,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (sheetCtx) {
        final bottomPad = MediaQuery.of(sheetCtx).padding.bottom;
        final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(rootContext);
        final isPro = provider.hasProAccess;

        return Container(
          padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 14, 20, 22 + bottomPad),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: const LinearGradient(
              colors: [
                Color(0xF5062C28),
                Color(0xF70A1528),
              ],
              begin: Alignment.topLeft,
              end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            ),
            borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(28)),
            border: Border.all(
              color: const Color(0xFF34D399).withValues(alpha: 0.45),
            ),
          ),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Center(
                child: Container(
                  width: 44,
                  height: 4,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.white24,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              Row(
                children: [
                  const Text('💾', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 24)),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  const Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'CADANGAN & PEMULIHAN DATA',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            color: Color(0xFF34D399),
                            fontSize: 10,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                            letterSpacing: 1.2,
                          ),
                        ),
                        Text(
                          'Amankan Data Kas Pondok Anda',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            color: Colors.white,
                            fontSize: 15.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(sheetCtx),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: Colors.white60),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),

              _actionTile(
                emoji: '⬇️',
                title: 'Backup Standar (.JSON)',
                subtitle: 'Simpan & bagikan file cadangan lokal standar (Gratis)',
                accent: const Color(0xFF34D399),
                isLockedPro: false,
                onTap: () async {
                  Navigator.pop(sheetCtx);
                  await _exportStandardJson(rootContext);
                },
              ),
              _actionTile(
                emoji: '🔐',
                title: 'Backup Terenkripsi AES-256 (.KSBAK)',
                subtitle: 'Dilindungi password kriptografi anti-intip',
                accent: const Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                isLockedPro: !isPro,
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.pop(sheetCtx);
                  EncryptedBackupHelper.backupEncryptedKsbak(rootContext);
                },
              ),
              _actionTile(
                emoji: '⬆️',
                title: 'Pulihkan Data Backup (.JSON / .KSBAK)',
                subtitle: 'Muat kembali data dari file cadangan perangkat',
                accent: const Color(0xFFA78BFA),
                isLockedPro: false,
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.pop(sheetCtx);
                  EncryptedBackupHelper.restoreBackupAnyFormat(
                    rootContext,
                    provider,
                  );
                },
              ),
              _actionTile(
                emoji: '☁️',
                title: 'Google Drive Auto-Backup',
                subtitle: 'Sinkronisasi cadangan privat ke akun Google Anda',
                accent: const Color(0xFFFBBF24),
                isLockedPro: !isPro,
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.pop(sheetCtx);
                  if (!isPro) {
                    PaywallScreen.show(
                      rootContext,
                      triggerFeature: 'Auto-Backup & Restore Google Drive',
                    );
                    return;
                  }
                  Navigator.push(
                    rootContext,
                    MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const SettingsScreen()),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  static Future<void> _exportStandardJson(BuildContext context) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    try {
      final dump = await DatabaseHelper.instance.dumpBackupJson();
      final jsonStr = const JsonEncoder.withIndent('  ').convert(dump);
      final dir = await getTemporaryDirectory();
      final file = File(
        '${dir.path}/backup_kas_santri_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.json',
      );
      await file.writeAsString(jsonStr);
      AppFeedback.success();
      await Share.shareXFiles([XFile(file.path)], text: 'Backup Kas Santri (.JSON)');
    } catch (e) {
      if (context.mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Gagal membuat backup JSON: $e'),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF43F5E),
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  static Widget _actionTile({
    required String emoji,
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
    required Color accent,
    required bool isLockedPro,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: onTap,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: const Color(0xFF07111F).withValues(alpha: 0.78),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            border: Border.all(color: accent.withValues(alpha: 0.38)),
          ),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Text(emoji, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20)),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: Text(
                            title,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              color: Colors.white,
                              fontSize: 12.5,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                        if (isLockedPro)
                          Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 7,
                              vertical: 2,
                            ),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: const Color(0xFFF59E0B).withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                              border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFFBBF24)),
                            ),
                            child: const Text(
                              '🔒 PRO',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                color: Color(0xFFFDE68A),
                                fontSize: 9,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      subtitle,
                      style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white60, fontSize: 11),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, color: accent, size: 20),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../utils/currency_formatter.dart';

class QuickChipsWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  final ValueChanged<int> onAddAmount;
  final VoidCallback onTakeRemainingQuota;
  final int sisaJatahHariIni;

  const QuickChipsWidget({
    Key? key,
    required this.onAddAmount,
    required this.onTakeRemainingQuota,
    required this.sisaJatahHariIni,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        SingleChildScrollView(
          scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
          physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              _buildAddChip(context, 1000, '+1.000'),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              _buildAddChip(context, 2000, '+2.000'),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              _buildAddChip(context, 3000, '+3.000'),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              _buildAddChip(context, 5000, '+5.000'),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              _buildAddChip(context, 10000, '+10.000'),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        // Tombol Ambil Sisa Jatah Hari Ini
        if (sisaJatahHariIni > 0)
          InkWell(
            onTap: onTakeRemainingQuota,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.amber.shade50,
                border: Border.all(color: Colors.amber.shade400, width: 1),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              ),
              child: Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Icon(Icons.bolt, size: 16, color: Colors.amber.shade900),
                  const SizedBox(width: 4),
                  Text(
                    'Ambil Sisa Jatah Hari Ini (${CurrencyFormatter.format(sisaJatahHariIni)})',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: Colors.amber.shade900,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildAddChip(BuildContext context, int amount, String label) {
    return ActionChip(
      label: Text(label),
      labelStyle: const TextStyle(
        fontSize: 13,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
        color: Color(0xFF00796B),
      ),
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE0F2F1),
      side: BorderSide(color: Colors.teal.shade200),
      visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 2),
      onPressed: () => onAddAmount(amount),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'package:file_picker/file_picker.dart';
import '../models/santri.dart';
import '../providers/kas_santri_provider.dart';
import '../utils/app_feedback.dart';
import '../utils/currency_formatter.dart';
import '../screens/paywall_screen.dart';
import '../screens/santri/santri_detail_screen.dart';
import 'kartu_qr_santri_dialog.dart';

class QuickEditSantriBottomSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final Santri santri;

  const QuickEditSantriBottomSheet({Key? key, required this.santri}) : super(key: key);

  static Future<void> show(BuildContext context, Santri santri) async {
    await showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      useSafeArea: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => QuickEditSantriBottomSheet(santri: santri),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<QuickEditSantriBottomSheet> createState() => _QuickEditSantriBottomSheetState();
}

class _QuickEditSantriBottomSheetState extends State<QuickEditSantriBottomSheet> {
  late TextEditingController _namaLengkapController;
  late TextEditingController _namaPanggilanController;
  late TextEditingController _kamarController;
  late TextEditingController _noWaWaliController;
  late TextEditingController _jatahHarianController;

  String? _fotoPath;
  late String _kategoriSantri;
  late String _statusSantri;
  bool _isLoading = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final s = widget.santri;
    _namaLengkapController = TextEditingController(text: s.namaLengkap);
    _namaPanggilanController = TextEditingController(text: s.namaPanggilan);
    _kamarController = TextEditingController(text: s.kamar);
    _noWaWaliController = TextEditingController(text: s.noWaWali ?? '');
    _jatahHarianController = TextEditingController(
      text: CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(s.jatahHarian),
    );
    _fotoPath = s.fotoPath;
    _kategoriSantri = s.kategoriSantri;
    _statusSantri = s.statusSantri;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _namaLengkapController.dispose();
    _namaPanggilanController.dispose();
    _kamarController.dispose();
    _noWaWaliController.dispose();
    _jatahHarianController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _pickPhoto() async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    try {
      final result = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: ['jpg', 'png', 'jpeg', 'webp'],
      );
      if (result != null && result.files.single.path != null) {
        setState(() {
          _fotoPath = result.files.single.path!;
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  void _removePhoto() {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    setState(() {
      _fotoPath = null;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    final nama = _namaLengkapController.text.trim();
    if (nama.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('Nama lengkap wajib diisi!'), backgroundColor: Colors.red),
      );
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    AppFeedback.success();

    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    final parsedJatah = CurrencyFormatter.parse(_jatahHarianController.text);
    final jatah = parsedJatah > 0 ? parsedJatah : widget.santri.jatahHarian;

    final updated = widget.santri.copyWith(
      namaLengkap: nama,
      namaPanggilan: _namaPanggilanController.text.trim().isNotEmpty
          ? _namaPanggilanController.text.trim()
          : (nama.split(' ').isNotEmpty ? nama.split(' ').first : nama),
      kategoriSantri: _kategoriSantri,
      statusSantri: _statusSantri,
      kamar: _kamarController.text.trim().isNotEmpty ? _kamarController.text.trim() : widget.santri.kamar,
      noWaWali: _noWaWaliController.text.trim().isNotEmpty ? _noWaWaliController.text.trim() : null,
      jatahHarian: jatah,
      fotoPath: _fotoPath,
    );

    await provider.saveSantri(updated, isEdit: true);

    if (mounted) {
      Navigator.pop(context);
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('Data ${updated.namaLengkap} berhasil diperbarui!'),
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  void _confirmDelete(BuildContext context) {
    final s = widget.santri;

              Expanded(

                  'Hapus ${s.namaLengkap}?',

                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,

                children: [

                    style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12, height: 1.4),
                  ),
                  if (s.saldoTotal > 0 || s.tunggakan > 0) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: const Color(0xFF451A03).withValues(alpha: 0.55),

                        border: Border.all(
                          color: const Color(0xFFFBBF24).withValues(alpha: 0.55),

                      ),
                      child: Text(
                        s.saldoTotal > 0
                            ? '⚠️ Santri ini masih memiliki saldo titipan sebesar ${CurrencyFormatter.format(s.saldoTotal)}.\n'
                                'Jika dihapus permanen, saldo tersebut dianggap dikembalikan tunai kepada santri/wali dan otomatis dicatat KELUAR pada Kas Laci Tunai (mutasi_dompet) serta Jejak Audit agar Brankas & Dompet tetap 100% seimbang.'
                            : '⚠️ Santri ini masih memiliki catatan tunggakan sebesar ${CurrencyFormatter.format(s.tunggakan)}. Sebaiknya arsipkan sebagai Boyong/Lulus agar riwayat tetap tersimpan.',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          color: Color(0xFFFDE68A),
                          fontSize: 11,
                          height: 1.38,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),

                  SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                        foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF6EE7B7),
                        side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF34D399)),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),

                      onPressed: () async {
                        final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
                        final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(
                          context,
                          listen: false,

                        Navigator.pop(ctx);

                      setDialogState(() => confirmedCheck = !confirmedCheck);

                              setDialogState(() => confirmedCheck = v ?? false);

                            child: Text(

                                  ? 'Saya paham saldo ${CurrencyFormatter.format(s.saldoTotal)} dianggap dikembalikan & ingin menghapus permanen.'
                                  : 'Saya paham & yakin ingin menghapus data santri ini permanen.',
                              style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFFECDD3), fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () {
                AppFeedback.tap();
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
              },

            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: confirmedCheck ? const Color(0xFFE11D48) : Colors.white12,
                foregroundColor: confirmedCheck ? Colors.white : Colors.white38,
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
              ),
              onPressed: !confirmedCheck
                  ? null
                  : () async {
                      final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
                      final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
                      Navigator.pop(ctx);
                      Navigator.pop(context); // close bottom sheet
                      AppFeedback.tap();
                      await provider.deleteSantri(s.id);
                      messenger.showSnackBar(
                        SnackBar(
                          content: Text('Santri ${s.namaLengkap} berhasil dihapus dari daftar.'),
                          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
              child: const Text('Ya, Hapus Permanen', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildChoiceChip({
    required String label,
    required String value,
    required String selectedValue,
    required Color accent,
    required ValueChanged<String> onSelect,
  }) {
    final isSelected = selectedValue == value;
    return Expanded(
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () {
          AppFeedback.tap();
          onSelect(value);
        },
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8, horizontal: 4),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isSelected ? accent.withOpacity(0.18) : const Color(0xFF0F172A),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11),
            border: Border.all(color: isSelected ? accent : Colors.white12),
          ),
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: Text(
            label,
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: TextStyle(
              color: isSelected ? accent : Colors.white60,
              fontSize: 10,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildField(
    String label,
    TextEditingController controller,
    String hint, {
    bool isNumber = false,
    bool isPhone = false,
    bool isCurrency = false,
  }) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(
          label,
          style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white54, fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        TextField(
          controller: controller,
          keyboardType: isNumber || isPhone ? TextInputType.number : TextInputType.text,
          inputFormatters: isCurrency ? [RibuanInputFormatter()] : null,
          style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
          decoration: InputDecoration(
            hintText: hint,
            hintStyle: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white30, fontSize: 11.5),
            isDense: true,
            filled: true,
            fillColor: const Color(0xFF0F172A),
            contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
            border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12), borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Colors.white12)),
            enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12), borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Colors.white12)),
            focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12), borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF06B6D4), width: 1.5)),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import '../utils/app_feedback.dart';
import '../utils/currency_formatter.dart';

class SambanganReceiptDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  final Santri santri;
  final InfakSantriModel infak;
  final int totalDiterima;
  final int sisaJajan;
  final int jatahBaru;
  final int nominalPotongTunggakan;

  const SambanganReceiptDialog({
    Key? key,
    required this.santri,
    required this.infak,
    required this.totalDiterima,
    required this.sisaJajan,
    required this.jatahBaru,
    this.nominalPotongTunggakan = 0,
  }) : super(key: key);

  static Future<void> show(
    BuildContext context, {
    required Santri santri,
    required InfakSantriModel infak,
    required int totalDiterima,
    required int sisaJajan,
    required int jatahBaru,
    int nominalPotongTunggakan = 0,
  }) async {
    await showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => SambanganReceiptDialog(
        santri: santri,
        infak: infak,
        totalDiterima: totalDiterima,
        sisaJajan: sisaJajan,
        jatahBaru: jatahBaru,
        nominalPotongTunggakan: nominalPotongTunggakan,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<SambanganReceiptDialog> createState() => _SambanganReceiptDialogState();
}

class _SambanganReceiptDialogState extends State<SambanganReceiptDialog> {
  final ScreenshotController _screenshotController = ScreenshotController();
  bool _isSharing = false;

  String _berasSummary() {
    if (widget.infak.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasBebas) {
      return '✓ Bebas Beras';
    }
    if (widget.infak.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasFisik) {
      final l = widget.infak.berasLiter;
      final str = l == l.roundToDouble() ? l.toInt().toString() : l.toString();
      return '🌾 Fisik $str Liter';
    }
    if (widget.infak.jenisBeras == InfakSantriModel.berasUangVal) {
      return CurrencyFormatter.format(widget.infak.berasUang);
    }
    return '⏳ Belum Setor';
  }

  Future<void> _copyWaText(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final text = ReportService.instance.generateSambanganReceiptText(
      santri: widget.santri,
      infak: widget.infak,
      pengaturan: provider.pengaturan,
      totalDiterima: widget.totalDiterima,
      sisaJajan: widget.sisaJajan,
      jatahBaru: widget.jatahBaru,
      nominalPotongTunggakan: widget.nominalPotongTunggakan,
      isProUser: provider.isProUser,
    );
    await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text));
    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Teks struk pembagian Sambangan disalin ke Clipboard!'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFF10B981),
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _sendWaOneClick(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    if (!provider.isProUser) {
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: 'Kirim Struk Sambangan 1-Klik ke WA Wali',
      );
      return;
    }

    final text = ReportService.instance.generateSambanganReceiptText(
      santri: widget.santri,
      infak: widget.infak,
      pengaturan: provider.pengaturan,
      totalDiterima: widget.totalDiterima,
      sisaJajan: widget.sisaJajan,
      jatahBaru: widget.jatahBaru,
      nominalPotongTunggakan: widget.nominalPotongTunggakan,
      isProUser: true,
    );

    final launched = await ReportService.instance.openWhatsAppDirect(
      rawPhone: widget.santri.noWaWali,
      message: text,
    );
    if (!launched && mounted) {
      await Share.share(text, subject: 'Struk Sambangan - ${widget.santri.namaLengkap}');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _sharePng(KasSantriProvider provider) async {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    if (!provider.isProUser) {
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: 'Bagikan Struk Gambar PNG Bebas Watermark',
      );
      return;
    }
    if (_isSharing) return;
    setState(() => _isSharing = true);
    try {
      final bytes = await _screenshotController.capture(pixelRatio: 2.5);
      if (bytes == null) return;
      final dir = await getTemporaryDirectory();
      final file = File(
        '${dir.path}/struk_sambangan_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.png',
      );
      await file.writeAsBytes(bytes);
      await Share.shareXFiles(
        [XFile(file.path)],
        text: 'Struk Setoran Sambangan — ${widget.santri.namaLengkap}',
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isSharing = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context);
    final isPro = provider.isProUser;

    return Dialog(
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 24),
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Screenshot(
              controller: _screenshotController,
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  gradient: const LinearGradient(
                    colors: [Color(0xFF0A1424), Color(0xFF071B1E)],
                    begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                    end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                  ),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: const Color(0xFF34D399).withOpacity(0.65),
                    width: 1.5,
                  ),
                ),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Container(
                          width: 40,
                          height: 40,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: const Color(0xFF10B981).withOpacity(0.2),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFF34D399)),
                          ),
                          alignment: Alignment.center,
                          child: const Text('🎁', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20)),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 10),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Column(

                            children: [
                              Text(
                                provider.pengaturan.namaPondok.toUpperCase(),
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: Color(0xFF34D399),
                                  fontSize: 10,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                                  letterSpacing: 0.5,

                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),

                          ),
                          child: Text(

                            style: const TextStyle(

  Widget _row(String label, String value, {bool isBold = false, Color color = Colors.white}) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 3),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [
          Text(label, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white60, fontSize: 11.5)),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          Flexible(
            child: Text(
              value,
              textAlign: TextAlign.right,
              style: TextStyle(
                color: color,
                fontSize: isBold ? 13 : 11.5,
                fontWeight: isBold ? FontWeight.w900 : FontWeight.w700,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../models/santri_status.dart';
import '../providers/theme_wallpaper_provider.dart';
import '../utils/currency_formatter.dart';
import '../utils/time_category_helper.dart';
import '../utils/app_feedback.dart';
import 'quick_edit_santri_bottom_sheet.dart';

class SantriCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final SantriStatusHariIni status;
  final bool isTwoCol;
  final VoidCallback onAmbilTap;
  final VoidCallback onTunggakanTap;
  final VoidCallback? onDetailTap;

  const SantriCard({
    Key? key,
    required this.status,
    this.isTwoCol = true,
    required this.onAmbilTap,
    required this.onTunggakanTap,
    this.onDetailTap,
  }) : super(key: key);

  String _getInitials(String name) {
    if (name.trim().isEmpty) return 'KS';
    final parts = name.trim().split(RegExp(r'\s+'));
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
      return (parts[0][0] + parts[1][0]).toUpperCase();
    }
    return parts[0].substring(0, parts[0].length >= 2 ? 2 : 1).toUpperCase();
  }

  BoxDecoration _getCardDecoration(BadgeStatusHariIni badge, double cardOpacity) {
    List<Color> gradientColors;
    Color borderColor;
    Color shadowColor;
    final darkAlpha = (0.95 * cardOpacity).clamp(0.44, 0.94);

    switch (badge) {
      case BadgeStatusHariIni.utuh:
        gradientColors = [
          const Color(0xFF10B981).withOpacity((0.60 * cardOpacity).clamp(0.22, 0.65)),
          const Color(0xFF06B6D4).withOpacity((0.35 * cardOpacity).clamp(0.14, 0.45)),
          const Color(0xFF0B1322).withOpacity(darkAlpha),
        ];
        borderColor = const Color(0xFF34D399).withOpacity(0.55);
        shadowColor = const Color(0xFF10B981).withOpacity(0.3);
        break;
      case BadgeStatusHariIni.sebagian:
        gradientColors = [
          const Color(0xFF06B6D4).withOpacity((0.60 * cardOpacity).clamp(0.22, 0.65)),
          const Color(0xFF6366F1).withOpacity((0.35 * cardOpacity).clamp(0.14, 0.45)),
          const Color(0xFF0B1322).withOpacity(darkAlpha),
        ];
        borderColor = const Color(0xFF38BDF8).withOpacity(0.6);
        shadowColor = const Color(0xFF06B6D4).withOpacity(0.3);
        break;
      case BadgeStatusHariIni.limitHabis:
        gradientColors = [
          const Color(0xFFF59E0B).withOpacity((0.60 * cardOpacity).clamp(0.22, 0.65)),
          const Color(0xFFEC4899).withOpacity((0.35 * cardOpacity).clamp(0.14, 0.45)),
          const Color(0xFF0B1322).withOpacity(darkAlpha),
        ];
        borderColor = const Color(0xFFFBBF24).withOpacity(0.6);
        shadowColor = const Color(0xFFF59E0B).withOpacity(0.3);
        break;
      case BadgeStatusHariIni.overlimitKritis:
        gradientColors = [
          const Color(0xFFEC4899).withOpacity((0.66 * cardOpacity).clamp(0.24, 0.7)),
          const Color(0xFFA855F7).withOpacity((0.40 * cardOpacity).clamp(0.16, 0.48)),
          const Color(0xFF0B1322).withOpacity(darkAlpha),
        ];
        borderColor = const Color(0xFFFB7185).withOpacity(0.65);
        shadowColor = const Color(0xFFF43F5E).withOpacity(0.35);
        break;
    }

    return BoxDecoration(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(26),
      gradient: RadialGradient(
        center: const Alignment(0.8, -0.8),
        radius: 1.3,
        colors: gradientColors,
        stops: const [0.0, 0.5, 1.0],
      ),
      border: Border.all(color: borderColor, width: 1.5),
      boxShadow: [
        BoxShadow(
          color: shadowColor,
          blurRadius: 18,
          offset: const Offset(0, 8),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStatusBadge(BadgeStatusHariIni badge, int countAmbil) {
    Color bg;
    Color border;
    Color text;
    String label;

    switch (badge) {
      case BadgeStatusHariIni.utuh:
        bg = const Color(0xFF10B981).withOpacity(0.25);
        border = const Color(0xFF34D399).withOpacity(0.4);
        text = const Color(0xFFA7F3D0);
        label = '🟢 Utuh';
        break;
      case BadgeStatusHariIni.sebagian:
        bg = const Color(0xFF06B6D4).withOpacity(0.25);
        border = const Color(0xFF38BDF8).withOpacity(0.4);
        text = const Color(0xFFBAE6FD);
        label = '${countAmbil}x Ambil';
        break;
      case BadgeStatusHariIni.limitHabis:
        bg = const Color(0xFFF59E0B).withOpacity(0.25);
        border = const Color(0xFFFBBF24).withOpacity(0.4);
        text = const Color(0xFFFDE68A);
        label = '🟡 Habis';
        break;
      case BadgeStatusHariIni.overlimitKritis:
        bg = const Color(0xFFF43F5E).withOpacity(0.3);
        border = const Color(0xFFFB7185).withOpacity(0.5);
        text = const Color(0xFFFECDD3);
        label = '🔴 Over';
        break;
    }

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 7, vertical: 2.5),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: bg,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(color: border),
      ),
      child: Text(
        label,
        style: TextStyle(
          color: text,
          fontSize: 9,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStatusKeaktifanPill(Santri santri) {
    final isPulang = santri.isPulang;
    final bg = isPulang
        ? const Color(0xFF34D399).withOpacity(0.22)
        : const Color(0xFF94A3B8).withOpacity(0.22);
    final border = isPulang
        ? const Color(0xFF6EE7B7).withOpacity(0.55)
        : const Color(0xFFCBD5E1).withOpacity(0.45);
    final textColor =
        isPulang ? const Color(0xFFA7F3D0) : const Color(0xFFE2E8F0);
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: bg,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        border: Border.all(color: border),
      ),
      child: Text(
        isPulang ? '🏡 Pulang' : '📦 Pindah',
        style: TextStyle(
          color: textColor,
          fontSize: 8.5,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// Field kaca modern pengganti DropdownButton untuk memilih santri secara instan & akurat
class SearchableSantriField extends StatelessWidget {
  final Santri? selectedSantri;
  final bool isAllSelected;
  final String allLabel;
  final String placeholder;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final bool compact;

  const SearchableSantriField({
    Key? key,
    this.selectedSantri,
    this.isAllSelected = false,
    this.allLabel = 'Semua Santri',
    this.placeholder = 'Cari & pilih santri...',
    required this.onTap,
    this.compact = false,
  }) : super(key: key);

  String _initials(String name) {
    final trimmed = name.trim();
    if (trimmed.isEmpty) return 'KS';
    final parts = trimmed.split(RegExp(r'\s+'));
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
      return (parts[0][0] + parts[1][0]).toUpperCase();
    }
    return parts[0].substring(0, parts[0].length >= 2 ? 2 : 1).toUpperCase();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cardOpacity = Provider.of<ThemeWallpaperProvider>(context).cardOpacity;
    final s = selectedSantri;
    final hasFoto = !isAllSelected &&
        s != null &&
        s.fotoPath != null &&
        s.fotoPath!.trim().isNotEmpty;

    return InkWell(
      onTap: () {
        AppFeedback.tap();
        onTap();
      },
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      child: Container(
        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: compact ? 10 : 12,
          vertical: compact ? 8 : 10,
        ),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: const Color(0xFF060B14).withOpacity((0.85 * cardOpacity).clamp(0.45, 0.9)),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          border: Border.all(
            color: (s != null || isAllSelected)
                ? const Color(0xFF38BDF8).withOpacity(0.42)
                : Colors.white12,
          ),
        ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Container(
              width: compact ? 30 : 38,
              height: compact ? 30 : 38,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: LinearGradient(
                  colors: isAllSelected
                      ? const [Color(0xFF38BDF8), Color(0xFF818CF8)]
                      : const [Color(0xFF10B981), Color(0xFF06B6D4)],
                ),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(compact ? 10 : 12),
              ),
              child: ClipRRect(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(compact ? 10 : 12),
                child: isAllSelected
                    ? Center(
                        child: Text(
                          '👥',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: compact ? 14 : 17),
                        ),
                      )
                    : (hasFoto
                        ? Image(
                            image: ResizeImage(
                              FileImage(File(s.fotoPath!)),
                              width: 120,
                            ),
                            fit: BoxFit.cover,
                            errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => Center(
                              child: Text(
                                _initials(s.namaLengkap),
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  color: const Color(0xFF040914),
                                  fontSize: compact ? 10 : 12,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          )
                        : Center(
                            child: Text(
                              s != null ? _initials(s.namaLengkap) : '?',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                color: const Color(0xFF040914),
                                fontSize: compact ? 10 : 12,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                              ),
                            ),
                          )),
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(width: compact ? 8 : 11),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    isAllSelected
                        ? allLabel
                        : (s != null ? s.namaLengkap : placeholder),
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: (s != null || isAllSelected) ? Colors.white : Colors.white54,
                      fontSize: compact ? 11.5 : 13,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                    ),
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
                  if (!isAllSelected && s != null) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Wrap(
                      spacing: 6,
                      runSpacing: 2,
                      crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          '${s.kategoriLabel}${s.kamar.trim().isNotEmpty ? ' • ${s.kamar}' : ''}',
                          style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white60, fontSize: 10),
                        ),
                        Text(
                          'Saldo ${CurrencyFormatter.format(s.saldoTotal)}',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            color: Color(0xFF34D399),
                            fontSize: 10,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                            fontFamily: 'monospace',
                          ),
                        ),
                        if (s.tunggakan > 0)
                          Text(
                            '• Tunggakan ${CurrencyFormatter.format(s.tunggakan)}',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              color: Color(0xFFFDA4AF),
                              fontSize: 10,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                            ),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 6),
            Container(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(compact ? 4 : 6),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.08),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
              ),
              child: Icon(

                color: const Color(0xFF67E8F9),
                size: compact ? 15 : 17,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Modal Bottom Sheet Glassmorphism dengan pencarian real-time Nama Lengkap, Panggilan & Kamar
class SearchableSantriPicker extends StatefulWidget {
  final List<Santri> santriList;
  final String? selectedSantriId;
  final bool allowAllOption;
  final String allOptionLabel;
  final String title;

  const SearchableSantriPicker({
    Key? key,
    required this.santriList,
    this.selectedSantriId,
    this.allowAllOption = false,
    this.allOptionLabel = 'Semua Santri',
    this.title = 'Pilih Santri',
  }) : super(key: key);

  static Future<String?> show(
    BuildContext context, {
    required List<Santri> santriList,
    String? selectedSantriId,
    bool allowAllOption = false,
    String allOptionLabel = 'Semua Santri',
    String title = 'Pilih Santri',
  }) {
    return showModalBottomSheet<String>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      useSafeArea: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => SearchableSantriPicker(
        santriList: santriList,
        selectedSantriId: selectedSantriId,
        allowAllOption: allowAllOption,
        allOptionLabel: allOptionLabel,
        title: title,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<SearchableSantriPicker> createState() => _SearchableSantriPickerState();
}

class _SearchableSantriPickerState extends State<SearchableSantriPicker> {
  final TextEditingController _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();
  String _query = '';
  String _kategoriFilter = 'ALL'; // ALL, SANTRIYIN, SANTRIYAT, SANTRI_BARU
  String? _kamarFilter;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String _initials(String name) {
    final trimmed = name.trim();
    if (trimmed.isEmpty) return 'KS';
    final parts = trimmed.split(RegExp(r'\s+'));
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
      return (parts[0][0] + parts[1][0]).toUpperCase();
    }
    return parts[0].substring(0, parts[0].length >= 2 ? 2 : 1).toUpperCase();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cardOpacity = Provider.of<ThemeWallpaperProvider>(context).cardOpacity;
    final bottomSafe = MediaQuery.of(context).padding.bottom;
    final viewInsetsBottom = MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom;

    final kamarSet = widget.santriList
        .map((s) => s.kamar.trim())
        .where((k) => k.isNotEmpty)
        .toSet()
        .toList()
      ..sort();

    final q = _query.trim().toLowerCase();
    final filtered = widget.santriList.where((s) {
      if (_kategoriFilter != 'ALL' && s.kategoriSantri != _kategoriFilter) {
        return false;
      }
      if (_kamarFilter != null && s.kamar.trim() != _kamarFilter) {
        return false;
      }
      if (q.isEmpty) return true;
      return s.namaLengkap.toLowerCase().contains(q) ||
          s.namaPanggilan.toLowerCase().contains(q) ||
          s.kamar.toLowerCase().contains(q);
    }).toList();

    return FractionallySizedBox(
      heightFactor: 0.86,
      child: Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: viewInsetsBottom),
        child: RepaintBoundary(
          child: Container(
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              gradient: LinearGradient(
                colors: [
                  const Color(0xFF072233).withValues(alpha: (cardOpacity + 0.22).clamp(0.82, 0.96)),
                  const Color(0xFF091326).withValues(alpha: (cardOpacity + 0.24).clamp(0.84, 0.97)),
                ],
                begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                end: Alignment.bottomRight,
              ),

                                child: Center(
                                  child: Text(
                                    'Santri tidak ditemukan pada pencarian ini.',
                                    style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white54, fontSize: 12.5),

                            final hasFoto =

                              child: Container(

                                decoration: BoxDecoration(

                                    colors: isSelected

                                            const Color(0xFF081324).withValues(alpha: 0.68),

                                    color: isSelected
                                        ? const Color(0xFF34D399)
                                        : const Color(0xFF38BDF8).withValues(alpha: 0.22),
                                  ),

                                child: ListTile(
                                  dense: true,

                                    horizontal: 12,
                                    vertical: 4,
                                  ),

                                      width: 40,
                                      height: 40,

                                      alignment: Alignment.center,
                                      child: hasFoto
                                          ? Image(
                                              image: ResizeImage(
                                                FileImage(File(s.fotoPath!)),
                                                width: 120,
                                              ),
                                              width: 40,
                                              height: 40,
                                              fit: BoxFit.cover,
                                              errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => Text(
                                                _initials(s.namaLengkap),
                                                style: const TextStyle(
                                                  color: Color(0xFF34D399),
                                                  fontSize: 12,
                                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                                                ),
                                              ),
                                            )
                                          : Text(
                                              _initials(s.namaLengkap),
                                              style: const TextStyle(
                                                color: Color(0xFF34D399),
                                                fontSize: 12,
                                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                                              ),
                                            ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  title: Row(
                                    children: [
                                      Expanded(
                                        child: Text(
                                          s.namaLengkap,
                                          style: const TextStyle(
                                            color: Colors.white,
                                            fontSize: 13,
                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                          ),
                                          maxLines: 1,
                                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                      if (s.isPulang || s.isPindah)
                                        Container(
                                          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6),
                                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                            horizontal: 6,
                                            vertical: 2,
                                          ),
                                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                            color: s.isPulang
                                                ? const Color(0xFF34D399).withValues(alpha: 0.2)
                                                : const Color(0xFF94A3B8).withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                          ),
                                          child: Text(
                                            s.isPulang ? 'PULANG' : 'PINDAH',
                                            style: TextStyle(
                                              color: s.isPulang
                                                  ? const Color(0xFF6EE7B7)
                                                  : const Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
                                              fontSize: 8.5,
                                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                                            ),
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                    ],
                                  ),
                                  subtitle: Padding(
                                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 2),
                                    child: Wrap(
                                      spacing: 8,
                                      runSpacing: 2,
                                      children: [
                                        Text(
                                          '${s.kategoriLabel}${s.kamar.trim().isNotEmpty ? ' • ${s.kamar}' : ''}',
                                          style: const TextStyle(
                                            color: Colors.white70,
                                            fontSize: 10.5,
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                        Text(
                                          'Saldo: ${CurrencyFormatter.format(s.saldoTotal)}',
                                          style: const TextStyle(
                                            color: Color(0xFF34D399),
                                            fontSize: 10.5,
                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                            fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                        if (s.tunggakan > 0)
                                          Text(
                                            'Tunggakan: ${CurrencyFormatter.format(s.tunggakan)}',
                                            style: const TextStyle(
                                              color: Color(0xFFFDA4AF),
                                              fontSize: 10.5,
                                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                            ),
                                          ),
                                      ],
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  trailing: isSelected
                                      ? const Icon(
                                          Icons.check_circle_rounded,
                                          color: Color(0xFF34D399),
                                          size: 20,
                                        )
                                      : const Icon(
                                          Icons.chevron_right_rounded,
                                          color: Colors.white38,
                                        ),
                                  onTap: () {
                                    AppFeedback.tap();
                                    Navigator.pop(context, s.id);
                                  },
                                ),
                              ),
                            );
                          },
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
    );
  }

  Widget _chip(
    String label,
    bool selected,
    VoidCallback onTap, {
    Color accent = const Color(0xFF34D399),
  }) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () {
          AppFeedback.tap();
          onTap();
        },
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 11, vertical: 6),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: selected ? accent.withOpacity(0.22) : Colors.black.withOpacity(0.32),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
            border: Border.all(color: selected ? accent : Colors.white12),
          ),
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: TextStyle(
              color: selected ? accent : Colors.white70,
              fontSize: 10.5,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import '../models/serah_terima_infak.dart';

import '../services/report_service.dart';
import '../utils/app_feedback.dart';
import '../utils/currency_formatter.dart';
import '../utils/date_formatter.dart';

class SerahTerimaFormSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const SerahTerimaFormSheet({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  static Future<void> show(BuildContext context) async {
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    if (!provider.hasProAccess) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: 'Serah Terima Kas Infak & Beras ke Dapur / Yayasan',
      );
      return;
    }
    await showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      useSafeArea: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => const SerahTerimaFormSheet(),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<SerahTerimaFormSheet> createState() => _SerahTerimaFormSheetState();
}

class _SerahTerimaFormSheetState extends State<SerahTerimaFormSheet> {
  final TextEditingController _nominalController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _literController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _penerimaController = TextEditingController(
    text: 'Ustadzah Dapur / Bendahara Yayasan',
  );
  final TextEditingController _catatanController = TextEditingController();

  late String _tanggalSerah;
  String _posInfak = 'GABUNGAN'; // GABUNGAN, MASAK, LISTRIK, BERAS_UANG, BERAS_FISIK
  String _sumberDompet = 'TUNAI'; // TUNAI, REKENING, GUDANG_BERAS
  bool _isSaving = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _tanggalSerah = DateFormatter.toLocalDateString(DateTime.now());
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    if (provider.kasInfakTunai > 0) {
      _nominalController.text =
          CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(provider.kasInfakTunai);
    }
    if (provider.stokBerasFisikLiter > 0) {
      final l = provider.stokBerasFisikLiter;
      _literController.text =
          l == l.roundToDouble() ? l.toInt().toString() : l.toString();
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nominalController.dispose();
    _literController.dispose();
    _penerimaController.dispose();
    _catatanController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    if (_isSaving) return;
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    final penerima = _penerimaController.text.trim();
    if (penerima.isEmpty) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Nama penerima wajib diisi!'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFFF43F5E),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final isBerasFisik = _sumberDompet == 'GUDANG_BERAS';
    final nominalUang =
        isBerasFisik ? 0 : CurrencyFormatter.parse(_nominalController.text);
    final liter = isBerasFisik
        ? (double.tryParse(_literController.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.')) ??
            0.0)
        : 0.0;

    if ((!isBerasFisik && nominalUang <= 0) || (isBerasFisik && liter <= 0)) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Isi nominal uang atau jumlah liter beras dengan benar.'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFFF43F5E),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isSaving = true);
    final item = SerahTerimaInfakModel(
      id: const Uuid().v4(),
      tanggalSerah: _tanggalSerah,
      periodeBulan: provider.selectedInfakPeriode,
      posInfak: _posInfak,
      sumberDompet: _sumberDompet,
      nominalUang: nominalUang,
      jumlahBerasLiter: liter,
      penerima: penerima,
      catatan: _catatanController.text.trim().isNotEmpty
          ? _catatanController.text.trim()
          : null,
    );

    await provider.catatSerahTerimaInfak(item);
    AppFeedback.success();
    if (mounted) {
      Navigator.pop(context);
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Serah terima ke Dapur / Yayasan berhasil dicatat!'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFF10B981),
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context);
