```dart
                child: ElevatedButton(
                  onPressed: _isSaving ? null : _submit,
                  style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFFBBF24),
                    foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF030712),
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
                  ),
                  child: const Text(
                    '🤝 SIMPAN SERAH TERIMA KE DAPUR / YAYASAN',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _miniStat(String label, String val, Color color) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(label, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white54, fontSize: 9.5)),
        Text(val, style: TextStyle(color: color, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, fontFamily: 'monospace')),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _sumberChip(String label, String value, Color accent) {
    final selected = _sumberDompet == value;
    return Expanded(
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () {
          AppFeedback.tap();
          setState(() {
            _sumberDompet = value;
            if (value == 'GUDANG_BERAS') {
              _posInfak = 'BERAS_FISIK';
            }
          });
        },
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8, horizontal: 4),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: selected ? accent.withOpacity(0.18) : const Color(0xFF060B14),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11),
            border: Border.all(color: selected ? accent : Colors.white12),
          ),
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: Text(
            label,
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: TextStyle(color: selected ? accent : Colors.white60, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class SerahTerimaHistorySheet extends StatelessWidget {
  const SerahTerimaHistorySheet({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  static Future<void> show(BuildContext context) async {
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    if (!provider.hasProAccess) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: 'Riwayat & Berita Acara Serah Terima Infak',
      );
      return;
    }
    await showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      useSafeArea: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => const SerahTerimaHistorySheet(),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context);
    final items = provider.serahTerimaList;
    final bottomSafe = MediaQuery.of(context).padding.bottom;

    return SafeArea(
      top: true,
      bottom: false,
      child: Container(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(
          maxHeight: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height * 0.85,
        ),
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          color: Color(0xFF0E1422),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(28)),
          border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF38BDF8), width: 1.5)),
        ),
        padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 12, 18, bottomSafe + 16),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Container(
              width: 44,
              height: 4,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Colors.white24, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Row(
              children: [
                const Text('📜', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20)),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                const Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    'Riwayat Serah Terima Infak',
                    style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 15.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                  ),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: Colors.white60),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const Divider(color: Colors.white12),
            if (items.isEmpty)
              const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.all(28),
                child: Text(
                  'Belum ada catatan serah terima ke Dapur / Yayasan.',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white54, fontSize: 12.5),
                ),
              )
            else
              Flexible(
                child: ListView.separated(
                  shrinkWrap: true,
                  itemCount: items.length,
                  separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  itemBuilder: (ctx, idx) {
                    final item = items[idx];
                    final nilaiStr = item.jumlahBerasLiter > 0
                        ? '${item.jumlahBerasLiter.toStringAsFixed(item.jumlahBerasLiter == item.jumlahBerasLiter.roundToDouble() ? 0 : 1)} Liter Beras'
                        : CurrencyFormatter.format(item.nominalUang);
                    return Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: const Color(0xFF060B14),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                        border: Border.all(color: Colors.white12),
                      ),
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Row(
                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                            children: [
                              Expanded(
                                child: Text(
                                  '${item.tanggalSerah} • ${item.posInfak} (${item.sumberDompet})',
                                  style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF67E8F9), fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                                ),
                              ),
                              Text(
                                nilaiStr,
                                style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF34D399), fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, fontFamily: 'monospace'),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Text(
                            'Penerima: ${item.penerima}',
                            style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                          ),
                          if (item.catatan != null && item.catatan!.isNotEmpty)
                            Text(item.catatan!, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white60, fontSize: 11)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                          Row(
                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.end,
                            children: [
                              TextButton.icon(
                                onPressed: () async {
                                  AppFeedback.tap();
                                  final ba = ReportService.instance.generateSerahTerimaBeritaAcaraText(
                                    item: item,
                                    pengaturan: provider.pengaturan,
                                  );
                                  await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: ba));
                                  await Share.share(ba, subject: 'Berita Acara Serah Terima Infak');
                                },
                                icon: const Icon(Icons.share_rounded, size: 15, color: Color(0xFF34D399)),
                                label: const Text('Berita Acara WA', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF34D399), fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                              ),
                              TextButton.icon(
                                onPressed: () async {
                                  final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
                                    context: ctx,
                                    builder: (dCtx) => AlertDialog(
                                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0F172A),
                                      title: const Text('Hapus Catatan Serah Terima?', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 15)),
                                      content: Text('Saldo kantong infak akan dikembalikan sebesar $nilaiStr.', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12)),
                                      actions: [
                                        TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dCtx, false), child: const Text('Batal')),
                                        ElevatedButton(
                                          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48)),
                                          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dCtx, true),
                                          child: const Text('Hapus'),
                                        ),
                                      ],
                                    ),
                                  );
                                  if (ok == true) {
                                    await provider.hapusSerahTerimaInfak(item.id);
                                  }
                                },
                                icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline, size: 15, color: Color(0xFFFB7185)),
                                label: const Text('Hapus', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFFB7185), fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
class StrukGambarDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  final SantriStatusHariIni status;
  final PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan;

  const StrukGambarDialog({
    Key? key,
    required this.status,
    required this.pengaturan,
  }) : super(key: key);

  static Future<void> show(
    BuildContext context, {
    required SantriStatusHariIni status,
    required PengaturanAplikasi pengaturan,
  }) async {
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    if (!provider.hasProAccess) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: 'Bagikan Struk Gambar PNG Resmi Tanpa Watermark',
      );
      return;
    }
    await showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => StrukGambarDialog(
        status: status,
        pengaturan: pengaturan,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<StrukGambarDialog> createState() => _StrukGambarDialogState();
}

class _StrukGambarDialogState extends State<StrukGambarDialog> {
  final ScreenshotController _screenshotController = ScreenshotController();
  bool _isSharing = false;

  Future<void> _captureAndShare() async {
    if (_isSharing) return;
    setState(() => _isSharing = true);
    AppFeedback.tap();
    try {
      final bytes = await _screenshotController.capture(pixelRatio: 3.0);
      if (bytes == null) {
        throw Exception('Gagal merender gambar struk.');
      }
      final dir = await getTemporaryDirectory();
      final safeName = widget.status.santri.namaLengkap
          .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_]'), '_')
          .toLowerCase();
      final file = File(p.join(dir.path, 'struk_kas_$safeName.png'));
      await file.writeAsBytes(bytes);

      AppFeedback.success();
      await Share.shareXFiles(
        [XFile(file.path)],
        text: 'Struk Mutasi Kas Santri — ${widget.status.santri.namaLengkap} (${widget.pengaturan.namaPondok})',
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Gagal membagikan struk: $e'),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE11D48),
          ),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isSharing = false);
    }
  }
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';
import '../models/santri.dart';
import '../providers/kas_santri_provider.dart';
import '../screens/paywall_screen.dart';
import '../screens/santri/import_santri_excel_screen.dart';
import '../utils/app_feedback.dart';
import '../utils/currency_formatter.dart';

class TambahSantriBottomSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final ValueChanged<String>? onOpenSetoran;

  const TambahSantriBottomSheet({
    Key? key,
    this.onOpenSetoran,
  }) : super(key: key);

  static void show(
    BuildContext context, {
    ValueChanged<String>? onOpenSetoran,
  }) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      useSafeArea: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => TambahSantriBottomSheet(
        onOpenSetoran: onOpenSetoran,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<TambahSantriBottomSheet> createState() =>
      _TambahSantriBottomSheetState();
}

class _TambahSantriBottomSheetState extends State<TambahSantriBottomSheet> {
  final TextEditingController _namaController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _panggilanController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _kamarController =
      TextEditingController(text: 'Kamar 1');
  final TextEditingController _noWaController = TextEditingController();
  late final TextEditingController _jatahController;
  final TextEditingController _tunggakanController =
      TextEditingController(text: '0');

  String _kategoriSantri = Santri.kategoriSantriyin;
  String _statusSantri = Santri.statusAktifVal;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final defaultJatah = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false)
        .pengaturan
        .defaultJatahHarian;
    _jatahController = TextEditingController(
      text: CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(
        defaultJatah > 0 ? defaultJatah : 10000,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _namaController.dispose();
    _panggilanController.dispose();
    _kamarController.dispose();
    _noWaController.dispose();
    _jatahController.dispose();
    _tunggakanController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    final nama = _namaController.text.trim();
    if (nama.isEmpty) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Nama lengkap santri wajib diisi!'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFFF43F5E),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final panggilanInput = _panggilanController.text.trim();
    final panggilan = panggilanInput.isNotEmpty
        ? panggilanInput
        : nama.split(RegExp(r'\s+')).first;
    final kamar = _kamarController.text.trim().isNotEmpty
        ? _kamarController.text.trim()
        : 'Kamar 1';
    final noWa = _noWaController.text.trim();
    final jatah = CurrencyFormatter.parse(_jatahController.text);
    final tunggakan = CurrencyFormatter.parse(_tunggakanController.text);

    final santri = Santri(
      id: const Uuid().v4(),
      namaLengkap: nama,
      namaPanggilan: panggilan,
      kategoriSantri: _kategoriSantri,
      statusSantri: _statusSantri,
      kamar: kamar,
      noWaWali: noWa.isNotEmpty ? noWa : null,
      saldoTotal: 0,
      setoranAwal: 0,
      jatahHarian: jatah > 0 ? jatah : 10000,
      tunggakan: tunggakan,
      catatanTunggakan: tunggakan > 0 ? 'Tunggakan Awal' : '',
    );

    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    if (provider.hasReachedFreeSantriLimit) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pop(context);
        PaywallScreen.show(
          context,
          triggerFeature:
              'Santri Tanpa Batas — Kuota Mode Gratis maksimal ${KasSantriProvider.maxFreeSantriQuota} santri aktif telah tercapai.',
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    await provider.tambahSantriBaru(santri);
    AppFeedback.success();

    if (!mounted) return;
    final openSetoranCb = widget.onOpenSetoran;
    final parentNav = Navigator.of(context);
    final parentMessenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
    parentNav.pop();

    if (openSetoranCb != null) {
      await showDialog<void>(
        context: parentNav.context,
        builder: (dlgCtx) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0A192C),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
            side: BorderSide(
              color: const Color(0xFF34D399).withValues(alpha: 0.45),
            ),
          ),
          title: const Row(
            children: [
              Text('🎉', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20)),
              SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  'Santri Berhasil Disimpan',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.white,
                    fontSize: 15.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          content: Text(
            'Data $nama ($kamar) terdaftar dengan saldo awal Rp 0.\n\nIngin langsung mencatat setoran atau sambangan pertama untuk santri ini?',
            style: const TextStyle(
              color: Colors.white70,
              fontSize: 12.5,
              height: 1.4,
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dlgCtx),
              child: const Text(
                'Nanti Saja',
                style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white60),
              ),
            ),
            ElevatedButton.icon(
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
                foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF030712),
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                ),
              ),
              onPressed: () {
                Navigator.pop(dlgCtx);
                openSetoranCb(santri.id);
              },
              icon: const Text('📥', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13)),
              label: const Text(
                'Langsung Input Setoran?',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    } else {
      parentMessenger.showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('Santri $nama berhasil ditambahkan (Saldo awal Rp 0).'),
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final bottomSafe = MediaQuery.of(context).padding.bottom;

    return SafeArea(
      top: true,
      bottom: false,
      child: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          gradient: const LinearGradient(
            colors: [
              Color(0xF5063128),
              Color(0xF70A182D),
              Color(0xF713122B),
            ],
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
          ),
          borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(32)),
          border: Border(
            top: BorderSide(
              color: const Color(0xFF34D399).withValues(alpha: 0.55),
              width: 1.5,
            ),
          ),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: const Color(0xFF10B981).withValues(alpha: 0.20),
              blurRadius: 24,
              offset: const Offset(0, -6),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(
          top: 12,
          left: 20,
          right: 20,
          bottom: MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom + bottomSafe + 24,
        ),
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Center(
                child: Container(
                  width: 44,
                  height: 4,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.white24,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),

              Row(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                children: [
                  const Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      '👦 TAMBAH SANTRI BARU',
                      style: TextStyle(

                  ),
                  Builder(
                    builder: (btnCtx) {
                      final isPro = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(btnCtx).hasProAccess;
                      return TextButton.icon(
                        onPressed: () {
                          AppFeedback.tap();
                          final nav = Navigator.of(context);
                          nav.pop();
                          if (!isPro) {
                            PaywallScreen.show(

                    shadowColor: const Color(0xFF10B981).withValues(alpha: 0.4),

                  child: const Text(
                    'SIMPAN DATA SANTRI',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                      letterSpacing: 0.5,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),

  }

  Widget _buildPillChoice({
    required String label,
    required String value,
    required String selectedValue,
    required Color accent,
    required ValueChanged<String> onSelect,
  }) {
    final isSelected = selectedValue == value;
    return Expanded(
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () {
          AppFeedback.tap();
          onSelect(value);
        },
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8, horizontal: 4),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isSelected
                ? accent.withValues(alpha: 0.22)
                : const Color(0xFF060B16).withValues(alpha: 0.72),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11),
            border: Border.all(color: isSelected ? accent : Colors.white12),
          ),
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: Text(
            label,
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: TextStyle(
              color: isSelected ? accent : Colors.white70,
              fontSize: 10,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../providers/kas_santri_provider.dart';
import '../screens/paywall_screen.dart';
import '../utils/app_feedback.dart';
import '../utils/currency_formatter.dart';

class TarikTunaiBottomSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const TarikTunaiBottomSheet({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  static Future<void> show(BuildContext context) async {
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    if (!provider.hasProAccess) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      await PaywallScreen.show(
        context,
        triggerFeature: 'Multi-Dompet: Pisah Kas Laci Tunai vs Rekening Bank & Tarik ke Laci',
      );
      return;
    }
    await showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      useSafeArea: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => const TarikTunaiBottomSheet(),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<TarikTunaiBottomSheet> createState() => _TarikTunaiBottomSheetState();
}

class _TarikTunaiBottomSheetState extends State<TarikTunaiBottomSheet> {
  final TextEditingController _nominalController = TextEditingController(text: '100.000');
  final TextEditingController _catatanController = TextEditingController();
  bool _isSubmitting = false;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nominalController.dispose();
    _catatanController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  int get _nominal => CurrencyFormatter.parse(_nominalController.text);

  void _addChip(int amount, int maxBank) {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    final next = (_nominal + amount).clamp(0, maxBank);
    setState(() {
      _nominalController.text = next > 0 ? CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(next) : '0';
    });
  }

  void _setAllBank(int maxBank) {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    setState(() {
      _nominalController.text = maxBank > 0 ? CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(maxBank) : '0';
    });
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);
    final bank = provider.rekeningBank;
    final nominal = _nominal;

    if (nominal <= 0) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Masukkan nominal tarik tunai lebih dari Rp 0!'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFFF43F5E),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    if (nominal > bank) {
      AppFeedback.alert();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('Saldo Rekening Bank tidak mencukupi (tersedia ${CurrencyFormatter.format(bank)}).'),
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF43F5E),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isSubmitting = true);
    try {
      await provider.tarikTunaiKeLaci(
        nominal: nominal,
        catatan: _catatanController.text.trim(),
      );
      AppFeedback.success();
      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pop(context);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(
              'Berhasil memindahkan ${CurrencyFormatter.format(nominal)} dari Rekening Bank ke Kas Laci Tunai.',
            ),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isSubmitting = false);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('$e'), backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF43F5E)),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context);
    final bankNow = provider.rekeningBank;
    final laciNow = provider.kasLaciTunai;
    final bankAfter = (bankNow - _nominal).clamp(0, double.infinity).toInt();
    final laciAfter = laciNow + _nominal;
    final isOverBank = _nominal > bankNow;
    final bottomSafe = MediaQuery.of(context).padding.bottom;

    return SafeArea(
      top: true,
      bottom: false,
      child: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          gradient: const LinearGradient(
            colors: [Color(0xF52B1D07), Color(0xF70C172B), Color(0xF7062328)],
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
          ),
          borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(32)),
          border: const Border(top: BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFF59E0B), width: 1.5)),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: const Color(0xFFF59E0B).withValues(alpha: 0.18),
              blurRadius: 24,
              offset: const Offset(0, -6),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(
          top: 12,
          left: 20,
          right: 20,
          bottom: MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom + bottomSafe + 24,
        ),
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Center(
                child: Container(
                  width: 44,
                  height: 4,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Colors.white24, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),

              Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(

                            border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFFBBF24).withOpacity(0.5)),
                          ),
                          child: const Text(
                            '👑 MULTI-DOMPET PRO',
                            style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFFDE68A), fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../providers/kas_santri_provider.dart';
import '../screens/paywall_screen.dart';
import '../utils/app_feedback.dart';
import '../utils/currency_formatter.dart';

class TunggakanBottomSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final Santri santri;

  const TunggakanBottomSheet({
    Key? key,
    required this.santri,
  }) : super(key: key);

  static Future<void> show(BuildContext context, Santri santri) async {
    await showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      useSafeArea: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => TunggakanBottomSheet(santri: santri),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<TunggakanBottomSheet> createState() => _TunggakanBottomSheetState();
}

class _TunggakanBottomSheetState extends State<TunggakanBottomSheet> {
  final TextEditingController _nominalController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _catatanController = TextEditingController();
  bool _isBayarMode = true; // true = Bayar / Cicil, false = Tambah Tunggakan
  String _sumberDompet = 'TUNAI';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _isBayarMode = widget.santri.tunggakan > 0;
    if (_isBayarMode) {
      _nominalController.text = CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(widget.santri.tunggakan);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nominalController.dispose();
    _catatanController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  int get _nominal => CurrencyFormatter.parse(_nominalController.text);

  void _isiLunas() {
    AppFeedback.tap();
    setState(() {
      _nominalController.text = CurrencyFormatter.formatWithoutSymbol(widget.santri.tunggakan);
    });
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    if (_nominal <= 0) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Masukkan nominal tunggakan lebih dari Rp 0!'),
          backgroundColor: Color(0xFFF43F5E),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final provider = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context, listen: false);

  Widget _buildDompetChip(String label, String value, Color accent) {
    final isPro = Provider.of<KasSantriProvider>(context).hasProAccess;
    final isLockedRekening = value == 'REKENING' && !isPro;
    final isSelected = _sumberDompet == value && !isLockedRekening;
    final displayLabel = isLockedRekening ? '$label 👑' : label;
    return Expanded(
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () {
          AppFeedback.tap();
          if (isLockedRekening) {
            PaywallScreen.show(
              context,
              triggerFeature: 'Multi-Dompet: Pisah Kas Laci Tunai vs Rekening Bank',
            );
            setState(() => _sumberDompet = 'TUNAI');
            return;
          }
          setState(() => _sumberDompet = value);
        },
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 9),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isSelected ? accent.withOpacity(0.18) : const Color(0xFF060A14),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            border: Border.all(
              color: isSelected
                  ? accent
                  : (isLockedRekening
                      ? const Color(0xFFFBBF24).withValues(alpha: 0.45)
                      : Colors.white12),
            ),
          ),
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: Text(
            displayLabel,
            style: TextStyle(
              color: isSelected
                  ? accent
                  : (isLockedRekening ? const Color(0xFFFDE68A) : Colors.white60),
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

class UndoToastHelper {
  static Timer? _dismissTimer;

  static void showPostWithdrawal({
    required ScaffoldMessengerState messenger,
    required KasSantriProvider provider,
    required String message,
    required double bottomMargin,
    bool isWarning = false,
  }) {
    _dismissTimer?.cancel();
    messenger.hideCurrentSnackBar();

    messenger.showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        dismissDirection: DismissDirection.horizontal,
        margin: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, bottomMargin),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          side: BorderSide(
            color: isWarning
                ? const Color(0xFFFB7185).withOpacity(0.6)
                : const Color(0xFF34D399).withOpacity(0.45),
          ),
        ),
        backgroundColor:
            isWarning ? const Color(0xFF881337) : const Color(0xFF0F172A),
        content: Row(
          children: [
            Icon(
              isWarning ? Icons.warning_amber_rounded : Icons.check_circle_rounded,
              color: isWarning ? const Color(0xFFFDE68A) : const Color(0xFF34D399),
              size: 18,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                message,
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            InkWell(
              onTap: () async {
                _dismissTimer?.cancel();
                messenger.hideCurrentSnackBar();
                await provider.undoLastTransaction();
                _showAutoDismissInfo(
                  messenger: messenger,
                  message: 'Transaksi dibatalkan & saldo dikembalikan.',
                  bottomMargin: bottomMargin,
                );
              },
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 5),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: const Color(0xFFFBBF24).withOpacity(0.18),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: const Color(0xFFFBBF24).withOpacity(0.55),
                  ),
                ),
                child: ValueListenableBuilder<UndoState?>(
                  valueListenable: provider.undoStateNotifier,
                  builder: (context, undoState, _) {
                    final secs = undoState?.countdown ?? provider.undoCountdown;
                    return Text(
                      secs > 0 ? 'Batal (${secs}s)' : 'Batal',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        color: Color(0xFFFDE68A),
                        fontSize: 11.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 4),
            InkWell(
              onTap: () {
                _dismissTimer?.cancel();
                provider.dismissUndo();
                messenger.hideCurrentSnackBar();
              },
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              child: const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.all(4),
                child: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: Colors.white54, size: 16),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );

    _dismissTimer = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 4), () {
      messenger.hideCurrentSnackBar();
    });
  }

  static void _showAutoDismissInfo({
    required ScaffoldMessengerState messenger,
    required String message,
    required double bottomMargin,
  }) {
    _dismissTimer?.cancel();
    messenger.hideCurrentSnackBar();
    messenger.showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        dismissDirection: DismissDirection.horizontal,
        margin: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, bottomMargin),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 9),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
        backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF59E0B),
        content: Text(
          message,
          maxLines: 1,
          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
          style: const TextStyle(
            color: Color(0xFF030712),
            fontSize: 12,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
    _dismissTimer = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 2), () {
      messenger.hideCurrentSnackBar();
    });
  }
}

                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(

                ),
                child: Text(
                  'BATAL (${undoState.countdown}s)',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),

              ),
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.close, color: Colors.white54, size: 18),
                onPressed: () => provider.dismissUndo(),
                visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,

            ],

        );
      },
    );
  }
```

### [115/123] `prd.md`

````markdown
# Product Requirements Document (PRD): Aplikasi Kas-Santri

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **ATURAN WAJIB PEMELIHARAAN PRD (STANDING RULE):**
> Setiap kali ada penambahan fitur baru, perubahan arsitektur/skema database, perubahan aturan bisnis, pembaruan keamanan, atau perubahan konfigurasi build/CI/CD di masa mendatang, agen AI / pengembang **WAJIB** memperbarui dokumen `prd.md` ini pada commit yang sama agar `prd.md` selalu 100% sinkron dengan kondisi aktual kode sumber (*Single Source of Truth*).

- **Nama Produk:** Kas-Santri (Sistem Manajemen Uang Saku, Titipan, Tunggakan & Infak Santri Terpadu)
- **Versi Rilis Aktif:** `v4.2.0+42` (`AppConfig.appVersion = '4.2.0'`)
- **Platform:** Mobile App Android (Flutter — Offline-First + Cloud Backup PRO) untuk distribusi Direct APK (DANA/QRIS) dan Google Play Store (`.aab`)
- **Target Pengguna:** Pengurus Pondok, Musyrif/Musyrifah, Bendahara Asrama, Bendahara Infak, atau Wali Kamar di seluruh Pondok Pesantren
- **Tema Visual Utama:** *Dark Translucent Aurora Glassmorphism v4.2* (Obsidian Dark `#090D16`, Emerald `#10B981`, Royal Gold `#F59E0B`, dengan 1 Global `AppBackgroundWrapper` + Tata Letak Tombol Kartu 2 Kotak)
- **Pengembang:** Moch Khoirul Azman
- **Repositori Utama:** https://github.com/mochkhoirulazman-max/kas-santri.git (Workspace: `project antigrafity`)
- **Status Dokumen:** **Versi 4.2 Final Master** (Smooth 60–120 FPS, Multi-Pondok Neutral, Strict PRO Gating `hasProAccess`, Rekonsiliasi Akuntansi 100%, Modular Repository Architecture, Ed25519 License + Admin Command Center, & Standar CI/CD AGP 9.3.1)

---

## 1. Latar Belakang & Konteks Masalah (Problem Statement)

Di lingkungan pondok pesantren, santri tidak diperbolehkan memegang uang tunai dalam jumlah besar untuk menghindari kehilangan, pemborosan, atau pencurian. Selain mengelola uang jajan harian, bendahara pondok juga mengurus **Infak Bulanan (Masak/Makan, Listrik, dan Beras)** yang sering kali dititipkan sekaligus oleh orang tua saat menjenguk (*sambangan*).

### Masalah Utama di Lapangan
1. **Pengambilan Harian yang Acak (*Micro-Withdrawals*):** Santri mengambil jatah harian secara dicicil acak (pagi Rp 2.000, siang Rp 5.000, malam Rp 3.000), sehingga pencatatan buku kertas rawan salah hitung saat antrean padat.
2. **Pembagian Amplop Sambangan (*Split Payment*) yang Rumit:** Saat wali santri menjenguk dan menitipkan uang total (misal Rp 500.000), bendahara harus memecahnya untuk Infak Masak (Rp 130.000), Infak Listrik (Rp 20.000), Infak Beras (baik berupa fisik 15 Liter maupun uang pengganti Rp 150.000), memotong tunggakan, lalu memasukkan sisanya ke Saldo Uang Jajan.
3. **Pencatatan Buku Infak Kertas Rawan Salah & Sulit Direkap:** Bendahara harus membuka 3 buku terpisah (Santriyin, Santriyat, Santri Baru), menandai santri pulang/pindah dengan stabilo hijau, rawan salah tulis Tgl Habis (+1 bulan), serta kesulitan memisahkan total beras fisik (Liter) vs uang beras (Rupiah).
4. **Campur Aduk Kantong Uang:** Tanpa pemisahan tegas antara Titipan Uang Jajan Santri, Kas Infak Pondok (yang harus disetor ke Dapur/Yayasan), Kas Laci Tunai, dan Saldo Rekening Bank, bendahara rentan mengalami selisih saat tutup kas malam (*Cash Opname*).
5. **Kasus Khusus (*Overlimit*, *Carry-Over* & Tunggakan):** Sulit melacak santri yang mengambil melebihi batas harian, akumulasi jatah sisa kemarin, serta tunggakan/talangan administrasi.

### Solusi Kas-Santri v4.2 PRO
Aplikasi mobile **Kas-Santri v4.2 PRO** dengan antarmuka super cepat (*3-Tap Transaction* di bawah 5 detik dan Scan QR 1 detik), *Smart Split Setoran Sambangan*, *Buku Infak Bulanan Digital* (Santriyin, Santriyat, Santri Baru), *Serah Terima Infak ke Dapur/Yayasan*, rekonsiliasi 3 kantong kas presisi 0 selisih, verifikasi fisik *Cash Opname*, serta ekspor laporan PDF/Excel resmi berkop logo pondok yang berjalan mulus 60–120 FPS di latar belakang (`compute()` isolate).

---

## 2. Logika Bisnis & Mesin Perhitungan (Core Financial Engine)

### A. Perhitungan Jatah Harian Dasar & Pembulatan Tunai Otomatis
Saat santri menyetorkan uang bersih $S_{bersih}$ untuk durasi $D_{hari}$ (default: $30$ hari), dengan opsi pemotongan tunggakan $P_{tunggakan}$:

$$S_{bersih} = S_{awal} - P_{tunggakan}$$

Hasil bagi dibulatkan ke bawah (*floor*) pada kelipatan pecahan tunai $K$ (default $K = \text{Rp } 500$ atau dapat diatur ke $K = \text{Rp } 1.000$ di Pengaturan):

$$J_{harian} = \left\lfloor \frac{S_{bersih}}{D_{hari} \times K} \right\rfloor \times K$$

- Selisih pembulatan tidak hangus dan tetap tersimpan utuh di $Saldo_{akhir}$ santri.
- Pada **Top-Up / Setoran Susulan**, `jatah_harian` santri otomatis diperbarui apabila kalkulator menghasilkan nominal `jatahHarianBaru > 0` (atau dapat dipertahankan manual oleh bendahara).
- Saat menambah **Santri Baru**, saldo awal otomatis dimulai dari `Rp 0` agar seluruh pemasukan uang tercatat rapi melalui modul **Setoran & Sambangan** dan terekam di `mutasi_dompet`.

### B. Perhitungan Pengambilan Harian Bertahap (*Multi-Withdrawal*)
Dalam satu hari yang sama, santri dapat melakukan $n$ kali pengambilan ($P_1, P_2, \dots, P_n$):

$$T_{hari\_ini} = \sum_{i=1}^{n} P_i, \qquad Sisa_{jatah\_hari\_ini} = J_{efektif\_hari\_ini} - T_{hari\_ini}$$

### C. Perhitungan Sisa Saldo Total & Estimasi Ketahanan Hari

$$Saldo_{akhir} = (S_{awal} + S_{susulan} - P_{tunggakan}) - \sum T_{seluruh\_hari}$$

$$\text{Estimasi Hari} = \left\lfloor \frac{Saldo_{akhir}}{J_{harian}} \right\rfloor$$

Jika $\text{Estimasi Hari} < 3$, santri otomatis masuk kategori **Saldo Kritis**.

### D. Aturan Khusus (*Edge Cases Logic*) & Rekonsiliasi Akuntansi v4.2
1. **Pengambilan Melebihi Jatah Harian ($T_{hari\_ini} > J_{efektif\_hari\_ini}$):** Memunculkan *Warning Modal* izin darurat dengan pilihan:
   - **Opsi A (`OverlimitHandling.potongBesok`):** Kelebihan pengambilan hari ini otomatis memotong kuota `jatahHariIni` santri pada hari berikutnya (`computeEffectiveDailyQuotaMap`).
   - **Opsi B (`OverlimitHandling.hitungUlangRataRata`):** Menghitung ulang `jatah_harian` berdasarkan sisa hari periode aktual dari `setoran_bulanan` terakhir santri:
     $$J_{harian\_baru} = \left\lfloor \frac{Saldo_{akhir}}{Sisa_{hari\_periode\_aktual} \times K} \right\rfloor \times K$$
2. **Mode Sisa Jatah Harian (`ModeSisaHarian.ketat` vs `ModeSisaHarian.akumulasi`):**
   - **Mode Ketat (Default):** Sisa kuota hari ini tetap tersimpan di $Saldo_{akhir}$, dan kuota besok kembali ke $J_{harian}$ standar (dikurangi potongan overlimit kemarin jika ada).
   - **Mode Akumulasi:** Sisa kuota kemarin yang tidak diambil ($J_{harian} - T_{kemarin} > 0$) otomatis ditambahkan ke kuota `jatahHariIni` hari berikutnya (dibatasi maksimal `saldoTotal`).
3. **Rekonsiliasi Ketat `editTransaksi()`, `voidTransaksi()`, dan `deleteSantri()` (0 Selisih Brankas vs Dompet):**
   - **`editTransaksi()`:** Menolak transaksi yang sudah `isVoided` atau `newNominal <= 0`, otomatis mengonversi kekurangan saldo menjadi `tunggakan` (`TALANGAN_SALDO`) agar `saldo_total` tidak pernah negatif, dan memperbarui/mencatat jurnal penyesuaian di `mutasi_dompet`.
   - **`voidTransaksi(TipeTransaksi.setoran)`:** Memulihkan potongan tunggakan (`nominal_potong_tunggakan`), menandai void pada `setoran_bulanan`, mencatat mutasi penyeimbang `KELUAR` di `mutasi_dompet`, dan apabila sebagian saldo setoran sudah terlanjur dipakai jajan (`saldo_total < nominal_bersih`), otomatis mencatat selisih yang terpakai sebagai `tunggakan` (`TALANGAN_SALDO`) dengan peringatan konfirmasi jelas di UI.
   - **`deleteSantri()` (Opsi Hybrid Aman):** Menyediakan pilihan utama **"Arsipkan sebagai Boyong/Lulus"** jika santri memiliki saldo/riwayat. Jika bendahara tetap memilih **Hapus Permanen** saat `saldo_total > 0`, sistem menampilkan dialog konfirmasi nominal pengembalian saldo lalu otomatis mencatat mutasi penyeimbang `KELUAR` di `mutasi_dompet` (default `TUNAI`) serta `audit_log` agar `totalBrankasFisik == kasLaciTunai + rekeningBank` tetap 100% seimbang.

### E. Logika Smart Split Setoran Sambangan (Infak + Uang Jajan)
Saat wali menitipkan total uang $U_{total}$ (contoh: $\text{Rp } 500.000$) dalam satu kali sambangan/transfer:

$$I_{uang} = I_{masak} + I_{listrik} + I_{beras\_uang}$$

$$S_{jajan} = U_{total} - (I_{uang} + P_{tunggakan})$$

- **Tarif Default Awal Pondok (dapat diubah bebas di Pengaturan):**
  - Infak Masak / Makan Bulanan: `Rp 130.000`
  - Infak Listrik: `Rp 20.000`
  - Infak Beras Fisik: `15 Liter` (jika bawa beras fisik, maka $I_{beras\_uang} = \text{Rp } 0$)
  - Infak Beras Pengganti Uang: `Rp 150.000`
- **Perhitungan Otomatis Tgl Habis (*Rolling Date*):** `tgl_habis` otomatis dihitung $+1$ bulan kalender dari `tgl_masuk` (contoh: `18-11-2026` -> `18-12-2026`).
- **Penentuan Otomatis Status Infak:** `LUNAS`, `CICIL`, atau `BELUM`.

### F. Akuntansi 3 Kantong Kas & Verifikasi Cash Opname Terpadu
1. **Kantong 1 — Brankas Titipan Uang Jajan Santri ($\text{Rp}$):** $\sum Saldo_{akhir,\text{santri}}$ (terpecah menjadi Kas Laci Tunai dan Rekening Bank).
2. **Kantong 2 — Kas Infak Pondok Belum Disetor ($\text{Rp}$):**
   $$\text{Saldo Kas Infak} = \sum I_{uang,\text{masuk}} - \sum \text{Serah Terima ke Dapur/Yayasan}$$
3. **Kantong 3 — Catatan Gudang Beras Fisik ($\text{Liter}$):** Total akumulasi liter beras fisik dikurangi serah terima beras fisik ke dapur.
4. **Verifikasi Tutup Kas Malam (*Cash Opname*):**
   $$\text{Target Uang Fisik di Laci} = \text{Kas Laci Tunai (Uang Jajan)} + \text{Kas Infak Tunai Belum Disetor}$$
   $$\Delta_{selisih} = \text{Total Uang Fisik di Laci} - \text{Target Uang Fisik di Laci}$$

## 3. Spesifikasi Fitur Lengkap & Gerbang Ketat PRO (`hasProAccess`)

### A. Gerbang Terpusat `SubscriptionService.hasProAccess`
Seluruh pengecekan fitur premium wajib melalui satu getter terpusat:
```dart
bool get hasProAccess => isProActive || isTrialActive;
```
- Tombol simulasi debug PRO (`toggleDebugPro`) **DILARANG** tampil atau aktif pada *release build* (`if (!kDebugMode) return;`).
- Pada mode **Gratis (Free)** saat Uji Coba 14 Hari belum diaktifkan atau sudah berakhir, **10 kelompok fitur PRO** berikut wajib terkunci rapat (menampilkan badge `🔒 PRO` / `👑` dan mengarahkan ke `PaywallScreen`):
  1. **Tambah Santri ke-16 ke atas** (maksimal 15 santri aktif di mode Gratis, termasuk saat Import Excel maupun pengaktifan kembali santri arsip).
  2. **Multi-Dompet (Rincian Kas Laci Tunai vs Rekening Bank, Tombol Tarik Bank ke Laci, & Chip Input `🏦 Rekening Bank`)** di `SafeVaultCard`, `SetoranScreen`, `InfakEditBottomSheet`, dan `TunggakanBottomSheet`.
  3. **Kalkulator Cash Opname Pecahan Fisik.**
  4. **Scan QR Kartu Santri & Cetak Massal / Satuan Kartu QR PDF** (termasuk di `QuickEditSantriBottomSheet` dan `SantriDetailScreen`).
  5. **Ekspor Excel (`.xlsx`) & PDF Resmi** (di Riwayat Mutasi, Rekap WA, Buku Infak, dan Buku Mutasi Individu `SantriDetailScreen`).
  6. **Kirim WA 1-Klik, Bagikan Struk Gambar PNG bebas watermark, Filter Saldo Kritis (`< 3 Hari`), & Filter Jatuh Tempo Infak (`<= 3 Hari`).**
  7. **Upload Logo Kustom Pondok, Kunci Aplikasi PIN & Biometrik, serta Backup Cloud Google Drive & Backup Terenkripsi `.KSBAK` (AES-256-GCM).**
  8. **Dashboard Analitik Eksekutif Yayasan (`ExecutiveDashboardScreen`).**
  9. **Pusat Antrean Pengingat WA Cerdas (`SmartWaReminderScreen`).**
  10. **Manajemen Tahun Ajaran & Pindah Kamar Massal (`TahunAjaranScreen`) serta Log Audit Keamanan SHA-256 (`AuditLogScreen`).**

### B. Rincian Modul Utama (Fase 1 s.d. Fase 10)
- **Beranda & Pencairan Cepat 3-Tap (`HomeFastWithdrawalScreen`):**
  - Header pondok netral multi-pondok (default `'Nama Pondok'`), jam lokal real-time, ikon Mahkota PRO (`👑`) dengan animasi terisolasi `RepaintBoundary` (otomatis berhenti saat status PRO aktif untuk menghemat GPU).
  - `SafeVaultCard` dengan tombol privasi saldo, rincian Multi-Dompet, pintasan `🌾 Buku Infak`, `Scan QR`, pencarian instan, filter status/kamar, serta grid 2-kolom / 1-baris kartu santri (`SantriCard` dengan `ResizeImage` 180px tanpa `existsSync()` di `build()`).
  - Toast Undo 5 detik (`UndoToastOverlay`) yang dikendalikan oleh `ValueNotifier<UndoState?>` terisolasi sehingga countdown 1 detik **tidak pernah** memicu `notifyListeners()` global pada 4 tab `PageView`.
- **Buku Mutasi Lengkap Individu (`SantriDetailScreen` — Reconnected v4.2):**
  - Dapat dibuka langsung dari tombol **"📄 Lihat Buku Mutasi Lengkap"** di dalam `QuickEditSantriBottomSheet` maupun `RekapLaporanScreen`.
  - Menampilkan profil & metrik lengkap santri, aksi cepat (Ambil Uang, Setoran/Sambangan, Kelola Tunggakan, Edit Profil, Cetak Kartu QR PRO, Cetak PDF Mutasi PRO, dan Arsip/Hapus Santri Hybrid), serta tab riwayat transaksi & setoran lengkap dengan Void berperingatan rekonsiliasi.
- **Setoran Bulanan, Smart Split Sambangan & Buku Infak (`SetoranScreen` & `BukuInfakView`):**
  - 2 sub-tab terpadu: `💸 Input Setoran` (Top-Up Uang Jajan & Smart Split Sambangan) dan `🌾 Buku Infak` (monitoring infak bulanan Santriyin/Santriyat/Santri Baru, edit cicilan infak dengan audit log `EDIT_INFAK_MANUAL`, Serah Terima ke Dapur/Yayasan, dan ekspor PDF/Excel 4-Sheet).
- **Onboarding Multi-Pondok & Spotlight Walkthrough (`OnboardingScreen` & `InteractiveWalkthroughOverlay`):**

## 4. Arsitektur Modular v4.2 (Facade & Repository Pattern)

Untuk menjaga *maintainability* jangka panjang dan mencegah *God Classes* tanpa merusak pemanggil yang sudah ada (*Zero Regression*), lapisan data dan ekspor dipecah secara modular dengan pola **Facade + Repository**:

1. **Lapisan Database SQLite (`lib/database/`):**
   - `lib/database/database_helper.dart` (**Public Facade** — mempertahankan 100% tanda tangan metode `DatabaseHelper.instance`).
   - `lib/database/schema_migrator.dart`: DDL pembuatan 10 tabel, indeks performa, migrasi aman v1->v4, `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON`, dan backfill QR/hash.
   - `lib/database/repositories/santri_repository.dart`: CRUD santri, filter, pindah kamar massal, tutup buku tahun ajaran, dan penghapusan santri hybrid berpenyeimbang `mutasi_dompet`.
   - `lib/database/repositories/ledger_repository.dart`: Mesin transaksi `catatPengambilan`, `catatSetoranBaru`, `catatSambanganSmartSplit`, `editTransaksi`, `voidTransaksi`, manajemen tunggakan, batch query `getAllTransaksiPengambilanHariIniMap`, agregasi SQL `getSaldoDompet`, tarik tunai bank ke laci, dan `cash_opname_logs`.
   - `lib/database/repositories/infak_repository.dart`: CRUD `infak_santri`, `serah_terima_infak`, dan agregasi SQL `getSaldoKantongInfak`.
   - `lib/database/repositories/backup_audit_repository.dart`: Pengaturan aplikasi, akun bendahara, rantai hash `audit_log`, `dumpBackupJson`, `restoreFromJson` (anti-elevasi `is_pro`/`has_used_trial`), dan `seedDemoData`.
2. **Lapisan Ekspor Laporan (`lib/services/`):**
   - `lib/services/yayasan_export_service.dart` (**Public Facade** & model data laporan).
   - `lib/services/exports/yayasan_excel_exporter.dart`: Pembuatan workbook Excel Yayasan 3-Sheet & Buku Infak 4-Sheet di dalam background isolate `compute()`.
   - `lib/services/exports/yayasan_pdf_exporter.dart`: Generator dokumen PDF Resmi Yayasan & Buku Infak berkop logo pondok.

## 5. Skema Database SQLite Offline-First (10 Tabel — Versi Skema 4)

Koneksi SQLite wajib mengaktifkan `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;` pada callback `onConfigure` dan menjalankan migrasi skema secara deterministik pada `onUpgrade`.

| No | Nama Tabel | Fungsi Utama & Kolom Kunci |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `santri` | Profil & saldo santri (`id`, `qr_code`, `nama_lengkap`, `nama_panggilan`, `kategori_santri`, `status_santri`, `kamar`, `foto_path`, `nama_wali`, `no_wa_wali`, `saldo_total`, `jatah_harian`, `tunggakan`, `status_aktif`, `created_at`, `updated_at`). |
| 2 | `setoran_bulanan` | Riwayat setoran & Smart Split (`id`, `santri_id`, `nominal_setoran`, `nominal_potong_tunggakan`, `nominal_bersih`, `durasi_hari`, `jatah_harian_hasil`, `tipe_setoran`, `sumber_dompet`, `catatan`, `tanggal_setor`). |
| 3 | `transaksi_harian` | Mutasi keluar/masuk harian (`id`, `santri_id`, `nominal`, `saldo_sebelum`, `saldo_sesudah`, `tipe`, `waktu_ambil` **[kolom urutan utama]**, `tanggal_lokal`, `kategori_waktu`, `tag_keperluan`, `catatan`, `operator_nama`, `is_overlimit`, `overlimit_handling`, `is_void`, `alasan_void`, `sumber_dompet`). |
| 4 | `tunggakan_log` | Riwayat tambah/bayar/potong/talangan tunggakan (`id`, `santri_id`, `nominal`, `tipe`, `sumber_dompet`, `catatan`, `tanggal`). |
| 5 | `mutasi_dompet` | Buku besar Kas Laci Tunai vs Rekening Bank (`id`, `jenis_dompet`, `tipe`, `nominal`, `kategori`, `referensi_id`, `catatan`, `tanggal`). |
| 6 | `cash_opname_logs` | Riwayat audit pecahan uang fisik laci (`id`, `tanggal_lokal`, `waktu_simpan`, `total_fisik`, `saldo_sistem_tunai`, `selisih`, `rincian_pecahan_json`, `catatan`, `operator_nama`). |
| 7 | `pengaturan_aplikasi` | Konfigurasi singleton (`id = 1`, `nama_pondok` default `'Nama Pondok'`, `tahun_ajaran`, `nama_pengurus`, `no_wa_pengurus`, `logo_path`, `jatah_harian_default`, `durasi_default_hari`, `kelipatan_pembulatan`, `mode_sisa_harian`, `mode_sisa_bulan_lalu`, `tarif_infak_*`, `pin_hash`, `is_pin_enabled`, `is_biometric_enabled`, `is_pro`, `pro_plan`, `has_used_trial`, `trial_start_date`, `last_backup_date`). |
| 8 | `infak_santri` | Buku Infak bulanan per santri (`id`, `santri_id`, `periode_bulan`, `tahun_ajaran`, `nominal_masak`, `is_masak_bebas`, `nominal_listrik`, `is_listrik_bebas`, `jenis_beras`, `beras_liter`, `beras_uang`, `tgl_masuk`, `tgl_habis`, `status_lunas`, `sumber_dompet`, `setoran_id`, `catatan`, `updated_at`). |
| 9 | `serah_terima_infak` | Berita acara penyerahan uang infak/beras ke Dapur/Yayasan (`id`, `tanggal_serah`, `periode_bulan`, `pos_infak`, `sumber_dompet`, `nominal_uang`, `jumlah_beras_liter`, `penerima`, `catatan`, `created_at`). |
| 10 | `audit_log` | Jejak audit keamanan *append-only* berantai SHA-256 (`id`, `timestamp`, `actor`, `action`, `target_id`, `summary`, `prev_hash`, `entry_hash`). |

**Indeks Performa Wajib:**
- `idx_transaksi_santri_tanggal ON transaksi_harian (santri_id, tanggal_lokal)`
- `idx_transaksi_waktu ON transaksi_harian (waktu_ambil DESC)`
- `idx_infak_periode_santri ON infak_santri (periode_bulan, santri_id)`
- `idx_serah_terima_periode ON serah_terima_infak (periode_bulan, tanggal_serah DESC)`
- `idx_audit_log_ts ON audit_log (timestamp DESC)`
- `idx_mutasi_dompet_jenis_tipe ON mutasi_dompet (jenis_dompet, tipe)`
- `idx_mutasi_dompet_ref ON mutasi_dompet (referensi_id)`

## 6. Keamanan, Lisensi Ed25519, Kepatuhan Play Store & Admin Command Center

1. **Lisensi Offline Asimetris Ed25519 (`LicenseService`):**
   - Kode aktivasi berformat `KSPRO-<PAYLOAD_B32>-<SIGNATURE_B32>` diverifikasi secara offline menggunakan kunci publik Ed25519.
   - Kunci publik produksi dapat disuntikkan saat kompilasi melalui `--dart-define=KAS_SANTRI_ED25519_PUBKEY=<BASE64_32_BYTE_PUBKEY>` (dengan fallback aman untuk unit test CI).
   - Generator lisensi HTML warisan berbasis SHA-256 **telah dihapus permanen** dan digantikan sepenuhnya oleh **Admin Command Center (`admin_dashboard/index.html`)** berbasis Ed25519 yang dilengkapi proteksi *Subresource Integrity* (SRI `sha384-...`) dan *Content Security Policy* (CSP).
2. **Proteksi Anti-Tamper Backup & Jam Perangkat:**
   - `restoreFromJson()` memblokir manipulasi status `is_pro`, `pro_plan`, `has_used_trial`, dan `trial_start_date` dari file `.json` luar, diikuti pemanggilan `syncSubscriptionEntitlement()` ke `SubscriptionService`.
   - Enkripsi/dekripsi `.ksbak` (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 60.000 iterasi + AES-256-GCM) berjalan di background isolate `compute()`.
3. **Kepatuhan Penuh Google Play Store (`PLAY_STORE_BUILD=true`):**
   - Menyembunyikan seluruh UI/teks pembayaran DANA & aktivasi kode luar baik di `PaywallScreen` maupun di dalam `LegalDocumentSheet.showTerms`.
   - `CustomerSyncService` menonaktifkan pengiriman *Personal Identifiers* (`nama_bendahara` dan `no_wa` dikosongkan) pada build Google Play Store agar 100% patuh terhadap deklarasi *Google Play Data Safety*, serta disinkronkan penuh dengan `docs/privacy.html`.
   - Seluruh aset gambar bawaan (`assets/wallpapers/default_wallpaper.jpg`) 100% bebas watermark pihak ketiga.

- **v4.2 (Saat Ini):** Eliminasi query `N+1` di `loadAllData()` (-99% query SQLite), agregasi SQL `SUM(CASE WHEN ...)` pada `getSaldoDompet()` & `getSaldoKantongInfak()`, rekonsiliasi akuntansi 100% pada `editTransaksi`/`voidTransaksi(setoran)`/`deleteSantri`, isolasi `UndoStateNotifier` + background isolate `compute()` untuk Excel & `.ksbak`, kepatuhan Data Safety Play Store & wallpaper bebas watermark, penghubungan kembali `SantriDetailScreen` + penghapusan 5 layar warisan v1.0, modularisasi *Repository Pattern*, dan optimasi pipeline CI/CD 2-Job.

## 8. Panduan Build CI/CD, Kompatibilitas Versi & Git Push (WAJIB DIPATUHI)

### A. Spesifikasi Kompatibilitas Versi (DILARANG DIUBAH SEMBARANGAN)
- **Android Gradle Plugin (AGP):** `9.3.1` (`android/settings.gradle`)
- **Gradle Wrapper:** `9.5.0` (`android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties`)
- **Kotlin Version:** `2.4.20` (`android/settings.gradle`)
- **Java Target:** `Java 17` di `android/app/build.gradle` (dijalankan di atas runner JDK 21 Temurin pada GitHub Actions untuk kompatibilitas AGP 9.3.1 / Gradle 9.5.0)
- **SDK Targets:** `compileSdk = 36`, `targetSdk = 36`, `minSdkVersion = 24`
- **AndroidManifest Storage Permissions:** `READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` dibatasi `android:maxSdkVersion="32"` dan `WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` dibatasi `android:maxSdkVersion="29"`
- **BuildConfig:** Wajib `buildFeatures { buildConfig = true }` di `android/app/build.gradle`; **DILARANG** memakai flag usang `android.defaults.buildfeatures.buildconfig=true` di `android/gradle.properties`

### B. Arsitektur 2-Job GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/flutter-apk.yml`)
1. **Job 1 — `quality-gate` (`1. Quality Gate (Format, Analyze & Unit Tests)`):**
   - Menjalankan `flutter pub get`, verifikasi `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test`, analisis statis ketat `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --fatal-warnings`, dan seluruh suite pengujian `flutter test --coverage` dalam 1 runner VM terpadu.
2. **Job 2 — `build-release-apk` (`2. Build Signed Release APK & AAB`, `needs: [quality-gate]`):**
   - Menyuntikkan secrets opsional `REVENUECAT_ANDROID_API_KEY`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, dan `KAS_SANTRI_ED25519_PUBKEY` via `--dart-define`.
   - Memberikan peringatan eksplisit pada `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` apabila secret keystore release (`KEYSTORE_BASE64`) belum dikonfigurasi.
   - **Build APK Release (Direct DANA/QRIS):**
     ```bash
     flutter build apk --release --obfuscate --split-debug-info=build/app/outputs/symbols --android-skip-build-dependency-validation --dart-define=PLAY_STORE_BUILD=false "${EXTRA_DEFINES[@]}"
     ```
   - **Build AAB Release (Google Play Store Billing):**
     ```bash
     flutter build appbundle --release --obfuscate --split-debug-info=build/app/outputs/symbols --android-skip-build-dependency-validation --dart-define=PLAY_STORE_BUILD=true "${EXTRA_DEFINES[@]}"
     ```

### C. Prosedur Git Commit & Push
- Path Git lokal: `C:\Users\smkit\AppData\Local\Programs\Git\cmd\git.exe` (jalankan dengan `BypassSandbox: true` saat melakukan operasi jaringan `git push origin main`).
- Pastikan seluruh 10 tabel SQLite tercakup dalam Backup & Restore `.JSON`, `.KSBAK`, dan Google Drive Backup.
````

```dart
      expect(santriTambah.tunggakan, 145000);
    });

    test('H. Logika Setoran Otomatis Potong Tunggakan & Penarikan Saldo Habis', () {
      // 1. Santri punya tunggakan Rp 50.000, setor awal bulan Rp 300.000
      int tunggakan = 50000;
      int setoran = 300000;
      int sisaSetoranMasukSaldo = setoran;

      if (tunggakan > 0) {
        if (sisaSetoranMasukSaldo >= tunggakan) {
          sisaSetoranMasukSaldo -= tunggakan;
          tunggakan = 0;
        } else {
          tunggakan -= sisaSetoranMasukSaldo;
          sisaSetoranMasukSaldo = 0;
        }
      }

      expect(tunggakan, 0); // Tunggakan lunas
      expect(sisaSetoranMasukSaldo, 250000); // Sisa bersih masuk saldo
      const durasiHari = 30;
      final jatahBaru = (sisaSetoranMasukSaldo / durasiHari).round();
      expect(jatahBaru, 8333); // Kuota harian dihitung dari sisa setoran bersih

      // 2. Santri saldo Rp 2.000, ingin ambil Rp 5.000 (Saldo habis -> talangan brankas jadi tunggakan)
      int saldo = 2000;
      int nominalAmbil = 5000;
      int tunggakanSantri = 0;

      if (saldo >= nominalAmbil) {
        saldo -= nominalAmbil;
      } else if (saldo > 0) {
        final kekurangan = nominalAmbil - saldo;
        saldo = 0;
        tunggakanSantri += kekurangan;
      } else {
        saldo = 0;
        tunggakanSantri += nominalAmbil;
      }

      expect(saldo, 0); // Saldo habis
      expect(tunggakanSantri, 3000); // Kekurangan Rp 3.000 jadi tunggakan
    });

    test('I. Presisi Rollback Void Transaksi & Penanganan Hapus Santri', () {
      // Simulasi void transaksi pengambilan yang sebelumnya menimbulkan tunggakan
      int saldo = 0;
      int tunggakan = 3000;
      const nominalVoid = 5000;

      int sisaRefund = nominalVoid;
      if (tunggakan > 0) {
        if (sisaRefund >= tunggakan) {
          sisaRefund -= tunggakan;
          tunggakan = 0;
        } else {
          tunggakan -= sisaRefund;
          sisaRefund = 0;
        }
      }
      saldo += sisaRefund;

      expect(tunggakan, 0); // Tunggakan talangan dibatalkan
      expect(saldo, 2000); // Saldo asli sebelum transaksi berhasil dipulihkan presisi
    });

      final jatah1000 = CurrencyFormatter.hitungJatahHarianBulat(250000, 30, kelipatan: 1000);
      expect(jatah1000, 8000);

      final jatah300 = CurrencyFormatter.hitungJatahHarianBulat(300000, 30, kelipatan: 500);
      expect(jatah300, 10000);
      expect(CurrencyFormatter.hitungSelisihPembulatan(300000, 30, jatah300), 0);
    });

    test('L. Logika Multi-Dompet (Kas Laci Tunai vs Rekening Bank & Tarik ke Laci)', () {
      int laciTunai = 666000;
      int rekeningBank = 1000000;
      int totalBrankas() => laciTunai + rekeningBank;

      expect(totalBrankas(), 1666000);

      // 1. Setoran masuk ke Rekening Bank sebesar Rp 300.000
      rekeningBank += 300000;
      expect(rekeningBank, 1300000);
      expect(totalBrankas(), 1966000);

      // 2. Pengambilan uang harian santri Rp 16.000 memotong Kas Laci Tunai
      laciTunai -= 16000;
      expect(laciTunai, 650000);

      // 3. Tarik Tunai (Bank -> Laci) Rp 500.000 tidak mengubah Total Brankas
      const tarik = 500000;
      rekeningBank -= tarik;
      laciTunai += tarik;
      expect(rekeningBank, 800000);
      expect(laciTunai, 1150000);
      expect(totalBrankas(), 1950000);
    });

    test('M. Kalkulator Cash Opname Fisik 8 Pecahan & Deteksi Selisih', () {
      const kasSistem = 666000;
      final pecahanCocok = <int, int>{
        100000: 5,
        50000: 2,
        20000: 2,
        10000: 2,
        5000: 1,
        1000: 1,
      };
      int hitungFisik(Map<int, int> m) =>
          m.entries.fold(0, (sum, e) => sum + (e.key * e.value));

      final fisikCocok = hitungFisik(pecahanCocok);
      expect(fisikCocok, 666000);
      expect(fisikCocok - kasSistem, 0);

      final pecahanKurang = <int, int>{
        100000: 5,
        50000: 2,
        20000: 2,
        10000: 2,
        5000: 1,
        500: 1,
      };
      final fisikKurang = hitungFisik(pecahanKurang);
      expect(fisikKurang - kasSistem, -500);
    });

      expect(AuthService.isValidPinFormat('1234567'), false);
      expect(AuthService.isValidPinFormat('12ab'), false);
      expect(AuthService.isValidPinFormat('12 34'), false);

      final h1 = AuthService.instance.hashPin('246810');

    test('S. Verifikasi Lisensi Asimetris Ed25519 (MONTHLY, YEARLY, LIFETIME, Anti-Forged)', () async {
      const deviceA = 'KS-A7B94X2M';
      const deviceB = 'KS-ZZZZ9999';
      final now = DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 25, 10, 0);

      String encodeB32(List<int> bytes) {
        const alpha = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567';
        final out = StringBuffer();
        var buffer = 0;
        var bitsLeft = 0;
        for (final b in bytes) {
          buffer = (buffer << 8) | (b & 0xff);
          bitsLeft += 8;
          while (bitsLeft >= 5) {
            out.write(alpha[(buffer >> (bitsLeft - 5)) & 0x1f]);
            bitsLeft -= 5;
          }
        }
        if (bitsLeft > 0) {
          out.write(alpha[(buffer << (5 - bitsLeft)) & 0x1f]);
        }
        return out.toString();
      }

      final ed = Ed25519();
      final testKeyPair = await ed.newKeyPair();
      final testPubKey = await testKeyPair.extractPublicKey();
      final testPubB64 = base64Encode(testPubKey.bytes);

      Future<String> signTestCode({
        required String deviceId,
        required String tier,
        required int expiryEpochSec,
        SimpleKeyPair? keyPairOverride,
      }) async {
        final payload = utf8.encode('$deviceId|$tier|$expiryEpochSec');
        final sig = await ed.sign(payload, keyPair: keyPairOverride ?? testKeyPair);
        return 'KSPRO-${encodeB32(payload)}-${encodeB32(sig.bytes)}';
      }

      // 1. Verifikasi paket YEARLY
      final futureEpoch = DateTime.utc(2027, 11, 25).millisecondsSinceEpoch ~/ 1000;
      final y1Code = await signTestCode(
        deviceId: deviceA,
        tier: 'YEARLY',
        expiryEpochSec: futureEpoch,
      );
      final y1Res = await LicenseService.verifyCodeAsync(
        code: y1Code,
        deviceId: deviceA,
        now: now.toLocal(),
        publicKeyBase64Override: testPubB64,
      );
      expect(y1Res.isValid, true);
      expect(y1Res.planKey, 'YEARLY');

      // 2. Verifikasi paket LIFETIME (expiry = 0)
      final ltCode = await signTestCode(
        deviceId: deviceA,
        tier: 'LIFETIME',
        expiryEpochSec: 0,
      );
      final ltRes = await LicenseService.verifyCodeAsync(
        code: ltCode,
        deviceId: deviceA,
        now: DateTime(2050, 1, 1),
        publicKeyBase64Override: testPubB64,
      );
      expect(ltRes.isValid, true);
      expect(ltRes.planKey, 'LIFETIME');

      // 3. Ditolak jika device berbeda
      final wrongDevice = await LicenseService.verifyCodeAsync(
        code: y1Code,
        deviceId: deviceB,
        now: now.toLocal(),
        publicKeyBase64Override: testPubB64,
      );
      expect(wrongDevice.isValid, false);

      // 4. Ditolak jika sudah kadaluarsa
      final expiredEpoch = DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 1).millisecondsSinceEpoch ~/ 1000;
      final expiredM1 = await signTestCode(
        deviceId: deviceA,
        tier: 'MONTHLY',
        expiryEpochSec: expiredEpoch,
      );
      final expiredRes = await LicenseService.verifyCodeAsync(
        code: expiredM1,
        deviceId: deviceA,
        now: now.toLocal(),
        publicKeyBase64Override: testPubB64,
      );
      expect(expiredRes.isValid, false);
      expect(expiredRes.isExpired, true);

      // 5. Ditolak jika ditandatangani key lain (anti-keygen / anti-forge)
      final rogueKp = await ed.newKeyPair();
      final forgedCode = await signTestCode(
        deviceId: deviceA,
        tier: 'LIFETIME',
        expiryEpochSec: 0,
        keyPairOverride: rogueKp,
      );
      final forgedRes = await LicenseService.verifyCodeAsync(
        code: forgedCode,
        deviceId: deviceA,
        now: now.toLocal(),
        publicKeyBase64Override: testPubB64,
      );
      expect(forgedRes.isValid, false);
    });

    test('T. Logika Uji Coba Gratis 14 Hari & Konstanta Dual-Mode DANA', () {
      expect(AppConfig.adminDanaNumber, '082130678956');
      expect(AppConfig.adminWhatsappNumber, '6282130678956');
      expect(
        SubscriptionService.qrisAssetForPlan('MONTHLY'),
        'assets/qris_dana_25k.jpg',
      );
      expect(
        SubscriptionService.qrisAssetForPlan('YEARLY'),
        'assets/qris_dana_179k.jpg',
      );
      expect(
        SubscriptionService.qrisAssetForPlan('LIFETIME'),
        'assets/qris_dana_399k.jpg',
      );

      // 1. Belum pernah trial
      final fresh = SubscriptionService.evaluateTrial(hasUsedTrial: false);
      expect(fresh.isActive, false);
      expect(fresh.isExpired, false);
      expect(fresh.remainingDays, 0);

      // 2. Baru mengaktifkan trial hari ke-1
      final start = DateTime(2026, 11, 25, 8, 0);
      final expires = start.add(const Duration(days: 14));
      final day1 = SubscriptionService.evaluateTrial(
        hasUsedTrial: true,
        startedAt: start,
        expiresAt: expires,
        now: start.add(const Duration(hours: 2)),
      );
      expect(day1.isActive, true);
      expect(day1.remainingDays, 14);

      // 3. Hari ke-14 (sisa kurang dari 24 jam tetap terhitung sisa 1 hari)
      final day14 = SubscriptionService.evaluateTrial(
        hasUsedTrial: true,
        startedAt: start,
        expiresAt: expires,
        now: expires.subtract(const Duration(hours: 6)),
      );
      expect(day14.isActive, true);
      expect(day14.remainingDays, 1);

      // 4. Setelah 14 hari lewat -> otomatis expired
      final day15 = SubscriptionService.evaluateTrial(
        hasUsedTrial: true,
        startedAt: start,
        expiresAt: expires,
        now: expires.add(const Duration(minutes: 1)),
      );
      expect(day15.isActive, false);
      expect(day15.isExpired, true);
      expect(day15.remainingDays, 0);
    });

    });

    test('AA. Hardening v3.3: Anti-Clock Tampering, AES-256-GCM .ksbak, Random Salted Auth & Audit Chain', () async {
      // 1. Anti-Clock Tampering
      final baseTime = DateTime(2026, 11, 26, 12, 0);
      final normalClock = SecurityGuardService.evaluateClockTamper(
        currentNow: baseTime,
        lastKnownEpochMs: baseTime.subtract(const Duration(minutes: 5)).millisecondsSinceEpoch,
      );
      expect(normalClock.isTampered, false);

      final rewoundClock = SecurityGuardService.evaluateClockTamper(
        currentNow: baseTime.subtract(const Duration(hours: 2)),
        lastKnownEpochMs: baseTime.millisecondsSinceEpoch,
      );
      expect(rewoundClock.isTampered, true);
      expect(rewoundClock.reason, 'CLOCK_REWIND');

      final networkDrift = SecurityGuardService.evaluateClockTamper(
        currentNow: baseTime.subtract(const Duration(days: 3)),
        lastKnownEpochMs: null,
        networkNow: baseTime,
      );
      expect(networkDrift.isTampered, true);
      expect(networkDrift.reason, 'NETWORK_DRIFT');

      // Monotonic check via mock SharedPreferences
      SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({});
      final mono1 = await SecurityGuardService.instance.checkAndAdvanceClock(
        nowOverride: baseTime,
      );
      expect(mono1.isTampered, false);
      final mono2 = await SecurityGuardService.instance.checkAndAdvanceClock(
        nowOverride: baseTime.subtract(const Duration(minutes: 30)),
      );
      expect(mono2.isTampered, true);

      // 2. Random 16-byte salted PIN & Account Password
      final pHash1 = AuthService.instance.hashPin('2580');
      final pHash2 = AuthService.instance.hashPin('2580');
      expect(pHash1, startsWith('v33:'));
      expect(pHash1 != pHash2, true);
      expect(AuthService.instance.verifyPinAgainstStored('2580', pHash1), true);
      expect(AuthService.instance.verifyPinAgainstStored('1111', pHash1), false);

      final accHash1 = AccountAuthService.hashPassword('bendahara', 'Rahasia123');
      final accHash2 = AccountAuthService.hashPassword('bendahara', 'Rahasia123');
      expect(accHash1, startsWith('v33:'));
      expect(accHash1 != accHash2, true);
      expect(
        AccountAuthService.verifyPasswordHash(
          usernameOrEmail: 'bendahara',
          password: 'Rahasia123',
          storedHash: accHash1,
        ),
        true,
      );

      // 3. AES-256-GCM .ksbak Backup & Restore Validation
      final sampleBackup = <String, dynamic>{
        'version': 33,
        'exported_at': baseTime.toIso8601String(),
        'santri': <dynamic>[],
        'setoran_bulanan': <dynamic>[],
        'transaksi_harian': <dynamic>[],
        'tunggakan_log': <dynamic>[],
        'mutasi_dompet': <dynamic>[],
        'cash_opname_logs': <dynamic>[],
        'pengaturan_aplikasi': <dynamic>[],
        'audit_log': <dynamic>[],
      };
      final encryptedKsbak = await BackupService.encryptBackupToKsbak(
        backupData: sampleBackup,
        password: 'PondokAman2026!',
      );
      expect(BackupService.isEncryptedKsbakBytes(encryptedKsbak), true);

      final wrongPwdRes = await BackupService.decryptAndValidateKsbak(
        bytes: encryptedKsbak,
        password: 'SalahPassword',
      );
      expect(wrongPwdRes.isValid, false);

      final okRes = await BackupService.decryptAndValidateKsbak(
        bytes: encryptedKsbak,
        password: 'PondokAman2026!',
      );
      expect(okRes.isValid, true);
      expect(okRes.parsedData?['version'], 33);

      // 4. Immutable Hash-Chained Audit Log (SQLite v4 FFI)
      sqfliteFfiInit();
      final db = await databaseFactoryFfi.openDatabase(
        inMemoryDatabasePath,
        options: OpenDatabaseOptions(version: 4),
      );
      await DatabaseHelper.instance.createSchemaForTesting(db);
      DatabaseHelper.instance.setDatabaseForTesting(db);

      await DatabaseHelper.instance.insertAuditLog(
        actor: 'Ustadz Ahmad',
        action: 'VOID_TRANSAKSI',
        targetId: 'tx-001',
        summary: 'Void salah nominal',
      );
      await DatabaseHelper.instance.insertAuditLog(
        actor: 'Ustadz Ahmad',
        action: 'EDIT_SANTRI',
        targetId: 's-001',
        summary: 'Ubah kamar ke A2',
      );
      await DatabaseHelper.instance.insertAuditLog(
        actor: 'Ustadz Ahmad',
        action: 'PRIVASI_LAYAR',
        summary: 'Aktifkan FLAG_SECURE',
      );

      final intact = await DatabaseHelper.instance.verifyAuditLogIntegrity();
      expect(intact.isValid, true);
      expect(intact.totalEntries, 3);
      final logs = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getAuditLogs();
      expect(logs.last.prevHash, AuditLogEntry.genesisHash);

      // Simulasi kecurangan pengubahan langsung isi tabel audit_log
      await db.execute(
        "UPDATE audit_log SET summary = 'Diubah diam-diam' WHERE action = 'VOID_TRANSAKSI'",
      );
      final tampered = await DatabaseHelper.instance.verifyAuditLogIntegrity();
      expect(tampered.isValid, false);

      await db.close();
      DatabaseHelper.instance.setDatabaseForTesting(null);
    });

    test('AB. CustomerSyncService v3.4: Privasi Payload, Semver, Remote Revoke & Mode Offline', () async {
      // 1. Verifikasi payload hanya berisi metadata lisensi non-sensitif (0 data santri/saldo)
      final payload = CustomerSyncService.buildTelemetryPayload(

      );

        'p_device_id',
        'p_nama_pondok',
        'p_nama_bendahara',
        'p_no_wa',
        'p_tier',
        'p_expiry_date',
        'p_app_version',
        'p_payment_channel',
      });
      expect(payload['p_device_id'], 'KS-ABCD1234');
      expect(payload['p_tier'], 'YEARLY');
      expect(payload['p_payment_channel'], 'DANA');

      // 2. Verifikasi perbandingan versi Semver
      expect(CustomerSyncService.compareSemver('3.5.0', '3.4.0'), 1);
      expect(CustomerSyncService.compareSemver('3.4.0', '3.4.0'), 0);
      expect(CustomerSyncService.compareSemver('3.3.9', '3.4.0'), -1);

      // 3. Mode offline / belum dikonfigurasi selalu gagal sunyi tanpa melempar error
      final unconfigured = await CustomerSyncService.instance.syncDeviceInBackground(
        deviceId: 'KS-ABCD1234',
        namaPondok: 'PP Al-Hikmah',
        namaBendahara: 'Ustadz Ahmad',
        noWaPengurus: '081234567890',
        tier: 'FREE',
        supabaseUrlOverride: '',
        supabaseAnonKeyOverride: '',
      );
      expect(unconfigured.synced, false);
      expect(unconfigured.isRevoked, false);

      // 4. Verifikasi MockClient menangani Remote Revoke + AppRemoteConfig
```
